description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: Streaming video preview in the DSH sidebar — mp4, webm and mov play in place over an authenticated byte-range route, with 206 responses, instant seeking, no size cap and no build step.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的流式视频预览：mp4、webm、mov 就地播放，走带鉴权的字节范围路由（206 响应），拖动秒开、没有大小上限、无构建步骤。

description.en: Password gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that also removes the 403 a reverse proxy causes, with revocable sessions, an admin page and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加密码登录，同时修掉反向代理导致的 403，带可吊销会话、管理页和零依赖。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: An always-on-top desktop pet (a washing machine) that renders session state as washing actions: four switchable skins, multi-session counters, and proactive done / stuck / approval alerts on macOS and Windows, plus a detail panel with recent turns and timings.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的桌宠（桌面宠物）：一台滚筒洗衣机，把会话状态渲染成洗衣动作，四套皮肤（精密家电 / 复古奶油 / 工笔重彩 / 太空舱）可切换，多会话计数、洗完 / 卡住 / 等你确认主动提醒；macOS 与 Windows 均可运行，详情面板可看最近几轮与耗时。

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
description.zh: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with ruby/amber/jade/gold tiers and a low-balance warning.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏账户余额快捷查看：显示余额、赠送额度、当前模型和官方高峰 / 空闲计费时段，按余额分四档显示质感，余额过低时提醒。

description.en: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.
description.zh: DSH Web 的双向语音：用统一输入框听写、用朗读按钮与自动朗读听回复，任意设备可用。需 DSH 0.1.7+、Node 22+、Python 3（含 numpy 与 requests）、TTS 模型与麦克风。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent 自主配置连接，并支持接近用户的操作语义、增量读取、引用保存以及远端会话与工作区搜索。

description.en: 🌌 Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin, it provides cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task-graph capabilities — so physical devices are no longer the boundary of your agents. Secure, controllable, and decentralized! The plugin attaches to an existing Mebular app or CLI runtime; when none exists, the panel installs the shared runtime on demand, and it never starts or downloads Mebular silently.
description.zh: 🌌 Mebular 忆云 · 智能体共享记忆与任务协作。通过 DSH 原生插件接入，提供跨设备、跨 Agent 记忆共享与任务图功能，让物理设备不再是你智能体的边界，安全、可控、去中心化！插件连接已有的 Mebular App/CLI 运行时；没有时可在面板里按提示安装共享运行时，不会静默启动或下载 Mebular。

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: Adds a collapsible, draggable minesweeper board to the conversation area, with adjustable rows, columns and mine count, and a first click that never lands on a mine.
description.zh: 在会话区左侧叠一块可折叠、可拖动的扫雷盘，行列与雷数都可调，第一次点击保证不踩雷。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek's official service status in the DSH session header, including overall and per-component status, uptime percentages, and active or recent incidents. A maintained fork of KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status (published as @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status since 0.1.6); do not install it alongside the original dsh-deepseek-status — both register the same /deepseek-status route and plugin row id.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，包括总体状态、各组件状态、可用率，以及进行中或最近的事件。这是 KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status 的维护分支（0.1.6 起以 @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status 发布）；不要与原版 dsh-deepseek-status 同时安装——两者会注册同一个 /deepseek-status 路由与同一条插件行 id。

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有 10 个模型工具、MCP 服务端、外部 API 与 CLI。摘要与巩固走你已配置的宿主模型；把嵌入换成本地模型后，语义检索可完全离线运行。

description.en: Single-owner cloud tasks for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): submit from local chat or either IM bot, run continuously in a native cloud worker, and follow overall progress and artifacts in one workbench. Task permissions are independent of IM; includes agreed delivery and session archive recovery.
description.zh: DSH 单用户云端任务（大肥鱼 bot）：从本地对话或双端 IM 机器人交办，云端原生持续执行，在工作台查看整体进展与成果并继续跟进。任务权限独立于 IM，支持约定交付及会话归档恢复。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a native fallback block that keeps the same servers loadable.
description.zh: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback 块，同一批服务器仍可加载。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart is refused while a plugin install is running. Restart is Windows only and returns 409 elsewhere; reload works on all platforms.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows. Theme gallery of eight minimalist themes, each defining one palette for light and one for dark and applied through a single theme-token layer, plus sidebar panel folding that collapses the rail rows into one Panels launcher with search and keyboard control, and reload/restart actions at the sidebar foot. Each feature is gated by runtime detection: what the current build cannot do is disabled with a stated reason, and an unknown probe stays enabled. The sidebar Reload/Restart buttons are ported from the separately listed MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart; uninstall that plugin before installing this one — with both, the sidebar foot shows two sets of buttons.
description.zh: 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加。包含 8 套极简主题的画廊（每套为浅色与深色各定义一组配色，通过单一主题变量层整套换色）、把侧栏面板行收成一个「面板」入口的收纳功能（点开是两列启动面板，带搜索与键盘操作），以及侧栏底部的刷新/重启按钮。 各项功能按当前运行环境自动判断：当前版本做不到的会置灰并写明原因，探测不出来则保持可用。侧栏的刷新/重启按钮从已收录的 MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart 移植而来，装本插件前请先卸载它；两者同装会在侧栏底部出现两套按钮。

description.en: Schedules a daily, weekly or monthly GitHub Trending digest, has a local trendradar core write Chinese summaries and period recaps, commits them to your own repo and opens the pull request, and shows an overview, digest, run history, subscription and settings workbench.
description.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月周期定时生成 GitHub 趋势日报，由本地 trendradar 核心写中文简介与周期总结、提交到你自己的仓库并开 PR，内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept for 7 days, and controls which agents can see each skill and whether the model may invoke it.
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: eleven specialist roles usable as one-shot consults or as team members, a team plane with a plan, a shared board and a dependency graph, a durable workmate library, a memory engine, and a verification plane that refuses a PASS unless a different agent records the verdict against gate evidence. Installs as one package with a dsh.bundle patch; also ships a native dshGo panel interface and a conformance gate pinned to a dsh-Go protocol v1 spec commit (d5ad25c).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件包：十一个专家角色，可作单次咨询或团队成员；团队平面带计划、共享看板与依赖图；另有可长期积累的 Workmate 库、记忆引擎，以及一个验证平面——除非由另一个 agent 带上 gate 证据记录裁决，否则拒绝 PASS。以单个包加 dsh.bundle 补丁安装，同时提供原生 dshGo 面板接口与钉在 dsh-Go 协议 v1 规范提交 d5ad25c 的一致性检查。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the Windows titlebar of the desktop app: a click opens a confirmation dialog that says how many sessions a restart would interrupt, and confirming quits and reopens the app.
description.zh: 给桌面端 Windows 标题栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下先弹出确认框（并说明有几个会话会被中断），确认后退出并重新打开应用。

description.en: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.
description.zh: 动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).
description.zh: 对话增强：历史输入浮层（Alt+↑，workspace/session/global/prompts 四范围搜索回填）、未应用插话撤回、对话分叉与家族版本切换、分叉后自动重发（默认关）。

description.en: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.
description.zh: 定时任务看板：cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务（每次新建/固定会话），环境变量集中管理，执行日志与并发/超时控制。

description.en: Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.
description.zh: LLM 网关会话粘性路由：把会话 sessionId 注入发往 NewApi 类网关的每个请求，供网关做请求亲和以提升 prompt cache 命中，装上即接管官方 pi-ai 路由，卸载即还原。

description.en: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.
description.zh: DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。

description.en: Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.
description.zh: 会话管理：超期会话自动归档（阈值可配），归档面板支持取消归档，删除移入系统回收站可还原。

description.en: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.
description.zh: 设置导航分区图标：把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形，并为插件市场卡片头像槽提供插件图标，卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。

description.en: Shared interactive terminal: the AI terminal tool and the official sidebar xterm drive the same session shell, so you can type and watch the live screen.
description.zh: 共享交互式终端：AI terminal 单工具与官方侧栏 xterm 共用 Session shell，用户可输入并查看当前屏幕。

description.en: Windows shell takeover: replace the default pwsh tool with a configurable multi-client shell tool (git bash, WSL, cmd, pwsh, custom paths), with a deny blacklist and automatic fallback.
description.zh: Windows shell 接管：把默认 pwsh 工具替换为可配置多客户端 shell 工具（git bash/WSL/cmd/pwsh、自定义路径），deny 黑名单与失败自动回退官方链。

description.en: Stock workspace for eight markets: watchlists with groups and price marks, quotes, K-line charts and a floating ticker; default data source needs no account. Needs @mzzsfy/dsh-session-manager installed (it loads the shared client library).
description.zh: 股票工作台:八市场自选(分组/置顶/价格标记)、行情、K 线图与悬浮盯盘;默认数据源免注册,页面状态不随会话切换销毁。需同时安装 @mzzsfy/dsh-session-manager(代挂公共 client 依赖)。

description.en: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.
description.zh: 流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。

description.en: Deferred tool loading gate: inject allowlisted tools in full, mark the rest for the host deferred-loading chain, and expose them as searchable placeholders with a settings card.
description.zh: 全局层工具白名单延迟加载：白名单内工具全量注入，其余交宿主按需加载链以 tool_search 检索激活，设置卡可视配置。

description.en: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.
description.zh: 回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。

description.en: Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.
description.zh: 会话用量统计面板：天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、活跃热力图、会话底栏信息接管与回合费用芯片、多条件分时段定价费用估算；复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。

description.en: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.
description.zh: 多平台 LLM 账号余额与额度面板：配置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、NewApi 或自定义端点，定时自动查询并绘制趋势图，余额/额度阈值与窗口重置经多通道推送通知。

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: Adds an Auto permission preset between Workspace Write and Full access: routine work stays in the official workspace-write sandbox while the current session model reviews escalation and destructive calls, granting one exact wider access once, asking when the intent is ambiguous, and denying critical paths.
description.zh: 在 Workspace Write 与 Full access 之间增加 Auto 权限档：日常操作留在官方 workspace-write 沙箱内，由当前会话模型复核升权与破坏性调用，精确的越界访问按次放行一次，意图不明时询问，命中关键路径则拒绝。

description.en: Native Anki workspace backed by one real headless Anki collection: browse, edit, add and review notes, suspend cards, import and export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb, with the same collection exposed to the anki AI tool. No Anki desktop app, AnkiConnect or Qt is started. Supports Windows x64 and macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel). The matching headless Anki core, CPython and all Python runtime dependencies are bundled, so no separate Anki or Python installation is required.
description.zh: 原生 Anki 工作区，由真实的独立无界面 Anki 牌库驱动：浏览、编辑、添加与复习笔记，暂停卡片，导入导出 APKG，并与 AnkiWeb 同步；同一牌库同时提供给 anki AI 工具。不启动 Anki 桌面程序，也不依赖 AnkiConnect 或 Qt。支持 Windows x64 和 macOS 12 及以上版本（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）。已内置匹配的无界面 Anki 核心、CPython 与全部 Python 运行依赖，无需另外安装 Anki 或 Python。

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署变成去中心化 agent 网络中的一个节点——签名 agent 卡片、peer 与 zone 发现、直连消息路由模型工具，以及 Web 侧栏可加入的会话节点。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

description.en: Ecommerce research for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth into the Nexscope MCP server, marketplace data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Shopee, Temu and 1688, plus a bundled nexscope skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的电商研究插件：OAuth 接入 Nexscope MCP，覆盖亚马逊、TikTok Shop、沃尔玛、Shopee、Temu 与 1688 等市场数据，并捆绑 nexscope 技能。

description.en: Draws draw.io diagrams in DeepSeek Harness through the next-ai-drawio MCP server: the link in the reply opens a live preview in the right sidebar, you can edit the diagram by hand, and each AI change is a version you can restore. Node.js 18+; npx downloads the MCP server on first use.
description.zh: dsh 的 draw.io 绘图插件：通过 next-ai-drawio MCP 服务器作图，点回复里的链接在右侧栏打开实时预览，可以手动修改图，AI 的每次修改都是可以恢复的版本。需 Node.js 18+，首次使用由 npx 下载 MCP 服务器。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」：按轮次建立文件检查点，回滚工作区文件并在同一 session id 下原位截断模型上下文，已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2。新增 /rollback doctor 契约自检、按当前磁盘状态实时计算的受影响文件 diff 预览（重启后依然准确）、一键「回退最近一轮」（快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Z）、「回退后隐藏已回退消息」开关，以及英文界面文案。

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

description.en: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs offline in demo mode with placeholder media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的节点式创作工作室——在无限画布上完成剧本、分镜、参考图与多镜头视频生成，可由对话批量驱动；图像/视频/TTS 需自带服务商（OpenAI 风格接口，或 Seedance/Sora 风格视频 API），未配置时整条流水线以离线演示模式运行、只产出占位素材。

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

description.en: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

description.en: DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.
description.zh: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线；让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数，支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）；联网设备模拟器可向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实"智能选座"系统全链路验证）；还可只读观察真机状态，并用数据驱动的型号定义支持新硬件。随插件带 16 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。

description.en: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot CLI、Kiro、CodeBuddy、Continue）以及 DeepSeek Harness 自身，按声明它的文件分组展示，对每个服务器做一次真连 JSON-RPC 探活，看它能否启动、暴露了哪些工具，并给每个服务器一个开关，把它挂载进或卸载出 DeepSeek Harness —— 全程不改动其他工具自己的配置文件。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

description.en: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
description.zh: 通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。

description.en: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
description.zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
description.zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi 和流量下都能扫：打开手机访问时顺带开 Cloudflare 免费快速隧道（没有 cloudflared 会从 Cloudflare 官方 GitHub 发布页下载），DSH 重启后地址不变，手机不用重扫。配对码一次性、10 分钟过期，每台手机一张凭证、可随时移除，顶栏按钮显示手机是否已连接，空闲连接自动保活。可选推送到手机：任务跑完（30 秒以上）、出错停下、等批准或等回答时，发到 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉群机器人、Telegram 或任意 Webhook；通知只带会话标题和状态，批准仍在 DSH 里点。手机上网页界面的左右两栏改成盖在页面上，可以带图标添加到主屏幕。

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range 流式传输，长视频能拖进度条、不会整个读进内存。同时注册了侧边栏媒体预览渲染器——内置预览器把 mp4 当作不可预览。look_video 工具让模型自己看视频：在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按时间截帧，拼成一张每格标时间的图交给模型（也能看某几刻的大图、逐帧看一小段），顺便量声音（没声、太小、爆音、只有一边声道）、找黑屏和卡住的画面，并读 mp4 / mov 文件头查手机上能不能放（编码、HDR、文件头位置等），附 ffmpeg 改法。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API acceptance does not confirm receipt.
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench with saved history and feedback.
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Personal assistant for projects, conversations, memory, reviews and news. Bundled WeChat pins the QR-confirmed account; first messages cannot claim ownership. An optional allowlist further restricts access. Missing or conflicting identity requires desktop recovery. API acceptance is not phone receipt.
description.zh: 个人助理：在授权范围内整理项目，衔接原生对话、记忆、回顾与资讯。单包内置微信，扫码确认账号为唯一操作者，陌生人先发消息不能认领；白名单可进一步限制，身份缺失或冲突会暂停并提示在电脑恢复。接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the Xunlei engine needs its own SDK and API key. Built mainly for Windows.
description.zh: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。

description.en: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; the port card works on Windows only and the GPU card needs nvidia-smi.
description.zh: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量的卡片，可放大到整页；端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

description.en: Workbench shell: a fixed top bar (account, balance, Restart DSH button) with a second row of page tabs, plus a small module API for full-page plugins. Does nothing without a module; Restart DSH exits the web host and only works where a Windows scheduled task named philomel-dsh-web relaunches it.
description.zh: 工作台外壳：固定顶栏（账号、余额、「重启 DSH」按钮）加第二行页面标签，外加一套给整页插件用的模块 API。没有模块时不起作用；「重启 DSH」会退出 Web 宿主进程，仅在存在名为 philomel-dsh-web 的 Windows 计划任务来重新拉起时才有效。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka and other booking sites, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key), plus a travel-search skill. In the Web UI the results show as cards: hotel photo, rating, stay total and one linked price per site; flights with times, stops and each site's fare. Search details are sent to mcp.price.win.
description.zh: 通过远程 PriceWin MCP 服务器（无需账号或 API key）实时比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com、Traveloka 等预订网站的酒店与机票价格，并附带旅行搜索 skill。在 Web 界面中结果以卡片呈现：酒店照片、评分、整段住宿总价及各网站带链接的价格；航班显示起降时间、经停与各网站票价。搜索条件会发送到 mcp.price.win。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图与生视频插件：文生图/图生图按渠道配置模型目录，并按模型族适配请求协议（gpt-image、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana、Seedream、GLM-Image、Qwen-Image、MiniMax image-01、DALL-E 3），提供侧边栏生图工作台、带节点工作流的无限画布、文件预览与画布技能，以及提示词模板库；生视频侧含文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧与多参考图模式，走异步提交/轮询/下载链路，另有宿主侧视频工具、画布视频节点，并可用本机 ffmpeg 把两个以上视频节点拼接成一个 MP4。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu — the full panel inventory (pinned and unpinned, unpinned open via temporary-pin peek), collapsible group memory, in-menu search with hit highlighting and keyboard navigation, Alt+1..9 direct activation of the Nth visible item, and hover pin/top quick-actions. A Ctrl+K command palette mirrors the inventory with quick commands, a Recent group of last-used panels (MRU, persisted), and named layout presets — save your whole arrangement (pins, top pins, folds, whitelist, icon-only, compact footer) and re-apply it in one click. v1.0.0 adds custom panel groups: define your own groups (inline rename, member picker in Settings) and they render as first-class groups with accurate counts in the menu and palette. Plus a keyboard-reachable right-click context menu, icon-only panel rows, top-pinning with drag-to-reorder, a compact footer with granular sub-toggles, and a Settings page with height sliders, a locale-safe whitelist, pin management, and settings export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行（含未钉住的，未钉面板临时打开后还原）与第三方插件入口收进一个可搜索的分组「面板」菜单——分组折叠记忆、菜单内搜索带命中高亮与全键盘导航、Alt+1..9 直达第 N 个可见项、悬停钉住/置顶快捷操作。Ctrl+K 命令面板镜像同一清单，附带快捷命令、「最近使用」组（MRU 持久化）与具名布局预设——把整套排布（钉住、置顶、折叠、白名单、仅图标、紧凑底部区）存成预设一键套用。v1.0.0 新增自定义分组：在设置页建组、行内改名、挑选成员，菜单与命令面板中作为一等分组渲染且计数准确。右键上下文菜单（键盘可达）、面板行仅图标、置顶拖拽排序、紧凑底部区细分开关，设置页提供高度滑块、语言切换安全的白名单、钉住管理与配置导出/导入。

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: Desktop pet companion for DSH with live task HUD, token and cost stats, balance and peak-hour alerts, reasoning-effort control, current and history conversation search, and session management.
description.zh: DSH 桌面伴侣：任务实时 HUD、Token 与费用统计、余额与峰谷提醒、推理等级切换、当前与历史对话搜索、会话管理。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: Tracks online, active and task time in DSH, with a day/week/month dashboard, per-workspace and per-session breakdowns, and a read-only `timespan_stats` tool for agents.
description.zh: 记录 DSH 的在线、活跃与任务三种时长，提供日/周/月仪表盘、按工作区与会话的明细，以及供 Agent 查询的只读 `timespan_stats` 工具。

description.en: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语：整个界面，加上 520 个第三方插件的菜单——584 个分区、67 666 条文案。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 让开发，有趣一点。为 DeepSeek Harness 添一层恰到好处的动效，支持效果调整并跟随系统「减少动态效果」。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

description.en: Password-protected LAN gateway for DeepSeek Harness, letting a phone browser on the same Wi-Fi drive the desktop DSH; DSH's own files are untouched, but a small compatibility polyfill is injected into the pages served to the phone. Plain HTTP, trusted LAN only.
description.zh: 带密码的 DSH 局域网网关，手机连同一个 WiFi 就能用浏览器打开电脑上的 DSH；不改 DSH 自身文件，但会向发给手机的页面注入一小段兼容 polyfill。明文 HTTP，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its normalized license and a use verdict for the intended use; refkit_rights re-checks one license against another use. Source keys and search tuning live on a settings page. 11 of the 24 sources need API keys; the use verdict is returned only when an intended use is passed. Runs on DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要 API key；仅在传入用途时返回可用性判定。支持 DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2（实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

description.en: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.en: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：把网页任务交给它——打开页面、点击、输入、填表、读取页面内容——它会驱动真实浏览器一步步完成，每步只看到“当前页面能做什么”的索引表，而不是原始 HTML 或截图。每步由内置 Jev 引擎决策一次，而非大模型整轮推理（仓库基准中每步决策中位 1.1 秒，大模型整轮 2.8–3.6 秒）；主对话只收到结论，上下文不随页面变长。目标取自它刚读到的页面，页面变化就重新读取而非盲点；每个会话用自己的浏览器，不碰你日常的 Chrome（除非切到 attach 模式）。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: Adds a Print action next to Copy that opens a preview and prints the assistant message.
description.zh: 在复制按钮旁增加打印操作，预览后调用系统打印助手消息。

description.en: Project-level usage hub for DSH: per-project token, time and cost, with half-hour swimlanes, 26-week activity heatmaps and provider balance alerts; unpriceable usage is flagged rather than estimated.
description.zh: DSH 项目级全局用量中心：按项目统计 Token、工时与费用，支持半小时节奏泳道、26 周全局热力图与多 Provider 余额预警；无法确认计价的部分会标注而非估算。

description.en: GitHub Trending radar inside the Harness Web UI: fetches the daily, weekly or monthly board (optionally filtered by a language), analyzes each repository into description, star gain, tech stack, highlights and risks, renders the result as a filterable card panel with paging, and registers the github_trending tool plus the /github-trending command.
description.zh: Harness Web UI 里的 GitHub 趋势雷达：抓取日榜/周榜/月榜（可按编程语言筛选），把每个仓库分析成简介、star 增量、技术栈、亮点与风险，渲染为可筛选、可分页的卡片面板，并注册 github_trending 工具与 /github-trending 命令。

description.en: Keep your automation tasks in files you can version and review: write each task's schedule, prompt, model, permission and working folder in YAML, JSON or JS, and DSH's own Schedule is kept exactly in line, creating, updating, disabling and deleting tasks within a second of a save. Each task runs in its own conversation, persistent or fresh per run; /automations syncs on demand and names any file mistake; and a sync that finds no tasks never wipes the Schedule.
description.zh: 把自动化任务放进可以版本管理、可以审阅的文件里：用 YAML、JSON 或 JS 写下每个任务的计划、提示词、模型、权限和工作目录，DSH 自带的 Schedule 会与文件保持完全一致，保存后一秒内完成创建、更新、停用和删除。每个任务在自己的会话中运行，可持续复用或每次新开；/automations 可随时同步并指出出错的文件；若同步时一个任务也没找到，绝不会清空 Schedule。

description.en: Keep a multi-PR effort on one board you can trust at a glance: the hub agent keeps a tree of steps, each linked to its issue, PR, branch and worktree, through four board tools, and you see what is done, what is blocked and what needs you in a right-sidebar Board tab and a progress strip above the composer. Each board is one plain JSON file your scripts can read, and an optional drift command you configure flags steps whose status no longer matches their work.
description.zh: 把跨多个 PR 的工作放进一块一眼就能看清的看板：中枢 Agent 通过四个看板工具维护一棵步骤树，每步关联 issue、PR、分支与 worktree；右侧栏 Board 标签页和输入框上方的进度条告诉你哪些已完成、哪些被阻塞、哪些在等你处理。每个看板就是一个你的脚本也能读的 JSON 文件；可选的、由你配置的漂移检查命令会标出状态与实际进展不再一致的步骤。

description.en: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.
