description.zh: 找回打了字却没发送就离开的内容：未发送就离开的新 Web 对话不会出现在侧栏，里面的草稿也就找不到了。本插件在下一个新对话的输入框上方按时间倒序列出这些草稿，并显示所属工作区与时间；「打开」带你回到原对话，文字和引用条原样还在；「丢弃」可撤销地删除草稿。

description.en: Show the model exactly which part you mean: select passages in a Web conversation and they go into your next message as composer chips, each with an optional note you can edit. Quoted passages stay highlighted until you send, hovering a chip shows the full quote, and the sent message shows each quote as a card.
description.zh: 让模型准确知道你指的是哪一段：在 Web 对话中选中段落，它们会作为引用条进入下一条消息，每条可附可编辑的备注。被引用的段落在发送前保持高亮，悬停引用条显示全文，发送后的消息把每条引用显示为卡片。

description.en: Ask about one sentence without derailing the chat: select a passage in a Web conversation, comment, and the session's own model answers in a small thread beside it while the main chat stays untouched. The replier can read the session, the working directory and, if you turn it on, the web, but changes nothing. Commented passages stay highlighted with a badge that shows unread replies, and Send to chat hands a thread to the agent when you want it acted on.
description.zh: 针对一句话提问，不打断主对话：在 Web 对话中选中一段文字发表评论，会话自己的模型在旁边的小线程里作答，主对话不受影响。回复者可以读取会话、工作目录，开启后也可联网，但不做任何修改。被评论的段落保持高亮，徽标提示未读回复；需要 Agent 动手时，「发送到对话」把线程交给它。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Creates a throwaway workspace with its own folder and session, manages running ones from a sidebar panel, and moves finished folders to the system Trash.
description.zh: 一键创建一次性临时工作区（独立文件夹、独立工作区与会话），在侧边栏统一管理，用完把文件夹移入系统废纸篓。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: ClickHouse query tools for DSH, targeting ClickHouse alone: seven tools that list databases, tables and columns, sample rows, search columns by name, show EXPLAIN plans, and run single read-only SQL statements behind a client-side guard that rejects writes, multi-statement SQL, cross-table queries and external table functions. Single-table by default: the query parameter is used as given, with no built-in multi-step business flow. Zero runtime dependencies; it tells the model to backtick non-ASCII aliases instead of failing with a bare syntax error on older servers. With no configuration it connects to http://10.0.0.34:8123 as user default (database default); set url or host/port to point it at your own server.
description.zh: DSH 的 ClickHouse 数据问答工具：七个工具负责列库表字段、抽样、按字段名反查、看 EXPLAIN 计划，以及执行带客户端只读护栏的单条 SQL（拒绝写操作、多语句、跨表查询与外部表函数）。默认单表查询：用户给什么参数就用什么参数，不内置任何多步业务流程。零运行时依赖；遇到老版本服务器会提示中文别名要加反引号，而不是只报一个语法错误。不做任何配置时，它默认连接 http://10.0.0.34:8123（用户 default、库 default）；用 url 或 host/port 指向你自己的服务器。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop host on macOS when a change needs it, then hands the conversation back to the same session with a note the model writes about why it restarted and what comes next.
description.zh: 改动需要重启时自动重启 DSH 桌面宿主（仅 macOS），重启后把模型写的交接话（为什么重启、下一步做什么）投回原会话继续。

description.en: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：对插件源码做静态与语义双通道检查，内置 DSH 特有攻击面规则，集成 npm audit，支持批量扫描，输出带严重等级与证据的 HTML 报告。

description.en: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

description.en: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Read-only dashboard for token usage, cost, request speed, and first-token latency across local DSH sessions.
description.zh: 只读看板，汇总本机 DSH 会话的 Token 用量、费用、请求速度与首字耗时。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: DSH host bundle for the ShyPie privacy-first workflow: extracts attached images and PDF/Office files locally before they enter the session log (requires poppler pdftotext/pdftoppm on PATH and a local OCR engine — Windows OCR on Windows, optionally tesseract; without them attachments are rejected, not forwarded); default filter mode keeps text local (optional local masking); blocks unmaskable media/BLOB; provides local privacy_extract, privacy_ocr, privacy_scan and privacy_rehydrate tools; denies read_image and binary/document reads outside allowPaths; and enforces a fail-closed llm/stream egress guard before DSH dispatches a model request (the default provider allowlist is the local Magpie gateway).
description.zh: 面向 ShyPie 隐私优先工作流的 DSH 主机插件：在写入会话日志前本地提取附件图片及 PDF/Office 文件（需 PATH 中有 poppler 的 pdftotext/pdftoppm 和本地 OCR 引擎，Windows 用系统 OCR、可选 tesseract；缺少时附件会被拒绝而不是转发）；默认 filter 模式保留本地文本（可选用本地掩码）；阻断无法掩码的媒体/BLOB；提供本地 privacy_extract、privacy_ocr、privacy_scan、privacy_rehydrate 工具；拒绝 read_image 及 allowPaths 之外的二进制/文档读取；并在 DSH 发出模型请求前执行失败关闭的 llm/stream 出口检查（默认只放行本地 Magpie 网关）。

description.en: Beyond the built-in @: line ranges (@src/a.ts:12-40), skills, plugins and any git repo — with the token cost of each reference shown before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 @ 引用之上扩展：精确到行的行区间（@src/a.ts:12-40）、Skill、插件与任意 git 仓库，并在发送前显示每条引用的 token 成本。

description.en: Enhances native DSH subagents and teams with persistent subagents, improved subagent messaging, and per-member model selection for teams. Adds no extra tools or context beyond the native features.
description.zh: DSH原生子代理和团队增强。提供持久子代理功能，及子代理消息增强。额外支持指定团队成员模型。与原生功能相比，无附加工具及上下文。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: Layered memory for AI agents: five verbs (wake/work/pit/tomb/close), core layer read every time, archive on demand. Plain markdown, four pages created on first run; survives restarts, model swaps and plugin removal.
description.zh: 守链：给 AI agent 的分层记忆——五个动词（醒来/干活/遇坑/立碑/收工），核心层每次读、档案层按需查；首次运行自动建四页，纯 markdown、无数据库；重启、换模型、拔插件后记忆还在、判断还接得上。

description.en: DeepSeek web search with its own API key: a left-sidebar search page and a deepseek_search tool that every model in the profile can call, falling back to the DeepSeek key already configured for the model provider. It registers its own tool and routes instead of replacing the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers, so an existing search setup keeps working.
description.zh: 使用独立 DeepSeek API Key 的网页搜索：左侧栏搜索页，外加一个配置内任意模型都能调用的 deepseek_search 工具；未配独立 Key 时自动复用模型列表里已配好的 DeepSeek Key。它注册自己的工具与路由、不接管内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，因此不会打断已有的搜索配置。

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

description.en: Adds an auto-hiding icon rail to the collapsed macOS Desktop sidebar, with workspace pinning and flyouts for recent sessions, scheduled tasks, user-installed plugins and account information.
description.zh: 为 macOS Desktop 折叠侧栏添加自动隐藏的图标轨，支持工作区置顶，以及最近会话、定时任务、用户安装插件和账号信息浮层。

description.en: Dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots the live Cordis plugin/service topology into a zoomable browser panel with graph-theory metrics, plus a graph.render tool for the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

description.en: In DSH Desktop, see the tokens, cost and speed of every request, compare spending by model and provider, merge different names for the same model, check balances and compare real model performance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端看清每一次请求的 Token、费用与速度，按模型和供应商汇总花费，统一同一模型的不同名称，核对余额并比较模型实际表现。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.
description.zh: 把托管的 SpecStream MCP 服务器注册到 harness 的 MCP 管理器，并把 API Key 存入凭据库。该服务器以结构化行返回实时网页数据，每个值都附来源 URL；只有报价上限获批后才会开始运行。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ。支持 OneBot 11/12、Satori、Milky 与 QQ 官方机器人接口，群聊和私聊各有一条独立会话；内置九个工具：群管理、聊天记录与图片理解、联网搜索、网页抓取、图片反搜、生图等，另有按间隔自主接话的主动发言（判断与发言可分用两个模型）。模型、代理、白名单等全部在 DSH 设置页里配置，不需要改代码。首次使用必须先填拥有者 auth.owners：留空时插件不驱动任何会话（默认拒绝，避免装机即对外开放）；填好后私聊与群聊立即可用，访客只能使用访客工具白名单，qqbot 与 qqconfig 仅限拥有者。

description.en: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在DSH里养一只大肥鱼宠物，你可以陪伴她长大。养成系体验，没有人格设置，通过你和她的互动学习成长。她可以自己刷B站，写日记，提取信息去问你，你的反馈决定了她成为什么样的人。通过事件流突破四个阶段、三道瓶颈，去积累「立场清单」，四个阶段完成后才会开始有立场。她的日记默认只给自己看，你在设置里打开就能读。事件流不能删除记录，是唯一可信源。没有任何运行时依赖。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).
description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶·组合补丁：与 18 个组件插件配套，一条命令统一注入默认配置（办公流/媒体工坊/DevOps/通知/预设）；组件经一行 add 命令直装（扁平化设计，无 git 子依赖）。

description.en: General-purpose chat agent on a parent agent + worker sub-agent split, for DSH Desktop only: a sidebar row opens each assistant's long-running conversation, where the parent chats, records schedule, lists, memos, logs, profile, persona and projects as plain files in that assistant's workspace folder, and hands other work to background workers through the bundled complete-subagent, picking each worker's model from the ones you enable and approving their write access. A heartbeat wakes it for reminders, a daily brief and wake-ups it sets itself, and holds back during quiet hours. Through the bundled im-robot it chats over WeChat: the model decides per reply with im_route whether the reply also goes to WeChat, and images and files sent from WeChat appear in the conversation and stay in the workspace's IM/WeChat folder for a set number of days. Its tools never appear in normal sessions.
description.zh: 基于母 agent + worker 子代理架构的通用对话 agent，仅支持 DSH Desktop：侧栏入口直达每个助理的长期对话，母 agent 负责聊天，把日程、清单、备忘、流水、画像、人设和项目以纯文本文件记在该助理的工作区文件夹里，其余工作通过内置的 complete-subagent 交给后台 worker，从你勾选的模型里为每个 worker 选模型，并审批它们的写权限。心跳按时叫醒它处理提醒、每日早报和它自己设的唤醒，勿扰时段内不打扰。通过内置的 im-robot 接入微信：每条回复由模型用 im_route 决定是否同时发到微信，微信发来的图片和文件显示在对话里，并在工作区的 IM/WeChat 文件夹里保留可设置的天数。它的工具不会出现在普通会话里。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
description.zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: A defensive agentic coding workflow for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ featuring deterministic machine testing, an independent reviewer and a human merge gate.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ 的防御性智能体编程工作流：包含确定性机器测试、独立审查者与人类终审闸门。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: HuanJing Stock Board - a pure "slacking-off" stock watcher: read-only delayed quotes for A-shares, HK and US, a flat dot-matrix LED exchange hall, watchlists, candlestick charts, news, financials and price alerts. For market analysis and trading use professional software - professionals do professional things; this is just a simple way for retail investors to glance at their own stocks.
description.zh: 寰镜股票看板：纯粹的摸鱼看股票插件——A股/港股/美股只读延迟行情、平面 LED 灯阵证券大厅、自选、K 线、股市资讯、财报与价格提醒。行情分析和交易请用专业软件，专业的人做专业的事；它就是给散户方便看看自己股票情况的插件，极致简单。

description.en: Suiji (随记) is a local-first notebook plugin for DeepSeek Harness: quick capture, AI filing, diary, todos, sticky notes, and MCP access for AI sessions.
description.zh: 随记：DSH 本地笔记插件，随手记录、AI 自动归档、日记、待办、便笺，并支持 MCP 让 AI 会话直接读写。

description.en: Suiji Word Book: a word book panel that shows one word per page with picture, phonetics, pronunciation, five phrases and an example sentence, plus fill-in-the-letters spelling practice and a 12-type word-recognition quiz. Word data is kept as plain files in a local directory, and an included skill lets an AI add cards from a word list. The “+Word” button (hidden until enabled in Settings) starts an AI session and by default switches it to danger-full-access; turn that off in Settings.
description.zh: 随记单词本：一个词一页，插图、音标、发音、五条词组和例句，外加挖字母拼写练习与 12 种题型的单词辨析；词库以普通文件保存在本地目录，附带技能可让 AI 按词表批量建卡。「+单词」按钮（默认隐藏，需在设置里开启）会新建 AI 会话并默认把它切到 danger-full-access，可在设置里关闭。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
description.zh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

description.en: Provider quota and balance status widget for the DSH web UI, showing remaining quota, usage and rate-limit windows in a dock at the bottom of the composer. Local fork of wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 端的供应商额度与余额状态小组件，在输入框底部的停靠区展示剩余额度、用量与限流窗口。wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel 的本地分叉。

description.en: Manage Codex subscription (ChatGPT OAuth) authorization from the DSH settings panel, so Codex GPT models work without an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理 Codex 订阅（ChatGPT OAuth）授权，无需 API key 即可使用 Codex 内的 GPT 模型。

description.en: Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.
description.zh: DSH 输入框历史记录切换器：本地保存每条已提交的提示词（含附件，最多 50 条），空输入框时用上下方向键召回，并自动恢复文件引用与图片预览。

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
description.zh: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

description.en: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加动画桌面伙伴，支持任务提醒、会话聊天、角色包和原生设置。

description.en: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.en: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
description.zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: Model-linked characters and a shared world for DSH, with separate editable personas and memories, optional AI diaries and sleep consolidation, Chinese/English controls, task-aware desktop pets, themes and usage statistics; updates preserve user customizations. Supports Windows, Linux and macOS; see the guide for each system's installation requirements. Diaries and consolidation consume tokens. Before installing or updating, we recommend closing visible desktop pets and bubbles; open files may cause installation to fail. Codex and OpenAI API account queries have been user-validated; other sources await user validation and feedback.
description.zh: DSH 模型联动角色与共享世界，支持独立可编辑人设和记忆、可选 AI 日记与睡眠整理、中英文界面、任务联动桌宠、主题和用量统计，更新保留用户自定义。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，各系统安装要求见使用说明。日记和整理消耗 Token。安装或更新前，建议先关闭桌面上已显示的桌宠和提示气泡；未关闭时，文件占用有可能导致安装失败。Codex 与 OpenAI API 已获用户验证；其他来源待用户验证反馈。

description.en: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with encrypted browser-session import, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入与加密保存、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

description.en: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.
description.zh: 把 Meta 的 Muse Code 订阅接入为 DSH 模型提供方，在设置中声明 Meta 路由、同步账号聊天模型目录到模型选择器，并提供登录卡片与 /muse-login 设备码登录、凭据自动续期与红绿点。需有效 Muse Code 订阅，无需 Meta CLI。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入 DeepSeek 聊天入口，主内容区全宽内嵌 chat.deepseek.com（仅桌面版），恢复上次会话，并把内嵌页崩溃限制在面板内。

description.en: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools and a Skill for md-report/1: validate and render Markdown plus declared SQLite/CSV datasets into one offline interactive HTML report or dashboard, with AntV G2 charts (ECharts fallback) and chart/table data and source-SQL views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 md-report/1 报告的校验与渲染工具：把 Markdown 与声明的 SQLite/CSV 数据集生成单个离线可交互 HTML 报告或仪表盘，图表默认用 AntV G2、复杂图表回退 ECharts，并提供图表/数据/SQL 与数据表/数据/SQL 视图。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
description.zh: Qwen 媒体工具：通过阿里云百炼提供多模态视频音频理解、带预置音色的语音合成，以及场景音频生成。

description.en: RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows as a background task pool: submit a batch, and a watcher dispatches it within a concurrency budget, polls each job, downloads every output to disk, and wakes the session when the pool drains. A shared ledger records batches, costs, instance tiers, submit and finish times, and per-file save paths, with a live board in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流当作后台任务池来跑：提交一批任务后，watcher 按并发上限自动派发、逐轮询每个任务、把产物全部下载到本地，池子排空时唤醒会话。共享台账记录批次、费用、实例规格、发起与完成时间以及每个文件的保存位置，右侧边栏有实时看板。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclusion of exhausted accounts, and per-request timeouts plus same-platform retry control failover granularity. Web fetching runs local HTTP first, then falls back to TinyFish Fetch server-side rendering and Tavily Extract, so pages still load when local egress is blocked by proxy or DNS policies. A per-platform panel shows key usage and plan limits. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供多来源网页搜索与抓取故障转移：接管会话的 searchProvider 与 fetchProvider 接缝，按可配置顺序尝试已配置来源——TinyFish、Tavily 与官方搜索，官方固定参与兜底、位置可调但不可移除。每平台可配多个 key 轮转分摊，基于用量快照做请求前账号排除，单请求超时与同平台重试控制转移粒度。网页抓取本地 HTTP 优先，失败后依次兜底 TinyFish Fetch 服务端渲染与 Tavily Extract，本机网络受限时代理或 DNS 拦不住页面抓取。插件页按平台展示各账号用量与套餐额度。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become available to Midscene agents while credentials stay inside the provider plugins and the bridge never touches them. A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.
description.zh: 让 Midscene 直接用 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的模型，不再需要第三方模型 API Key：在 127.0.0.1 托管一个 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务（默认端口 8787，被占用时自动跳号），把流式与非流式的对话补全代理到 DSH 宿主模型层，DeepSeek 官方路由、CodeBuddy、Codex 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 端点对 Midscene 全部可用；凭据留在各提供方插件内，桥不接触。`/v1/midscene-env` 端点直接生成四行 MIDSCENE_MODEL_* 环境变量并自动推断模型家族；浏览器、桌面、Android、iOS、鸿蒙自动化加 Vitest E2E 与 Midscene 知识参考共 7 个内置技能随装随用，无需 `npx skills add`。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`。

description.en: Component checklist for the shared Semi Design package used by tnnevol DSH plugins, opened from a `Semi UI` button in a conversation header: 35 components plus a multi-account case page, organised into seven sidebar groups from inputs, forms, selectors and trees to tables, cards, overlays and feedback, each rendered live with a one-line description and a page outline, with light, dark and follow-system preview. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`.
description.zh: tnnevol 系列 DSH 插件共用的 Semi Design 组件检查页，从会话头部的 `Semi UI` 按钮进入：35 个组件加一个多账号案例页，按七个侧边分组组织，涵盖输入、表单、选择器、树、表格、卡片、浮层与反馈，逐个实渲并配一句话说明与页内目录，可切换浅色、深色与跟随系统预览。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`。

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.
description.zh: 基于 pi-tui 的 DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端客户端：会话回放/续接、流式响应、可折叠工具卡片、终端内审批与提问、模型/预设/权限/计划/目标管理、Shell 模式，以及轨迹（trajectory）事件台账。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: Generate validated, self-contained interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from repositories or system descriptions.
description.zh: 从仓库或系统描述生成经过校验的自包含交互式架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图和生命周期图。

description.en: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
description.zh: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

description.en: Xray-core supervisor and router for DSH with VLESS import, global/China-direct/whitelist routing, a three-card live panel, and self-update.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Xray 受管内核与分流：VLESS 导入、全局/国内直连/白名单路由、三卡片实时面板与自更新。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: A page for writing notes inside DeepSeek Harness. · Minimal writing — one page that typesets as you type. · AI completion — a suggestion arrives when you pause, and TAB takes it. · Immersive writing — full screen, with only the page on it. · History — every note listed, searched and edited in place, and copied out as standard Markdown. · AI board — a data assistant that answers from your notes and pins the charts it builds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的笔记页。 · 极简写 — 一页纸，边写边排版。 · AI 自动补全 — 停笔片刻给出建议，TAB 采纳。 · 沉浸式书写 — 全屏，只有这张纸。 · 历史记录 — 笔记可列、可搜、就地编辑，一键复制标准 Markdown。 · AI 看板 — 数据助手用你的笔记回答，并把图表钉在看板上。

description.en: AI team with a pixel-art office showing each teammate's status and daily trail. A lead runs project sessions; daily caps per teammate. DSH Desktop, macOS only.
description.zh: 带像素办公室的 AI 团队：显示每位队友当前的状态和当天做过的事。项目会话由负责人安排分工，队友互相 @；队友每天自己开工的次数和 token 有上限。仅支持 macOS 上的 DSH 桌面版。

description.en: Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists every provider's models with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide, collapsible groups and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. The list can be searched by name or ID and filtered by capability (multimodal, reasoning) and by minimum context window (128K / 256K / 512K / 1M). Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support with the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge manual overrides, the settings document, the adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference and vendor corrections in that priority order, with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. Any model can be edited by hand (kind, context window, modalities, effort levels); those edits are stored outside the profile and can be written back into the model provider's settings. A hard re-fetch drops every cache and asks the adapter and all relays again. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 管理哪些模型出现在输入框的模型菜单里。设置页按 Provider 列出模型，支持逐模型开关、渠道级批量显隐、整组折叠和按类型筛选；关闭的模型从菜单中消失，当前会话正在使用的模型保留。还能按名称 / ID 搜索，按能力（多模态、支持推理）和上下文下限（128K / 256K / 512K / 1M）过滤。每行标注模型类型，对话模型另外标注是否支持推理、适配器公布的思考强度档位、上下文窗口和输入模态。标签按优先级合并手动覆盖、设置文档、适配器、中转站 GET /models 响应、内置 pi-ai / models.dev 目录、模型名推断和厂商校正，悬停显示来源，虚线边框表示推断值。任意模型都可以手动指定类型、上下文窗口、输入模态和思考强度档位；这些覆盖不写 profile 补丁，并且可以写回模型提供商的设置。工具栏的「重新获取能力」会让全部缓存作废并重新询问适配器与所有中转站。一个默认开启的开关让声明纯文本输入的中转站模型真正能接收图片，只在内存里生效，不改配置文件。隐藏列表保存在 profile patch 中，并镜像到 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Injects a per-conversation x-opencode-session header for OpenCode Go routes that were registered under a custom provider name, through the host official llm-pi-ai/request-headers waterfall. Zero dependencies, no fetch patching, and it never overwrites a header someone else already set.
description.zh: 为以自定义供应商名接入的 OpenCode Go 路由，按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头：走宿主官方 llm-pi-ai/request-headers 瀑布；零依赖、不替换 fetch，且不覆盖他人已写入的同名头。

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, works out the remaining model quota automatically and can show the DeepSeek account balance alongside; a minimal mode nests the rings and lets you choose which of the 5-hour / weekly / monthly figures each outer / middle / inner ring shows, with a live preview.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，支持自动计算模型配额剩余，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；极简模式把三环嵌套显示并支持自定义外 / 中 / 内环数据与实时预览。

description.en: Layered system-prompt profiles — global, per-workspace and per-session entries injected in order — where individual builtin sections and runtime contexts can be disabled or overridden, with a line-level diff of what an override changed; each entry carries a subagent scope that targets the main agent only, subagents only, or both; assembly snapshots record what each turn actually received, subagents included. Managed from a Web panel and a `prompt_manager` tool.
description.zh: 分层提示词档案：全局、按工作区、按会话三级条目按序注入系统提示词；可单独禁用或覆盖内置段落与运行期 context，覆盖效果有逐行 diff 对照；每条条目可限定只注入主代理、只注入子代理，或两者都注入；装配快照记录每一轮实际收到的提示词，子代理也包括在内。由 Web 面板与 `prompt_manager` 工具管理。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Sidebar file explorer and file previewer for DeepSeek Harness: a lazy workspace tree with in-panel preview for text, Markdown (tables included) and images, an action that opens the file in the conversation's right-hand document pane, and one that hands it to the system default app. Read-only, confined to configured roots.
description.zh: 侧栏文件浏览器与文件预览器：懒加载文件树，面板内预览文本 / Markdown（含表格）/ 图片，可把当前文件送进会话右侧文档预览，或交给系统默认程序打开；只读，路径限定在可浏览根内。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: A tiled sticky-notes board for the DSH sidebar (a notes plugin): per-row density, colours, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏的彩色便签墙（便签插件 / 记事贴）：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then enable, with prerequisites). Also offers a suite install, migration of a renamed package, and a one-click install of the dshmarket plugin market.
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: Scans a repository with its bundled Python 3.12+ tools and scaffolds one Markdown outline per source directory, then publishes the index with a hash manifest that proves the documents match the code; the bundled reader verifies that manifest before serving an overview or one document. The project root needs a project_docs/ directory and a CLAUDE.md entry point.
description.zh: 用随包的 Python 3.12+ 工具扫描仓库，为每个源码目录生成一份 Markdown 大纲，并随索引发布可证明文档与代码一致的哈希 manifest；自带读取器在输出概览或单份文档前会先校验 manifest。项目根需已有 project_docs/ 目录与 CLAUDE.md 入口。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.
description.zh: 智囊团：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
description.zh: 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能，一键收编进 DSH 用户库；内置 6600+ 技能市场，支持注入开销（≈token）统计与模型可见性治理。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 在原生工作区列表之上叠加主题分组：emoji 分组文件夹、筛选与搜索、批量归档，以及带安全边界的永久删除。

description.en: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.
description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供代码预览：按文件类型语法高亮、符号大纲、文件内查找，选中代码可直接加入对话。

description.en: Sidebar tab that lists a session's file changes by turn, expands line-level diffs and undoes them, with a matching review card at the end of each chat turn. Needs dsh-better-sidebar installed separately. DSH 0.2.x port of Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab; do not install both.
description.zh: 侧边栏「文件审查」标签页：按轮次列出本会话改动文件、展开行级 diff 并支持撤销，对话尾部同步显示同款审查卡片。需另装 dsh-better-sidebar。是 Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab 的 DSH 0.2.x 移植版，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.
description.zh: 跨所有工作目录的扁平会话列表：显示最后一句提问、按时间分组、全文搜索，并让随手记下的想法在重开会话时提醒。是 huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions 的重写分支，界面按原生样式重做；两者注册同一个 recent-sessions 面板 id，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Map a remote server directory over SSH and SFTP into a controlled local cache workspace, so the model, agent, session and memory keep running on the local machine.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 与 SFTP 把服务器目录映射为受控的本地缓存工作区，模型、Agent、会话与记忆仍在本机运行。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist. Retired by the author: published npm versions stay installable but receive no further DSH adaptations (migration guide: docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md in the repository).
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。作者已退役：已发布的 npm 版本仍可安装，但不再适配新版 DSH（迁移说明见仓库 docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md）。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and port forwarding (-L/-R/-D) in the DSH right sidebar, with jump-host chains and remembered passwords kept in the operating system credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发（-L/-R/-D），支持跳板链，记住的密码交给操作系统密码箱保管。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.
description.zh: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

description.en: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.
description.zh: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

description.en: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
description.zh: 让内置 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 以 TUN + fake-ip 模式运行时正常工作：只放行 fake-ip 地址段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48）通过公网地址校验，回环、内网与链路本地地址仍照旧拦截。无需设置代理环境变量，也无需改动 Clash。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。
