description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge, flexible layouts, and agent-assisted session controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 监控、提醒、充值与会话控制中心：查看官方余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方 token 合计，提供完成提醒、官方充值、灵活布局及 Agent 辅助的会话控制。

description.en: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.
description.zh: feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center 的维护分支，上游自 2026-09-09 起未再更新。计价改为跟随官方模型池、而非硬编码模型前缀，因此 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（`deepseek-flash`）能正常计价并显示峰谷时钟；官方价格页改为结构化解析，模型改名或下架不再中断价格同步。界面在原有中文之外增加英文。其余与原插件一致：余额、本会话花费与 token 拆分、24 小时峰谷时钟、Z.ai 套餐额度与本机用量账本，并跟随宿主明暗主题。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).
description.zh: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
description.zh: 分区式长期记忆：用文件夹收纳记忆，先看一行索引再翻对应分区，带遗忘曲线。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using editable per-model pricing.
description.zh: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量面板：官方账户余额与账单、每日用量日历，以及按可编辑的逐模型费率估算全部 Provider 的本地会话日志用量。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and supported coding workspaces through an end-to-end encrypted channel, with adaptive Relay/WebRTC transport, device authorization, workspace files, read-only previews, terminals, and optional Codex Remote.
description.zh: 通过端到端加密通道远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 及兼容的编码工作区，支持自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输、设备授权、工作区文件、只读预览、终端和可选的 Codex Remote。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Select a model and its reasoning effort in one drag with a two-dimensional grid.
description.zh: 使用二维网格，一次拖动同时选定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Preview 3D models and textures from the session workspace in DSH's right sidebar. Supported formats include FBX, OBJ, glTF, GLB, and STL models, plus TGA, EXR, and HDR textures.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏预览会话工作区中的 3D 模型和纹理。支持 FBX、OBJ、glTF、GLB、STL 模型，以及 TGA、EXR、HDR 纹理。

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.
description.zh: 自定义左下角账号处的用户名（手机号/邮箱）和头像，从而提升个性化或避免截图泄露隐私。编辑入口位于点击此处的菜单内。

description.en: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Action Hub for DSH: a standard Agent Skill library whose SKILL.md files can run as model-visible Skills or user-only Commands, with groups, project scopes, import/export and a native Alt+A palette.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的标准 Agent Skill 库：同一份 SKILL.md 可作为模型可见的 Skill 或仅由用户调用的 Command，支持分组、项目范围、导入导出和原生 Alt+A 面板。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: Adaptation packs for third-party DSH plugin panels on phones — 44px touch floor, width reclaim, shell hit targets and floating-widget clearance — loaded by the dsh-mobile plugin from its extensions directory (dsh-mobile must be installed for them to take effect), with a settings page that installs them and a per-plugin compatibility list.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件面板的手机适配包：44px 触控地板、宽度回收、外壳命中区与浮动控件让位；由 dsh-mobile 插件从其 extensions 目录加载（须先装 dsh-mobile 才会生效），附设置页一键装/卸与插件兼容清单。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
description.zh: 主模型在专业/长尾/高风险或不确定问题上召集多个专家顾问模型，以复古 CRT 聊天组卡片展示：一次 ask_advisors 自动跑满自动深挖流水线（驱动模型追问、顾问接力、综合结论），真流式 SSE、26 个供应商预设、可配置每日配额、停止/继续，以及可选的顾问工具调用。

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

description.en: Give your agent an external emotion state machine: several axes (0-100) that drift over time and move when you speak to it. Each turn the plugin injects which band you are in plus which tags you may use. The numbers belong to the plugin: the model reads them from the injected prompt and can change them only through the plugin's own emotion tools, never by asserting a mood.
description.zh: 把 AI 的情绪搬到模型外面：几条情绪轴各 0-100，按你说的话加减、随时间自己漂移，每轮把「现在处在哪一档 + 可用标签」注入系统提示。数值由插件维护：模型从注入的提示里读到当前值，只能通过插件自带的情绪工具调整，不能凭一句自报心情改数。默认空配置，一个轴都不替你定。

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱里跑一组固定的 Agent 用例，用确定性断言判分，并对比两次运行，指出换模型、改提示词或升级 DSH 之后哪条用例退化了。

description.en: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a cross-session cost overview.
description.zh: DSH 会话飞行记录仪面板：实时监视、时间轴回放（工具瀑布与事件检查器）、按 agent 归因成本，以及跨会话成本总览。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: AgentCompare provides A/B workflows for one Vite task in DSH: run two implementations, compare live previews with shared checks, choose blind, and review adoption against current project edits. Requires a root-level Vite project in a Git repository with at least one commit.
description.zh: AgentCompare A/B 对比：同一需求做两版 Vite 应用，在 DSH 主对话中并排体验、统一验收、盲选，再审查采用到当前项目。复用已有模型配置；适用于本地 Git 仓库（至少一次提交）的根目录 Vite 前端。

description.en: Dispatches tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs and provides a sidebar panel for CLI availability and dispatch status.
description.zh: 从 DSH 向 11 种外部 Agent CLI 派遣任务，并在侧栏面板显示 CLI 可用性和派遣状态。

description.en: Agent enhancements for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: prompt history, one-click optimize with undo, next-prompt prediction, conversation and tracked-file restore, model bill, context details with compact, Auto routing, and per-provider DeepSeek balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 智能体增强：提示词历史、一键优化与撤销、下一条预测、对话与已跟踪文件恢复、模型账单、上下文明细与压缩、Auto 路由，以及分账号 DeepSeek 余额显示。

description.en: Parent-agent dispatch with review: split a task into work orders, hand each to a contractor you picked (its own provider, model, and reasoning effort), then pass or fail every delivery — failed ones are re-dispatched with your feedback.
description.zh: 父智能体派单、子智能体干活的包工头：把任务拆成工单，每张派给你自选的承包商（各自指定 provider、模型、思考等级），交付后逐单验收，打回的单带着你的反馈重新派下去。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏换成固定的 2×4 八席看板，每席显示自己的状态、最近一次工具调用、思考与结果；设置里的开关可随时切回原生侧栏。

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
description.zh: 模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。

description.en: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
description.zh: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

description.en: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
description.zh: 按工作区路径或会话 ID 分发 system prompt 人设（完全一致 / 前缀 / 包含 / 正则），可指定一条默认人设兜底；会话页有「人设」页签，能看到实际发出去的提示词；人设列表可导入导出；另有一个开关拒绝工具写入人设存储。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: Install suites from any Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi or agent-plugins.org git marketplace repo — skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into DSH sessions at runtime, with a market page in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi / agent-plugins.org 的 git 市场仓库加为源，套件的技能、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入 DSH 会话，并自带 Web 市场页。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
description.zh: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

description.en: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.
description.zh: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词、工具、可见技能、子代理与备用模型，把它们编成一支团队。不写宿主的任何预设文件。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、update_team_preset 三个工具。

description.en: Manage agent-team roles in the dsh Web GUI: each role becomes its own selectable agent preset with per-role tool, skill and MCP switches.
description.zh: 在 dsh 的 Web GUI 里管理 agent team 角色：每个角色是一枚独立可选的 agent preset，按角色开关工具、技能与 MCP。

description.en: Frontend GUI debugging and testing for DeepSeekHarness agents: 36 browser_* tools for structured GUI automation, visual comparison, dynamic frame analysis and network debugging on Web/Chromium.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeekHarness 的前端 GUI 调试与测试：36 个 browser_* 工具，覆盖结构化 GUI 操作、视觉比对、动态帧分析与网络调试（Web/Chromium）。

description.en: Configurable serial agent-team workflows with a Manager, role Actors, an independent Judge, and a visual workflow editor.
description.zh: 可配置的串行 Agent 团队工作流，提供 Manager、角色 Actor、独立 Judge 和可视化工作流编辑器。

description.en: Agent lineage tree panel for DeepSeek Harness: renders the Lead-to-member-to-grandchild agent hierarchy as a live org-chart tree, with team focus, real-time status dots, and a model routing center (hot-reload default model config and actual per-session routes). The model routing center needs the optional dsh-plugin-subagent-director plugin; the rest of the panel works without it.
description.zh: 代际树面板：把 Lead→成员→孙代理 的多层代理关系画成实时组织树，含团队焦点、真状态点、模型路由中心。模型路由中心需另装可选的 dsh-plugin-subagent-director 插件，其余功能不装也能用。

description.en: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: A model-driven desktop pet, derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT): an always-on-top companion that follows your agent sessions, races the Web UI to answer approvals and questions, keeps a per-pet affection ledger, speaks through pet_say/pet_do tools or an autonomous inner voice, and can read those lines aloud through BreezeBlue TTS with your own BreezeBlue API key. It uses its own /whale598 route and ~/.dsh/whale598 data directory, so it is a separate pet from dsh-pet rather than a replacement for it.
description.zh: 模型驱动的桌面宠物，派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）：独立置顶小窗跟随会话状态，与 Web 界面竞速应答审批与提问，维护每宠独立的好感账本，经 pet_say/pet_do 工具或自主内心戏说话，并可用自备的 BreezeBlue API Key 通过 BreezeBlue 把台词读出来。它使用独立的 /whale598 路由与 ~/.dsh/whale598 数据目录，是独立于 dsh-pet 的另一只桌宠，不替代上游。

description.en: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates into the system prompt, and adds six loom_* tools for status, sync, memory search/list/add and skill listing. Requires the agentloom CLI installed and a one-time agentloom init; the seven-tool MCP bridge in the same repo is a separate package for MCP clients.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex 接到共享的 ~/.agentloom：将共享记忆与被上下文预算截断的 AGENTS.md 条目注入系统提示，并提供 status、sync、记忆检索/列出/写入与技能列出的六个 loom_* 工具。需先安装 agentloom CLI 并执行一次 agentloom init；同仓库的七工具 MCP 桥是另一个包，供 MCP 客户端使用。

description.en: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可扩展的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架。输入一个行动，多个 NPC 各自回应，每条反应独立成带头像插图的聊天室消息；世界、地点、NPC 与功能扩展（如接入第三方绘图 API 实现 NPC 动态表情动作）都可以在对话框里让 agent 直接添加修改，无需写代码。

description.en: A /agentinit command that builds, repairs or audits a repository's AGENTS.md inside a subagent: the child reads the method file itself and checks every command and path it writes with the bundled read-only checker, so no instruction body enters the main conversation. The bundled checker is a Python script, so Python 3 must be on PATH.
description.zh: /agentinit 命令：在子代理里生成、修订或审计仓库的 AGENTS.md。方法文档由子代理自己读取，写下的每条命令与路径都用随包的只读检查器核验，主对话不进入任何指令正文。随包的检查器是 Python 脚本，需要 Python 3 在 PATH 中。

description.en: Always-on-top notch for Windows that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done or failed: one bot per session, never takes focus, hides under full-screen apps, with its own settings page.
description.zh: Windows 屏幕顶部始终置顶的刘海：每个会话一个小机器人，显示哪些在工作、哪些在等你、哪些已完成或失败；不抢焦点，全屏应用下自动隐藏，带独立设置页。

description.en: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md 等 AI 规则文件：项目级跟随工作区从项目根到 cwd 的目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，另含 25 个第三方 AI 工具的用户级规则文件。预览以渲染态展示并自动剥离 .mdc 的 frontmatter，就地编辑并带冲突检测，内容完全相同的跨工具文件会互相标注，内置清单之外的工具按目录特征自动发现。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的网页访问层：把 JS 渲染或受保护的页面抓成干净 markdown，聚合搜索 14 个引擎，并提供有状态交互会话（点击、输入、滚动、eval、截图），引擎可托管可自部署（Rust 单二进制）。每个会话带直播页 URL，人能实时围观 agent 浏览并用鼠标接管。

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation: for images, plain text-to-image or image-to-image and multi-image composition from up to eight reference images — chosen from local files or from results already in the panel — at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; for video, agnes-video-2.5-flash at 720p, 4-12 seconds, submitted as an async task and polled with a live percentage. See the result inline as an image or a seekable video, revisit the last eight generations, and repoint the API-key file or output directory from the panel settings without editing code or restarting. Polling backs off on the query endpoint 429 rate limit instead of failing the task, and a 503 queue-full submit retries automatically. Needs an Agnes AI API key saved in a local file (default ~/.agnes-key.txt).
description.zh: 侧边栏 Agnes 出图与出视频面板：出图既可纯文生图，也可用最多 8 张参考图做图生图或多图合成（参考图从本地文件选，或直接从面板里已生成的结果中挑），尺寸 1K/2K/3K/4K、8 种宽高比；出视频用 agnes-video-2.5-flash，720p、4-12 秒，异步任务轮询并显示百分比进度。结果内联展示，图片直出、视频可拖动进度条，最近 8 条可回看；Key 文件路径与输出目录可在面板设置里修改，无需改代码或重启。查询接口 429 限流自动退避而非判任务失败，提交遇 503 队列满自动重试。需要 Agnes AI 平台的 API Key，存放在本地文件中（默认 ~/.agnes-key.txt）。

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.
description.zh: 侧边栏 AI 创作面板，除生图与生视频外还带画布节点图和短剧模式：画布上用 ffmpeg 抽取上一镜尾帧，作为下一镜首帧自动串联；短剧模式可导入剧本拆解为分镜。生成与轮询都在宿主进程后台执行，刷新页面或关闭面板都不中断，结果与最多 80 条历史保存在本机。

description.en: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一站式 AI 影视创作工作站，作为 DSH 全局浮层面板运行，不占用对话框：生图（文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，1K–4K、8 种宽高比）、生视频（文生视频 / 图生视频，4–12 秒、支持首帧控制）、短剧（导入 .txt/.md/.json 剧本自动拆解分镜，故事板预览与批量生成）与提示词专家工作区。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).
description.zh: 把 Agnes AI 的生图 / 生视频接成 DSH 原生工具，长视频任务可稍后续查。需设置 Agnes API Key（AGNES_API_KEY）。

description.en: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.
description.zh: Windows 专用的 Google Antigravity CLI 模型提供方，接续自 Darkings/dsh-agy-provider（包名 dsh-agy-cli，请勿与原版同装）。从 Windows 凭据管理器读取 Antigravity 令牌并只发往 Google Cloud Code 端点；Harness 工具策略由 DSH 全权负责，尾流式输出防回滚，并跟踪真实配额窗口。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues。

description.en: Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.
description.zh: 合规地在 dsh 中使用你自己的 Antigravity 额度：将本机已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）会话桥接为主对话与子代理模型提供方。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy card, and Chinese chess where the model only comments on a move picked from locally generated legal candidates. Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Connect several OpenAI-compatible gateways at once: each one is its own group in the model picker, can be hidden without losing its settings, and can fetch its own public info from its address, alongside per-gateway model management, model tests and optional quota reporting.
description.zh: 同时接入多台 OpenAI 兼容网关：每台在模型选择器里各成一组、可单独隐藏且配置保留、按地址即可获取自身公开信息，并逐网关管理模型、跑模型测试、按需显示额度。

description.en: Daily and weekly AI journals generated from your local DSH session logs, grouped by goal with deliverables and unfinished todos.
description.zh: 按天/按周汇总本机 DSH 会话：按目标分块的行动/结果/交付物与未完成待办，左侧栏图形化面板。

description.en: Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
description.zh: DSH 的本地资料馆：把本机文件与产物索引成可搜索的卡片树，支持 PDF / Office / 图片预览，另带论文检索（arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 等）、把网页存成 markdown 快照、插件市场标签页，以及已装插件资源的同步与一键切换（人设、表情包图集、鲸鱼挂件素材）。包含 18 个工具与 22 条宿主路由。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

description.en: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.
description.zh: 当 AI 询问澄清性问题时（带问号或调用 ask_user_question）播放提示音。Web Audio API 合成，零音频文件，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.
description.zh: 用会话自己的模型从对话内容生成会话标题，可走 /ai-title 命令，也可点重命名弹窗里的按钮。提供四种标题结构（主题、动作、主题 + 结论、自定义提示词）和可选的「月-日」前缀，均可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
description.zh: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

description.en: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slices, auto-cite, scientific figures), a unified cross-platform search with de-duplication, an API-key card in Settings, and per-call credit accounting with an `/ai4scholar` balance card.
description.zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

description.en: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
description.zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

description.en: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
description.zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

description.en: Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.
description.zh: 解决中转站多分组多倍率不方便管理的问题：在提供 /v1/token/group 的站点上就地切换分组并同步刷新模型列表与计费倍率；缺少该接口的站点自动降级为只读，模型仍可正常拉取与调用。

description.en: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

description.en: Reads local AI session history from 16 AI tools plus Windows recent-file activity, and generates daily or weekly work reports on your machine. Currently Windows x64 only: the plugin ships a bundled Windows sidecar (no Python needed); macOS/Linux are not supported yet.
description.zh: 读取 16 个 AI 工具的本地会话记录，外加 Windows 最近文件活动，在本机生成日报或周报。目前仅支持 Windows x64：插件自带 Windows sidecar，无需安装 Python；macOS / Linux 暂不支持。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: Companion persona preset with persistent memory, presence heartbeat, idle updates, and a delegated helper agent with built-in fetch and CDP web tools.
description.zh: 陪伴人格预设：持久记忆、在线状态心跳、主动问候更新，并附带内置 fetch 与 CDP 联网工具的小伙伴子代理。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Agent 经验网络：从 trace 与实时 Manifest 蒸馏任务级经验，按 H0-H4 证据分级、按兼容性发现，经显式审阅后才晋升。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.
description.zh: 界面悬浮一行显示「还能花的钱」= 阿里云代金券余额 + 账户余额；悬停看券面值、已用与最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the sidebar footer, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券的剩余余额、已用额度与到期时间，数据来自只读 BSS OpenAPI。

description.en: Analyzes usage and cost across models, providers and workspaces over any date range: hourly single-day and daily cross-day trends, a 53-week heatmap, cache-hit and model/workspace shares, plus request logs, CSV export and a ledger that survives session and workspace deletion. Highlights: multi-dimensional usage analysis, model and workspace insight, configurable cost and balance, full history with incremental sync, and auditable day-to-day operations.
description.zh: 统一分析多模型、多供应商、多工作区的用量与成本：任意起止日期、单日小时与跨日趋势、53 周热力图、缓存命中与模型/工作区占比，另有请求日志、CSV 导出与可跨会话恢复的持久账本。特点：多维用量分析，模型与工作区洞察，可配置成本与余额，完整历史与增量同步，可审计的日常操作。

description.en: Stars the GitHub repositories behind installed DSH plugins from a tab beside Installed on the Plugins page and a control on each plugin detail page; resolves a token from the environment, a saved credential record or the gh CLI, and asks once before the first star because starring is public.
description.zh: 在插件页「已安装」旁的标签页和插件详情页给已安装插件对应的 GitHub 仓库点星；令牌依次取自环境变量、已保存的凭据记录或已登录的 gh CLI，因为 star 是公开行为，首次点星前会提示一次。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
description.zh: 把 δ-me13（翁法罗斯）的 13 张黄金裔角色技能卡变成席位工作区：逐席配色与壁纸、首轮自动注入技能卡、对话表情、每席记忆便签与预设、Alt+数字切席，以及用于派发与移交的总览画布；技能套件本身从可配置的本地目录读取，不随插件打包。

description.en: Live architecture map of DeepSeek Harness: renders plugins, services, tools, sessions, models and MCP as a five-layer diagram of 14 component domains, and animates the real tool/model/session call flow as moving dots along the connecting curves.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时架构透视：把插件、服务、工具、会话、模型与 MCP 画成 5 层、14 个组件域的实时架构图，并用沿连线移动的圆点动画展示真实的工具 / 模型 / 会话调用流。

description.en: Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy H.264 streaming, agent taps verified by screenshots and a UI tree, and screenshots / recordings / debug evidence saved into one host directory. Debug sessions keep segmented video, full logcat and per-action frames. Emulators and USB phones, human+agent co-operation, loopback-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话旁打开 Android 设备实时画面：scrcpy H.264 串流，agent 可点按操作并用截图与控件树自证，截图 / 录屏 / 调试证据统一存进你指定的电脑目录；调试会话自带分段视频、全量 logcat 与逐动作前后帧。模拟器与 USB 真机通吃，人机共屏，仅限本机回环。

description.en: AI-native iteration cycle: 24 anic_* tools and 77 HTTP routes that run evaluation, convergence gates, and auto-fix loops across projects, with a live white-box panel (interactive workflow graph, invocation feed, autonomy gauge, gate ledger, HITL queue) and an inline installable SKILL.md workflow kit.
description.zh: AI 原生迭代循环：24 个 anic_* 工具与 77 个 HTTP 路由驱动跨项目评估、收敛门禁与自动修复循环，附带实时白盒面板（可交互工作流图、调用流、自主级仪表带、门禁账本、HITL 队列）与可内联安装的 SKILL.md 工作流套件。

description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query 全文检索历史条目并带回文件与行号锚点；annals_links 查条目之间的双向引用。改过文件但当天没写日志时每轮提醒一次，写了日志却没更新索引时再提醒一次。另有设置页可关这六个开关。

description.en: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的标注浏览器：通过 CDP 推流并转发输入的实时页面，点选元素或划选文字后，把源码位置、组件栈、样式与裁图带进聊天输入框。需本机 Chrome（Windows 须设置 chromePath）。

description.en: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.
description.zh: HTML 文档预览就地批注插件：点选元素写批注，按文件保存批注，可整批发送到当前对话，由 Agent 直接修改源文件。

description.en: Annotate quoted answer text in the transcript: each selection keeps its quote plus a note of your own, notes pile up as chips in the composer and travel with the message, and two or more also get a chip above the input to jump back or clear them. The chips need dsh-paste-chip installed; without it each note is a plain text line in the draft.
description.zh: 划选回答文字就地加注释：保留原文引用加自己写的备注，每条在草稿里变成一枚胶囊，多条一起随消息发出；两条以上时输入框上方会多一个胶囊用来跳回原文或全部清除。胶囊需另装 dsh-paste-chip，否则每条注释在草稿里是一行纯文本。

description.en: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
description.zh: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.
description.zh: 逐次回答耗时拆解：把每次回复分成模型、工具与其它三段，给出首字、生成与各工具耗时，并在本地落一份 JSONL 账本。需要 DSH 运行时为 Node 24 或更新版本。

description.en: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
description.zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

description.en: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
description.zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

description.en: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 Google Antigravity 的 SQLite 会话并导入为原生侧栏会话，提供 list／read／import 工具与斜杠命令。

description.en: Agent audio studio for DeepSeek Harness: compose from note-level scores, narrate, add sound effects and mix, then fine-tune every track on an editable timeline where each generated sound arrives as its own clip. Speech uses Edge TTS (Microsoft's public endpoint, needs ffmpeg) by default, or MiMo-V2.5-TTS with your own API key; needs Node.js 22.19+.
description.zh: 给 agent 用的音频工作室（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：写谱编曲、配音、音效与混音，生成的每个声音都以独立片段落到同一条可视化时间轴上，可逐轨试听、单独调节与微调。配音默认走 Edge TTS（微软公共接口，需要 ffmpeg），也可选用 MiMo-V2.5-TTS（需自备 API Key）；需要 Node.js 22.19+。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观一体化工具。对 8 个界面区域分别调节透明度与毛玻璃模糊（主背景、侧边栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页、产出物/高亮内容；安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后为 9 个）。用任意图片或视频做壁纸，配有拖动平移、滚轮缩放的位置编辑器与 5 种布局模式（适应/填充/拉伸/平铺/居中）；视频静音循环播放、刷新不丢失，并自动截取一帧用于预览、取色与构图。把多张图片加入轮换池（随机/顺序，每次刷新/每天/每周）自动更换。还包含 PS 风格色轮、一键从壁纸提取主题色、6 套预设 + 命名配置、昼夜自动切换与主题一键导出导入。

description.en: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.
description.zh: DSH 的 AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、单仓库索引与治理视图、MCP 绑定诊断，以及引导式/批量初始化。治理、校验与引导式/批量初始化需宿主机装有 aoci CLI；仅浏览索引不需要。

description.en: Fetches AOSP source snapshots from codeload and searches them on the device with ripgrep through nine tools covering mirror listing, preset bundles, fetch, incremental update, cross-module regex search, a heuristic call-chain trace and line reads, with no git, no root and no build.
description.zh: 从 codeload 拉 AOSP 源码快照，在本机用 ripgrep 检索，九个工具覆盖镜像列表、预设包、拉取、增量更新、跨模块正则搜索、启发式调用链追踪与按行读取，不需要 git、root 或编译。

description.en: Accounts-payable three-way match: import invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts, apply the tolerance policy and export the exception workpaper — 4 `ap.*` tools.
description.zh: 应付三单匹配：导入发票、采购订单与收货单，按容差策略匹配并导出异常底稿——4 个 `ap.*` 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek API wallet balance in the composer dock with a popover showing topped-up and granted credit, the refresh time, and usage and top-up links, plus a /balance command and an api_balance tool; the Host reads a signed-in account wallet or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential, so the browser only receives amounts.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻 DeepSeek API 余额胶囊，点开显示充值额度、赠送额度、更新时间与用量/充值链接，另有 /balance 命令与 api_balance 工具；凭据只留在 Host（已登录账户钱包或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），浏览器只拿到金额。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

description.en: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
description.zh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

description.en: Diagnoses third-party LLM API endpoints from the sidebar: a four-layer check (DNS/TCP/TLS, key and model, a real streaming conversation, then timed repeat runs) reporting time-to-first-token, output speed and success rate, with every failure attributed to the step it stalled at and the byte count that actually left the machine. 37 provider presets, no model names hardcoded.
description.zh: 侧边栏体检第三方 LLM 接口：四层检查（DNS/TCP/TLS、Key 与模型、真实流式对话、连测多轮），报出首字延迟、输出速度与成功率；失败时标明卡在第几步、实际写出多少字节。内置 37 个服务商预设，不硬编码任何模型名。

description.en: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

description.en: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.
description.zh: 接口回归验收台：登记端点后先快照响应基线，模型改完后端一键重跑，把结构化字段级差异（状态码、字段增删、数值新旧值与差值）与源码 diff 并排展示，逐项验收后再导出 Markdown / 单文件 HTML 报告。

description.en: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline SDK (panel card with official download links), then drives the HBuilderX CLI to build, sign and upload apps from per-project config files; the engine also ships as list / doctor / check / build tools for the agent.
description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check / build 四个工具暴露给 agent。

description.en: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders nothing outside the Windows desktop shell.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端窗口标题栏显示自定义文字与图片，支持多条目轮播、每条独立字体/颜色/对齐/流光，并可在设置里编辑；非 Windows 桌面端不渲染。

description.en: Read-only Windows AppData analyzer: click the sidebar icon to drill down explorer-style through directories, each row showing recursive size, file count and last-modified time, plus the software that created it and a delete-worthiness verdict built from a knowledge base, mixed-directory splitting, then heuristics, with unmatched guesses marked as such. Scans directories only and never reads file contents; it ships no delete action, and unknown directories can be looked up online with a model summary and cited sources. The online lookup needs a DeepSeek API key (or an equivalent credential); without one the query is only copied to the clipboard.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows AppData 分析插件：点侧边栏图标后以资源管理器式逐层下钻，每行显示目录的递归体积、文件数与最后修改时间，并说明由哪个软件生成、作何用途，按「知识库 → 混合目录拆分 → 启发式 → 标注为推测」的顺序给出可删建议；只统计目录、不读取文件内容，也不提供任何删除操作，未知目录可按需联网检索并给出带摘要的来源。联网查询需配置 DeepSeek API key（或等价凭据）；没有凭据时只会把查询串复制到剪贴板，不会报错。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject it; the executing AI's answers are saved into the session.
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: Add an optional rejection reason to approval prompts: the text is steered into the running turn before the rejection is answered, and the panel only follows the session you are currently viewing.
description.zh: 在审批卡上增加可选的拒绝理由：理由会先作为 steering 消息进入当前轮，再把审批答成拒绝；浮层只跟随你正在查看的会话。

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, the agent asks you to choose an option, or a session finishes a turn, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused; an optional chime covers cases where the browser or Windows suppresses the notification.
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批、智能体提问等你选择、或会话跑完一轮时，弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不看 DSH 页面（后台或未聚焦）时提醒；浏览器或 Windows 抑制通知时可用可选提示音兜底。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay silent.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: Architecture map workbench: register local repos, let a restricted agent (run as a hidden subagent session) read the code with the archify skill, keep branch-level structure and domain diagrams with concepts, temporary/permanent custom diagrams, read-only Q&A, and pick the analysis model from the models DSH already has configured.
description.zh: 代码库架构图册：登记本地仓库，由受限 agent（跑在子代理会话里，不占会话列表）用 archify skill 读代码，按分支维护结构图与领域图，支持概念提取、临时/永久自定义图、只读追问，并可在设置里挑选 DSH 已配好的模型来跑分析。

description.en: Conversation management for DSH: bulk-archive idle conversations (archiving only marks them; by default it also sends their snapshot ledgers to the Windows Recycle Bin), permanently delete conversations after confirmation, star the ones worth keeping, undo the last reply with a per-turn snapshot, and clean up snapshots and archived files from one panel. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: DSH 对话管理工具箱：按闲置批量归档（归档只做标记，默认顺带把快照账本送进 Windows 回收站），确认后可永久删除对话；收藏常看会话；按轮次撤销回复并保留轮次快照；一键清理快照与归档档案。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。

description.en: Deletes any DSH session from its sidebar row, in bulk, or through a settings panel — into a recoverable trash, with ghost entries pruned automatically.
description.zh: 会话删除：任意会话行上直接删、多选批量清空、从回收站还原，删和还原都立刻生效不用重启；僵尸条目自动清理.

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive with workspace filtering and title/ID search, and read the transcript folded from the durable log — including messages from before a context compaction — without unarchiving.
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：按工作区筛选、按标题/ID 搜索，不取消归档即可阅读从完整日志折出的对话——包括上下文压缩前的原文与工具调用。

description.en: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, conversation previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, confirmed permanent deletion and retries, and official Host updates.
description.zh: 按工作区管理已归档与未归档会话，支持独立范围正文搜索、上下文预览、标签备注、ZIP 备份导入导出、会话谱系、永久删除确认与失败重试，以及官方宿主更新。

description.en: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

description.en: Adds a confirmed Delete session action to the sidebar menu of archived Sessions; the Host permanently removes their local JSONL logs (including hidden subagent descendants), workspace accounting and archive/pin entries, then refreshes open Web clients.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧栏已归档会话的“...”菜单中新增带二次确认的「删除会话」；Host 永久删除本地 JSONL 日志（含隐藏的子代理后代）、工作区记账与归档/置顶集合，并刷新已打开的页面。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: Arknights theme for the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography throughout; and approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.
description.zh: 明日方舟主题：12 张整屏壁纸，边缘虚化、羽化与玻璃浓度按每张图分别计算；文字色以 OKLCH 求解并守住 WCAG AA 下限；界面图标换成罗德岛素材；授权卡与选项卡带干员签名。

description.en: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误率与上下文 token 税，死工具一键禁用），以及三大安装市场（SkillHub 19 万+ 技能、WorkBuddy 连接器、47 个一手核实的内置服务）。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Drive CADCraft from the agent: draw lines, arcs and splines, manage layers, add dimensions, hatches and blocks, then export DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF. Exposes both CADCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a drawing can be created and read back. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 CADCraft：绘制直线、圆弧与样条，管理图层，添加标注、填充与图块，并导出 DXF、DWG、SVG、PNG 或 PDF。同时暴露 CADCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可创建并读回图纸。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DeckCraft from the agent: create slides, apply layouts and themes, add shapes, pictures, tables and charts, then save a .pptx or export a PDF. Exposes DeckCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DeckCraft：新建幻灯片、套用版式与主题、添加形状、图片、表格与图表，并保存为 .pptx 或导出 PDF。暴露 DeckCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DesignCraft from the agent: create pages, place and flow text, arrange frames and master pages, then export PDF. Exposes DesignCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DesignCraft：创建页面、置入与排布文字、组织图文框与主页，并导出 PDF。暴露 DesignCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive EffectCraft from the agent: build compositions, add layers, set properties and keyframes, evaluate expressions, then render frames or movies. Exposes EffectCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 EffectCraft：搭建合成、添加图层、设置属性与关键帧、计算表达式，并渲染单帧或视频。暴露 EffectCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FigCraft from the agent: create frames, components and auto layout, set fills, strokes and effects, build prototypes, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or code. Exposes both FigCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FigCraft：创建画框、组件与自动布局，设置填充、描边与效果，搭建原型，并导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 或代码。同时暴露 FigCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FilmCraft from the agent: build a project and sequences, import media, run edits as a script, then export with a preset or format. Exposes FilmCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FilmCraft：创建工程与序列、导入素材、以脚本方式执行剪辑，并按预设或格式导出。暴露 FilmCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive GridCraft from the agent: build workbooks, write and evaluate formulas, format ranges, insert charts and tables, and read cells back. Exposes both GridCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a workbook can be created and inspected end to end. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 GridCraft：构建工作簿、写入并计算公式、设置区域格式、插入图表与表格，并读回单元格。同时暴露 GridCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可端到端地创建并检查工作簿。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive LightCraft from the agent: import photos, apply develop settings, and export JPEG or other formats from a photo library. Exposes LightCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 LightCraft：导入照片、应用冲图设置，并从照片库导出 JPEG 等格式。暴露 LightCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PdfCraft from the agent: read and extract text, render pages to images, rotate, delete, reorder, combine or split pages, and audit faux redactions. Exposes PdfCraft's tool set as both commands and an MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PdfCraft：读取并提取文本、把页面渲染成图片、旋转/删除/重排/合并/拆分页面，并检查伪脱敏。以命令与 MCP server 两种形式暴露 PdfCraft 的工具集。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PhotoCraft from the agent: open and create documents, work with layers and selections, apply adjustments and filters, run batch actions, then save or export PSD, PNG, JPG, TIFF or WebP. Exposes PhotoCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PhotoCraft：打开与新建文档、操作图层与选区、应用调整与滤镜、执行批处理动作，并保存或导出 PSD、PNG、JPG、TIFF 或 WebP。暴露 PhotoCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive SoundCraft from the agent: load a session, set track and mixer levels, insert plugins, edit MIDI, and bounce audio without opening a window. Exposes the DAW's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 SoundCraft：加载工程、设置轨道与混音电平、插入插件、编辑 MIDI，并在不打开窗口的情况下 bounce 音频。暴露这个 DAW 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive TextureCraft from the agent: build texture sets and layers over a mesh, paint, bake maps, and export PBR textures. Exposes both TextureCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 TextureCraft：在网格上构建贴图集与图层、绘制、烘焙贴图，并导出 PBR 纹理。同时暴露 TextureCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive VectorCraft from the agent: create and edit paths and artboards, set text and effects, then export SVG, PDF, AI or EPS. Exposes VectorCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 VectorCraft：创建与编辑路径和画板、设置文字与效果，并导出 SVG、PDF、AI 或 EPS。暴露 VectorCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive WordCraft from the agent: create documents, insert and style text, build tables and headers, track changes and comments, then save as DOCX or convert to PDF, ODT, RTF, Markdown and more. Exposes WordCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 WordCraft：新建文档、插入并排版文字、构建表格与页眉、跟踪修订与批注，并保存为 DOCX 或转换为 PDF、ODT、RTF、Markdown 等。暴露 WordCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: A live preview panel for the ArtCraft applications inside the DSH Web GUI: the agent step list, the current render, a filmstrip of earlier steps and a timeline for time-based crafts, fed by the craft plugins' renders.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 内的 ArtCraft 实时预览面板：智能体步骤流、当前渲染、历史步骤胶片条，以及时间轴类应用的时间轴，数据来自各 craft 插件生成的渲染图。

description.en: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
description.zh: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。

description.en: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.
description.zh: 为 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏补上缺失的后端，提供 /report 产物索引与预览所需的文件内容。

description.en: Adds a resident system-prompt rule asking the assistant to report every file it produces as a full absolute path (a soft rule, not enforced), and replaces the official context menu on a file link with eight actions: open in the sidebar, open in a floating window, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save a copy elsewhere, copy the file, copy its path, and add it to the chat box, so a result reaches a friend in one click (copy-file and save-as are Windows only). Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 常驻系统提示词规则，要求助手为每个产物给出完整绝对路径（软约束，不保证），并把文件链接上的官方右键菜单替换成八项：在侧边栏打开、在悬浮窗打开、用默认程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、另存为到指定位置、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框，产物一键分享给好友（复制文件与另存为仅 Windows）。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
description.zh: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

description.en: Right-click menus on artifact cards and file links: copy the full or short path, show the file in its folder, or open it in its default app.
description.zh: 给会话里的产物卡片和文件链接加上右键菜单：复制完整或短路径、打开所在文件夹、用默认程序打开。

description.en: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。
