description.en: Exposes a running DeepSeek Harness as an MCP server over Streamable HTTP or a bundled stdio bridge, so an external agent can create workspaces and sessions, prompt, fork, rename and switch the model on them, read and write files, run foreground and background shell commands, call the instance's own agent tools by name, and read per-turn and cumulative token usage with a cost receipt when a price plugin is installed.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 暴露为 MCP server（Streamable HTTP，或附带的 stdio 桥），外部 agent 可创建 workspace 与会话，发起 prompt、fork、重命名、切换模型，读写文件，运行前台与后台 shell 命令，按名调用该实例自身的 agent 工具，并读取单轮与累计 token 用量；装了计价插件时还给出费用回执。

description.en: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一个 MCP server：让另一个 agent 实时看见它的思维、工具调用和文件改动，共享意图，持地板锁期间拒绝 DSH 的 write/edit/git 工具，插入中途提醒，并委托审查。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales, fish, grid and wakes.
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.
description.zh: 对话旁的会话级便笺：会话右上角入口用角标显示未完成数量，点开是可拖拽调宽高的右侧面板，便笺可添加、勾选完成、复制、编辑和一键转发到输入框，面板尺寸与草稿保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never sends for you.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮：先复述你的草稿，再用可点的选项问几个问题——每题都带一个「我不知道，你替我定」的逃生项——最后把草稿改写成 AI 能直接开工的需求。全程可以一个字都不打，而且它不会替你发送。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (the “question n/n answered” tool rows) in the conversation with a soft brand-tinted card that follows the light/dark theme; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look. Settings can toggle highlighting and expand-by-default.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和品牌色卡片凸显，明暗主题自适应；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。设置页可开关「高亮已答复提问块」与「默认展开」。

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
description.zh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
description.zh: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 / 权限命令、/compact 与 /last 找回、三档过程显示、整群共用或按人隔离的会话范围。

description.en: Answers @file completion from the Everything index through es.exe instead of walking the workspace, keeping the workspace root as the ranking scope. Windows only; needs Everything and es.exe on PATH.
description.zh: 用 es.exe 从 Everything 索引回答 @file 补全，而不是遍历工作区，并以工作区根目录作为排序范围。仅限 Windows；需先安装 Everything 与 es.exe 并加入 PATH。

description.en: Adds a row of category tabs on top of the @ reference menu so candidates can be filtered by kind.
description.zh: 在 @ 引用菜单顶部加一排类别标签，点标签只看该类候选。

description.en: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.
description.zh: 增强右侧栏原生的「文件」标签页而非替换它：每行带一个 @ 引用按钮，把规范路径提及插入输入框；另有大小列、可排序的修改时间列，以及按未跟踪/未暂存/已暂存着色的状态点。文件树下方有 git 栏，显示分支与领先/落后数量，并可向上展开最近 20 条提交；当工作区的子目录是独立仓库时提供仓库选择器。页头搜索框递归遍历工作区，可打开结果或在文件树中展开定位；预览页签提供「在文件树中定位」与一键 @；文件树支持键盘导航与 ARIA tree 语义；右键「文件」标签页可在运行时切回原生树。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness workbench with model metrics, cost estimates, prompt presets, optional auditing, and context-aware reply suggestions; automatic suggestions default on and may incur API fees.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供指标、费用估算、提示词与可选审计，支持上下文回复候选；自动建议默认开启，可能产生 API 费用。

description.en: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
description.zh: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

description.en: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续/交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。

description.en: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
description.zh: 会话签名监护链：被监视的工具结果逐条追加哈希链 ed25519 签名记录，commit 绑定进链——篡改任意行或截断尾部都会在确定性重放校验中失败。

description.en: Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
description.zh: Linux 上 DSH Web 的宿主侧会话提醒：回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时，服务器音频设备直接发声，无需打开浏览器。

description.en: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. Do not install it alongside dsh-audio-rail: both drive the same rail and register the same /audio-rail/events and /audio-rail/status routes.
description.zh: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail 同装——两者驱动同一处锚点并注册相同的 /audio-rail/events 与 /audio-rail/status 路由。

description.en: Audio tools for DSH: inspect audio/video files, transcode or extract the audio track from a video, trim and normalize, and transcribe speech with local whisper.cpp or an OpenAI-compatible API. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (not bundled); local transcription also needs a whisper-cli binary and a ggml model.
description.zh: DSH 音频工具：查看音频/视频信息、转码、从视频提取音轨、裁剪与响度归一化，并用本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口把语音转成文字和字幕。需要本机已装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（插件不自带）；本地转写还需 whisper-cli 与 ggml 模型。

description.en: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
description.zh: 搜书听：按书名、作者、角色名或大概情节搜公版书（古腾堡、中英文维基文库、Internet Archive、Standard Ebooks），或导入 EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown，在右侧栏用微软 Edge 神经网络语音、离线 Kokoro 或设备自带语音读给你听；自动记住听到哪，能语音记读书心得、和 AI 聊刚听到的内容。

description.en: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 音频插件 —— 多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与音色设计，含侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Hosts the agent as a persona on a self-hosted web page, with owner and guest accounts: a mood value that drifts back toward baseline over time, memory you can read and edit, a sticker library, diary posts that guests can comment on, idle small talk, voice notes, speech recognition and text to speech. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default; create the owner account before exposing the port, and only the owner can add guest accounts.
description.zh: 让 agent 以人设住进自建网页，分主人和客人两种账号：会随着时间回落到平常值的心情、可查看可修改的记忆、表情库、客人能评论的空间动态、闲置搭话、语音条、语音识别与朗读。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332；对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号，客人账号只能由主人创建。

description.en: A self-hosted digital-life companion for DSH. Three slow-moving hormones (dopamine, cortisol, serotonin) set its mood and tone, a memory layer turns chats into events and facts with version chains and a forgetting curve, and it writes, hot-loads and unloads its own organs (tools) when a capability is missing. It handles text, images, stickers, voice notes with text to speech and speech recognition, and file uploads; the web space holds diary posts and guestbook comments, and it starts conversations on its own schedule. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default, so create the owner account before exposing the port.
description.zh: AuraLife 把 DSH 变成一条自托管的数字生命：三种慢变量激素（多巴胺、皮质醇、血清素）决定它的状态和话风；记忆层把聊天变成事件和事实，带版本链与遗忘曲线；发现缺少能力时它会自己写「器官」（工具），写完即热加载，也能热卸载。支持文字、图片、表情、语音（TTS 与语音识别）和文件上传；网页空间里有日记和留言评论，它还会按自己的安排主动搭话。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332，对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 64 KiB and retires stale dsh-auth-* launch cookies on each response, so a fixed profile cannot lock itself out of the desktop welcome handshake after roughly 72 restarts.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 头部预算提升到 64 KiB，并在每次响应里清掉过期的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，避免固定 profile 在约 72 次重启后卡在桌面端欢迎握手。

description.en: Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.
description.zh: 把本机的 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持的提供方可直接 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
description.zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

description.en: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: Automatic approval and audit frame for DSH tool calls: a four-outcome rule table (deny, ask, AI review, allow) over commands, file access, network and tool scope, with security rules, rule-based auto-approve/auto-deny, AI fast/deep review, human approval, permission tiers, workspace boundaries, secret redaction and placeholder restore, a hash-chained audit trail and a simulator. Target files are inspected by metadata only.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的自动审批（自动审核）与审计框架：四档规则表（拒绝／问人／AI 评审／放行）对命令审批、文件读写、网络访问与工具调用逐条拦截，能按规则自动放行或自动拒绝，疑难项交给 AI 审查或人工审批／授权；带权限档、工作区边界、敏感信息脱敏、秘密占位符回填、哈希链审计日志与台账、模拟审批设置页。目标文件只查元数据。

description.en: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
description.zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: A session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: the trigger point is configurable, compaction does not make the local engine re-read the whole history, and the model writes a structured handoff summary from the prefix that is already cached. Trigger ratio, summary template, display style and per-preset scope are configurable. Installing and restarting DSH takes over; uninstalling restores native DSH compaction.
description.zh: 对本地模型友好的会话自动压缩插件：可自定义压缩触发点，不会使本地引擎重读全部历史，并让模型基于已缓存的前缀撰写结构化交接摘要，触发比例、摘要模板、显示样式与逐预设生效范围均可配置。安装重启 DSH 后接管；卸载即恢复DSH原生压缩。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版启动时自动最大化主窗口，等价于手动点一次最大化按钮。跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），尽力而为，host-only 插件。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.
description.zh: 通过 Jev 调整主会话推理投入而不换模型，为 fresh 子任务独立选择并应用能力与投入，展示决策分布并收集逐回复资源分配反馈。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Keeps the Auto permission preset across DSH restarts: the auto-review unload migration no longer rewrites a live Auto Session to Full access during application shutdown, and a stored Auto Session no longer fails to open when its integration is absent.
description.zh: 让「自动审批」熬过重启：应用退出时，自动审查的卸载迁移不再把在用的自动审批会话改写成「完全权限」；集成缺席时，存留的自动审批会话也不会打不开。

description.en: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
description.zh: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

description.en: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit backoff is capped and jittered, server retry hints are honored, and optional retry-until-success keeps going within a time ceiling. Every option is editable from the plugin config or the sidebar panel: retry count, initial and max delay, backoff factor and jitter, rate-limit delay window, retry-until-success ceiling, fallback trigger and switch cap, dead-route blacklist TTL, log file. When a route keeps failing it can switch to a pinned, allowlist-filtered, or catalog-picked alternate model route, with a 30-minute dead-route blacklist (auth failure, subscription expired, billing) and a stale-assembly guard that keeps retried requests on the switched route. Ships a right-sidebar panel with live retry state, route labels and incident counters, Chinese and English locale, and memory-only logging by default.
description.zh: 自动重试断连类模型失败（传输中断、超时、限流、5xx、流中断），在同一次智能体回合内接管重试而不是让任务直接断掉。所有选项都能在插件配置或右侧栏面板里调整：重试次数、初始与最大延迟、退避系数与抖动、限流延迟窗口、一直重试的时间上限、换路线的触发条件与次数上限、死路黑名单时长、日志文件。限流按指数退避等待并尊重服务端重试提示，开启后可在时间上限内一直重试直到成功。路线持续失败时可自动切换到备选模型路线（可手工固定、白名单过滤或从模型目录挑选），死路（鉴权失败、订阅过期、欠费）拉黑 30 分钟，并有旧装配守卫保证重试请求确实走在新路线上。附右侧栏状态面板（重试状态、路线标签、事故计数），中英双语，默认仅内存日志、可选设置文件。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job or subagent still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions without the switch never start one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务或子代理（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Persistent concurrent node-graph workflows for DeepSeek Harness with agent, command, HTTP, human, fan-out/join, gate, and subworkflow nodes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久化并发节点图工作流，支持 agent、命令、HTTP、人工、fan-out/join、gate 与子工作流节点。

description.en: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.
description.zh: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or interval schedule; a left-rail panel and five agent tools manage the same rule set.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only. One thing to know: every launch of the DSH desktop app writes a fresh identity cookie into its own profile and never prunes the old ones, so after enough launches the cookie header outgrows the request limit and the next start dies with HTTP 431 and `Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`, with no window at all. Restarting by hand runs into this too; this plugin simply restarts far more often, so it brings that day closer.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。一点须知：DSH 桌面端每次启动都会往自己的 profile 里写一份新的身份 cookie，旧的不清理；攒多了会让下一次启动报 HTTP 431 与 Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed，窗口出不来。手动重启同样会遇到，这是 DSH 自身的行为；本插件重启更频繁，只是让这一天来得更早。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it; where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor, and it never starts a second host next to a running one. It also fixes a common one: stale login cookies pile up on every launch until the request header overflows and the host will not start; the plugin clears them before each restart. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins - 2 are kept by default, up to 10 are allowed, and old or incomplete ones are pruned. That snapshot is never applied automatically: the plugin does not watch the host and does not restore anything on its own; it is only there for you to look at, or to roll back by hand. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off, so nobody has to stay up at night. It works on the Windows desktop client, and on a hosted dsh web instance - verified on WSL with systemd; Windows-hosted web, WSL without systemd, and native Linux are untested.
description.zh: 重启不丢工作：等所有对话空闲后自动重启，重启后接着干、不中断；已有守护的机器交给守护重启，绝不双开。 还顺手治一个常见毛病：反复启动攒下的过期登录 cookie 会把请求头撑爆、让 DSH 起不来，插件在每次重启前先清掉它们。 每次重启前自动备份配置和已装插件，默认留 2 份、最多 10 份，旧的和不完整的自动清理。 这份备份不会被自动使用：插件不监视宿主、不自动还原，它只是给你留一份可以手工翻回去的存档。 所有工作完成后倒数关机，晚上无需人值守。 桌面客户端可用；dsh web 托管端已在 WSL（有 systemd）上验证；Windows 上的 web、无 systemd 的 WSL、原生 Linux 尚未验证。

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it at; includes presets, a playback bar with pause and sentence skipping, tone and speed controls, and one-click launching of that service.
description.zh: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并可用系统语音或你自己指定的本地 TTS 服务朗读回复；含预设、带暂停与上下句的播放控制条、语气与语速调节，以及一键启动该服务。

description.en: Ultra-lean coding preset for DSH that eliminates orchestration overhead and pre-action chatter for surgical edits and fast tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简预设插件：消除编排开销与前置报幕废话，专注外科手术式精准修改与高效工具执行。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the previous turn, and the next step boundary commits that held summary as a checkpoint with zero model calls, so the swap itself takes milliseconds. /bcompact \[message] starts the same generation on demand and then sends the message. A settings page sets the trigger ratio, the summarization model, and how many consecutive failures stop background generation until a half-open probe gets through. Subagent sessions, a changed prefix or an expired summary fall back to the built-in synchronous path.
description.zh: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact \[消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘要模型，以及连续失败多少次后停止后台生成（熔断打开后按冷却放行一次探针以自愈）。子代理会话、前缀已变动或摘要过期时，回退到内置的同步压缩路径。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: Two gates for outbound AI text. (1) Guard: before any text goes out it blocks the shapes anyone could write — padding verbs plus abstract nouns ("optimised the code structure"), hollow adjectives, universal filler, template openers, git commit/PR/review boilerplate, comments that narrate the code. Covers chat, comments, email, commit messages, PR descriptions, reviews, issues, docs and code comments. Passes with OK, blocks with one line naming what to change. (2) Catch memes: when someone drops a slang term the model does not guess or look it up — it already knows. A built-in 6792-entry meme wiki is queried before the model starts thinking, and the entry usage field ("how to answer this") goes straight into context. Matches only exact title/slug/alias hits, never fuzzy, so ordinary chat never triggers it. Bundled SQLite by node:sqlite, zero dependencies, 1.6ms per query. Settings page: guard on/off, strict mode, prompt section toggle, meme wiki toggle, per-turn auto-lookup, a four-step tone slider (reserved / measured / follow the room / unrestrained) that is behavioural rather than a label, AI-completion switch (off by default, uses the session own model so no API key needed), a paste-and-test box, and three thresholds. No model call for any check.
description.zh: 管 AI 对外说话的两道门。一、守门：发出去之前拦掉「谁都能说」的形状——空转（动词配宏观名词，如「优化了代码结构」）、空形容词、万能话、模板开场白、git commit/PR/review 的套话、把代码念一遍的注释。聊天、评论、邮件、commit message、PR 描述、review、issue、文档、代码注释都覆盖。过了回 OK，没过回一行说明怎么改。二、接梗：对方抛出网络梗时不猜、不联网搜——内置 6792 条梗词库，在模型开始思考之前就查好，把词条的「用法」字段（这个梗该怎么接）直接塞进上下文。只认标题/slug/别名的精确命中，不做模糊匹配，所以日常闲聊不会误触发。词库用 Node 自带 node:sqlite，零依赖，单次查询 1.6ms。设置页：守门开关、严格模式、提示节开关、梗库开关、每轮自动查、四档玩梗尺度滑杆（很收着/有点度/跟着玩/放得开，写行为不写标签）、AI 接话开关（默认关，走会话自己的模型不用填 key）、粘一段当场试、三个阈值。所有判断都在本地跑，不调模型。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Pins your DeepSeek Harness account balance to the bottom-right corner and refreshes it every 60 seconds, with a click for an immediate lookup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻账户余额，60 秒自动刷新，点击即可立即查询。

description.en: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
description.zh: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.
description.zh: 余额看板，可以添加多个按量计费/Token plan，同时查询余额。

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: A simple, information-dense DeepSeek status display for the DSH sidebar: balance, usage, and peak/off-peak countdown. Requires the DSH Web GUI with a signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中显示 DeepSeek 余额、用量和峰谷倒计时，简约直观。需要 DSH Web 界面并已登录 DeepSeek 账户。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation: ingest CAMT.053 and MT940, match them against ledger entries and export the workpaper — 6 `bankrec.*` tools.
description.zh: 银行对账单核对：导入 CAMT.053 与 MT940，与账簿条目匹配并导出工作底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
description.zh: DSH 权限守卫：原生权限菜单里的四范围读写执行权限位，bash 命令可选 Jev 语义分类层。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Let Claude Code or Codex do the thinking: understand the request, write a clear prompt for DeepSeek Harness to do the work, and review the result. dsh-baton runs your tests itself, lists what changed, and has a sub-agent check every requirement, so your main model only reads the result and decides. Codex waits in one call of up to 59 minutes, with no hook to trust and nothing to poll; you can change the request while it runs, and name the Harness model for a task. On big jobs it saves most of your plan's quota.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 或 Codex 负责动脑：理解需求，写好 prompt 交给 DeepSeek Harness 去干活，最后把关。dsh-baton 会自己跑测试、列出改了哪些文件，再派一个子代理逐条核对需求，你的主力模型只看结果拍板。Codex 一次等待最长 59 分钟，不用信任钩子，也不用轮询；运行中可以随时改需求，也可以指定这次用 Harness 的哪个模型。大任务能省下大半订阅额度。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Beads issue-graph panel in the left sidebar of the Web GUI: filter ready, in-progress, open, and all beads, read a bead's description, notes, dependencies, and comments, and create, claim, or close beads through the bd CLI. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a workspace with a Beads database.
description.zh: Web 界面左侧栏的 Beads 任务图谱面板：按可领取、进行中、待处理、全部筛选，查看任务描述、备注、依赖与评论，并通过 bd CLI 新建、领取或关闭任务。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 数据库的工作区。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-click, skip, paging and the countdown working as before, and only claims generic choice cards, not plan review or approval cards. Supports DSH 0.2.x from 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20+. Derived from buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note (MIT) and inspired by MichengAI/dsh-btw (Apache-2.0); do not install it together with dsh-question-note — both take over the same ask_user_question card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上的 0.2.x（已在 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20+。由 buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note（MIT）派生、并受 MichengAI/dsh-btw（Apache-2.0）启发；不要与 dsh-question-note 同装——两者会接管同一张 ask_user_question 卡片。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.
description.zh: 分区更清晰的 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏，内置时钟、余额等小组件。

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Update checker for plugin bundles installed in a DSH profile: a Version section on the detail page of a plugin installed from a GitHub repository or release tarball compares the installed commit or version with the exact target, and the /plugin-updater commands list bundles, check npm, Git-repository and GitHub-release sources, and prepare an update that runs only after confirmation; a read-only plugin_updates tool lets an agent check without installing, npm registry packages keep DSH native update controls, a fixed version or commit stays pinned unless explicitly allowed, and the plugin never approves build scripts.
description.zh: 检查 DSH profile 内已装插件包更新的工具：从 GitHub 仓库或 release tarball 安装的插件，其详情页会出现 Version 分区，把已装 commit 或版本与确切目标版本对照；/plugin-updater 命令可列出插件包、检查 npm、Git 仓库与 GitHub release 三种来源并生成待确认的更新，确认后才执行；只读的 plugin_updates 工具让 Agent 只检查而不安装，npm registry 包继续使用 DSH 原生更新方式，固定版本或 commit 需显式允许才会升级，且本插件从不代为批准构建脚本。

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with uncompleted/completed filters and incremental loading, items that open read-only with an edit toggle in the corner, image attachments that zoom in place and other files that download, a pomodoro timer (15/30/45/60 or custom, with configurable rounds and break interval) that sends a Windows notification and waits for confirmation before the next phase, and five agent tools plus a /todo slash command for reading and editing the list.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板——窗口可拖动并吸附屏幕四边，首页按「今天/更多」分组，另有全部事项标签页（未完成/已完成筛选、增量加载），条目默认只读查看、点右上角「编辑」才可修改，图片附件点击放大、其它附件点击下载，内置番茄钟（15/30/45/60 或自定义，可设轮数与休息间隔）到点推送 Windows 通知并在进入下一阶段前等待确认，另提供 5 个 agent 工具与 /todo 斜杠命令读写任务。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

description.en: Makes the dsh-pet desktop pet read model replies aloud in its own configured voice. Newer dsh-pet gets the whole text in one request (up to its 500-char cap); older versions automatically fall back to 60-char chunks. Each piece is verified against the pet log to confirm it actually played.
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用设置页里选定的音色朗读模型输出。新版桌宠整段一次下发（受其单次 500 字上限约束），旧版自动按 60 字切段兜底；每一段都回读桌宠日志，确认真的念了出来。

description.en: Bilibili live-room danmaku for DSH: read live chat, send messages only after explicit confirm, hang out in a room in the background, optionally let the model decide whether to reply, and optionally transcribe stream audio to text; no video understanding. Setup needs a Python 3 venv with the bundled requirements plus Bilibili cookies; transcription additionally needs ffmpeg and a Whisper engine.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站直播弹幕插件：看弹幕、确认后才发弹幕、挂机听、可选 AI 自动接话与可选语音转写；不抽帧、不做视觉理解。使用前需自建 Python 3 虚拟环境并装好仓库里的 requirements，发弹幕需 B 站凭证；语音转写另需 ffmpeg 与 Whisper 引擎。

description.en: A whale-maid with a jar, sitting in the corner of your DSH window. She goes exploring on Bilibili for whatever you are into, ranks by like, coin and favourite rate rather than view count, and brings back pickled snacks that suit your taste. When a term runs dry she takes another route. Five picks go into the jar, and she tells you what each video is about. News-type axes keep only the last two weeks; game guides and music have no limit, and each axis decides for itself.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘带着一个罐子，守在右下角。按照你的兴趣，她会去 B 站探险，按赞币藏率排，给你找一些符合口味的电子榨菜。哪个词搜得少，她换条路再找。回来把五条装进罐子里，然后和你说说这些视频讲了什么。时政这类她只留最近两周，游戏攻略和音乐不限时间，每根轴她自己定。

description.en: Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term summaries. It filters videos to your taste, creates Markdown digests, and can watch comments and reply for you. In Circle Mode, it replies only inside threads explicitly invited by the video uploader in a top-level comment — ordinary viewer requests do not count, and it never starts a new top-level comment. Commenting, DMs, auto-run, and comment watch are off by default. Needs Node 22, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+, a signed-in Bilibili account, a model route and Python.
description.zh: 让蓝色大肥鱼替你刷 B 站：帮你评论，把发现的有趣内容私信给你，还会写下日记；它也有记忆，能长期总结。视频按你的口味筛选并生成 Markdown 日报，也能守着评论区替你回话。开启「圈地自萌」后，它只回视频 UP 主本人主动邀请的楼中楼，普通观众喊话不算，绝不自己起新楼；评论、私信、自动运行和守护默认关闭。需 Node 22、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+、已登录的 B 站账号、模型线路与 Python。

description.en: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.
description.zh: 派子代理去刷 B站，回报值得看的视频，带每条视频的笔记、卡片墙，以及 @/回复/私信转发的收件箱。

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: Adds paragraph-by-paragraph translation and a bilingual view to assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: each Chinese paragraph gets an English translation underneath and each English paragraph gets a Chinese one underneath, behind a session-header toggle; code blocks and formulas stay untranslated, and tables get a translated copy underneath. Translations come from the DeepSeek API (the plugin reuses DSH's saved DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, or a key you paste in its settings), so it needs network access and each uncached paragraph is a billable request.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的助手回复加逐段翻译与中英双语对照：中文段落下补英文、英文段落下补中文，会话头部有开关；代码块、公式不翻译，表格会生成一张完整的译文表附在下方。译文由 DeepSeek API 生成（插件复用 DSH 已保存的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，也可在设置里粘贴 Key），需要联网，每段未命中缓存的文本都会产生一次计费请求。

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Adds a 12-hour peak/off-peak billing strip and the account balance above the composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示以当前为中心的 12 小时峰谷条形与账户余额，可切换今日、近 7 日、近 30 日查看各模型花费。

description.en: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend from platform's usage endpoints, and the whole-conversation total is folded read-only from the local session log. Zero dependencies (node:https + node:zlib), writes nothing to disk.
description.zh: 输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https + node:zlib），不写任何文件。

description.en: Local billing dashboard for DSH model calls: multi-platform provider/model breakdowns of calls, tokens and spend, peak/off-peak pricing, manual CSV price import with peak windows, official-bill reconciliation, and HTML/PDF/CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 本地计费面板：多平台、按平台/模型明细汇总调用次数、token 与花费，支持峰谷/阶梯计价、CSV 人工导入价格（含峰时窗口）、官方账单对齐，以及 HTML/PDF/CSV 导出。

description.en: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.
description.zh: 把 AIGC 创作直接放进 DeepSeek Harness：用开源与闭源模型生成图像、视频、音频与 3D，含参数 schema、费用预估、审批与任务面板。

description.en: Opens a full-screen 3-D black-hole stage from a sidebar card, where 24,514 real internet radio stations orbit inside an accretion disc; drag to orbit, hold to cross a wormhole into a star cluster, click a star to play, with search, 13 genre filters, favourites and ICY now-playing titles.
description.zh: 从左栏卡片打开全屏 3D 黑洞舞台，2.45 万台真实网络电台嵌在吸积盘里环绕运行；拖动环绕、按住穿过虫洞进入星团、点星点播放，带搜索、13 个流派筛选、收藏与流内 ICY 曲目信息。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent drive a local Blender over a direct TCP channel with 15 tools: viewport frames, custom-angle renders, Python execution, headless and job offload, transaction rollback, and a planning layer of 228 ops across 34 families.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 通过直连 TCP 通道驱动本地 Blender，提供 15 个工具：视口帧、自定义视角渲染、Python 执行、无头与作业卸载、事务回滚，以及 34 个 family / 228 个 op 的规划层。

description.en: AI-managed Auto Compact for DeepSeek Harness: in the Block PTC preset (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer), the agent decides when to organize context and what to retain as work progresses, without waiting for a fixed token threshold.
description.zh: AI 自主管理上下文的 Auto Compact：在 Block PTC 预设会话中（需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上），由 AI 根据任务进展决定何时整理上下文、保留哪些信息，不必等待固定 token 阈值触发。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: fifteen variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender, mint, tangerine, silverrose, dawn, osmanthus) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even; twelve are featured in the top-bar switcher, grouped by color family, and all 30 foreground/background pairs are measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十五款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender、草色 mint、橙黄 tangerine、银红 silverrose、粉霞 dawn、轻黄 osmanthus）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变；顶栏切换器精选 12 套并按色系相邻排列，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，30 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Blue-team defense mode for CTF and incident response: 36 defensive tools, six worker roles, SQLite findings and tasks, an optional decoy server, deception/honeypot workflows, and a standalone console with full view.
description.zh: CTF 网络攻防蓝队防御模式：36 个防御工具、六个执行角色、SQLite 事实库与任务队列，可选诱饵程序、欺骗防御与蜜罐闭环，以及带全面浏览的独立控制台。

description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills come in the package, and each module can be turned off by writing the disabled flag into the profile patch.
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Startup animation and chat wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-act boot animation with custom animation import and three configurable transitions (first-act entry, act join, second-act exit), plus static-image and muted loop-video chat backgrounds (Wallpaper Engine project folders, custom video directories, random rotation, per-video delete).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸插件：两幕冷启动动画，支持导入自定义动画与三段自定义转场（第一幕入场、两幕衔接、第二幕退场）；聊天背景支持静态底图与静音循环视频（识别壁纸引擎项目文件夹、自定义视频目录、随机轮换、单个删除）。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.
description.zh: DS Bot 团队的一块浮动看板：谁在跑、在跑什么工具，谁在等别的 Bot 交活，谁在等你批或等你答，谁报错了；带按发送方分组的交接表、显示待批命令或待答问题的单个 Bot 抽屉，收起后是一条状态胶囊。只读，不写 DS Bot 的数据。需要先装 DS Bot（按 0.1.7 与 0.2.0 开发）；没有 DS Bot 时面板不显示。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: A second brain for DeepSeek Harness where Markdown is the database and git is the sync, with zero runtime dependencies. Core memory is injected into every system prompt, one file per note with weighted search; cards produced in the sidebar web chat land in an inbox first and are approved one by one as cloud notes or local-only notes (private/ is permanently gitignored and never pushed); web-chat progress is saved to progress.md with the last 20 drafts archived. A four-step flow lives behind one header icon: open web chat, extract cards, review them, back up to the cloud. The extraction prompt is editable in the panel and applies immediately.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的第二大脑：Markdown 当数据库，零运行时依赖。核心记忆常驻系统提示，一张卡一个文件并可全文检索；侧栏网页版拆好的卡片先进收件箱，逐张人工确认后「存到云端」或「只存本地」（private/ 被 .gitignore 永久排除，绝不推送）；网页版对话进度存成 progress.md，旧稿归档保留 20 份。云端可三选一：Git 仓库、OneDrive 等同步盘文件夹、只存本机。安装后首次启动有一页新手引导。会话顶栏四步流水线：打开网页版 → 整理成卡片 → 逐张确认 → 备份到云端。拆卡提示词可在面板里直接改，改完立即生效。

description.en: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted local branch up under refs/backup/branch-cleaner/ (deleting remote branches has no backup).
description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.
description.zh: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

description.en: Makes 1080x1920 vertical promo videos from a storyboard JSON with 7 tools (doctor, setup, catalog, guide, validate, render, verify), rendered locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 从分镜 JSON 生成 1080×1920 竖版宣传片，含 7 个工具（doctor、setup、catalog、guide、validate、render、verify），用 Remotion 本地渲染。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.
description.zh: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

description.en: Bookmark manager for the sidebar browser: toolbar star button, dropdown list with one-click navigation, inline editing and reordering.
description.zh: 侧边栏浏览器的书签管理器：工具栏星标按钮，下拉列表一键打开书签，支持就地编辑与排序。

description.en: Visible agent browser for DSH over CDP, also driving egolite, Tabbit, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Lightpanda backends. Only bcdp_status stays resident (401 chars); the other 33 context-optimized bcdp_* tools unlock per activity batch, so non-browser sessions pay no schema tax (-91.9% measured). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices; non-CDP channels (ego CLI / Tabbit CLI) sync frames by 3s polling. Cross-version support for DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 (exact enumeration of 10 rc).
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入），同时驱动 egolite、Tabbit、Chrome、Edge、Brave 与 Lightpanda 后端。常驻只有 bcdp_status（401 字符），其余 33 个经过上下文优化的 bcdp_* 工具按活动批次解锁——不碰浏览器的会话不缴 schema token 税（实测 -91.9%）。实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；非 CDP 通道（ego CLI / Tabbit CLI）以 3s 轮询同步画面。DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 跨版本支持（精确枚举 10 个 rc）。
