description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: Cuigengji, your fiction-writing assistant and editor: organize settings, develop plots, draft chapters, and revise prose with AI. Share plot canvases, character cards, and worldbooks while you choose the direction, style, and what stays in the story.
description.zh: 催更姬｜你的小说助手与编辑。AI 帮你：理设定、推剧情、起草正文、润色改稿。共用剧情画布、角色卡与世界书，边讨论边创作。你定方向、文风和内容取舍，AI 协助把故事写下去。

description.en: Math-modeling contest workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar P0–P7 progress board and traceable facts ledger, one-click render/check/layout/compile, PDF preview, and human sign-off; paired with the math-modeling-cumcm skill. Requires the math-modeling-cumcm skill's scripts (set skillDir), Python 3.10+ and XeLaTeX with ctex/xeCJK; fully verified only on Windows 11 + MiKTeX.
description.zh: 国赛论文工作台：侧栏展示 P0–P7 进度与可追溯的 facts 台账，一键执行 render/check/layout/编译，预览 PDF，并支持人工签字；配套 math-modeling-cumcm skill。需配置该技能的脚本（skillDir）、Python 3.10+ 与 XeLaTeX + ctex/xeCJK 环境，目前仅在 Windows 11 + MiKTeX 完整实测。

description.en: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with CLI readiness and proxy diagnostics, child-model settings, and a read-only connectivity test.
description.zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供命令行就绪/代理诊断、子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Adds configurable HTTP header profiles that can be selected per model.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
description.zh: 所有工作区共用的长期系统提示词：在 DSH 自己的设置面板里新增「自定义指令」页，文本会加入每个会话（含子代理）的系统提示词，并保存在 profile 而不是任何项目里。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性检查：按规则 ID 输出字段级发现。

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: IM stand-in seat for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel polls Feishu/Lark, WeCom and DingTalk (switched on from the panel) through the platform CLI you are already logged in to, and wakes the DSH session you bound when a new message arrives, so that session reads it and replies as you — drafts are shown to you first unless you have explicitly allowed sending without confirmation. Groups are polled only after you add them to the watch list, and by default only @-mentions wake the agent; blocked chats are never fetched, message bodies stay in a local state file, and the plugin opens no port of its own.
description.zh: 把「替你值守 IM」做成 DSH 侧边栏的常驻席位：复用本机已登录的飞书/Lark、企业微信、钉钉（需在面板里先启用）CLI 按节奏拉取会话，新消息进来就唤醒你绑定的 DSH 会话，由它读上下文、以你本人的语气起草回复；默认先把草稿给你看，你明确说全自动才直接发出。群要你加进值守名单才开始轮询，且默认只有 @你 的消息唤醒 agent；屏蔽的会话永不拉取，消息正文只留在本机状态文件里，插件不开任何端口。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: Cloudflare D1 数据库工具：d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，通过 D1 HTTP API 访问，默认只读（SQLite 语义的词法级只读保护）、LIMIT 行数上限、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Adds a fish-ear microphone to DSH that transcribes speech locally, estimates tone and emotion, and lets BigFish reply with an emotion-aware prompt.
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加一个鱼耳麦克风，本地转写语音、估计语气与情绪，并让大肥鱼按情绪自然回复。

description.en: A persistent AI companion for DSH that explores Bilibili, interacts with permission controls, and grows through evidence-backed life memories, evolving interests, simulated emotions, social relationships, and autonomous to-dos.
description.zh: 让 DSH AI 角色自主探索 B站并按权限互动，从真实经历中沉淀长期记忆，逐渐形成兴趣、模拟情绪和好友关系，同时管理自主待办。

description.en: A desktop pet for DSH: a blue whale girl with 104 animations and built-in voice. It is standalone, but its pet runtime is a rework of dsh-dafeiyu — disable the upstream dsh-dafeiyu before installing, or both will run and fight over the control port. Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads about 580 MB of assets.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：蓝色鲸鱼娘，自带 104 个动作与内置语音。插件独立，但桌宠运行时基于 dsh-dafeiyu 改造——安装前需先禁用上游 dsh-dafeiyu，否则两只同开会抢控制口；仅支持 Windows x64，首次启动需下载约 580MB 素材。

description.en: An animated cat companion for the DSH chat UI. It reacts to session states, shows editable click-to-read lines and per-turn token counts, and supports dragging with a squish effect, left/right flipping and Ctrl+wheel resizing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面显示呆猫桌宠：跟随会话状态切换动画，点击展示可编辑台词，每轮结束显示 token 用量；支持拖动压扁回弹、左右翻转及 Ctrl+滚轮缩放。

description.en: Tarot daily-luck plugin: enter your birthday, draw one of 22 Major Arcana, get five-dimension scores and a concrete answer to your question.
description.zh: 今日好运来临：写入生日，抽一张大阿尔卡纳，得到事业/感情/财运/身心/交际五维评分，并针对你的问题给出具体回答。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.
description.zh: 道一-易经推演：通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）。六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），强关联一票否决，内置电机设计/股票趋势/商业成功率剧本，纯 JS 零求解器依赖。免费档每日限 9 次推演，激活码可提升；stock-trend 剧本会按请求里的股票代码向腾讯行情接口拉取实时行情。

description.en: Answers Dark Souls III questions from your own Windows PC save (default `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`): level and stats, current area, bonfires/rings/spells/covenants counted by family, kill state for the 24 bosses, and Steam achievements when Steam is installed - exposed as model tools plus a progress pill beside the composer and a 19-area sidebar page with next-step suggestions. The save stays read-only and is parsed locally by a bundled Python 3 script; Python 3 and the `cryptography` package must be installed, and the game data ships with the plugin.
description.zh: 读你自己的《黑暗之魂3》Windows 存档（默认 `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`）回答问题：等级与属性、当前区域、按家族统计的篝火/戒指/法术/誓约完成度、24 个 Boss 的击杀状态，装有 Steam 时还包括 Steam 成就；以模型工具提供，另配输入框旁的进度药丸和 19 区域侧栏页。存档只读，由随包提供的 Python 3 脚本本地解析；运行前需装好 Python 3 与 `cryptography`，游戏数据随插件分发。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏只读预览 SQLite 文件与 MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server 连接：表、分页数据、列、索引，列宽可拖动，从不写库。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Five-layer persona (L1–L5), event memory with FTS5 plus Dice retrieval, cognitive filter, skill cards with auto-frozen asset packs, millisecond reflex rules, three-tier safety degradation, a read-only brain star map, and an optional VPet-Simulator MOD bridge.
description.zh: 五层人格（L1–L5）、事件记忆（FTS5 与 Dice 混合检索）、认知滤网、技能卡与自固化资产包、毫秒级条件反射、三档安全降级、只读脑星图，另附可选的 VPet-Simulator 桌宠 MOD 桥。

description.en: Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供安全且可审计的 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 访问：schema 内省、强制只读查询、写审批门与持久化 JSONL SQL 审计追踪。

description.en: Database workbench inside DSH: import the connections DBeaver already stores (data-sources.json, decrypting saved passwords locally) or register SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle sources by hand, then hand them to the agent through eight mcp__db__ tools — list_datasources, list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, execute_sql, explain_query, get_ddl and test_connection. Sources start read-only; one global switch enables INSERT/UPDATE/DDL, every call is row-capped and appended to a JSONL audit log. Also covers groups, bulk actions, a read-only schema browser and a bundled Python MCP server whose dependencies install from the panel. No DSH files to edit.
description.zh: DSH 里的数据库工作台：可以直接导入 DBeaver 已有的连接（读 data-sources.json，本地解密已保存的口令），也可以手工登记 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Oracle 数据源，然后交给智能体通过 8 个 mcp__db__ 工具使用——list_datasources、list_tables、describe_table、sample_rows、execute_sql、explain_query、get_ddl、test_connection。数据源默认只读，一个全局开关才放开 INSERT/UPDATE/DDL；每次调用都限制行数并写入 JSONL 审计日志。另有分组、批量操作、只读结构浏览，以及依赖可在面板一键安装的内置 Python MCP 服务。不需要改 DSH 的任何文件。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

description.en: Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
description.zh: 把 DBHub MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的数据库插件：按工作区 × 环境配置 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 SQL Server 连接，让 Agent 通过固定 4 个工具配置连接、列出数据源、执行 SQL、搜索 SQLite 对象。密码与完整连接串由用户在设置界面输入、不作为工具参数接收，模型只看到 mysql://host:3306/db 这类元数据；每个环境可设为只读（模型只能开启、不能关闭）或经手动 SSH 隧道访问。每次调用独立启动一条用完即退的 dbhub 进程，未安装 dbhub 时自动安装。

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

description.en: System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness, 4 questions asked before tool calling (risk reversible, relevance, injection suspension) and allow/ask/reject action. Needs an API key for a system-one compatible provider; decision requests are sent there.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 System-1 决策守卫：在每次工具调用前问模型四个问题 （风险、可逆性、任务相关性、注入嫌疑），据此放行、询问或拦截。

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by estimated size (internal up to 5 minutes, shown without approval up to 20, approval required beyond); and asking about unclear intent instead of guessing. Waiting is limited in code by wrapping the official shell, job and question tools: foreground commands move to background jobs after 30 s (configurable), a steered user message ends the current wait so the model reads it, foreground pauses over 5 s and long timers in run_code are refused, and questions run in timed mode. The mode derives its preset from the official PTC declaration shipped by the installed Harness and inherits upstream composition changes, so an official PTC update — including removed or renamed modules — does not break existing sessions. A settings card selects the preset executor — Automatic, WSL Bash, Windows PowerShell, native Zsh or native Bash.
description.zh: 深度PTC模式是 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 Agent preset：保留内置 PTC 的工具面，把人设换成一份工作契约——写明 DeepSeek 身份与无限 token 预算，要求不为省 token 跳过读取、命令和验证；按预计耗时分档计划（5 分钟内直接做，5–20 分钟告知计划但不等审批，超过 20 分钟需批准）；意图不清时先提问而不是猜测。等待由代码限制：包装官方的命令、job 与提问工具，前台命令超过 30 秒（可配置）自动转为后台 job，用户插入消息时立即结束当前等待让模型读到消息，前台超过 5 秒的暂停和 run_code 中的长定时器被拒绝，提问采用限时模式。该模式在加载时从已安装 Harness 声明的官方 PTC 预设派生组成并继承上游变更，官方对 PTC 的增删改（包括移除或改名的模块）不会破坏已有会话。设置卡片可选择该预设的执行器——自动、WSL Bash、Windows PowerShell、原生 Zsh 或原生 Bash。

description.en: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.
description.zh: 让桌宠鲸鱼娘自主刷 B站：自己搜片、读字幕原文，经你允许后发评论、发动态，并写日报、做视频。c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（MIT）的维护分支，新增逐项授权、记忆、表情与本地视频制作；与上游注册同名的 bili_* 工具，不能与 dsh-bili-scroll 同装。视频制作需要 Python 3.11–3.13（或 uv），首次使用时自动安装媒体依赖。

description.en: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.
description.zh: 五种模式精读图书与文章（快速/深度/知识地图/费曼/全书），输出观点—证据—数据报告、四档置信度、Mermaid/XMind 思维导图，支持批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，可导出 MD/MM/HTML。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中提供 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 Harness 工作区之间的切换。

description.en: Sidebar footer widget that shows DeepSeek service health: a status dot plus the live latency of four probes (API, chat, docs, status page) run from this machine, with a popover listing official component statuses read from status.deepseek.com. Refresh cadence 15s-2min.
description.zh: 左侧栏底部的一行状态挂件：绿点加本机四项探针（API、网页、文档、状态页）的实时延迟，点开弹出卡片看官方组件状态。刷新间隔 15 秒到 2 分钟可选。

description.en: Sticker library for DeepSeek Harness: a composer button opens two bundled packs (10 GPT-drawn plus 8 community fan-art), one click sends a 180px sticker, and a send_sticker tool lets the model understand and reply with stickers.
description.zh: DSH 表情包库：输入区按钮打开默认表情（10 张 GPT 绘制）与社区二创梗图（8 张）两个包，点一下发送 180px 贴纸，模型也能通过 send_sticker 理解并回发表情。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Registers DeepSeek Search and Fetch API providers for the ctx.web seam, replacing both the web_search and web_fetch backends with DeepSeek's Search and Fetch JSON APIs, with configurable retries and backoff, settings that apply to the next call, and a configuration page on the bundle page. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a DeepSeek API key with access to /v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/fetch (calls are billed by DeepSeek; account sign-in is not supported).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 接缝上注册 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 的搜索与抓取 provider，用 DeepSeek 的 Search / Fetch JSON API 替换 web_search 与 web_fetch 两个后端；支持可配置的重试与退避、下次调用即生效的实时设置，以及 bundle 详情页里的配置页。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，以及一个可访问 /v1/tools/search 与 /v1/tools/fetch 的 DeepSeek API key（调用由 DeepSeek 计费；不支持账号登录）。

description.en: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

description.en: A fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web that bridges the DeepSeek web client into DSH, so short-context conversations, workflows and skill packs run without an API key, and a picture pasted in DSH gets read for free. Ships a floating ball plus sidebar, one-click login that stays logged in, and a right-click action that sends any selected text into the web input after clearing it. It keeps the upstream provider id deepseek-web, so it cannot be installed next to another plugin that owns the same provider. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1. Reuses your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com session (needs Chrome/Edge/Brave/Chromium or a managed browser download); this may violate DeepSeek's terms and risks rate limiting or a ban. Cannot be installed alongside y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web.
description.zh: y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork：把 DeepSeek 网页版桥接进 DSH，不花 API 额度就能跑短上下文对话、工作流与技能包，直接发图片也能免费识图。带悬浮球与侧边栏，一键登录后长期保持登录；正文任意文字右键即可投送到网页端输入框，投送前自动清空原输入框。沿用上游 provider id deepseek-web，不能与占用同一 provider 的其他插件同时安装。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。复用你自己已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 会话（需 Chrome/Edge/Brave/Chromium 或由插件下载托管浏览器），可能违反 DeepSeek 服务条款，有限流/封禁风险；不能与 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 同装。

description.en: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
description.zh: 新增 deepseek-web provider，把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端模型接入 DSH：浏览器登录抓取、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输与基于提示词的工具调用。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: Reads the session files forty-two other coding agents on this machine already wrote (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more), including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 读取本机上其他四十二个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等），包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页中归档、恢复并删除会话。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Turns a repository and a running system into acceptance material - database design, design specs, a user manual with screenshots, and test / go-live / acceptance reports. Sections follow GB/T 8567-88; anything it cannot verify is left blank instead of invented. Requires Python 3 with python-docx for .docx output, and Google Chrome for automatic screenshots.
description.zh: 把代码仓库与运行中的系统变成验收材料：数据库设计、概要设计、详细设计、带截图的使用说明书，以及测试报告、上线报告、验收报告。章节按 GB/T 8567-88 组织，无法核实的字段与结论一律留空，不编造。需 Python 3 与 python-docx 生成 .docx，自动截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. Its tools sit in floating groups at the canvas corners and a bottom dock with text labels, and a home screen offers one prompt box, recent designs and large template cards. When the home screen's style is Auto, the plugin picks a style card that fits the subject and hands its colors and fonts to the model; your own words, a chosen card, a reference image or a default brand design system take precedence. Each design gets its own folder. When a design needs photos, the model can copy from a library of 64 AI-generated placeholder images in 8 themes (about 8 MB, downloaded from npm the first time they are needed; made with OpenAI image generation and screened by a person, not real places, products or people); export and handoff remind you to replace them before launch. When the model builds web pages, app screens, desktop app windows, WeChat mini programs, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; while the model writes a page, the sidebar grows with it and a few cursors draw boxes, fill colors and type where it is writing, with a timer in the status bar; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact, and an existing HTML file or folder opens by browsing or by dragging it into the sidebar (desktop app). A design library gathers every design you made in any session, your saved inspiration (reference images, URLs, style cards) and a design market of shared templates, design systems and style cards (16 templates, 3 design systems and 20 style cards to start; search, filters, full-size screens and a live view; an offline copy ships with the plugin): start from one in a click, or share your own design to the market after a personal-data scan and an offline design check. Mini program screens get the WeChat capsule in the top-right corner, which turns white over a dark top bar, and the design check flags text and buttons hidden under it. App and mini program screens follow platform layout (status and nav bars, a tab bar of 2 to 5 items, safe areas), desktop app screens get macOS traffic lights or Windows caption buttons, and the design check flags content under the Dynamic Island, the home indicator or the window buttons. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer, or draw on the preview (pen, highlighter, arrow, box, circle, text) and hand the marked-up screenshot to the model; picks, markup and style changes appear in the composer as small chips while the model still gets the full text. It can extract a brand design system from your website or project (colors by role, fonts, type scale, radius, shadows, buttons, inputs and cards) and use it for every new design. The model adds a few tweak sliders to each design (spacing, radius, brand color, layout variants) that update all screens live and write back to the stylesheet in one click. A finished design can be turned into React, Vue, Next.js or plain HTML code, or for mini programs into uni-app or native WeChat code; existing uni-app (including HBuilderX projects without package.json), Taro and native mini program projects are recognized so new pages go straight in, and each built screen is diffed pixel by pixel against the design. Also has a design tokens panel, twenty style presets (each a live sample screen you can open full size), a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through try-it mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and seven tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model; extract_design_system builds a design system from a site or project; handoff_design writes a handoff pack (screenshots, routes, tokens, shared components); compare_design diffs the built local page against the design and marks what differs. find_photos copies matching placeholder photos from the photo library into the design. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the seven tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show. An experimental option, off by default, has the model also write business annotations (rules, states and edge cases the UI does not show), shown as numbered markers on the page and cards in the sidebar and passed on in code handoff.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。工具放在画布四角的浮块和底部工具坞里，按钮都带字；首页一个大输入框直接发，下面是最近的设计和模板大图。首页风格选「自动」时，插件按题材挑一张风格卡，把配色和字体交给模型；你在话里说了风格、手选了风格卡、放了参考图，或者有默认的品牌设计系统，就照你的来。每套设计一个文件夹。设计需要照片时，模型可以从照片库的 64 张 AI 生成示意图（8 类题材，约 8 MB，第一次用到时从 npm 下载；OpenAI 图像生成、人工挑选，不是真实的店铺、产品或人物）里取用；导出和转代码时会提醒上线前换掉。模型做网页、App 界面、桌面软件窗口、微信小程序、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；模型写页面时右侧栏跟着一段段长出来，几只鼠标在写到的地方拖框、刷色、打字，顶上状态条带计时；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常；已有的 HTML 文件或文件夹，点「浏览…」或拖进右侧栏就能打开（桌面版）。设计库里有你在各个会话做过的所有设计、收的灵感（参考图、网址、风格卡），还有设计市场：大家分享的模板、设计系统和风格卡（首批 16 套模板、3 套设计系统、20 张风格卡，能搜、能筛、看大图、实时看，插件自带离线目录），点一下就能拿来接着改；自己做的设计查过个人信息、断网体检后也能分享到市场。小程序屏画上微信右上角的胶囊，顶栏是深色时胶囊自动变白，设计体检会查出被胶囊挡住的字和按钮。App 和小程序按平台规矩画（状态栏、导航栏、2–5 项底部标签栏、安全区），桌面软件画上 Mac 红绿灯或 Windows 窗口按钮，体检会查出伸进灵动岛、底部横条或压在窗口按钮上的内容。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框；也能直接在预览上画（画笔、荧光笔、箭头、方框、圆圈、文字），把叠上标注的截图交给模型。点选、标注、调样式放进输入框都是一个小标签，模型照样拿到完整内容。能从你的官网或项目里提取品牌设计系统（按角色的配色、字体、字号阶梯、圆角、阴影，按钮、输入框、卡片的样子），以后做新设计都照它来；模型给每套设计配几个专属调节滑块（留白、圆角、主色、版式几选一），拖动时所有屏一起变，一键写回样式；做好的设计能转成 React / Vue / Next.js / 纯 HTML 代码，小程序能转成 uni-app 或微信原生小程序代码；认得出现有的 uni-app（包括 HBuilderX 建的、没有 package.json 的）、Taro 和原生小程序项目，新页面直接加进去；每屏做完和设计稿逐像素对比。另有设计变量面板、二十套风格卡（每张都是画好的一小屏样板，能点开看原大）、调样式面板（字号、颜色、圆角、内边距等，可以写回 HTML，或连同每项由哪条 CSS 规则、在第几行决定一起交给模型）、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片 / PDF / PPTX（屏和屏之间的跳转照样能点）、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击试用、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，以及设计体检（文字超出、截断、叠在一起，对比度、点击区大小等）。自带 ui-design 技能和七个工具：preview_page 打开预览；check_design 在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按真实尺寸量每一屏（顶栏底栏压住内容、脚本报错、资源没载到、死链；对比度和字号问题写明 CSS 文件和行号；严重问题附局部截图）；look_design 把真实截图交给模型；extract_design_system 从网站或项目提取设计系统；handoff_design 写交接包（每屏截图、路由、设计变量、该抽的组件）；compare_design 把做出来的本机页面和设计稿逐像素比，标出差在哪。find_photos 把合适的示意照片从照片库复制进设计。新会话可以选「设计模式」（标准模式的工具，加上这个技能、这七个工具和做设计的人设），各部分在插件页里各有开关。从手机或别的电脑打开 DSH 时，本地 HTML 做的设计打包进沙盒框里，照样能看。试验功能「业务标注」（默认关）打开后，模型会同时写下界面上看不出来的规则、状态和边界，页面上标编号、右侧栏列卡片，转代码时一起交给开发。

description.en: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

description.en: Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个登录自启开关：只管理用户启动文件夹里的一个快捷方式，不写注册表、不需要管理员权限、不额外常驻进程。

description.en: Windows-only desktop floating ball with a bilingual WebView2 quick-chat window, including in-window question and approval cards.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮球，内置中英文 WebView2 快捷聊天窗口，支持在窗口内回答提问和审批操作。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

description.en: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
description.zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏底部加两个圆形按钮：重启应用（全程不闪黑窗）和打开 DeepSeek 充值页。重启走 WMI + wscript 拉起 helper，新进程不继承控制台；动手前会先核对可执行文件路径，并保留原始命令行。仅支持 Windows 10/11（包声明 os: win32）。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching your clipboard, and drive WeChat / Office / browsers / online-class pages. It never steals your mouse or keyboard (it waits for you to stop), never resizes your windows, lets you type corrections mid-task from a sidebar panel, and after every action it reads the screen back and tells you honestly when it could not confirm. Persistent built-in browser channel. No driver, no extra runtime.
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制，共 21 个工具：UIA 控件树 + 离线 OCR 看屏幕、按控件名字点击、不占剪贴板地打中文，微信 / Office / 浏览器 / 网课都能操作。不抢你的鼠标键盘（你在用它会等）、从不改你的窗口大小，侧边栏「指挥台」可随时打字纠正，每步操作后都会回头核对屏幕并如实说明结果。内置持久登录的网页通道，无需驱动、无额外运行时。

description.en: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行换成可配置状态栏：10 个字段可选可排序，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷口径实时估算费用，支持自定义模型单价、CNY / USD 计价切换与账户余额显示。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
description.zh: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
description.zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件 diff 复用内置 DiffTab 打开。

description.en: Starts a whole dev stack from one place: it scans a directory for projects, matches each one's start command, starts them in dependency order once their ports answer, and shows their colourised logs in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一个地方管起整套开发环境：扫描目录发现项目并匹配各自的启动命令，按依赖顺序启动、以端口探测确认就绪，日志带彩色显示在侧栏。

description.en: Workbench with an AI assistant, pause/stop controls, separate background-model settings, tasks/replies, Linky, scoped knowledge capture, local and Yunzhijia search, news reading and developer tools. Optional embeddings download a model. Yunzhijia needs its CLI/account; web chats need the desktop app.
description.zh: 智能工作台，集成可停止的AI助手、后台模型独立配置、待办与回复跟进、Linky研发、知识收藏与检索、云之家搜索、资讯原文及开发工具；可选本地向量需下载模型，云之家需账号及CLI，多AI对话需桌面端。

description.en: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent review, and npm package browsing, packing, pre-publish review and publishing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。

description.en: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.
description.zh: 把 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟机投进 DSH 的浮窗，可同时开多个，并在投屏画面上点、拖、打字，输入回传到设备。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.
description.zh: DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。

description.en: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的文章整理成会话内的 Excalidraw 画布：Agent 用 diagram_create 起草结构，你在画布中修改文字、节点和布局并自动保存，可导出 PNG、SVG 或 .excalidraw，Agent 再用 diagram_read 读回你改过的画布。0.6 新增大型三层分类树的可编辑总览与完整明细索引。

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and every rule carries its own on/off switch so a single rule can be muted without deleting it (muted rules are skipped at injection and the remaining numbering stays contiguous); any number of conversations can also be excluded as a whole so they receive no fence at all, and picking conversations never touches the rules themselves; the enabled rules are injected as one runtime-context section at a fixed order so the system prompt prefix stays stable.
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，每条规则右侧都有独立开关，可以随时单独停用某一条而不用删掉它（停用项不参与注入、剩余条目编号仍然连续）；也可以多选若干对话整体排除在外，让它们完全不受围栏约束，勾选对话本身不会改动任何规则；启用中的规则作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注入，不重写系统提示词前缀。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的待处理改动审查：每次 edit/write/str_replace_editor 改动都会自动汇总到文件列表，可对单个差异块、选区内的多块或整个文件执行保留/回退，支持撤销重做。还能导入工作区的版本控制改动，以单栏或左右对照视图展示差异，并提供亦能保留/回退差异的 Markdown 预览、文件内搜索、差异块跳转与可复制的行号引用；差异数据持久化存储，重启后可继续审查。

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.
description.zh: 在编辑/写入工具行内联 +N −M 徽标，每轮末尾给出可折叠的文件变更汇总卡：对齐差异、逐文件审查与撤销；覆盖原生 edit/write、str_replace_editor 与 Code Dispatch 子调用，不依赖 git。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
description.zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

description.en: Open delivered files, changed-file rows and inline file mentions in the system default app with a left click; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus, only where DSH has none, or never. Desktop app only: the Web client has no system-open capability, so clicks stay with DSH.
description.zh: 左键以系统默认程序打开交付文件、改动文件行和对话中的文件提及；右键接管方式可选：全部接管、只接管原生没有菜单的、或完全不接管。仅桌面端可用：Web 端没有系统打开能力，点击仍交给 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: A Windows disk cleaner for DeepSeek Harness that scans known-safe cache locations, shows their sizes, reclaims the space from a Web panel, and offers a read-only audit of what it cannot clean automatically.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 磁盘清理插件，扫描已知的安全缓存目录、显示占用大小，在 Web 面板中回收空间，并对无法自动清理的部分提供只读审计。

description.en: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Treemap disk usage map with linked cleanup suggestions, a reviewed trash plan, and an append-only audit log on macOS.
description.zh: 用树图查看 macOS 磁盘占用，联动可清理建议，确认计划后移入废纸篓，并写入追加式审计日志。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: A persistent download server for DSH — jobs outlive the session, survive a restart, and resume from the last byte.
description.zh: DSH 的全自动轻量常驻下载服务器 —— 任务活过会话、扛过重启，断点按字节续传。

description.en: Per-session document ledger in the DSH sidebar (Windows only, Chinese-language UI): which documents a session read, created or modified, with time ordering, type grouping, search, two preview modes and a cross-session view.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏按会话查看文档台账（仅 Windows，界面仅中文）：用过哪些文档、创建/修改了哪些，带时间排序、类型分组、搜索与两种预览。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
description.zh: 把 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和文本文件读取为智能体工具，并用 tesseract.js 在本地对扫描版 PDF 或图片做 OCR。提供 doc_read、pdf_read、xlsx_read、doc_meta、doc_ocr 五个工具。

description.en: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

description.en: Adds a global document-routing prompt so PDFs, images, and Office files are read with the right tool.
description.zh: 加入全局文档路由提示，让 PDF、图片和 Office 文件自动走正确的读取工具。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. It applies the layout only when the request mentions 公文 (official document) and writes no signature block unless asked.
description.zh: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。只有请求里提到「公文」时才套用版式，用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.
description.zh: 从已配置的 Provider 选择 API 域名或手动添加，让命中的 DSH 后端 Fetch/Undici 请求通过已有本机 HTTP(S) 代理，其他请求沿用原有路线；可选开启内存调用记录，查看实际分发路线、首内容等待、token 速度与用量，不保存提示词、回答或 API Key。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Keeps an agent working continuously over long stretches: set a deadline, and if it finishes the task early, Dont-Stop automatically nudges it to keep iterating and take on the next step on its own.
description.zh: 保证智能体长时间持续工作：设定一个截止时间，若提前完成任务，Dont-Stop 会自动督促它继续迭代、自主推进下一步任务。

description.en: Volumes and handoffs for DeepSeek Harness: group sessions per project and hand state to a fresh session through a generated handoff document instead of replaying context.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期项目分卷：会话按项目归档，用一份约 1500 token 的交接文档把状态交给新会话，而不是重放上下文。

description.en: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone, and any app notification can wake her; she installs apps herself and browses, likes and comments in apps such as Xiaoheihe or Bilibili; she has her own QQ (NapCat / SnowLuma, multi-part replies, stickers); memory with people cards, a daily diary at 23:30 and automatic recall before each wake (local embeddings by default, SiliconFlow / DashScope optional); a life between conversations (after HDS-Interlude); and an optional microVM computer with approval gates. Sidebar tabs show her phone, her computer and a dot panel; personal settings live in ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json, and each of the six components can be turned off. Only the QQ number set with /qq owner counts as you; other people's messages are treated as untrusted notifications.
description.zh: 住在自己手机上的角色：插件自动安装并运行她的 Android 手机，任何 App 的新通知都能叫醒她；她自己装 App，逛小黑盒、B 站等并点赞评论；有自己的 QQ（NapCat / SnowLuma，分条回复、发表情包）；记忆含人物卡、每天 23:30 的日记和叫醒前的自动召回（默认本机 embedding，可切 SiliconFlow / DashScope）；两次对话之间的生活（幕间，按 HDS-Interlude）；可选 microVM 电脑带审批闸门。右侧栏有手机画面、虚拟机画面和 dot 面板；个人设置集中在 ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json，六个组件都能单独关闭。只有 `/qq owner` 指定的 QQ 号算你本人，别人的消息按不可信通知处理。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
description.zh: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

description.en: Autonomous Douyin watching in a dedicated Edge browser on Windows (requires Node.js 22.13+): sampling decisions, frame storyboards, danmaku-aware comments, persona memory and a watch diary, all under daily viewing limits. Fork of LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent — uninstall the upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的专用 Edge 浏览器里自主刷抖音（需 Node.js 22.13+）：采样决策、抽帧拼故事板、带时间的高赞弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，全程受每日时段与额度限制。改自 LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
description.zh: 在专用浏览器中按每日时段和额度观看抖音，共享本地人格与兴趣，提供原生设置、自检、用量和观看日报。回复与分享限定所选好友和群聊，群聊仅在被 @ 或叫到设定昵称时回复；公开评论需单独开启。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
description.zh: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

description.en: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs, authorized local HTML and running Windows apps through a searchable native sidebar or @. Open browser candidates and the webpage sidebar refresh when the extension connects, disconnects or changes tabs, including an unchanged search query. Windows application lists skip protected processes with unreadable identity metadata and preserve other running apps. Read scoped snapshots, batch actions, capture screenshots and use available WebMCP tools; supports authorized uploads, drag/drop and opt-in network metadata. Browser actions preserve failure evidence, accept an explicit post-action observation scope and can check one final visible/text/value/URL condition without replaying effects. Expandable context preserves model content; dockable annotations support a session-bound staging queue with edit/delete/restore, and append to chat drafts without sending. App control prefers a matching installed MCP or approved installation, then Cua Driver with text, hotkeys and paged controls; desktop reads present the window once per connection or when recovery is needed. Background input depends on the app. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ with the companion MV3 extension manually loaded and paired; installing the plugin does not install the extension.
description.zh: 通过可搜索的原生侧栏或 @ 引用已登录的 Chrome / Edge 标签页、已授权的本地 HTML 和运行中的 Windows 应用。扩展连接、断开或标签页变化时，已打开的浏览器候选与网页侧栏自动更新，无需修改搜索词。Windows 应用列表跳过身份信息无法读取的受保护进程，保留其他运行中的应用。读取局部快照、批量操作、截图及调用可用的 WebMCP 工具；支持授权上传、拖放和按需网络元数据。浏览器动作失败后保留执行证据，可显式指定后置观察范围，并在末尾检查一次可见性、文本、输入值或 URL 条件，不自动重放副作用。可展开引用保留模型内容；可收纳批注支持绑定会话的暂存队列与编辑、删除、恢复，加入聊天草稿而不自动发送。应用控制优先匹配的本地 MCP，未安装先询问，无匹配时使用 Cua Driver，支持打字、快捷键及控件分页；桌面读取在连接首次或需要恢复窗口时展示。后台输入取决于应用。需要 Chrome / Edge 125+，手动加载配套 MV3 扩展并配对；插件不会自动安装扩展。

description.en: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

description.en: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.
description.zh: 基于 Markdown 的 dsh 草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑，本地持久化。

description.en: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

description.en: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer — and on the new-conversation screen — that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方（以及新建对话窗口）加一个 ✦ 按钮，用当前配置的默认模型把草稿改写成更完整的提示词（保持原意与语言），原地替换草稿、不发送。

description.en: One click beside the composer turns a half-formed draft into a structured prompt the AI can act on: goal, constraints, output format and acceptance criteria filled in, placeholders only where a real decision is missing. Rewritten in place and never sent — undo with one click or Ctrl+Z. Four editable presets (general / code / writing / translation), optional conversation context to resolve references, and a model that either follows the session or is pinned to a chosen provider and reasoning effort. Requests survive session switches and typing while a rewrite is in flight; a result that no longer matches the draft is kept for retry instead of overwriting it. Pure JS, no build, no bundled dependencies.
description.zh: 输入框旁一键，把想到一半的草稿变成 AI 真能照着干的结构化提示词：补齐目标、约束、输出格式与验收标准，只在缺关键决策时留占位符。原地改写、绝不替你发送，一键或 Ctrl+Z 还原。四套可编辑预设（通用/编程/写作/翻译），可选读取会话上下文消解指代，模型可跟随会话或固定到指定 provider 与思考强度。改写期间切会话、继续打字都不会中断；结果与当前草稿不匹配时保留待重试而不是覆盖。纯 JS、无构建、无自带依赖。

description.en: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
description.zh: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。拖侧栏的工作区（文件夹）行，则把那个文件夹的路径插进草稿，整个目录一起交给模型。候选按 session id 匹配而不是按标题，标题重名或为空都不会插错对话。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，宿主侧调大后自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows x64，0.5.4 预览版：两个受控工具（dragon_browser 与 dragon_desktop），网页走 DOM/CDP、桌面走 Windows UI Automation，按网站来源和可执行文件分 read/control 权限，支持多步 batch、物理 Esc 急停与脱敏动作日志。0.5.4 只是把 DSH 兼容范围放宽到 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1.x——0.5.3 把版本钉死，在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1 上会被宿主静默跳过。原生命令改成两个常驻进程，省掉每次动作重新起进程，同机单步按键约 0.7 秒；前台被别的窗口抢走时直接中止这一步，不会把字打到别处。网页侧自带 Edge/Chrome 启动器与 CDP 客户端，不再依赖其他浏览器插件或 Electron 运行时。它不是系统沙箱，登录、管理员窗口和安全桌面仍由用户处理。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

description.en: Connects a ComfyUI server to the agent through five draw_* tools (status, workflows, models, generate, reverse) and a sidebar panel. It ships no workflows and assumes nothing about your models: every API-format JSON you drop into the workflow directory is inspected to find where prompt, negative, width, height, steps, cfg, seed and LoRA live, and a sidecar file can override what was detected. LoRA injection splices into any graph. All paths are configuration, editable from the panel and saved to a settings file, so it works against a remote or already-running ComfyUI. Headless auto-start and idle shutdown are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 接给 agent：五个 draw_* 工具（状态、工作流、模型、生图、反推）与侧栏面板。插件本身不带任何工作流、也不假设你用什么模型：放进工作流目录的每个 API 格式 JSON 都会被自动检查，找出 prompt / 负向提示词 / 宽高 / steps / cfg / 种子 / LoRA 落位，可用同名 sidecar 文件覆盖检测结果；LoRA 能插进任意连线图。所有路径都可配置、可在面板里改并保存到设置文件，因此对着远程或已经开着的 ComfyUI 也能用。无头自动启动与空闲关闭默认关闭，需自行开启。

description.en: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native .drawio files: the canvas opens and saves them losslessly — cells it does not understand are preserved byte-for-byte — and a file-fingerprint revision powers optimistic locking against concurrent edits.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的可编辑画布，加两个模型工具（diagram_read、diagram_apply），直接读写工作区、载体是原生 .drawio 文件：无损写回让画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件指纹 revision 支撑起对并发编辑的乐观锁。

description.en: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
description.zh: AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

description.en: Draw.io in chat: describe it, get an interactive diagram in the transcript; 12 Chinese scenario templates; keep editing or undo the same .drawio file; right-sidebar preview. No account, no MCP server, no editor.
description.zh: 聊天里画 draw.io：说一句需求，对话里直接出可交互图表；内置 12 个中文场景模板；可继续改图、撤销同一个 .drawio 文件；右侧栏预览不再是 XML。不登录 draw.io、不需要 MCP server、不用装编辑器。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话的行为漂移报告：对比两份 session log，输出工具序列对齐、工具构成、推理量、耗时、重试与文件目标的差异，并支持可选的 CI 阈值门禁。零依赖。

description.en: Rclone backup tooling with four tools: target inventory, local/remote status, rclone check verification, and approved copy/sync transfers with dry-run previews and an audit line. Requires rclone installed and a remote configured with `rclone config`; the plugin never reads the rclone config or credentials.
description.zh: 基于 rclone 的备份工具，含四个工具：目标清单、本地/远端状态、rclone check 校验，以及带预演与审计行的审批式 copy/sync 传输。需已安装 rclone 并用 `rclone config` 配好远端；插件不读取 rclone 配置或凭据。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页提供配置卡。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。
