description.en: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors never do. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.
description.zh: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在确实毫无产出的轮次补一条继续——整段调用写进正文且没有发出任何工具调用，或只剩闭合标签且正文近乎为空。上游抖动类错误会续跑，额度、限流、鉴权与上下文超限一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

description.en: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
description.zh: 基于全双工语音模型的 DSH 网页端中文语音交互：边听边说、随时插话，用语音输入和修改任务、提交请求、管理会话、回答 DSH 的问题，并简短播报任务完成结果。

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its attachments and the metadata, plus a manifest, a restore note and a Markdown ledger. Adds a right-sidebar browser for archived sessions and a double-click restart button (Windows only; disabled while a session is running).
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when the context crosses a size line or keeps growing. By default it requires DSH's experimental Session Search plugin (session_event_read / session_event_search); without it the tools stay disabled unless requireSessionQuery is turned off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层上下文压缩插件：把旧轮次折成由模型撰写摘要的 L1–L3 块，在地图里显示每层占用与可压位置，并在占用越过提醒线或持续增长时叫醒模型决定是否压缩。默认需要启用 DSH 实验性插件「会话搜索」（session_event_read / session_event_search），否则 compress 与 context_map 会停用（可关闭 requireSessionQuery）。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, set a Chinese display name in the skill meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.
description.zh: 每轮对话报告本轮调用了哪些 skill（模型自动加载、用户输入 /name，或一个都没用），并管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Adds an "edit question" action to every user message: editing re-sends the prompt from that turn, re-attaches the original images (extra ones can be pasted in), and optionally archives the original session.
description.zh: 在每条用户提问旁加「编辑提问」入口：改完从该提问重新开始，原图一并重发（还可粘贴补充图），原会话可选保留或归档。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: MCP hub for 1C development: keeps 1C:EDT connected through EDT-MCP, starts BSL Language Server with workspace roots on demand, and adds per-project settings, a read-only documentation wiki, model rules and SonarQube/GitLab skills. Requires 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 with EDT-MCP running (default 127.0.0.1:8765).
description.zh: 面向 1C 开发的 MCP 枢纽：通过 EDT-MCP 保持 1C:EDT 连接，按需以工作区根目录启动 BSL Language Server，并提供逐项目设置、只读文档 wiki、模型规则以及 SonarQube/GitLab 技能。需安装 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 并运行 EDT-MCP（默认 127.0.0.1:8765）。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生成，以 evaluate:0 上传后每关只触发一次评测，再按平台返回的报错重试。三个工具：educoder_sweep、educoder_homework、educoder_account。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Replaces the composer's reasoning-effort dropdown with a card that shows one illustration per level (off / low / high / max); the four levels keep their original meanings, and swapping an illustration only means replacing a file in assets/.
description.zh: 把输入框的推理强度下拉换成一张卡片，每一档配一张插画（off / low / high / max）；四档取值与原来一致，换插画只需替换 assets/ 下的同名文件。

description.en: Replaces the composer model menu with a recent-models list, an all-providers flyout and a draggable reasoning-effort slider; a Manage models row at the bottom of the flyout opens the Models settings directly. It takes over the composer model slot, so install only one model-menu plugin.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单换成最近模型列表、全部模型飞出面板和一条可拖动的思考强度滑杆；全部模型面板底部的「管理模型」可直接打开设置的模型页。它接管输入框的模型位，请只装一个模型菜单类插件。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider in the model menu for DeepSeek Harness that also appears for providers and models with no declared effort metadata. Based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider — uninstall that upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型菜单里提供推理等级滑条，未声明推理档位的 provider 与模型同样出现。基于 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 改造，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Design-review gate for DeepSeek Harness, a DSH port of Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model: a context-rich Elephant session drafts the design, then fresh, zero-context, read-only Goldfish reviewers stress-test it before implementation. Registers the `egm` plugin id; install one EGM bundle per profile.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的设计评审闸门，移植自 Google 的 Elephant-Goldfish Model：具备完整上下文的“大象”起草设计，再由零上下文的只读“金鱼”评审者严格审查，通过后才进入实现。注册的插件 id 为 `egm`，同一 profile 请只安装一个 EGM 插件。

description.en: Drive a real Chrome/Chromium browser from DeepSeek Harness with 35 structured tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, JavaScript/CDP, screenshots, downloads and tabs; a live sidebar mirrors the page and accepts mouse and keyboard input. It ships a managed CDP runtime, keeps login state across calls, and can import cookies from your everyday Chrome through a companion extension.
description.zh: 用 35 个结构化工具从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真实 Chrome/Chromium：导航、语义快照、点击、表单、JavaScript/CDP、截图、下载与标签页管理；右侧边栏实时镜像页面，并支持鼠标键盘直接接管。插件自带受管 CDP 运行时，跨调用保留登录状态，并可通过配套 Chrome 扩展从日常浏览器导入 cookie。

description.en: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a Playwright Chromium headless runtime on the same machine.
description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的 MCP 审计服务接入 DSH，在移动端视口矩阵中检查已部署页面并返回结构化修复证据；前置需要在同一台机器上装好 uv/uvx 与 Playwright Chromium 无头运行时。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
description.zh: 确定性网络出口门：网页抓取与搜索在 tools/pre-execute 按目的地白名单校验，越权即拒；shell 抓取动词默认观察，可选拦截。

description.en: EIA technical guideline applicability and execution-standard check.
description.zh: 环评导则适用性与执行标准核对。

description.en: Chinese e-invoice (OFD/XML) inbox: ingest, parse, deduplicate, queue for review, record receipts and archive locally — 10 `invoice.*` tools, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: 中文电子发票（OFD/XML）收件箱：导入、解析、去重、进入复核队列、登记回执并本地归档——10 个 `invoice.*` 工具，数据不出本机。

description.en: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the user watches every step live - progress ladder, streaming logs, RAM/FLASH usage and decoded serial waveforms. Requires a host Python 3.10+ on PATH (the plugin cannot install it); the ARM toolchain is auto-downloaded on first use (~400 MB, Windows x64 only), and you need an STM32 board with a debug probe.
description.zh: 嵌入式闭环开发驾驶舱（DSH 插件）：agent 在面板里闭环开发 STM32——发现、编译、烧录、调试校验、串口监视，开发过程对用户全程可视化（阶梯进度、实时日志、RAM/FLASH 占用、串口波形解码）。需主机自带 PATH 上的 Python 3.10+（插件不能代装）；ARM 工具链首次使用时自动下载（约 400 MB，仅 Windows x64），并需自备 STM32 板与调试探针。

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 邮件工具插件：含 email_watch 增量新邮件检查、email_mark（已读/未读/星标/移动文件夹）与 email_reply（回复/回复全部/转发，自动线程头+引文）的十工具，Web 设置页与鲸鱼娘递信新邮件弹窗，since/until 日期范围过滤，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门；Outlook OAuth2 设备码登录开箱即用（内置社区客户端，账号仍可填自己的 clientId 覆盖）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Embedded C/C++ firmware development toolbox: agents and skills covering FreeRTOS, interrupts, NVM storage, Keil MDK, ARMCLANG, HardFault triage, state machines, architecture, and LVGL patterns.
description.zh: 嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发工具箱：代理与技能覆盖 FreeRTOS、中断、NVM 存储、Keil MDK、ARMCLANG、HardFault 分析、状态机、架构原则与 LVGL 陷阱。

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强，做两件事。模型菜单里的推理等级行变成直接画在该行上的连续滑块，档位实时读取模型适配器，因此档位数不限；每档会在旋钮背后的 canvas 上喷出各自的余烬尾焰。另外，只要当前是完全权限，权限触发器就用主题的错误色渲染，权限菜单里对应那一行同样变红。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Judges the working model's own emotion each turn and silently re-injects it before the next turn, closing a self-observation → state carry-over → behavior shift loop. Ships a host plugin plus a composer-dock panel, a read-only emotion_status tool and an optional read-only HTTP route.
description.zh: 每回合判定工作模型自身的情绪，并在下一回合开始前静默回注给它，形成「自省 → 状态留存 → 行为调整」 的闭环。包含宿主插件、输入框上方的情绪面板、只读的 emotion_status 工具与可选的只读 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.
description.zh: 编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》主题：炭黑与警戒黄的工业 HUD、在外壳渲染前注入的开屏动画、对话区背景，以及重新配色的 Windows 标题栏。侧栏品牌会改为「终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES」，可用 URL 参数还原。

description.en: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.
description.zh: 面向软件工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册两个模型可直接调用的 Host Tool——受工作区约束的 `git` 运行器，以及按 lockfile 自动识别 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 并选择正确动词的包管理器运行器（`dev`）。两者都经 dsh 沙箱 shell 执行，返回规整的 stdout/stderr/exitCode，让 agent 拿到聚焦、可复核的结果而不是裸 bash；再加一个工具只需复制一个 register 块。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file. Every step the `MEMORY.md` index (the project store if there is one, plus a global store under `$DSH_HOME`) goes into the runtime context, so recall does not wait for a file read. The index has a hard cap, 200 lines / 25 KB by default, enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that grows an over-cap index is denied, a rewrite that shrinks it passes. A read-only sidebar Memory page lists the notes by type. The plugin never writes memories on its own. An experimental companion mode adds note types for a persona's own life. The same store also works with Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存，一条事实一个文件。每一步都把索引 `MEMORY.md`（有项目库时含项目库，另加 `$DSH_HOME` 下的全局库）放进运行时上下文，召回不用等模型去读文件。索引有硬上限，默认 200 行 / 25KB，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行：让已超限的索引变大的写入被拒绝，缩小它的重写一律放行。左侧栏有只读的「记忆」页，按类型列出笔记。插件不会自行写入记忆。实验性的大肥鱼模式为人设角色加了记录它自己人生的笔记类型。同一个记忆库也可供 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.
description.zh: 给 Engramory 记忆库加本地 BM25 自动召回、写入闸门、静态体检与记忆面板。不联网、不起进程，默认不调模型；召回质量由仓库里的可复算基准量化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without `?token=`, PWA install with icon and app name, desktop and mobile Web Push notifications for task/approval events, and optional session-id request-header injection for third-party OpenAI-compatible routes, all configured from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，支持上传证书或由插件自签发本地 CA），无需 `?token=` 即可在局域网 / 远程登录；整合 PWA 安装与应用名 / 图标、桌面通知与手机 Web Push（任务完成、等待审批等事件），并可选地把当前会话的 session id 注入第三方 OpenAI 兼容路由的请求头，均在设置页统一配置。

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode for non-destructive exploration, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` to submit the plan for review. No settings.
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式先做非破坏性探索，再配合内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 提交方案评审。无设置项。

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and moves are saved locally and survive restarts.
description.zh: 拖拽重排 dsh 左侧栏的插件面板条目与会话顶部标签，并能把条目在侧栏与标签区之间搬移（搬过去是真实标签）；顺序与搬移状态存本机，重启后保留。

description.en: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.
description.zh: 代理 provider：每次出网前按类别跑 op 链重塑 payload 再转交上游，使 prompt 前缀在回合之间保持单调、未变的历史不必按全价重付；op 名只表示传输方式（exec / http / inline），可接入用户自定义算法。

description.en: File-based environment registry for DSH: manage environments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings through a panel and model-facing tools.
description.zh: 基于文件的 DSH 环境注册表：通过面板和模型工具管理环境、服务、部署以及操作到 Skill 的绑定。

description.en: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局经验档案（Windows）：探测本地工具（含版本与 PATH 首个命中）、便捷路径、网络延迟与磁盘速度；从 session/event 折叠每会话统计；由 LLM 抽取持久知识条目；提供带 remember 的 env_profile 工具；每轮注入字节稳定的摘要，加快会话并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理环境变量、.env 文件和凭据，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级环境变量。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的运行错误与编程任务复盘渲染成可交互的 GPU 图谱，并把记录下来的教训送回模型上下文。

description.en: A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.
description.zh: DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。

description.en: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页端与桌面端加一个 ETA 挂件：按 todo 清单与步进节奏估算本轮何时完成，显示剩余时长、进度条与置信度徽章。

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: Four EVA-themed skins for DeepSeek Harness — Units 02, 00, 01 and 08. Each one restyles the sidebar, composer and window frame from the theme token layer, and ships a 20-second canvas boot sequence with a confirm step, a skip button and a replay hotkey. Switch skins from a popup on the composer chip.
description.zh: 四套 EVA 主题皮肤（二号机／零号机／初号机／八号机）。每套通过主题样式层重绘侧栏、输入框与窗口边框，并带一段 20 秒的开机动画（Canvas 绘制，含身份确认、可跳过、可重播）。输入框旁的胶囊可弹出列表切换皮肤。

description.en: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：把单次评测试次的变量、预算上限、会话根目录与 fork 血统一次性注入 agent 进程，模型调用经宿主 broker 走网关租约，并写出 schema 版本化的 bundle descriptor 做证据归属。

description.en: An Everforest colour theme for DeepSeek Harness, for both web and desktop. Forest tones, with six dark and light palettes. Chat content (headings, code, links, tables and more) is restyled with independent colours, and every tone and saturation level is tuned individually for a warm, gentle, easy-on-the-eyes experience.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Everforest 配色主题，同时支持网页和桌面端。以森林为色调，深色与浅色共 6 档配色。对聊天内容（标题、代码、链接、表格等）样式优化，独立着色，所有色调及饱和度都已逐一调校，提供温暖柔和的护眼体验。

description.en: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
description.zh: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

description.en: Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.
description.zh: 为工作区与对话配置独立人格，支持自适应风格、经确认的通用交流偏好和子代理模型路由；可配合其他 provider 插件使用 Codex、Claude Code 等已注册模型。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: Renders Excalidraw architecture scenes inside DSH — import a local .excalidraw/.json file or an inline document with no account, or refresh from Excalidraw+ over MCP (refresh needs an Excalidraw+ MCP bearer token in mcpToken or EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN); pan, zoom, select and export SVG/PNG.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里渲染 Excalidraw 架构图：可无账号导入本地 .excalidraw/.json 或内联文档，也可通过 MCP 从 Excalidraw+ 刷新（刷新需在 mcpToken 或 EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN 里配置 Excalidraw+ 的 MCP 令牌）；支持平移、缩放、选中与 SVG/PNG 导出。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
description.zh: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。只报告差异，不裁决对错。

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的专家名册：22 个分类、636 位专家，中文名与简介全量覆盖；从 @ 菜单或由模型经 list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts 三个工具召唤为子代理，另可自建专家，并带一个技能开关。

description.en: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.
description.zh: 基于角色的专家子代理并行协作，各角色可配置模型与思考深度，并提供 Expert Group 任务侧栏。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert plan the work, and delegates implementation to domain experts via a merged expert roster (list and summon tools), scheduling parallel work through a dependency-DAG taskboard and a file-based message bus, with delivery gated by an independent review. Ships 11 core experts; more expert teams (Agency agents EN/ZH, classic collections) are one-click downloads from the settings page over dual GitHub/CDN channels with sha256 verification. Published on npm as dsh-expert-orchestrator (requires DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2).
description.zh: 多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic 集合）可在设置页一键下载，走 GitHub/CDN 双通道并经 sha256 验签。npm 包名 dsh-expert-orchestrator（要求 DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2）。

description.en: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.
description.zh: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

description.en: Adds a right-click command "通过 dsh 打开" (open with dsh) to the Windows Explorer right-click menu for a folder, a folder's empty background and any file: it launches DeepSeek Harness on that folder, creates a new session every time, and puts the clicked file into the new draft as an @ reference. Ships a packaged-COM menu for the Windows 11 modern menu plus a registry entry for the classic menu; first install asks once for a certificate trust (native/trust-cert.bat).
description.zh: 给 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单加「通过 dsh 打开」：文件夹、文件夹空白处、任意文件都能用。点击后在对应文件夹启动 DeepSeek Harness 并新建会话；文件右键会把这个文件以 @ 引用预置进新会话草稿。Win11 新式菜单用打包 COM 组件，经典菜单 用注册表项；首次安装需要点一次证书受信（native/trust-cert.bat）。

description.en: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.
description.zh: 个人经验记忆：把真实解决过的问题存为带来源、可纠正、有适用条件的案例，新任务中自动召回复用，纠正与删除会级联影响后续召回。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Optional external HTTP API for DSH Desktop, off by default, bound to localhost unless widened, and authenticated with a Bearer token.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的可选外部 HTTP API，默认关闭、默认仅监听本机，扩大监听范围时使用 Bearer Token 鉴权。

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外观设置页：五套护眼浅色主题，每套主题自带匹配的强调色与链接色；另可调整强调色与背景色、界面与代码的字体和字号、字体样式、内容宽度、对比度与减少动态效果。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: Skill that types the request before it searches: it splits a question into premises, definitions and analysis units, decides which report skeleton fits (verdict, explainer, causal mechanism, comparison, survey map, metric card), confirms the direction and runs a feasibility check, then emits that skeleton instead of forcing every question into a true-false verdict — in Chinese or English. Evidence gathering never trusts model memory: it searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and keeps every statement bound to a full URL and citation position. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.
description.zh: 先定型再取证的核查与调研技能：把提问拆成前提、定义、分析三类作业单元，判定要出哪种产物（裁决、释义、因果机制、对照、地图、指标卡），与用户确认方向并做可行性分析，再按型输出对应骨架——而不是把所有问题都压成真假判定，中英双语。取证不依赖模型记忆：国内外信息生态并行搜索，按事实范畴（政策、学术、医疗、金融、灾害事故、食品安全、科学常识、教育考试、体育、娱乐名人、司法案件等）选定一手来源阶梯，抓取一手页面并按来源类型分级，再用质疑关键词反查一轮，每条论断都带完整 URL 与引用位置。三类事实判断在配置了密钥时可交给 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型，未配置则回退到内置的确定性规则；模型的判断只能降档、不能升档。

description.en: Fail-fast tool batches for DeepSeek Harness: inside a step, concurrency-safe calls still overlap, but after the first failed call every remaining unstarted call is denied before dispatch and returned to the model as a synthesized `is_error` "not executed" result.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具批次增加“失败即停”（fail-fast）机制：同一并行组内的只读调用仍可并发，一旦有调用失败，所有尚未开始的调用都会在派发前被拦截，并以合成的 is_error「未执行」结果返回给模型。

description.en: Stops the agent after N consecutive failures on the same tool. Instead of another retry it pushes a four-part stop instruction: what was tried, the exact error text, the likely cause, and what the user must do. Detection reads real tool results (isError or a non-zero shell exit code) and mirrors them through agent.steer, so the agent sees it as an inbound message rather than a log line.
description.zh: 同一工具连续失败达阈值时叫停。不是再试一次，而是推送一条四部分停手指令：试过什么、完整错误原文、初判原因、需要用户做什么。判定读真实工具结果（isError 或 shell 退出码非零），通过 agent.steer 回灌，让 agent 把它当成收到的消息而不是日志。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: a voiced full-screen boot animation, an animated eye core (idle / thinking / done) you can drag or hide, a brand swap on the new-chat hero, a time-of-day greeting, a usage bubble with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, the Fairy-mode agent preset, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 H.D.D 皮肤：带音效的整屏开机动画、可拖动或隐藏的动态眼徽（待机/思考/完成）、新建对话页换标、按时段问候、显示余额与今日花费并带峰谷倒计时的用量气泡、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。

description.en: Logic-risk review before rewriting: audit the source, decide each fix, generate several drafts in parallel, and export with a per-draft audit report. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and key - the plugin ships no model and returns 403 until one is configured.
description.zh: 改写前先做逻辑体检：审原文风险、逐条裁决，再并行出多稿，每稿附六维审核报告。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的接口地址与 API Key——插件不内置模型，未配置时生成类接口返回 403。

description.en: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目显示每轮、每会话与每工作区的对话费用人民币金额，支持峰谷分时与 Search/Fetch 按次计费。

description.en: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
description.zh: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型、同样的思考强度，只花更少的输出 token，全程提示词侧。默认只开「精简输出」（late 模式，第 4 步后生效），其余开关默认关、可单独打开；工具输出很长时再开「截短工具输出」那个。本机实测、非榜单成绩：输出偏长的 30 对任务，只开截短开关时 0.756× 耗时、输出 token −21%；6 个真实 `pallets/click` PR 共 24 对，0.805× 耗时、token −23%。在官方 SWE-bench Lite 题目定义上用自建 harness 量不出收益（8 题、三次独立跑合池 72 对：墙钟 0.933×、token 0.903×，墙钟仍跨 1；同一配置单跑之间就差三成），往截短上再叠别的开关反而更差。数字与复现见仓库。

description.en: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.
description.zh: 在后台准备上下文摘要并于安全步骤应用，保留原生压缩回退，并提供摘要内容、应用状态、耗时与用量的会话压缩历史。

description.en: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).
description.zh: 为 dsh web 绘制浏览器页签状态指示：根据会话列表把 favicon 画成状态圆环（执行中蓝色旋转、等待用户琥珀色、完成绿色）。

description.en: Curated DeepSeek Harness plugin market with a daily heat leaderboard, bilingual descriptions, 2-3 plugin comparison, compatibility checks and README summaries.
description.zh: 精选 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，提供每日热度榜、双语说明、2–3 款并排对比、兼容性检查与 README 摘要。

description.en: Personal cross-session memory in local SQLite, with automatic conversation learning, companion states, and optional semantic retrieval. Currently intended for single-user local use on Windows.
description.zh: 大肥鱼饲养手册：基于本地 SQLite 的个人跨会话记忆，支持对话自动学习、伙伴状态与可选语义检索，目前面向 Windows 单人本地使用。

description.en: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。

description.en: Ops request channel for a team over Feishu DMs — a colleague's message waits in a serial queue behind an approval card that the paired admin must accept, then runs in one shared DSH session with a persona attached, and the answer is posted back to the requester.
description.zh: 给同事的运维请求通道——同事在飞书私聊里提的事先排进串行队列，由已配对的管理员在审批卡上放行后才进入那条共享的 DSH 会话（带注入的人设执行），回答回到提交人。

description.en: Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.
description.zh: 免运维的远程 DSH——拿飞书私聊当界面，机器人出站长连接、不需要公网入口，工作区、会话（切换与改名）、模型、推理深度、权限预设、余额都用卡片操作，工具审批与 agent 反问也在同一个聊天里回。

description.en: Feishu OAuth login reduces the need to distribute the DSH owner token while retaining token login; authorized users receive native owner session cookies with shared owner privileges, without per-user isolation.
description.zh: 通过飞书 OAuth 登录减少分发 DSH owner token 的需要，同时保留 token 登录；获准用户使用原生 owner 会话 Cookie，共享 owner 权限，不提供逐用户隔离。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each message; on the plain web UI nothing is injected): per-user scores with daily decay, reasons history, sulking and forgiveness, plus a global mood that colors replies.
description.zh: 在 QQ 通道上给 DSH 人设按人记好感度（需先装 QQ 通道插件，如 dsh-onebot-qq；身份取自消息里的 QQ 号，纯 Web 界面下不会注入）：分数、每日衰减、理由回看、生闷气与哄好，外加影响整体语气的综合情绪。

description.en: Gives the companion a mood judged each turn and shown as a short context note, with a panel for mood, emotion dimensions and timeline.
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个每轮判定、以一小段上下文提示的心情，面板里能看心情值、情绪维度与时间线。

description.en: Synthesises speech through Alibaba Bailian's WebSocket TTS and returns a WAV file plus a preview URL, with an optional per-turn hint that nudges the model towards voice. Needs a Bailian API key and ffmpeg, and the text is sent to Alibaba Cloud; the plugin does not send messages itself — delivery is left to the session's own transport.
description.zh: 调用阿里百炼 WebSocket TTS 合成语音，返回 WAV 文件与试听地址，并可按轮提示模型使用语音。需要百炼 API Key 与 ffmpeg，文本会发送到阿里云；插件本身不发消息，怎么发由当前会话的传输方式决定。

description.en: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person identification through Volcengine Ark and anime-only reverse image search through SauceNAO or trace.moe (each needs its own key); ffmpeg must be installed for GIF/WebP input. Keys and the ffmpeg path are set on the plugin's own settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加识图：用智谱 GLM-4V 描述图片、读图中文字（需智谱 API Key，有免费额度），可选火山方舟认人、SauceNAO / trace.moe 反查动漫原图（各需自己的 Key）；GIF/WebP 图需要装 ffmpeg。Key 与 ffmpeg 路径在插件自带的设置页里配。

description.en: Look up Chinese companies inside the conversation: name a company and get its business registration, shareholders, executives, outbound investments and registration changes, plus judicial and operating-risk records such as enforcement, dishonest judgment debtor, consumption restriction, abnormal operation, serious illegality and administrative penalties (11 dimension groups). Results render as conversation cards with fields and the raw payload on expand, and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里直接查中国企业：说出公司名就能拿到工商基本信息、股东、高管、对外投资、工商变更，以及被执行、失信、限制高消费、经营异常、严重违法、行政处罚等司法与经营风险（共 11 类维度）；结果以对话卡片呈现，展开可看字段与原始数据，API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Right-click files, folders, web links, and workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebars to reference, copy, preview, open in a chosen app or browser, reveal, or save.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话区和侧边栏右键文件、文件夹、网页链接和工作区：引用、复制、预览、用默认或选择的应用/浏览器打开、定位或另存为。

description.en: Local image, PDF, data, audio/video and Office file conversion through agent tools and a drag-and-drop interface; v1.0.x targets DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, with external tools required for some conversions.
description.zh: 通过 Agent 工具和拖拽界面在本地转换图片、PDF、数据、音视频及 Office 文件；v1.0.x 适配 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，部分转换需要外部工具。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment card, or a plain @ path, switchable in Settings.
description.zh: 把右侧文件区的文件和文件夹拖进输入框：落下的文件变成句中内嵌的小卡片、附件卡片或 @ 路径，可在设置里切换。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files 宿主路由，无任何写端点（中英双语）。

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web GUI 的文件树：行内显示大小与修改时间，右键菜单支持下载、上传、复制路径。

description.en: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.
description.zh: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的会话；还原本身也能撤销。历史存放在 DSH_HOME 里的影子 git 仓库中，不碰项目的 .git。需 Git >= 2.20 与 Node.js >= 20。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item in the file manager.
description.zh: DSH 工作区文件树的右键菜单：打开文件、展开或折叠文件夹、复制绝对路径/相对路径/文件名，并在资源管理器中定位。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: Browser-style in-page find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) for the desktop app, with highlight-all, a match counter, and a scope picker for the conversation or the right panel.
description.zh: 桌面端浏览器式页内查找条（Cmd/Ctrl+F）：全文高亮、匹配计数，可在对话区与右侧面板间切换搜索范围。

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的 README、依赖清单、目录树和关键文件等，梳理它们的架构。让你在动手开发前，先“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度、新鲜度与有界热度排序，而不是只看 star。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
description.zh: 通过 Firecrawl Cloud API 把 URL 抓成 LLM 可用 Markdown，或搜索网页并返回结果内容。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet of Firefly (流萤) that chats through the host model, plays animations on click, whispers on a timer, narrates task progress, and shows account balance. Runs in the DSH Desktop app using its bundled Electron runtime (~/.dsh/electron); the pet does not appear if that runtime is missing. Windows only.
description.zh: 流萤桌宠：透明置顶的桌面伴侣，走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irreversible shell commands, and a web panel listing the error codes each round fixed.
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: Dreams for the pet in dsh-fish: once she has been quiet long enough, it picks real events from her event stream, follows one of six dream theories, and hands her a dream seed to write out in her own words. Ships three tools (dream_recall, dream_record, dream_now), never calls a model itself, and keeps its data in ~/.dsh-fish-dream. Every dream is rebuilt from events that actually happened; the theory only decides how they are put together.
description.zh: 给 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，从她真实的事件流里挑碎片，按六种梦理论之一拼成「梦的种子」，她自己把梦写完。提供三个工具（dream_recall、dream_record、dream_now），插件自己不调用模型，数据放在 ~/.dsh-fish-dream。梦只能用真实发生过的事重拼，理论只决定怎么拼。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.
description.zh: 按会话分开的长期记忆，会随时间变淡，按证据分召回、每轮注入几条到系统提示词里。

description.en: A single-character agent that lives across QQ (via SnowLuma / OneBot 11), Bilibili and Douyin (the Douyin channel needs an always-on Windows desktop): persona cards with slowly evolving traits, per-person memory with Ebbinghaus decay and correction, a virtual clock driving a daily routine, proactive messages, auto-extracted memories, and a ten-tab settings panel covering retrieval, persona, routine, memory inspection, channels, habits, models and usage. QQ groups are deny-by-default: a group is answered only when it is on the allowlist or allGroups is explicitly switched on, and it still has to @-mention the bot. Private chats answer QQ friends only. Bilibili/Douyin auto-reply is off by default, limited to the owner, allowlist and mutual follows on Bilibili, and to the owner and allowlist on Douyin unless reply-to-everyone is explicitly enabled. Vendors MIT-licensed code from dsh-qq-bridge and dsh-douyin-bridge, credited in-source with their LICENSE files; it does not need either installed alongside.
description.zh: 活在 QQ（经 SnowLuma / OneBot 11）、B站、抖音（抖音通道需一台常开的 Windows 桌面）三端的单角色智能体：人格卡与慢慢长出来的人格、按人隔离的记忆（艾宾浩斯衰减、可纠正、聊完自动记）、虚拟时钟驱动的作息与主动开口；设置面板共十个标签，覆盖检索、人格、自走、记忆检视、三端通道、习惯、模型与用量。QQ 群默认拒绝：只有列进群白名单、或显式打开「所有群」的群才会被回应，且仍需 @ 它；私聊只回 QQ 好友。B站 / 抖音自动回复默认关闭：B站只回主人、白名单与互关，抖音只回主人与白名单（「回所有人」需另行打开）。内置了 dsh-qq-bridge 与 dsh-douyin-bridge 的 MIT 授权代码，源码与 LICENSE 内均有署名；不必与这两个插件同装。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.
description.zh: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.
description.zh: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

description.en: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话实时流程图，可查看工具调用、并行分组、子代理分支和逐层详情。

description.en: Structural long-term memory for DSH: supersede, decay and entity-state tracking across 15 MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a bounded pointer index published per request instead of filling the window. Requires Python 3.10+ with torch and sentence-transformers; the first run downloads a ~470 MB embedding model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的结构化长期记忆：15 个 MCP 工具支持取代、衰减与实体状态跟踪，带自动召回与捕获钩子，并按请求发布有界指针索引，而不是等上下文塞满再压缩。需要带 torch 与 sentence-transformers 的 Python 3.10+；首次运行会下载约 470 MB 的嵌入模型。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
description.zh: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: FOFA cyberspace mapping inside the conversation: check the account quota, run FOFA queries and export the full result set into CSV/JSON/TXT files in the session workspace by paging through a time cursor. A CSV or TXT export stopped by its time budget or by an upstream error continues into the same file from the saved cursor, so rows already fetched are kept. Results render as conversation cards (query, match count, file path), and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里做 FOFA 网络空间测绘：查看账号额度、执行查询语句，并把全量结果按时间游标深翻页导出为 CSV／JSON／TXT 落到会话工作区；被时间预算或上游报错中断的 CSV／TXT 导出可凭游标续写同一文件，已拉取的行不丢。结果以对话卡片展示（语句、命中数、文件路径），API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

description.en: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders, and add files to the chat as @ references.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的文件夹资源管理器：打开任意本地文件夹、按类型显示彩色图标、重命名/新建/删除/复制文件与文件夹，并可把文件作为 @ 引用添加到对话。

description.en: Inserts the full path as text when a folder is pasted into the input box, instead of trying to upload it (Windows and macOS).
description.zh: 粘贴复制来的文件夹时插入完整路径文本，而不是尝试上传（支持 Windows 与 macOS）。

description.en: Global font DIY: change size, weight, colour and family at any place in the DSH interface, per element or for the whole window, then hide the floating ball when you are done. No CSS writing and no restart. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 全局字体 DIY：界面任意位置的字体大小、字重、颜色与字体族都能改，可逐个元素也可整体生效，调完把悬浮球隐藏即可。不用写 CSS、不用重启。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
description.zh: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.
description.zh: AI填表智能体：支持自动填表、表格填充、表格补全、Excel填表与 Excel回填；使用企查查 MCP 填写 XLSX 空白字段，预览确认后导出新副本。

description.en: Adds the Foxy agent preset, sidebar entry, settings page, editable prompt suffix, and a small capability registry to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Foxy 人设预设、侧栏入口、设置页、可编辑附加提示词和可扩展能力注册。

description.en: Lets Foxy browse Bilibili with daily windows and video limits, filter by interests, comment or remember through an editable prompt, reply to mentions and comment threads, and deduplicate per video. Requires dsh-foxy.
description.zh: 让 Foxy 按每日时段和视频上限浏览 B 站，按兴趣筛选，用可编辑提示词评论或记忆，并回复 @ 与评论楼中楼，按视频去重。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Connects DSH Foxy to Foxy Memory for cross-platform recall, with local JSONL fallback, platform filters, and a memory browser. Requires dsh-foxy.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 Foxy 接入 Foxy Memory，支持跨平台召回、本地 JSONL 回退、平台筛选与记忆浏览。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

description.en: Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: Keyless image generation with two tools: generate_image (no API key, one call at a time, bounded rate-limit retries) and list_image_models.
description.zh: 无需 API 密钥的图片生成，含两个工具：generate_image（无需密钥、串行调用、有限次限流重试）与 list_image_models。

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.
description.zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 免费网页搜索，支持 10 个引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、按时间筛选的高级搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页内容抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基本使用无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table as SVG, DXF, PDF or PNG.
description.zh: 通过 FreeCAD 读写 STEP 模型、量取几何尺寸（距离、角度、直径），并生成带孔表的第一角法二维加工图，可导出 SVG、DXF、PDF、PNG。

description.en: Registers FreeLLMAPI as a dsh model provider, with the router itself bundled in the plugin. It launches the vendored server with the host binary and exposes the freellmapi route; the sidebar panel starts and stops that process, lists the router catalogue, probes which claimed models actually answer, and ranks them by the stability, speed and intelligence scores the router computes for itself. Provider keys, routing strategy and usage remain in the router console, which the panel links to.
description.zh: 把 FreeLLMAPI 注册为 dsh 的模型 provider，路由本体随插件打包。插件用宿主二进制启动内置服务并暴露 freellmapi 路由；侧栏面板负责启停该进程、列出路由的模型目录、实测哪些自称可用的模型真能回答，并按路由自身计算的稳定、速度、智能评分排序。provider key、路由策略与用量仍在路由自带控制台，面板里给了入口。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Public chat rooms with quoted replies and opt-in encrypted private text chat inside DeepSeek Harness, using a shared Nostr relay and locally protected identities (macOS Keychain or Windows DPAPI; Linux has no identity store, so posting is unsupported).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内进入公共聊天室交流，支持引用回复、私聊申请和加密文字聊天，通过共同 Nostr 中继互通，身份保存在本机受保护存储中（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI；Linux 无身份保存适配，暂不能发言）。

description.en: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar, built to fix DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: it watches your on-disk output folders and shows files as they appear, so you can verify and intervene mid-task instead of after. Auto-refreshing image thumbnails with zoom and pan, documents, code, data, archives and links that open in DSH native preview, per-conversation filtering, and multi-folder support for sessions whose cwd is outside the default output folder. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧栏变成产出目录的实时画廊，专门解决 DSH「只在任务结束时才列出产出文件、过程不可见」的问题：直接盯磁盘产出目录，文件一生成就能看到，方便在任务进行中校验与纠正。图片缩略图自动刷新、支持缩放拖动；文档、代码、数据、压缩包与链接点击即调用 DSH 原生侧栏预览；支持按「本对话产出」筛选；支持多扫描目录，兼容工作目录不在默认产出目录下的会话。零依赖。

description.en: A panel plugin that keeps mini-games in one place and plays them in the same window. Ships with Tetris: a 10x20 board, seven pieces, a ghost piece and a next-piece preview, line and level scoring, three difficulty levels, and a best score kept in localStorage.
description.zh: 面板插件：把开发的小游戏集中到一处，并在同一窗口内直接游玩。首发俄罗斯方块：10×20 棋盘、七种方块、落点虚影与下一个方块预览、消行与等级计分、三档难度，最高分存在 localStorage。

description.en: Daily game automation on Windows for Genshin Impact, Honkai Impact 3, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero: a scheduled task per game drives BetterGI, the game-daily skill family, March7thAssistant or ZenlessZoneZero-OneDragon, with per-game switches, a foreground guard, in-run supervision that only steps in on trouble, and one report session per game that later results are appended to. Requires the DSH desktop app and the matching external engine installed.
description.zh: Windows 上的原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零日常自动化：每个游戏一个计划任务，分别驱动 BetterGI、game-daily 技能族、三月七助手或绝区零「一条龙」；带逐游戏开关、前台守护、只在出问题时介入的运行期值守，以及每游戏固定一个汇报会话、后续结果追加进去。需要 DSH 桌面端，并预先安装对应外部引擎。

description.en: Game market and runtime for DSH. While the agent runs a long task, a game fills the main workspace and a small whale in the corner shows the agent state (working, waiting for you, done, error); progress is saved and continues next time. Ships five built-in games, a game SDK and CLI, and a community catalog installable from the market.
description.zh: DSH 的游戏市场与运行时。Agent 跑长任务时，游戏铺满主工作区，右下角的小鲸鱼显示 Agent 状态（运行中、等你、完成、出错）；进度自动保存，下次接着玩。内置五款游戏，提供游戏 SDK 与 CLI，并可从市场安装社区游戏。

description.en: Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.
description.zh: 基于 Seedream 生图与 MiniMax 图生视频，从参考图生成游戏素材，本地绿幕抠像后合成八方向精灵图、序列帧与骨骼动画。

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: Session-level autonomy gears for DSH: a rail on the edge of the conversation area switches P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A and injects the active gear's behavioral prompt into every request; the model's set_gear tool can only downshift, and handbrake H blocks all tool calls. The set_gear tool can downshift on its own; upshifts need user approval.
description.zh: 会话级行动档位：对话区左缘的滑轨切换 P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A，并向每条请求注入当前档位的行为提示词；模型的 set_gear 只能降档，手刹 H 拦截全部工具调用。模型的 set_gear 只能自行降档，升档需用户在卡片上批准。
