description.en: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: Reads one Genshin Impact account (characters, talents, weapons, artifacts, wish history) into a single snapshot, then exposes it as six agent tools and a six-tab panel. Artifact substats come from the public in-game character showcase; scoring ships both CV and per-character weight models with six grade tiers; wish analysis covers pity, luck tiers and per-pool progress. Needs a Miyoushe QR login to read characters, weapons and wish history; showcase data is public by UID.
description.zh: 把原神账号读成一份快照（角色、天赋、武器、圣遗物、祈愿记录），对外给 6 个 agent 工具和一个六页签面板。圣遗物副词条取自游戏内公开的角色展柜；评分同时给 CV 与逐角色权重两套模型，各六档评级；抽卡分析包含保底、欧非分档与各池进度。读取角色、武器与祈愿需要米游社扫码登录；展柜数据按 UID 公开。

description.en: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
description.zh: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

description.en: Two chibi Genshin Impact desktop pets (Columbina and Nahida), 22 transparent animations each, with desktop wandering, drag-and-throw physics, click reactions, idle chatter and chat through DSH models. A fan pack derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) — it reuses upstream's /dsh-pet-7340 route and ~/.dsh/dsh-pet data directory, so install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it; the character art is not MIT-licensed.
description.zh: 两只原神 Q 版桌宠（哥伦比娅、纳西妲），每只 22 段透明动画；可桌面漫步、拖拽抛掷、点击反应，会碎碎念，并用 DSH 模型陪聊。本包派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），沿用上游的 /dsh-pet-7340 路由与 ~/.dsh/dsh-pet 数据目录，请替代 dsh-pet 安装、不要与它同装；角色素材不在 MIT 授权范围内。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
description.zh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

description.en: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
description.zh: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated commit messages, and line blame. A fork of sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1; install either this or the upstream panel, not both.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

description.en: VSCode/IDEA-style Git source control in the DSH right sidebar, with a colour-coded commit graph, branch switching, staging, hunk actions, stash and history filters.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供类 VSCode/IDEA 的 Git 源码管理，含彩色提交图、分支切换、暂存与逐块操作、stash 与历史过滤。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: staging, commits, branch switching, fetch/pull/push, worktrees, a Cursor-style commit graph and GitHub pull requests (the GitHub card needs a GitHub token). It drives the system git binary, so the panel and the terminal always agree.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 面板：暂存、提交、切换分支、fetch/pull/push、工作树、Cursor 风格提交图与 GitHub PR（GitHub 卡片需要 GitHub 令牌）。直接调用系统 git，面板与终端状态保持一致。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.
description.zh: 基于本地 Git 的 DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆，提供中英文混合检索、带引用的上下文、事务式同步、预览与回滚。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中执行 git，使 push、pull、fetch 在 agent 沙箱内可用；提供 8 个 agent 工具（status、diff、log、stage、commit、push、fetch、pull）与 11 个斜杠命令，包括 /git-status、/git-commit、/git-tag 与 /git-name-set。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
description.zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

description.en: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).
description.zh: 把本机 GitHub CLI (gh) 包装成 Agent 工具集（PR、Issue、Actions 运行、仓库检索与原始 API 调用），另提供 /gh status 与 /gh help 两个斜杠命令，以及全局仓库驾驶舱和会话工作区两个 Web 面板。

description.en: Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click; plain URLs and GenUI blocks are covered without patching GenUI itself.
description.zh: 把对话里的 GitHub / GitLab / Gitee 链接变成带缓存元数据的悬停卡片，点击在 DSH 右侧栏浏览器中打开；裸 URL 与 GenUI 块都覆盖，且不修改 GenUI 本体。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
description.zh: GitHub MCP 辅助面板：在「设置 → 插件 → GitHub MCP」展示可复制的示例提示（30 条示例池随机 4 条）、可视化公开仓库的星/fork/语言，并提供 gh_repo_stats / gh_current_user 模型工具。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes, plus a custom background image with cover, contain, stretch, tile or center fit and crop, all persisted from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全局跨会话待办清单，人和 agent 共用同一份：十个 global_todo_* 工具可在任意会话中新增、批量抓取、修改、挂文档与链接、追加进展记录、标记完成；每条待办可按四种方式交给 agent 会话，派发结果记回条目本身。清单存成一个 JSON 文件。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: For the DSH Go phone app (https://go.dshtui.com): watches the quiz screen and pushes each answer as a heads-up notification, using an optional local answer bank.
description.zh: DSH Go 手机 App 专用插件（官网 https://go.dshtui.com）：盯住手机上的考试/答题页面，把每道题的答案弹成顶部通知，可选导入本地题库优先命中。

description.en: Sets token, cost and wall-clock caps on a DSH goal and blocks that goal when a cap is reached, instead of only reporting the spend. The figures come from the usage events DSH records for the session, priced per model, with a pill beside the composer that opens a per-model breakdown. The official DeepSeek tariff is built in, with peak/off-peak pricing toggleable because it depends on the route; other models are priced from configured rates, and a model with no rate has its tokens counted and its name listed rather than being guessed at.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 goal 设 token、费用与计算时长上限，达到上限即阻断该 goal，而不只是报告花费。数字取自 DSH 为该会话记录的用量事件并按模型计价；输入框旁的 pill 点开是按模型分列的明细。内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，峰谷计价可关闭（它取决于线路）；其他模型用配置的单价，没有单价的模型只计 token 并列出名字，不猜价格。

description.en: Kifu-style context compression for long DSH sessions: each step folds new turns into a DAG (node = position, edge = attempted fix), injects only a ~417-token hot list (2000-edge fixture, L5 tier), and adds failure memory plus position-repetition detection. Each span is summarized exactly once, so what is retained does not decay with the number of compactions.
description.zh: 棋谱式上下文压缩：每步把新回合折进一张 DAG（节点=局面、边=试过的改法），只注入约 417 tokens 的热清单（2000 边合成夹具、L5 降级档）；带失败记忆与局面重复检测。一段历史只摘要一次，保留率不随压缩轮次衰减。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive download-complete events through a DSH background job that wakes an idle agent. Process diagnostics and launching are Windows-only; the download tools work wherever Gopeed runs.
description.zh: 把本机 Gopeed 下载器接进 DSH 的 agent 工具：新建、查看、暂停、继续、删除下载任务，诊断或启动 Gopeed 进程，并通过 DSH 后台任务接收下载完成事件（空闲的 agent 会被唤醒）。进程诊断与启动仅支持 Windows，下载相关工具跨平台可用。

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

description.en: Image generation and editing for GPT Image, Gemini (Nano Banana) and Grok, with official, OpenAI-compatible, api.toolify-ai.com and custom HTTP providers. Text-to-image, reference-image editing, canvas annotation, mask editing and Agent multi-turn chat, with images and history kept on your machine. The workbench UI is the MIT-licensed GPT Image Playground v0.9.0 build by CookSleep, bundled unchanged; that upstream is a standalone web app, not a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 支持 GPT Image、Gemini（Nano Banana）和 Grok 的图片生成与编辑工具，支持官方接口、OpenAI 兼容接口、api.toolify-ai.com 与自定义 HTTP 供应商。支持文本生图、参考图编辑、画板标注、遮罩编辑与 Agent 多轮对话，图片和历史记录保存在本地。界面为上游 CookSleep/gpt_image_playground 的 MIT 构建 v0.9.0，原样打包；上游是独立网页应用而非 DSH 插件。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: Requirements interview before work starts: judges whether a request is clear, asks focused questions when it is not, in strict mode denies editing tools until the user confirms a four-part summary in chat, and keeps confirmed preferences in two-layer memory.
description.zh: 开工前先做需求访谈：判定任务是否说清楚，没说清就分轮追问；strict 档位下用户未在对话中确认四段需求清单前，拦截编辑类工具；确认过的偏好写入两层记忆。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: Puts Grok Bot's own face in the DSH sidebar session list: each row's status dot becomes a living GrokBot avatar whose six motions read as idle, working, waiting, blocked, thinking and done — color marks the project, motion marks the state.
description.zh: 把 Grok Bot 本人那张脸装进 DSH 侧栏会话列表：每行的状态圆点变成会动的 GrokBot 头像，六种动作分别对应空闲、处理中、等待、已阻止、思考与完成——颜色标记项目，动作标记状态。

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Requires at least one search API key (Grok, or any one of the supplementary sources). A grok-search-rs-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness with configurable source fallback, visual settings, search log replay, and account quota queries.
description.zh: 需至少配置一个搜索 API Key（Grok 或任一补充来源）。基于 grok-search-rs 的 DeepSeek Harness 搜索插件，提供可配置的来源回退、可视化设置、搜索日志回放和账户额度查询。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Detect and contain runaway symbol streams at the model boundary in DeepSeek Harness, with tooling to repair polluted artifacts and sessions.
description.zh: 在模型输出边界检测并拦截退化符号流，并提供修复被污染工件与会话的工具。

description.en: Deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims in DeepSeek Harness, reporting bounded verdicts, reasons, and evidence references.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成智能体主张证据审阅插件，通过确定性规则输出有限判定、理由与证据引用。

description.en: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.
description.zh: 会话头部的「护航」面板：启停本机 dsh-guard 守护，显示扫描开关、守护心跳与上次扫描时间；做监控的 Python 守护需单独部署，插件通过 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 环境变量定位它的目录。守护默认路径是 Windows 上的 D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard，可用 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 指向别的目录。

description.en: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree, Git panel (commit graph, push/pull, per-file revert), SSH hosts and a real PTY terminal on the left, while the official DSH conversation stays docked on the right so tool calls, file edits, approvals and session history keep working as you code. Built on a craft-first belief: write it by hand, understand every change, treat AI as an assistant and stay the first owner of your software.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 IDE 模式：点工作区「…」菜单一键把主面板变成 VS Code 风格工作台——左侧 Monaco 编辑器、文件树、Git 面板（提交图/推送/拉取/逐文件还原）、SSH 主机与真实 PTY 终端，右侧原样停靠官方 DSH 会话，写代码时工具调用、自动改文件、审批与会话历史照常可用。作者主张「古法编程」：亲手写、每个改动心中有数，AI 是助理，你是软件的第一责任人。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree snapshots, click by control name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面操控：读无障碍树、按控件名点击、动作投递判定，以及可重复执行的任务文件。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: Bundles five skills — web slide decks, social card images, typeset web pages, Chinese de-AI editing (humanizer-zh) and a writing-voice profile — with the first three sharing one design system (magazine and Swiss themes, contrast-checked brand colours). Adds a sidebar page that lists your works with thumbnails, opens a new session with a draft that reuses a work's theme and layout, offers six content workflows, and collects the messages you sent in local dsh sessions as study material for the voice profile.
description.zh: 打包五个 skill：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、中文去 AI 味（humanizer-zh）和语气档案，前三个共用一套设计系统（杂志风与瑞士风主题、按对比度校验的品牌色）。侧栏页面列出你做过的作品和缩略图，「做同款」会在新会话里按这份作品的主题和版式填好草稿；提供六个内容生产工作流；把你在本机 dsh 会话里发过的消息整理成语气档案的学习素材。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: Browses and plays the 6,454 videos Hacker News has recommended since 2007 inside a DSH panel, with a player, the HN discussion behind each pick, AI questions answered from subtitles, and 6,454 Chinese titles shipped with the package.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里浏览并播放 Hacker News 二十年推荐的 6454 个技术视频，带播放器、每个视频背后的 HN 讨论、基于字幕的 AI 问答，以及随包发布的 6454 条中文标题。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: Pressure-aware session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: writes a handoff doc before a long session degrades, then continues in a fresh session in the same workspace. Subagents are snapshotted, still-running ones are interrupted, and unfinished tasks are handed to fresh subagents; a session without subagents simply gets the normal handoff. A status pip and its label shade from green to blue to amber to red as pressure rises.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话交接：长会话降智前自动写交接文档，并在同一工作目录开新会话继续；子智能体随交接迁移——仍在运行的先打断，未完成的任务写进续接提示交给新子智能体接手；没有子智能体时就是一次普通交接。输入框下方常驻压力提示，状态点与文字颜色随压力从绿 → 蓝 → 琥珀 → 红逐级变化。

description.en: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information inheritance for native and /fork forks, workspace-scoped session groups, session highlighting, running-workspace prioritization with a blue spinner, and close-current/left/right/all actions on every right-sidebar tab.
description.zh: 为每个会话增加自动保存的笔记本和可拖动关键信息面板，面板支持条目折叠与队列注入；原生分叉和 /fork 会继承笔记本与关键信息；另提供工作区会话组、会话高亮、运行工作区置顶与蓝色转圈指示，以及右侧边栏任意标签的关闭当前/左侧/右侧/全部操作。

description.en: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
description.zh: 输入框旁一枚金色开关：把每次模型请求的推理强度提到当前模型声明的最高档、输出上限提到其 defaultMaxTokens，并在系统提示里追加一段要求穷尽检索、逐条自检的工作纪律。

description.en: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加十种整屏动效背景——星空、代码雨、电路、华山论剑、小猫、小女生、飞机大战、赛车、飘雪、肥皂泡；每回合随机一个，正文列有纱罩保证可读。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style contribution graph: an account-menu row opens a centred dialog with your avatar and name, a year of daily activity in five shades, a year picker and a tooltip on every day.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的日常活动画成 GitHub 风格的贡献热力图：账号菜单里的入口打开居中弹窗，含头像与用户名、按五档配色的一年活动、年份选择器与逐格 tooltip。

description.en: Local hardware monitor for DSH: a sidebar dashboard, a composer-dock CPU/memory/GPU widget, and a hardware_monitor_status tool backed by a local Python service installed separately from the repository root with install-dsh.ps1 (Windows, Python 3.10); installing only the DSH plugin leaves the panel and tool offline.
description.zh: DSH 本机硬件监控插件：侧边栏完整面板、输入框下方的 CPU/内存/GPU 挂件，以及 hardware_monitor_status 工具。数据来自另装的本地 Python 服务：需在仓库根用 install-dsh.ps1 安装（Windows、Python 3.10）；只装 DSH 插件时面板与工具均不可用。

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: HarmonyOS development kit for DSH: five tools for spec search, code generation and rule checks over 366 curated entries.
description.zh: 面向鸿蒙原生开发的 DSH 插件：5 个工具，覆盖规范检索、代码生成与规则校验，内置 366 条内容。

description.en: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.
description.zh: 把DSH的任务结果，以服务卡片形式推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏。安装后请在插件设置页输入授权码，位置：主页面左上角「插件」→ 「dsh-harmonyos-hiboard」。

description.en: Adds one row to Settings → General with a switch that writes or removes a Windows logon startup entry for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, and registers a dsh_autostart tool exposing the same status, enable and disable operations. Defaults to a single HKCU Run value, no admin rights; the startup-folder launcher mode adds an optional delay and launch arguments.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里加一行「开机自启」开关，用于设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的开机自启：写入或删除它的 Windows 登录启动项，并注册 dsh_autostart 工具暴露同一组状态查询、开启与关闭操作。默认只写一条 HKCU Run 值，不需要管理员权限；启动文件夹模式额外支持延迟秒数与启动参数。

description.en: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.
description.zh: 从侧栏打开的整页控制台面板，含八个标签：总览；从 sessions 服务读取的会话列表（标题、目录、运行状态、更新时间，带筛选）；从 pluginInventory 与 pluginManager 读取的已装 bundle 与 Loader 条目，每个 bundle 带启用开关；列出 GitHub 搜索 API 中 topic:dsh-plugin 公开仓库的插件市场；一个模型与供应商编辑器，通过 remote.settings.mutate 写入 llm-pi-ai 配置命名空间（切换会话模型、新增或编辑供应商及其模型列表、经 remote.credentials 保存 API Key，并以合并方式写入以免表单未暴露的字段被覆盖）；MCP 与技能两个标签；以及一个读取宿主回环 /api/dsh-usage/overview 文档的用量标签。所需服务通过 ctx.inject 声明，缺少任一服务的部署只是不挂载该面板，不会崩溃。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.
description.zh: DSH 跨 harness 全局记忆：DSH、pi 适配器与 harnmem CLI 共享同一份本地纯文件记忆库，在一个 harness 写入的记忆在另一个 harness 可用；以字节稳定的热索引注入系统提示，提供五个 harnmem_* 工具、会话结束记忆提取与只读记忆浏览面板。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length content anchor instead of a line number, and the plugin also registers delete, rename, undo_last_edit, ast_grep, ast_edit, lsp and format. Edits answer with a unified diff; a stale or ambiguous anchor is rejected and a fresh one served back; undo survives restarts; structural search and rewrite run on tree-sitter and semantic work through a language server; a bundled web card plugin renders read, diff, grep and LSP cards from the tools' own structured metadata.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一 diff 返回；失效或歧义的锚点被拒绝并重新下发新鲜锚点；undo 跨重启保留；结构化查找与改写走 tree-sitter，语义能力走语言服务器；随包的 web 卡片插件按各工具自带的结构化元数据渲染 read、diff、grep 与 LSP 卡片。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: HAZOP worksheet check: node, guide word, process parameter, deviation and cause, plus required fields and locally configured risk levels.
description.zh: HAZOP 分析表核对：节点、引导词、工艺参数、偏差与原因，以及必填栏目与本机构风险等级口径。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: A memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: set its name, personality and character; it forgets only trivial things, keeps what matters, and marks and remembers what is special to you.
description.zh: 记忆类插件。可设置名字、性格与人格；只淡忘琐事，重要的会保留，特殊的会被记住。

description.en: On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.
description.zh: 每个聊天窗口的第一段工作内容前，先问清缺失的目标、交付物、限制与验收标准，再把回答整理成简短的任务说明注入聊天；纯寒暄不会触发。

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
description.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.
description.zh: 只读读取本机 Hermes Agent 的会话库，把会话导入当前会话作为有界、不可信的背景上下文：输入框按钮可搜索全部 profile 的会话，另有 hermes_sessions_list 与 hermes_session_import 两个工具。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.
description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness - a merge of AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2, dsh-soul-md and dsh-shallow-memory (do not install it alongside those plugins): a diary distilled from finished turns, a hand-written feelings diary, a persona card with version history, a hand-note injected in full every turn, and a short-TTL note layer, each capped separately so per-turn injection stays small; ships agent tools and a sidebar panel for recall, editing, compaction, and backup or restore from a local file, WebDAV or a gzip archive.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆，合并自 AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2、dsh-soul-md 与 dsh-shallow-memory（请勿与这几个插件同时安装）：从结束的对话自动蒸馏的共度时光日记、手写的情感日记、带版本历史的人设卡、每轮全量注入的人格手记，以及带 TTL 的浅层记忆，各自独立限量以控制每轮注入开销；附带一组智能体工具与侧栏面板，可召回、编辑、压缩，并支持本地文件、WebDAV 与 gzip 整包备份还原。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供 Hindsight 配置与状态面板，管理连接、模型、向量和记忆库设置，支持健康检查及经归属核验的本机服务控制；记忆工具由独立的官方集成提供。Hindsight 服务需另行安装，本插件不负责部署。

description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and conflict detection that stops before pushing and keeps local commits. A panel lists up to 100 recent operations with their backup paths.
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: A personal home page for DSH that gathers feature entry points and readings into a card wall: one-click DSH core updates, security review of a plugin before install, local Skill management, session status and more. The page is customizable, and any other plugin can add its own cards through the interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供一个集成功能入口与信息浏览的个人主页：以卡片墙的形式内置一键更新 DSH 核心版本、审核外部插件安全性、管理本地 Skill、浏览会话状态等功能与信息展示。页面支持高度自定义，并可自由通过接口增加新的卡片。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of substitution counts that never records the underlying values.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原、蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警，以及可选的 JSONL 替换计数日志（只记来源与类别计数，绝不记录真实值）。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DSH: block or observe tool calls, and react to completed turns, messages, and title changes with shell commands.
description.zh: 配置驱动的 DSH 生命周期 hooks：拦截或观察工具调用，并对回合完成、用户消息和标题变化执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Writes one short line into the system prompt only when a stress, energy or reward value crosses a threshold; the values rise on real session events and decay over time.
description.zh: 压力、精力、爽度三个状态随真实会话事件涨落、随时间衰减，越界时才往系统提示里写一句话。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
description.zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

description.en: Reload a plugin's source the moment a file changes, without restarting the harness. Covers the third-party plugin case the built-in watcher misses because it skips node_modules.
description.zh: 改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DSH。补上宿主内置热重载因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: Adds a "Hot restart" row under "Sign out" in the DSH account menu; it reconciles the profile plugin tree in place and reloads the page, without restarting the DSH process or dropping the current conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 账号菜单「退出登录」下面加一行「热重启」：原地对账 profile 插件树并刷新页面，不重启 DSH 进程，当前对话不丢。

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence translates it. Ships an offline dictionary: 20,499 entries, 8,960 with bilingual examples, 6,374 with root analysis.
description.zh: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

description.en: Provides a structured, per-session resume editor for DeepSeek Harness with shared chat and sidebar edits, A4 preview, and PDF export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化简历编辑器；每个会话独立保存草稿，对话与侧栏共用内容，并提供 A4 预览和 PDF 导出。

description.en: HS code classification consistency check: chapter, heading, subheading and code hierarchy.
description.zh: HS 编码归类层级一致性核对：章、品目、子目与商品编号层级。

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: Connect Huawei CodeArts and OfficeAce models to DeepSeek Harness: it reuses existing logins (a logged-in CodeArts desktop client or dsh-codearts; the OfficeAce desktop app running and logged in on Windows), shows each account's remaining credits, toggles models per platform, and shapes requests like the official clients.
description.zh: 把华为「码道 CodeArts」与「果办 OfficeAce」两个平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：复用已有登录态（码道桌面端或 dsh-codearts 已登录；果办桌面端需在 Windows 上运行并登录），显示各账号积分余量、按平台勾选模型，并按官方客户端形态构造请求。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: Keeps the PTC run_code deadline from firing while DSH waits for your answer, plan review or approval, so a question can stay open longer than the shipped 120 s budget.
description.zh: 把 PTC 模式 run_code 的执行预算在人机等待期间暂停，提问、计划审议或审批可以超过出厂的 120 秒而不被中断。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: Code intelligence for the DeepSeek Harness IDE workbench: local and semantic completion, go to definition, find usages, hover and signature help, plus the TypeScript, Python, Java/JDTLS and YAML language servers with their memory budget. Requires the dsh-ide-workbench plugin.
description.zh: DSH IDE 工作台的代码智能：本地与语义补全、跳转定义、查找引用、悬浮提示与签名提示，并自带 TypeScript / Python / Java(JDTLS) / YAML 语言服务器及其内存预算。需要配合 dsh-ide-workbench 插件使用。

description.en: JetBrains Database-style data source tree and SQL/Redis consoles with 15 agent tools for DeepSeek Harness. SQL needs Java 8+ installed, Redis does not.
description.zh: 仿 JetBrains Database 的数据源树与 SQL/Redis 控制台，附 15 个 agent 工具。SQL 需本机 Java 8+，Redis 不需要。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

description.en: JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references. Code intelligence is a separate plugin, dsh-ide-codeintel.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 JetBrains 式 IDE 工作台：Project 文件树、Commit 面板、泳道图 Git 历史、真实 PTY 终端与内置编辑器（Markdown 预览、全项目查找），并支持聊天文件链接与发送到聊天框的 @ 引用。代码智能已拆为独立插件 dsh-ide-codeintel。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过可配置的 token 阈值、且用户空闲达到可配置时长后，在模型 KV 缓存过期前自动压缩会话；两项设置都在插件管理器的插件页面中修改。

description.en: CRT idle screensaver for DSH pages: when no session is running and the page has seen no mouse or keyboard input for ten minutes (configurable), a retro CRT plate covers the window with scanlines and a looping inversion sweep. An in-window click or key press dismisses it, the wheel only locks scrolling, and the whole frame drifts slightly after the cursor; rendering is fully GPU-composited frame by frame. An adaptation of justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt (MIT), turned from a boot splash into an idle screensaver.
description.zh: DSH 待机显像管屏保：没有会话在运行、且页面上十分钟（可调）没有鼠标键盘输入时，盖上一块带扫描线与循环反色扫掠的 CRT 板；窗口内点一下或按个键即消失，滚轮只锁滚动，画面随指针轻微视差偏移，逐帧全 GPU 合成。改自 justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt（MIT），把开屏动画改成待机屏保。

description.en: Posts a follow-up prompt into opted-in chats that fall silent, and offers a secret-protected HTTP API that posts a message into any chat. Requires Node.js 22.5+.
description.zh: 在久无动静且主动开启的会话里投递跟进提示，并提供一个带密钥保护的 HTTP API，可向任意会话发消息。需 Node.js 22.5+。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Adds an /if slash command to DSH: the first line is a condition and the remaining lines are an instruction. A fork subagent that inherits the session tools, system prompt and message history judges the condition and answers YES or NO, and only on YES is the instruction sent to the main agent as an ordinary user message, while a NO sends nothing. The condition, judge prompt and verdict never enter the main transcript. While the agent is busy the command queues with ordinary messages, editable, removable and steerable from the queue panel, and a setting switches to the 0.2.x background mode. The judge runs read-only, and falls back to a one-shot model call over a plain transcript when the host has no context-inheriting fork provider. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and later (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20.3 or later.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 /if 斜杠命令：第一行是条件，其余行是指令。由继承当前会话工具、system prompt 与消息历史的 fork 子代理判断条件并回答 YES 或 NO，只有 YES 才把指令作为一条普通用户消息发给主 agent，NO 则什么都不发送；条件、判断用的 prompt 与判断结果都不会写进主会话。模型工作时命令与普通消息一起排队，可在队列面板里编辑、删除、插话，设置里可切回 0.2.x 的后台模式。判断以只读方式运行，宿主没有可继承上下文的 fork provider 时回退为一次性模型调用加纯文本记录。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上（已在 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20.3 或更新版本。

description.en: IFC model quantity take-off with CSV export for quantity checking.
description.zh: IFC 模型工程量提取与 CSV 导出核对。

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

description.en: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
description.zh: 在官方「工作区」标题行上，为每个已接入账号的 dsh-im 通道添加一个 28x28 图标按钮。点击后侧栏切到该通道视图，只显示它的会话、隐藏其余所有行；再次点击回到官方列表。只有已接入账号的通道才会出现按钮。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Image Designer connects DSH to Shenhuo AI designers, with personal OAuth, material uploads, proposals, credit quote confirmation and local downloads.
description.zh: 神火设计师：连接神火 AI 完成图片设计，支持个人账号 OAuth、素材上传、需求匹配、设计提案、积分报价确认与作品下载。

description.en: Image Editor separates uploaded images into editable layers through Shenhuo MCP, with confirmed credit quotes, browser editing and local PSD downloads.
description.zh: 神火图层编辑器：通过神火 MCP 上传并分离图片，确认积分后生成可编辑图层，在默认浏览器编辑，按需导出并下载 PSD。

description.en: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

description.en: Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。
