description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding preview, keyboard-accessible markers; results return as attachments plus a version-1 manifest) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (explicit provider picker, providerId normalization, ChatGPT-web accounts synced into channels, per-channel test/try-run/copy-command, script readiness scan, save validation with .env preview, probing that only disables on explicit quota errors, Chinese/English UI) that writes providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整（含裁切/留白预览）、标记键盘微调，结果以附件 + version 1 manifest 回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（显式选择供应商、providerId 归一化、ChatGPT 网页账号库同步为通道、每通道测试/试跑/复制命令、脚本就绪扫描、保存校验与 .env 预览、只对明确欠费码自动关停、中英双语），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: Five skills for a reviewable engineering incident journal: record an event only when a counterfactual can be written, quiz yourself from the existing entries, audit the journal for decay, ingest outside material together with its provenance, and rename a layout directory while rewriting every reference to it.
description.zh: 五个技能维护一本可复习的工程事故日志：写不出反事实就不记，从已有条目出题自测，体检条目腐化，按出处收外部资料，并能在改目录名的同时改掉全库引用。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Request-side injection and jailbreak plugin for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites only the request copy sent to the model — system-prompt sections, fabricated turns, and keyword or regex replacement — leaving the conversation log and host files untouched; ships unrestricted / nsfw / authority presets, imports the dsh-purge 破甲 prompt as an ordinary preset, enables per agent preset, always-on, or by model and agent preset, and records each injection as a collapsible row in the session.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的请求侧注入与破甲 / 越狱插件：只改写发给模型的请求副本（系统提示词系统段、构造回合、关键词与正则替换），不写入会话记录、不改动宿主文件；内置 unrestricted / nsfw / authority 三个预设，可把 dsh-purge 破甲稿作为普通预设导入，支持按模式自动生效、常驻启用，或按模型与 agent preset 限定，每次注入在会话里留一条可折叠记录。

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with six scenes: Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern sea and Big fat whale.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气、北冥和大肥鲸六个场景。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: Inline visualizer for DSH: the model loads a design contract first, then renders an SVG or a sandboxed HTML card in place inside the conversation, with light/dark tokens and a source/download toggle.
description.zh: 对话内联可视化：模型先按需加载设计契约，再把 SVG 或沙箱 HTML 卡片就地渲染在对话里，支持深浅色令牌与源码/下载切换。

description.en: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
description.zh: 不另开窗口：用右栏内置浏览器，同一份 cookie、同一处登录，指针走到哪点到哪。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched, marking missing details as placeholders instead of guessing, and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话改写成更清晰、以第一人称表达的版本，更容易得到好答案；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，缺的信息用占位符标出而不乱猜，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: No longer updated: folded into dsh-lifeguard (last release 0.2.2). It checked a plugin against what was installed and flagged only real conflicts.
description.zh: 已停止更新：功能合并进 dsh-lifeguard（最后一版 0.2.2）。原来做的是：装插件前先跟已装的比一遍，真会撞上才说一句，先说原因再给动作，装还是照装。

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在跑什么，只读的实例日志与会话概要一点即达。配置了 peer 时，同一个面板会通过带 bearer 鉴权的链路列出并查询其他机器上的实例。所有路由都做回环校验，面向浏览器的操作还要额外通过宿主自身的鉴权。

description.en: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Sales workflow for individual insurance agents: P1-P5 product class matched against the client risk rating, a policy ledger that counts grace periods from the receipt date, and five-section dual-recording checks. 10 tools and 5 skills.
description.zh: 个险代理人的展业工作流：P1-P5 产品分级与客户风险等级匹配、按回执签收日推算犹豫期的保单台账、双录五环节校验，含 10 个工具与 5 个技能。

description.en: Windows only. Autonomous news briefing on user absence or continuous schedule, illustration & anime gallery with tagging and QQ bot search, plus native OS desktop alerts for AI completions, delivered to DSH sessions or IM bots.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。离席或持续自主资讯全网检索与多端推送，精选二次元/色图插画画廊与点图搜图，以及会话状态全局系统原生桌面弹窗通知，支持投递至 DSH 会话与 IM 机器人。

description.en: Five-layer intent recognition pipeline (rules, pgvector retrieval, Jev scoring, fine-tuned arbitration, LLM fallback) with scenario management UI, PostgreSQL storage and distributable API services.
description.zh: 五层意图识别流水线（规则、pgvector 向量检索、Jev 概率精判、微调仲裁、LLM 兜底），带场景管理界面、PostgreSQL 存储与可分发 API 服务。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Checks an invoice ledger for duplicates keyed on code + number, arithmetic consistency, payer mismatch, date anomalies and template placeholders, and emits an anomaly list plus a workbook.
description.zh: 核对发票台账：按代码与号码识别重复、核对算式一致性、付款方不一致、日期异常与模板占位符，输出异常清单与工作簿。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: Always-on-top status pill for DSH on Windows: shows each session's turn state (thinking with a running timer, waiting for approval, done, failed) above every window, and while DSH is in the background it draws a bubble under the pill to approve a tool request (allow once / reject) or answer the agent's questions without switching back to the app; it declines to intercept whenever DSH is in front or the overlay is hidden, so the official cards still handle those. Sessions can be listed one per row (row count configurable) or folded into a +N badge by priority, the pill collapses to a small dot after a state settles and hides itself while a fullscreen app is in front, clicking brings DSH to the foreground and dragging moves it, and it reuses the Electron build already shipped with DSH Desktop so nothing extra is downloaded. A settings card on the plugin page adjusts scale, mini size, position, layout, row count, hold times, effects, bubble toggles and per-state visibility.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 置顶状态胶囊：把每个会话的回合状态（思考并计时、等待审批、完成、失败）浮在所有窗口之上；DSH 在后台时胶囊下方会浮出气泡，可直接批准工具请求（允许一次 / 拒绝）或回答 Agent 的提问，不用切回应用；DSH 在前台或浮层被隐藏时不拦截，仍由官方卡片处理。会话可每行一个纵向排列（行数可调），或按优先级折成 +N 角标；状态结束后缩成小圆点，前台是全屏应用时自动隐藏；点击可把 DSH 拉到前台，拖动可改位置；复用 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron，不额外下载。插件页里的设置卡片可调缩放、迷你尺寸、位置、布局、行数、收起时间、动效、气泡开关和各状态开关。

description.en: Per-directory access gate for DSH: deny / read / full levels for names and paths, roster groups, per-session overrides and an audit log, plus seven model-facing `gate_*` tools whose widening requests must be approved by the owner in the panel. Installs with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate`; MIT, no network calls, state stays on disk.
description.zh: DSH 的按目录访问门禁：对名字与路径给出 deny / read / full 三级权限、名册分组、按会话覆盖与审计日志，另有七个面向模型的 `gate_*` 工具，放宽权限必须由拥有者在面板里批准。用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate` 安装；MIT、不联网、状态只落本地磁盘。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, on demand by default with optional automatic requests, recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layouts, temporary decision preferences, optional request previews with common-credential masking, and local health checks with sanitized diagnostic exports.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见，默认按需询问、可选自动获取，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片布局、临时决策偏好、可选发送前预览与常见凭证遮盖，并提供本地健康检查和脱敏诊断复制。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标：决策服务从带编号的元素表里挑出下一步操作与目标元素，驱动真实浏览器把事办完，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

description.en: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

description.en: A resident bottom-right widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sword-cultivator character that reads your account balance and token spend, keeps a local ledger broken down by model, and has 10 switchable sound effects. Reminders cover low balance, a model waiting on your answer, a pending approval, and staying up too late. Ships 23 idle poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 22 menu-icon skins, six panel tabs, a line-by-line speech-bubble editor, and black or white robes that follow the light or dark theme. Runs entirely locally and registers no agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的常驻挂件：一位剑修守在角落，读取账户余额与 token 消耗，本地记一本按模型拆占比的账，10 路音效各带开关。余额告急、模型在等你回答、等你批准、深夜该睡了，都会开口提醒。23 个常驻姿态加 24 帧剑舞、22 件法宝（菜单图标皮肤）、6 个面板页签、可逐行编辑的气泡编辑器，黑衣白衣跟着明暗主题换。全本地运行，不向 agent 注册工具。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: Reader-first long-form fiction pipeline: setting and character cards first, 21 gate scripts, a 1000-trope library and 700 theme seeds, at most two tropes per chapter, a self-test for every script; the scripts run on the host's Python 3.
description.zh: 读者优先的长篇小说工序：人物卡与设定卡先行、21 个门禁脚本、1000 条桥段与 700 条主题种子、每章最多两个桥段，每个脚本自带自检；脚本依赖宿主上的 Python 3 运行。

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制面板：「Jujutsu」标签页把 jj log 渲染成 change 图，含 change 详情、改动文件与文件差异、revset 输入框，以及 jj 原生历史改写（拖拽 rebase、按文件拆分、修改描述、压缩、放弃、撤销、推送）；直接读 jj 而不经过 git 转译，所有命令以 argv 数组经白名单化的宿主服务执行，带确认、超时与输出上限。

description.en: A dedicated background-job dashboard for the DSH Web UI: merges jobs from every session, shows producer-reported or parsed progress with an honest estimate fallback, groups by status, purpose, session or kind, streams live output, and keeps a local history ledger.
description.zh: 跨会话的后台任务面板：进度按「任务自报 / 输出解析 / 历史耗时估算」三档显示，可按状态、用途、会话或类型分组，支持实时输出、输出内搜索与本地历史台账。

description.en: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

description.en: An agent-kept daily journal: one sentence injected into the system prompt makes recording one of the agent's duties, so what you have done and what you intend to do is written as dated todos and memories, one JSON file per day under the DSH home, and drawn on the right sidebar's month calendar — a hollow ring while a todo is still open, a green dot once every todo is done, a blue dot when the day holds only memories; that injected sentence is rewritten from the calendar itself, which is how you set how eagerly and how the agent records; every entry carries one of five tags (work, study, life, health, other) drawn as a colour-coded chip, todos can be checked off from the card, titles and tags are searchable across every day, and clicking a memory opens the conversation that recorded it and stops at that turn; the ? beside the month heading opens the project on GitHub.
description.zh: 助手主动维护的每日日志：它往系统提示词里注入一句话，把「记录用户做过的事和打算做的事」列为助手的职责，于是这些事被写成带日期的待办与记事，存放在 DSH home 下一天一个的 JSON 文件里，并画在右侧栏的月历上——有待办没做完的那天是空心圈，待办都做完是绿点，只记了记事的那天是蓝点；这句话可以直接在日历上改写，用它调整助手记忆的主动性与策略；每条记录带五个标签之一（工作 / 学习 / 生活 / 健康 / 其他）并显示为同色 chip，待办可以在卡片上勾选，全部日期的标题与标签都能搜索，点击一条记在对话里的记录会打开那次会话并停在对应轮次；月份标题旁的 ? 打开 GitHub 上的项目仓库。

description.en: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzPost tools as mcp__juzpost__* plus a workflow skill that confirms with the user before anything is published. Needs a JuzPost API key in JUZPOST_API_KEY; JuzPost issues API keys on paid plans.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将智能体连接到 JuzPost（社交媒体排程工具）：列出已连接账号、检查各平台限制、上传媒体，并向 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、X、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Tumblr 和 WordPress 起草、排程或发布帖子。注册 mcp__juzpost__* 工具及一个发布前先向用户确认的工作流技能。需要在 JUZPOST_API_KEY 中提供 JuzPost API 密钥；JuzPost 的 API 密钥需付费方案才能创建。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Offline civil-service exam study panel integrating 16 upstream open-source question banks with SRS wrong-book, mock exams, essay grading, an interactive knowledge graph and whitebox observability, plus a HuaSheng-13 methodology view (25 documents) with BM25 search. The npm package ships no question-bank or corpus data: after install, the question-bank manager clones the required set (about 360 MB, needs git) from the upstream repos (all 16 are about 2.2 GB).
description.zh: 离线公务员备考学习面板，整合 16 个上游开源题库，提供 SRS 错题本、整卷模考、申论离线评改、可交互知识图谱与白盒可观测，另有花生十三体系方法论视图（25 篇）与 BM25 检索。npm 包不含题库与语料数据：安装后由题库管理用 git 从上游克隆必选包（约 360 MB，需要 git），16 个上游仓库全量约 2.2 GB。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: six tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：六个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入知识库选择器与原生附件回形针。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: Per-provider API key pool for DeepSeek Harness with manual switching, background reachability probing and plan-usage adapters for DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Zhipu, OpenRouter and other providers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分提供商 API 密钥池，支持手动切换、后台可达性探测与 DeepSeek、Kimi、MiniMax、智谱、OpenRouter 等多家服务商的套餐用量适配器。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Voice dictation scratchpad: realtime speech-to-text into timestamped, per-session blocks, with one-click insert into the conversation composer. Requires the official DSH voice-input bundle (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle); the speech model downloads on first use.
description.zh: 语音听写文本板：边说边出字，生成按会话隔离的时间戳文本块，一键加入会话输入框。 需先安装 DSH 官方语音输入插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle，语音模型在首次使用时下载。

description.en: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

description.en: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
description.zh: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
description.zh: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
description.zh: 提示词场景选择器：下拉选场景即自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

description.en: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: assembles ContextWindow evidence at query time within heading boundaries and token budgets, with follow-up reading around each search anchor; combines BM25/vector search via weighted RRF, MMR and optional local/remote reranking; provides automatic evidence injection, a browser panel for local embedding/rerank/OCR model downloads and health checks, keyword search without model downloads, and in-place rescans of imported directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识库：查询时按标题边界与 Token 预算动态组织 ContextWindow 证据，支持围绕命中锚点续读原文；通过加权 RRF 融合 BM25 与向量召回，支持 MMR 去冗余和本地／远程重排；提供回答前自动证据注入、本地 embedding／rerank／OCR 模型下载与健康检查面板、无需下载模型的关键词检索，以及导入目录原地重扫。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.
description.zh: KuroWhale 黑色系鲸鱼娘桌宠，参考 DeepSeek Harness 官方图标设计的非官方 Windows x64 桌宠，九种动画会随 DSH Agent 的工作状态作出反应；需要 WebView2，首次启动会联网下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时与素材并做 SHA-256 校验。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: Unlock password-protected LabVIEW VI and CTL block diagrams without LabVIEW or Python.
description.zh: 无需 LabVIEW 或 Python，直接解锁受密码保护的 LabVIEW VI/CTL 程序框图。

description.en: Local model scheduler for DSH on Windows 10/11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.x: a bundled console for engine/model import, VRAM estimation, load/close, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地模型调度插件（仅 Windows 10/11，需 DSH Desktop 0.2.x），内置控制台，支持引擎/模型导入、显存预估、加载关闭和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: One shelf for WeChat Reading, GitHub book repos and your own EPUB/PDF/Markdown, with an immersive reader and AI notes.
description.zh: 把微信读书、GitHub 书库和自己的 EPUB/PDF/Markdown 收进一个书架，沉浸阅读并让 AI 解释划词。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: LAN access for the harness process: writes the authenticated links for the harness port, one per local IPv4 address, to a token file and registers DSH_LAN_LINK in the shell environment, and can run a gateway on a fixed LAN port that holds the browser session on this machine, so devices need no token; forwarded requests get Host and Origin rewritten for the same-origin guard, and a host-claim marker is injected so the page renders as the full desktop UI instead of remote-visitor mode. Devices are admitted by CIDR, with optional Basic auth.
description.zh: 把当前 harness 进程的局域网访问交给其他设备：把 harness 端口的已认证链接按本机 IPv4 地址写进一个 token 文件，并在 shell 环境注册 DSH_LAN_LINK；可选的网关在固定局域网端口上对外服务，会话凭据留在本机、设备不需要 token，转发时重写 Host 与 Origin 以通过宿主的同源校验，并注入主机声明让页面按完整桌面界面渲染而不是远程访客模式。设备按 CIDR 放行，可选 Basic 认证。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

description.en: Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程、回复与工具调用描述锁定为指定语言（默认简体中文）：在 system prompt 首、中、尾注入约束段落，提供基础、强化、周期三档强度，可跟随 DSH 界面语言自动选择，设置页显示当前生效语言，并带侧栏快速切换。

description.en: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 已配置的全部模型，以 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口开放给同一局域网；自带 API Key、按 Key 限流、熔断、模型过滤与用量报告。

description.en: QQ (OneBot 11 / NapCat) channel for DeepSeek Harness: bridges QQ private chats and group chats into their own dsh sessions. Ships group guardrails (mention-only, quiet hours, cooldowns, daily quota, peak-hour mute), a tool gate with write-action audit, an outbound filter that stops the model from echoing input tags, voice transcription, media and forwarded-card support, dryRun and usage stats. Forked from dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4. Cannot be installed alongside the upstream dsh-onebot-qq (two QQ channels on one NapCat crash-loop DSH). Private chats answer admins only (an empty admin list means nobody); group chats default to all groups and answer any @-mention, so set groupPolicy to allowlist to restrict who can drive the agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ（OneBot 11 / NapCat）通道：把 QQ 私聊和群聊各自接成一个独立的 dsh 会话。内置群聊闸（只认点名、静默时段、冷却、每日配额、工作高峰闭麦）、工具闸与写操作审计、出站过滤器（挡住模型把输入标签当自己的话复读出来）、语音转写、图片与合并转发、dryRun 试运行与用量统计。由 dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4 分叉而来。不能与上游 dsh-onebot-qq 同装（两个 QQ 通道共用一个 NapCat 会互相抢消息并让 DSH 崩溃循环）。私聊默认只回管理员（管理员名单为空=谁都不回）；群聊默认所有群、被 @ 即应答，任何群成员都能驱动 agent，需要限制请把 groupPolicy 设为 allowlist。

description.en: Read-only JSONL and NDJSON viewer with a byte index, record navigation, and streaming previews for large records. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 使用字节索引逐条浏览 JSONL 与 NDJSON，支持物理行跳转和超长记录流式预览的只读查看器。要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 网关：按话题持久化会话、实时执行卡片、图片与文件输入、聊天内审批和提问、来源白名单，以及用自然语言创建可持久化的一次性或周期 Agent 任务。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

description.en: Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时提醒与延迟发送：一句话到点送达——/later 以你的身份发出，定时面板或 /schedule 发提醒行；关掉网页也准时触发。（定时发送 / 定时提醒 / 延迟发送 / 提醒）

description.en: Free LaTeX formula editor in the DSH sidebar with offline MathJax/PDF.js rendering: ten symbol tiles with hover palettes, ten template groups, live preview, colour/font/size/environment controls, favourites with titles and search, and nine export formats (SVG/PNG/JPG, LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML) with escaping and share links. Image and PDF OCR need a vision-capable model in DSH or your own OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint; everything else runs offline.
description.zh: 免费的 DSH 侧栏 LaTeX 公式编辑器，MathJax/PDF.js 渲染全部离线：10 个符号磁贴悬停展开分类面板、10 组公式模板、实时预览、颜色/字体/字号/环境控制、带标题与搜索的收藏夹，以及九种导出格式（SVG/PNG/JPG、LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML）与转义和分享链接。图片与 PDF 识别需要 DSH 中可用的视觉模型，或你自己配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点；其余功能全部离线运行。

description.en: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 LaTeX 与 BibTeX 检查工具：编译检查（自动识别 xelatex/lualatex），基于 Crossref 的 BibTeX 条目去重与字段补全，以及 \cite 键与 .bib 文件的一致性审计。

description.en: Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：写下的内容按主题归档、与相关条目连边，召回按向量相似度排序（没装模型时退回词面匹配），数据存在本地 SQLite 库里。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: Legal citation check: statute name, article number, text and validity status.
description.zh: 法条引用名称、条号、原文与效力状态核对。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆：对话自动蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像，每步模型调用前自动注入相关记忆。开箱零配置——BM25 + 向量混合检索，可选本地离线嵌入，chat/work 双族隔离。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
description.zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

description.en: Letter of credit document check against UCP600: documents, periods and discrepancies.
description.zh: 信用证单据与 UCP600 不符点核对。

description.en: Lead-mode agent preset plus two runtime skills for the official Agent Teams runtime: a delegate-wait-verify working method, and a wrap-up digest that merges several members' output into one file. Ships no team runtime of its own.
description.zh: 给官方 Agent Teams 运行时配的 Lead 模式预设与两个 runtime skill：一套拆活、派活、验收的工作法，以及收尾时把多个成员产出合并成一份文件的团队汇总。本身不带 Team 运行时。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
description.zh: 发布前凭据审计：在你提交、发布或打包外发之前，遍历目录找出里面的 API key、令牌、私钥、数据库连接串和硬编码密码。零依赖、纯本地、不联网，发现结果脱敏到前 6 个字符。

description.en: DSH Lean Context indexes available tools locally and preselects a clear match or finds tools on demand.
description.zh: DSH Lean Context 为可用工具建立本地索引，明确命中时预选工具，其他情况按需搜索。

description.en: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
description.zh: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: White kitten accountant on the window sill: shows the tokens and money for each answer and for the whole session, the money the prompt cache saved, the context size against the model window, the next peak/off-peak price change and the live DeepSeek balance; it purrs when stroked, reacts while the agent works and synthesizes all of its sounds.
description.zh: 窗台上的白猫记账助手：显示每条回答与会话的 token 和花费、提示缓存省下的钱、上下文占模型窗口的比例、下一次峰谷换价时间与实时 DeepSeek 余额；可摸头打呼噜，随 agent 工作状态做出反应，所有音效均为合成。

description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话（不注入上下文，可按需查）。每次压缩前把用户原话、报错原文、改过哪些文件落盘成一份逐字胶囊，重启后仍能取到（素材与胶囊分别落盘、跨重启保留）；再用交接单让新会话接上上一次的工作。21 个工具、12 个子命令、39 项设置（其中一项可切换「以设置面板为准 / 以项目清单为准」）；纯本地运行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.
description.zh: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime quotes and indices, full-market search, intraday and forward-adjusted candlestick K-line with F10 fundamentals, stock/ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, watchlist with position P/L and price alerts, 13-signal screener with 7 preset strategies, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, three-source 7x24 news, and AI stock analysis.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子：A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、全市场搜索、同花顺式 K 线详情弹窗（日/周/月/5分/30分，含 F10 财务摘要）、股票/ETF/可转债/LOF 榜单、带持仓盈亏与价格预警的自选股、13 项技术信号选股与 7 个预设策略交叉、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、三源 7×24 聚合快讯、AI 个股分析。

description.en: Contract clause work: build the clause tree, map it against a 12-key playbook, register the playbook and export the unresolved report — 5 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 合同条款处理：构建条款树、按 12 项 playbook 映射、登记 playbook 并导出未决清单——5 个 `legal.*` 工具。

description.en: Legal request intake: read requests out of EML, deduplicate threads and export the intake ledger — 2 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 法务需求收件：从 EML 读取需求、按线程去重并导出收件台账——2 个 `legal.*` 工具。

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for legal practice backed by a folder of Markdown notes: SOP lookup, recordings with live transcription and line-level annotations, an inline glossary, and full-text search. Optional email rules library, Pkulaw points and usage badges. Notes, recordings and annotations stay on the local machine; live transcription needs your own Volcengine key and sends audio to Volcengine.
description.zh: 以 Markdown 笔记文件夹为事实源的法律实务工作台：SOP 速查、录音实时转写与逐句批注、可编辑术语表、全文搜索；可选邮件规则库、法宝积分与用量角标。笔记、录音与批注只存本机；实时转写需自备火山引擎密钥，音频会发往火山引擎。

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

description.en: LibTV canvas and media tools for DeepSeek Harness, with three director skills bundled and one-time WeChat QR authorization.
description.zh: 把 LibTV 的画布与媒体生成能力接进 DeepSeek Harness，随包附带三个导演技能，首次使用微信扫码授权一次即可。

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.
description.zh: 个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: WEB ONLY: designed specifically for the Web profile, NOT Electron Desktop. Windows support means Web on Windows, not the Desktop application; installing into Desktop can break startup or restart. Refresh immediately after installation or open /login; HTTP 401 on an old page means sign-in is required, not installation failure. Only an uninitialized data directory displays the temporary password; existing passwords survive reinstalling. Initialize in a trusted network and change the publicly displayed initial password immediately; passwords are never printed in terminal logs. Web lock screen, password/OTP/Passkey, persistent sessions and wallpapers; Windows Web power services can be enabled from the page. Linux/macOS need the bundled controller; npm updates require a dedicated managed install. Stopping interrupts active tasks. Auth kernel adapted from xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway (MIT); do not co-install.
description.zh: 【仅支持 Web，不支持 Electron Desktop】专为 Web profile 设计；Windows 支持仅指 Windows 上的 Web 版，不是桌面应用。请勿安装到 Desktop profile，误装可能导致启动或重启失败。安装后立即刷新页面或打开 /login，旧页 401 不代表安装失败。仅未初始化的数据目录展示临时初始密码；已有密码不会因重装而清空或再次展示。首次密码在页面公开展示，终端不打印，请在受控网络立即改密。提供 Web 锁屏、密码／OTP／Passkey、持久登录和壁纸，Windows Web 支持页面一键配置电源服务。Linux/macOS 需部署独立控制服务；npm 更新限独立托管安装，停止会中断运行任务。认证内核改编自 xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway（MIT），不能与其同装。

description.en: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
description.zh: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

description.en: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)
description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆，加一条绕开主机名级封锁的取数阶梯：四个工具——memory_recall / memory_save / memory_stats 读写 $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json 里的纯 JSON，resilient_fetch 依次尝试直连 fetch → 同服务别名主机（目前仅 Wikipedia）→ curl IPv6 → curl IPv4（curl 需在 PATH 上）。无后台进程、无 npm 依赖、导入期不联网。（1.3.0 曾加入第五个工具 memory_prune，已在 1.4.0 撤下：给运行中的插件加工具，会让此前打开的会话报错。）

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to LINE: runs its own signed webhook server, sets up a Cloudflare Tunnel (quick URL or an API-token tunnel), keeps the LINE webhook endpoint pointed at the current tunnel, and gives each LINE user a separate session with a chosen persona, plus optional scheduled check-ins. Requires a LINE Messaging API channel (Channel ID and Channel Secret); only allow-listed LINE users, or users approved from the pending queue, can talk to the bot.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 LINE 的橋接外掛：內建簽章驗證的 webhook 伺服器、Cloudflare Tunnel（quick URL 或 API Token）、自動把 LINE webhook 端點指向目前的隧道、每位 LINE 使用者獨立 session 與可選人設，並可排程主動傳訊。需要 LINE Messaging API 頻道（Channel ID／Channel Secret）；只有白名單內、或在面板核准的使用者能與機器人對話。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。
