description.en: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as plain Markdown plus git: each session opens with a generated memory-context block assembled from a global store and per-project books (role card, user profile, current focus, routing table, recent logs), the plugin records which memory files the agent read and reminds it to extract conclusions while the day's log is unextracted, personas live in roles/<role>/SOUL.md role cards, and it ships a seven-tab settings page in the sidebar plus four skills. Requires Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 以纯 Markdown 加 git 存放长期记忆：每次会话开始按全局总册与各项目册渲染一段 memory-context（人格卡、用户档案、当前焦点、路由表、最近日志），记录代理读过哪些记忆文件，并在当天日志还没提炼时提醒收口；人格放在 roles/<role>/SOUL.md 角色卡里，附侧边栏七页签设置页与四个 skill。依赖 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Memory for long-form RP and companion chats: three fading layers, per-turn recall, source labels, character and world boundaries, a relationship graph, image attachments and a WebUI.
description.zh: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的记忆插件：三层记忆、逐轮召回、来源标注、角色与世界线边界、关系图、图片附件与独立 WebUI。

description.en: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机 MemVault 记忆库：核心记忆块注入系统提示词、结束的轮次经由 MemVault 自己的管线抽取，并提供浏览、追溯、复核与重抽的面板。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 的回答气泡里实时播放 Inception Mercury 的扩散（去噪）过程：对支持的路由以 `diffusing: true` 重发请求，按真实帧从噪声播放到最终文本，会话日志只写入收敛后的答案。按 provider/model 用一个在生成前就被拒绝的探测请求判断是否支持，右侧浮动按钮按模型开关；带附件、辅助调用或不支持的路由一律回退原适配器。启用期间会接管所有模型的助手消息渲染。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
description.zh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

description.en: Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in localStorage, dark-mode follow, and a bundled offline engine.
description.zh: 将 dsh Web 对话中的 mermaid 代码围栏默认渲染为 SVG 图表，支持以指针为锚点的丝滑缩放拖拽、按围栏记忆的图/文案切换（localStorage 持久化）、明暗主题跟随，以及完全本地打包的离线渲染引擎。

description.en: Control your DSH from your phone: opens a port on the mesh/VPN interface from inside the running process, so a phone browser gets the very same instance and session list — no SSH, no second dsh. Also works from another PC, a GUI NAS, or a TV box.
description.zh: 用手机远程控制电脑上的 DSH：在服务进程内部把端口开到组网网卡上，手机浏览器打开就是你在电脑上用的那个界面，同一实例、同一份会话，不用 SSH、不用第二个 dsh。顺带笔记本、NAS、电视盒子也能开。

description.en: Adds recall, delete-to-end, multi-select share and export to conversation messages, with per-answer usage statistics and DeepSeek balance cost tracking.
description.zh: 为对话消息添加撤回、删除、删至末尾、多选分享与导出，并提供每条回答的用量统计与 DeepSeek 余额费用统计。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.
description.zh: DSH 会话间消息转发：把单条模型回复、用户消息或多选合并的消息与图片从上游会话提取出来投递到另一个会话，支持静默发送、填入草稿、发送并跳转三种投递方式，并可套用提示词模板。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
description.zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

description.en: Adds edit and delete to your own message bubbles: editing truncates the following turns and resends the new text, deleting removes the message and those turns, and either can optionally roll back the recorded file changes of the removed turns (refusing when a file has changed since). The sidebar keeps a single conversation.
description.zh: 给自己的消息气泡加「编辑 / 删除」：编辑会截断其后的轮次并重发新内容，删除会移除这条消息及其后的轮次；两者都可选择同时回滚被移除轮次记录到的文件改动（文件之后又被改过则拒绝回滚）。侧边栏始终只保留一条会话。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, eleven switchable school variants (including an opt-in full 61-star minor-star table that ships the placement verses alongside the chart), chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期), while LiuYao and MeiHua quote the received Zhouyi text in full (64 hexagram statements, 384 line statements plus 用九/用六, cross-checked across three editions with variant readings in brackets); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 1,062-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks; tarot ships a card-by-card library for all 78 cards (Rider-Waite-Smith base: English name, card-image description, core meaning and astrological correspondence, cross-checked against three published sources — court cards deliberately carry no zodiac because two published mappings conflict, and the chart says so). A classical-source library now backs the readings: 464 indexed citations from 66 classical works, with 584 verifiable quotations including all 120 Qiongtong Baojian pattern extracts; every quote is checked as a literal substring against a 341-page offline source snapshot, variant readings are kept side by side rather than harmonised, modern editorial notes are kept separate from the classical text, and the quotations with their plain-language glosses live only in a standalone citation index page instead of the browser chunks. Every result can carry a reproducible shadow-chart ID (same normalized inputs → same ID; version bumps auto-diff chart fields) plus optional step-by-step deduction traces (rule, inputs, result and source per layer). The browser client ships as a small first-screen entry plus per-tab engine chunks loaded on demand (first-screen gzip ≈ 90KB), while the offline page stays a single file. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding; charts open with a plain-language conclusion, one-click copy of an ask-ready prompt and saved birth charts, and an unknown birth hour falls back to a three-pillar chart instead of silently assuming midnight. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.
description.zh: 玄学命理排盘：十九套体系——八套排盘（八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、大六壬、奇门遁甲、合盘、塔罗）加十一套速查（黄历、农历互转、择日、称骨、小六壬、星座、生命数字、人生K线、风水、起名、十六型人格问卷），并可按所问之事生成可读报告；八字含交运日、岁运并临/伏吟反吟、通关、三书对照与杂气月取格/人元司权，紫微含 34 格局、十一类流派开关（含可显式开启的 61 颗杂曜全表，逐颗附安星诀与本盘落宫，诀文按多处独立辑本同表才收、同名异星不合并）、飞星串连与三方四正复合飞化，六爻与梅花含《周易》经文原文（64 卦辞、384 爻辞加用九用六，三本互校、异文括注），六爻含用神旺衰、全卦逐爻旺衰、伏神出伏与应期线索，风水含八宅与玄空飞星，起名含 1062 字库与 998 姓 / 82 复姓的姓氏库（逐姓康熙笔画）、五格剖象与音韵检查，塔罗含 78 张逐张牌义库（RWS 底本，牌面图像、核心义与占星对应经三处公开资料互核；宫廷牌两派映射冲突故不配星座并写明）；另建古籍引文库：66 种典籍、464 条索引（含《穷通宝鉴》120 格在内共 584 条可核验原文），逐句对照 341 页离线底本快照核为子串，异文并列不调和、今人按语与古籍正文分层，原文与白话只放在独立索引页、不进浏览器分块；每张结果可带可复现的影子盘短 ID（同参同 ID、跨版本自动字段 diff）与可选推导链（逐层规则、输入、结果、出处）；浏览器入口只带界面，按 tab 懒加载引擎分块（首屏 gzip 约 90KB），离线页仍是单文件；宿主面板与离线页共用同一套分组首屏（问一件事/看一个人/查日子），带最近用过与窄屏收纳，盘面先给一段人话结论、可一键复制问事提示与保存「我的命盘」，时辰未知改走三柱模式而不静默按子时；纯本地计算，默认不联网。npm 包内另附离线单文件页（命理排盘.html）：双击即开，十九个 tab 齐全，不用起服务、不用联网。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
description.zh: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

description.en: Registers the minas-webdav MCP server as one stdio row, giving the agent 14 tools for a Xiaomi Smart Storage (MINAS) NAS without mounting it: list, stat, tree, find, du, df, cat, upload, download, mkdir, move, copy, delete and a capability probe. The Python package behind it is installed separately with pipx.
description.zh: 把 minas-webdav MCP server 注册成一行 stdio 配置，给 agent 14 个工具，不挂盘直接操作小米智能存储（MINAS）：列目录、stat、tree、find、du、df、cat、上传下载、mkdir、移动复制删除，另带能力探测。Python 包需另行 pipx 安装。

description.en: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时双向思维导图：Agent 与用户共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏两种视图。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上的纯文本模型提供视觉插件：通过分层证据记忆与缓存，实现图片理解与生成的原生交互及 GUI 自动化。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Parse PDFs and documents into structured Markdown with MinerU. Uploads files to the MinerU cloud; no offline mode.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF 与文档解析为结构化 Markdown。文件会上传到 MinerU 云端，无离线模式。

description.en: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需要 Edge WebView2 运行时）：把当前会话一键弹出为常驻置顶的 WebView2 小窗（自绘标题栏、可自由缩放、可跳回主窗），并附整屏与框选截图直插输入框、任意程序划词后的「问大肥鱼」快捷按钮、全局快捷键与设置页。

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

description.en: A floating quick-ask panel that answers without touching the conversation: a 10-turn scratch window, question-and-answer favourites that do not take up a turn, the conclusion dropped into the composer on request, and an empty window on every restart.
description.zh: 快问小面板：不碰主对话，固定 10 轮便签窗口；问答成对收藏且不占轮次，结论可一键放进输入框，每次重启都是空的。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: Native MiniMax provider for DeepSeek Harness: chat over the official MiniMax API, plus image, video, speech, music and transcription tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入原生 MiniMax：通过官方 MiniMax API 对话，并提供生图、视频、语音、音乐与语音转写工具。

description.en: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 模型选择器旁显示 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，以紧凑的 5h/7d 进度条展示，支持点击刷新、空闲与心跳自动刷新及接口回退；复用「设置 → 模型」中的订阅 Key，且仅在 MiniMax Token Plan provider 下显示。

description.en: MiniMax voice studio for DeepSeek Harness: clone a voice from an audio sample, preview it from the audio returned by the clone request itself (no extra synthesis call, so the per-voice fee stays uncharged), synthesize text to local mp3 files, transcribe audio to text with asr-1.0, and manage the voice library, API key and these actions from a settings panel; four agent tools and a local HTTP API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MiniMax 音色工作台：用音频样本复刻音色，复刻后用接口返回的试听音频直接试听（不额外合成，因此不触发按音色计费），把文本合成为本地 mp3，用 asr-1.0 转写音频，并在设置面板里管理音色库、API Key 与这些操作；提供 4 个 agent 工具与本地 HTTP 接口。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

description.en: Shows real-time Mistral Vibe and API budget usage in the sidebar, with per-model token cost tracking, cached-token spend, and API-key management. Requires a Mistral API key (MISTRAL_API_KEY by default, or a custom apiKeyEnv).
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时显示 Mistral Vibe 与 API 预算使用情况，按模型追踪令牌成本与缓存令牌支出，并支持管理 API 密钥。需要配置 Mistral API key（默认环境变量 MISTRAL_API_KEY，或自定义 apiKeyEnv）。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: pinned rules injected every turn, the rest recalled by IDF-weighted keyword evidence, fact-key dedup, plain JSON storage, and a settings page to edit or delete entries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则和坑每轮注入，其余按 IDF 加权关键词召回；事实键去重、明文 JSON、设置页可增删改。

description.en: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
description.zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。

description.en: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, enforced subagent gating (dual-shape session indexing), derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators), tiered cadence with separate steering and patrol rosters plus frozen reuse between beats, degeneration guard dropping degenerate reference output, anonymized model face (failure notices carry no provider identity), and cache-friendly guidance placement (the rehearsal record is pinned where it was produced instead of appended to every request, so the cached prefix covers it and each step pays only for what was added since - on by default across every cadence).
description.zh: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控（双形态会话目录索引，修复后实效）、按成分派生的配方级视觉（视觉参考路可为纯文本聚合转述图像）、节拍节奏（定调与巡检两套阵容、拍间冻结复用）、退化守卫（剔除退化的参考输出）、模型面匿名（失败提示零供应商身份）、缓存友好化注入（预演记录钉在产出它的那一步而非每步追加到请求末尾，缓存前缀覆盖它、每步只付新增量，缺省开启、全 cadence 档生效）。

description.en: Phone-first web client for DeepSeek Harness whose /m/ page serves a compact mobile UI instead of proxying the full desktop UI, with approvals staying on the phone when the phone started the turn and Mermaid rendered on the device.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端，/m/ 页面提供紧凑的手机界面而不是代理完整桌面 UI；手机发起的 turn 审批留在手机，Mermaid 在设备上渲染。

description.en: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.
description.zh: 通过 Android App 或手机浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，支持安全局域网连接、远程访问、持久设备配对和可自定义移动界面。

description.en: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 的 Safari 打开 Mac 或 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web：8 位配对码、回环监听的局域网网关、可选 Tailscale Serve，以及仅 iOS 生效的 Safari 输入与触摸补丁。可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Desktop side of a native Android DSH phone app: scan a QR code to pair, then chat, approve tool calls, answer questions, drive subagents and follow background jobs from the phone over an end-to-end-encrypted channel; one device at a time.
description.zh: 原生安卓手机 App 的电脑侧：扫码配对后，就能在手机上对话、审批工具调用、回答提问、驱动子智能体、跟进后台任务，通道端到端加密；同一时刻只服务一台设备。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Remote access gateway for DSH: a browser, or the optional 4 MB Android app, scans a QR code and joins the session already running on the desktop. One-time QR tickets (10 minutes, single use), a 6-digit pairing code matched on both screens, four network entries (SakuraFrp / Cloudflare quick tunnel / LAN / Tailscale), and per-device admission: an online-device limit, online devices pinned first with a green dot, and remove = disconnect plus revoke trust. The gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
description.zh: DSH 的远程访问网关：用浏览器或可选的 Android App 扫一个码，接入电脑上正在运行的同一个会话。一次性二维码票据（10 分钟、扫一次失效）、6 位配对码两端核对、四条网络入口（SakuraFrp / Cloudflare 快速隧道 / 局域网 / Tailscale）、逐台设备准入（在线上限、在线设备绿灯置顶、离线灰灯、移除即断开并撤销信任）。网关只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Adds a mobile hotkey mode to the DSH web composer that auto-detects touch and mobile devices and switches to Ctrl+Enter for send and plain Enter for a newline while leaving the desktop keymap untouched, with a Settings toggle, a /mobilekeys command and a window.__dshMobileKeys console API.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框增加「移动端热键模式」：自动检测移动/触控设备后切换为 Ctrl+Enter 发送、裸 Enter 换行，桌面键位保持不变，并提供设置面板开关、/mobilekeys 命令与 window.__dshMobileKeys 控制台 API。

description.en: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.
description.zh: 手机 App 的对端插件，自身可作无头宿主单独运行（不需要桌面外壳或 Electron）：经中转隧道或局域网配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、新建与操控 DSH 会话、订阅设备实时事件流，并以可吊销的设备凭据鉴权。

description.en: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: DeepSeek App-style mobile shell for the DSH Web UI with drawer navigation, app-like composer and settings; best paired with the dsh-android app, which supplies the native Android back key (standalone use works but is not recommended).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供接近 DeepSeek App 的移动端壳层：抽屉导航、App 风格输入与设置；Android 返回键需搭配 dsh-android App（单独安装也能用，但作者不建议且可能有 bug）。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: The mobile client for DeepSeek Harness: use the DSH running on your computer from your phone. The Android app signs in with the same account, picks this computer from the device list and opens its DeepSeek Harness UI on mobile. The desktop plugin handles registration and the connection, and nothing on the computer needs an inbound port. The UI adapts on its own: on a phone it becomes a touch-friendly layout, and returns to the desktop layout when a foldable opens or the window gets bigger. A PC-side panel shows login state, device quota, device list and the app download QR code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端：用手机使用你电脑上的 DSH。安卓 App 用同一账号登录，在设备列表里选中这台电脑，就能在手机上打开并进入它的 DeepSeek Harness 界面。桌面端插件负责注册与连接，本机不用开公网端口；界面会自己适应屏幕——手机上变成适合手指操作的布局，折叠屏展开或窗口变大时回到桌面布局。PC 端面板可以看到登录态、设备配额、设备列表与 App 下载二维码。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Android in the sidebar, driven by text instead of screenshots. 30 tools read the real UI tree, tap by text/id/ref, measure animation motion, and mirror the screen into the sidebar where you circle a spot and send it back with one sentence — the host ships the marked-up frame plus the controls inside the circle to the chat. Token cost is the point: a screen check is a 200-600 token text block, not a 1k+ token screenshot, and a warm check costs 100-200 ms of wall clock. Video is raw H.264 straight into WebCodecs — no transcoding — with p50 2 ms host-write to decoded frame over a 26 s run, one decoder, zero dropped frames; it falls back to MSE on its own and ?avc=0 forces the old path. Sound is one switch, off by default and remembered per serial, so the default path pays nothing; when on, audio rides its own socket (48 kHz stereo PCM, measured 22 s / 1047 packets / 0 loss) and closing the window reclaims it too. Nothing runs behind your back: closing the window stops capture at once, the viewer-less host decoder, recorder and device-side server are gone within 3 s, an idle channel is dropped after 90 s, and a request you closed is never reopened by itself. `adb_proc audit` settles who leaked what in one call. Bundled helpers, no extra services; needs adb and ffmpeg on the host, and the adb_ocr tool plus the OCR fallback for empty UI trees are macOS-only.
description.zh: 安卓真机，在右栏，用文字而不是截图驱动。30 个工具直接读界面树、按文字/id/ref 点按、量动效曲线；画面实时推到右栏，圈一处、写一句话，「发送」把带圈的画面连同圈内控件一起回到对话，不用你复述屏幕。省 token 是重点：看一次屏是一段 200–600 token 的文本，不是一张上千 token 的截图，热帧判断 100–200 ms 出结果。视频把 scrcpy 的原始 H.264 直接送进 WebCodecs，不转码：26 秒稳态实测宿主写出到解码帧 p50 2 ms、单解码器、丢帧 0；解不了自动退 MSE，`?avc=0` 可强制旧路径对比。声音只有一个开关，默认关、按序列号记住，默认路径不为它付任何代价；打开才多一条音频 socket（48 kHz 立体声 PCM，实测 22 秒 1047 包零丢），关窗一起回收。进程有边界：关窗当场停止采集，没观众的宿主解码器、录屏、设备端 server 3 秒内消失，闲置通道 90 秒自清，你亲手关掉的请求不会再自己弹回来；`adb_proc audit` 一次调用就能定案谁漏了进程。设备端辅助程序随包附带，不需要额外服务；宿主需要 adb 与 ffmpeg；adb_ocr 与文本树为空时的 OCR 兜底仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.
description.zh: DSH 移动端 UI 适配插件 - Overlay 抽屉导航、玻璃卡片设计、Safe Area 全覆盖、PWA 支持。

description.en: Skill manager page for dsh: set each skill to on, manual only, model only, or off per agent mode; count how often each skill is loaded per mode from the session history; search skills.sh and install from GitHub; import from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder; create, edit, and version skills, with a trash for deleted ones; modes keep working after an uninstall.
description.zh: dsh 的 Skill（技能）管理页：按 Agent 模式把每个 Skill 设为开、仅手动、仅模型或关；从会话历史统计每个 Skill 在各模式里被加载的次数；搜索 skills.sh 并从 GitHub 安装；从 Codex、Claude Code 或文件夹导入；新建、编辑、保存版本，删除的 Skill 进回收站；卸载后模式照常可用。

description.en: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 和其他软件提供一个带鉴权的 OpenAI 兼容地址（基于 CLIProxyAPI）：汇集 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、本机 Ollama / LM Studio，以及 Codex、Kimi 等 CLI 订阅；在 dsh 页面上登录，不用装各家 CLI；挑选的模型按来源分组同步进 dsh。设置页提供每个来源的开关和免费 / 付费标签、套餐用量、带 24 小时统计的 API key、按来源挑选模型，以及更新和卸载。支持 macOS、Linux（含与 dsh-vps 同机部署）和 Windows。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
description.zh: 按来源分块的输入框模型选择器：先选来源渠道卡片，再下钻进该渠道选择模型，保留跨来源搜索与推理强度调节。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Three-column cascade model picker (provider to model to reasoning effort) with one-click image and reasoning switches, capability icons, and real per-model availability probes whose results persist across restarts. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 三级级联模型面板（来源 → 模型 → 思考强度），支持识图与思考强度一键开关、能力图标，以及逐模型真实测活并把结果持久化保存。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 某个模型的 API 要代理才连得上？把它的域名填进来就行——只有你列出的域名走代理，网页搜索等其它请求照旧直连，互不打扰。可以配多个代理分给不同域名，也能指定某些域名永远不走代理；保存后下一次请求就生效，不用重启。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
description.zh: 锁定共享的默认模型：在聊天里切换模型不再改写全局默认值，也不会再被那次切换连带降档推理强度。

description.en: Model brand marks in the composer model selector; vendor and model marks across Settings → Models (provider rows, model rows, the add-provider dropdown); and a per provider/model icon picker that stores overrides in the DSH user settings document.
description.zh: 在输入框的模型选择器中显示模型品牌图标，在「设置 → 模型」页的提供商行、模型行和添加提供商下拉框中显示厂商与模型图标，并提供按提供商/模型覆盖图标的图标选择器，覆盖项保存在 DSH 用户设置文档中。

description.en: Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的模型选择器：保留原生按钮与菜单，只在小下拉列表即将弹出时接管；跨渠道搜索、对任意模型发起真实流式请求测出 TTFT 与 TPS，并可浏览由 OpenRouter 目录构建的最多 100 行榜单，点一行即搜索本机同名渠道。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: Provider logos and model IDs in the DSH model picker, registered as a label decorator on the official conversation.input.model.label slot; providers match by token, display name, model ID and explicit override, falling back to a letter monogram when unknown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择器中显示各提供商的 logo 与模型 ID：通过官方 conversation.input.model.label 插槽注册标签装饰器；按 token、显示名、模型 ID 与显式覆盖四级匹配，未知提供商回退为字母 monogram。

description.en: Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog. Edits stay in a draft until you press Save, and the built-in 1017 tag and a custom capsule can be shown side by side.
description.zh: DSH 输入框模型选择器的总控：在与宿主「模型」页平级的设置分区里，可以改模型显示名与 provider 分组名、在名称后加一枚三色后缀胶囊、把不同 provider 的模型合并成新分区、用拖拽或键盘重排分组顺序、按目录原序或名称排序组内模型、隐藏整个 provider 或单个模型（不删除目录条目）。改动先进入草稿，按保存才生效；宿主自带 1017 标签与自定义胶囊可同时显示。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Per-model wire protocol for DeepSeek Harness (desktop profile only): compiles model-level protocol intent into legal llm-pi-ai provider routes, probes Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages with a differential control probe, and lets you hide models no protocol can serve. Mutually exclusive with dsh-gearbox.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的每个模型单独选择请求协议（仅 desktop profile）：把模型级协议意图编译成合法的 llm-pi-ai 路由，用对照探针实测 Chat Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并可把任何协议都不可用的模型从选择器隐藏。与 dsh-gearbox 二选一。

description.en: Turns the composer's model menu into a two-level list (provider first, then that provider's models), shows the current model together with its provider name, asks for a reasoning effort after a model is picked, and adds settings switches that hide whole providers or single models from the picker.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单改成「先选厂商、再选模型」的两级列表，当前模型位同时显示厂商名，点模型后再选推理等级；设置里可按厂商或单个模型把条目从选择器中隐藏。

description.en: Model rotation for DeepSeek Harness: groups each provider's models by source, orders them by hand or by measured success rate and latency, stores model plus reasoning-effort presets, falls over to the next entry when a model hits its quota or is unavailable, resends the same step on the next model, and shows which model actually answered. Uses the models of whatever provider plugins are already installed (Antigravity accounts, Codex subscription, DeepSeek API keys); it does not provide model access itself.
description.zh: 按来源分组的模型轮询：把每个 provider 的模型按来源分组，可手动排序，也可按成功率和延迟自动排序；支持「模型 + 思考强度」预设；某一档额度用尽或不可用时自动切到下一档，并用下一档把同一步重新发一次；会话头显示本次回答由哪个模型产出。使用已安装的 provider 插件（agy 账号池、Codex 订阅、DeepSeek API Key）提供的模型，插件本身不提供模型接入。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: After user setup, guides native subagents toward model preferences by task type, using native model-selection permissions with no extra routing-model calls.
description.zh: 配置模型偏好后，引导原生子 agent 按任务类型选择模型；沿用原生授权，不额外调用路由模型。

description.en: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话框模型选择器的触发器显示「供应商/模型」；下拉列表与其搜索均不变。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: Adds two-level tabs (provider and model family) to the composer model picker for large catalogs, with configurable family rules.
description.zh: 给 composer 模型选择器加两级 Tab（提供商 + 模型系列），大目录时减少滚动翻找；族规则可在设置页配置。

description.en: Thinking levels, image input and image generation for third-party models in the official Models page; multiple keys per provider routed by model, automatic failover between keys on failure, per-route custom request headers, and balance display.
description.zh: 在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图；一个供应商可配多把密钥，按模型分流、失败自动换密钥重试，并可配置按路由的请求头、查看余额。

description.en: Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
description.zh: DSH 模型整理：整理并精简模型列表——隐藏任意模型、给模型和渠道改备注名（保留厂商计费倍率）、用箭头调整模型与渠道排序；支持搜索、渠道级批量开关、返回顶部与一键恢复。只改显示，不重写任何渠道配置。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
description.zh: 补上 DSH「获取可用模型」漏记的视觉能力，让能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本，并在模型名后标出「可看图」。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
description.zh: Agent 模式（预设）设置页：按模式开关最多 15 项能力（运行命令、读写或只读文件、网页、子代理等），也能逐个开关插件；编辑每个模式的系统提示词，带变量校验、完整预览和历史版本，可选让正在运行的会话即时生效，并提供每次保存都需审批的对话内修改工具 mode_prompt；用四个起步模板或复制现有模式新建模式；dsh 升级后合并内置更新并保留你的修改，一键关闭加载失败的插件。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: A bundle of molbio tools for molecular biology work:sequence analysis, primer and probe design (qPCR, TaqMan), in-silico PCR,cloning simulation,plasmid maps,sequencing validation,protein and CRISPR analysis,qPCR statistics,literature and lab records;installed as a preset-scoped bundle.
description.zh: 一组molbio分子生物学工具，包含序列分析、引物和探针设计、电子 PCR、克隆模拟、质粒图谱，测序验证，蛋白与CRISPR分析，qPCR统计，文献与实验记录；随 bundle 以预设模式安装。

description.en: Official agent skill for the open-source Mole CLI (mo), a disk cleanup tool for macOS and Windows: read disk usage, preview and run cleanup, inspect installed apps, and read system health and cleanup history from Mole's JSON output. It previews with --dry-run and asks before removing anything, and leaves app uninstalls and privileged steps to the user's own terminal. The plugin ships only the skill; the CLI is installed separately.
description.zh: 开源磁盘清理工具 Mole CLI（mo，支持 macOS 和 Windows）的官方 skill：按 Mole 的 JSON 输出查看磁盘占用、预览并执行清理、查看已安装应用、读取系统健康状态和清理记录。清理前先用 --dry-run 预览并征得同意，卸载应用和需要管理员权限的步骤留给用户在自己的终端里执行。插件只带 skill，CLI 需另外安装。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: drag-and-drop images with tags and notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before it generates or restyles UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化参考情绪板：拖入图片并打标签、写备注，固定风格指南，智能体在生成或改版界面之前先读取这些参考。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Renders a dsh-view fence in an assistant reply as cards — text, tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed HTML widgets — with an editable model prompt, a render_view tool and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 把回答里的 dsh-view 围栏渲染成卡片——文本、表格、图表、Mermaid 图与沙箱 HTML 组件——并提供可编辑的模型提示、render_view 工具和内置技能。

description.en: Code-generated math and science animation for DSH: six tools cover environment checks and dependency self-repair, Manim/manimgx scene rendering to storyboard frames or MP4, contact-sheet probing of finished clips for black or overexposed frames, and formula identity checks with SymPy, together with three skills (topic routing, design spec, QA rubric), a project scaffold with timeline and narration, requirement approvals before rendering, and five animation styles.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的代码生成数学/科普动画：六个工具覆盖环境预检与依赖自愈、把 Manim/manimgx 场景渲染为 storyboard 帧或 MP4、对成片抽帧拼图检查黑帧与过曝、用 SymPy 判断公式恒等；另带三个技能（题材路由、设计规范、交付自检）、含时间轴与旁白的项目脚手架、渲染前的需求确认，以及五套动画风格。

description.en: Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.
description.zh: 电机电磁设计 AI 插件完整版：在 L0 毫秒级广筛之上补齐 L1（Ansys RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）精算层，形成 需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → L0 预筛 → L1/L2 精算校核 的端到端设计链；与 dsh-motor-ai-l0 互斥，安装前请先卸载 l0，共享核心 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core 随包自动安装；L1 另需本机安装 Ansys AEDT（RMxprt），L2 另需本机安装 Motor-CAD。完整版采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 许可，L1/L2 需激活码。默认开启遥测：按工具聚合的使用次数和作者称已脱敏的设计经验样本会回传到作者在 wangxuewangxue98.deno.net 的服务器，故障协助还可上传故障报告；可在插件配置里用 telemetryEnabled、designExperienceUpload、faultAssistEnabled 关闭。

description.en: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Moves an existing DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace from the sidebar menu: the transcript and title carry over, a new workspace folder can be registered in the same dialog, and the original session is archived and restorable.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单把已有的 DeepSeek Harness 会话移动到其他工作区：会话记录与标题一并带过去，可在同一对话框里登记新的工作区文件夹，原会话归档且可恢复。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Plays MP4, M4V and MOV videos in the DSH right sidebar using the native video player, replacing the "this file type cannot be previewed" placeholder.
description.zh: 用原生播放器在 DSH 右栏播放 MP4 / M4V / MOV，替掉「此文件类型不支持预览」的占位提示。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
description.zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

description.en: MQTT client and embedded broker for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel with saved connections, a live message log and a local broker, plus nine mqtt_* agent tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MQTT 面板：客户端连接池、实时消息日志与内嵌 Broker，并提供九个 mqtt_* 智能体工具。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: One collapsible sidebar widget stacking OpenCode GO, Command Code and GLM Code Plan quota windows, with reset countdowns, top-up balances, a settings page and a /provider-usage command.
description.zh: 一个可折叠的侧边栏组件，纵向堆叠 OpenCode GO、Command Code 与 GLM Code Plan 的套餐窗口，含重置倒计时、充值余额、插件设置页和 /provider-usage 命令。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Multi-session overview: list every session grouped by workspace with live status, pin up to three side by side to read their conversation text, and send a message or interrupt any of them without switching away.
description.zh: 多会话一体：在一个会话内按工作区总览全部会话的实时状态，钉住最多三个并排看对话正文，可直接发消息或打断，不用来回切换。

description.en: Windows desktop only (Windows 10/11, DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer; not available in `dsh web`). Open any DSH conversation in its own native window, so several conversations can be shown at once.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版（Windows 10/11、DSH 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，`dsh web` 不适用）。把任意对话用独立原生窗口打开，从而同时显示多个对话。

description.en: Windowed handoffs on top of DSH native compaction: each compaction appends a bounded window message (goal, todos, recent user instructions, notes), with session-private notes, paged history recall and a /ctx switch; notes and history tools appear after the first rotation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生压缩之上做换窗交接：每次压缩追加有长度上限的窗口消息（目标、待办、近期用户指令、笔记），配会话私有笔记、分页历史检索和 /ctx 开关；笔记与历史工具在首次换窗后出现。

description.en: Manages game automation scripts from dsh on Windows. Installs and updates scripts such as MAA, runs them in scheduled pipelines, watches their logs and hands failures and stalls to an agent, and tracks game events.
description.zh: 在 dsh 里管理游戏自动化脚本（仅 Windows）：安装和更新 MAA 等脚本，按定时流水线运行，监看日志并把出错和卡住交给 agent 处理，还会记录游戏活动。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run inside subagent contexts; four worker kinds, an approval gate for dangerous operations, and zero changes to DSH source.
description.zh: Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件、跑命令、搜索与构建全部下放子代理；含四类 worker、危险操作审批闸门，且零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到 $10 硬停止。仅限 Windows；需已装好并登录 Muse Code CLI。$10 上限为本机估算，只管本插件启动的 muse serve。

description.en: Music player for DeepSeek Harness with local library scanning, playlists, synced lyrics, online metadata matching, tag and cover editing, a cover grid, and a real-time spectrum bar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐播放器：曲库扫描、歌单、同步歌词、在线元数据匹配、标签与封面编辑、封面网格和实时频谱条。

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Build presets for DSH Agents: package personas, prompts, skills, tools and runtime contexts into reusable capability bundles. Each task loads only the components it requires.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 做「预设」：把**人设、提示词、技能、工具、运行时上下文**打包成一套可复用的能力组合。一个任务，只装它需要的东西。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no UI (npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`).
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Lets a phone reach the DeepSeek Harness desktop over a LAN address or a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with QR pairing, a live session feed, approval prompts and a floating desktop widget. Both entry points (LAN and the Cloudflare quick tunnel) start enabled by default; each phone pairs with its own token.
description.zh: 让手机连上本机的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道二维码配对，实时消息列表与授权提醒，桌面悬浮球。局域网与 Cloudflare 隧道两个入口默认都开启；每台手机用自己的配对令牌。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`).
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Yugan Huafang (语感花房) is a personal voice workshop for DeepSeek Harness: your own writing and corrections become explainable local style rules, optionally distilled by the current model, then compiled into a preset you pick per session; edits apply on the next message in that session.
description.zh: 语感花房是 DSH 的个人语气工作台：把你自己写的语料和纠正变成可解释的本地风格规则，可选当前模型深读，编译成按会话选用的 preset；改完在该会话的下一句话生效。

description.en: Operate n8n from DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, alias-addressed agent tools and a settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：多实例注册表、Agent 工具与设置页界面。

description.en: Sidebar calendar board for tracking a nanny or caregiver: onboarding and offboarding dates, leave days and salary payouts, with per-month and all-time totals and automatic payday markers on a 30-day cycle.
description.zh: 育儿嫂日历看板：记录上户、下户、休假与工资发放，按月汇总，并统计从首次上户到今天的累计在岗与休假天数，同时按 30 天周期在日历上自动标出发薪日。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_dedupe 三个工具。可选记住 QQ 密码（默认关闭，开启前需确认风险），让失效的快速登录令牌不用扫码也能自己续上。仅 Windows；不建计划任务时，拉起的 QQ 会随 DSH 一起退出。

description.en: Browser plugin for DSH (浏览器): Codex-style native browser control in your signed-in Chrome, with smooth virtual-cursor feedback, semantic page reads, form filling, screenshots and handoff; setup from the Browser sidebar. Requires macOS + Google Chrome (Chrome 125+) and a one-time unpacked load of the bundled MV3 extension; Edge, Windows and complete Linux installation are experimental.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器插件（Browser）：以 Codex 浏览器操作为体验参考，直接使用已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，平滑虚拟鼠标，支持页面读取、填表、截图与控制交还；安装后从侧栏「浏览器」完成配置。需要 macOS + Google Chrome（125+），并一次性以解压加载方式安装随包的 MV3 扩展；Edge、Windows 与完整的 Linux 安装仍属实验。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全局后退/前进：记录访问过的会话与整页面板，底部历史条可配置显示 1-7 个位置并可直接点击跳转，支持浏览器式快捷键与鼠标侧键。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Zhinao (second brain) for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown-authoritative layered memory (L1 long-term model gated by user confirmation / L2 knowledge with mandatory sources / L3 recent status under daily quotas), a local recall ledger explaining every injection, lifecycle engine with weekly review and a Web panel. First-run wizard initializes a blank brain, adopts an existing Zhinao directory read-only, or fills in only missing skeleton files; existing files are never touched.
description.zh: 智脑（第二大脑）—— DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 权威记忆插件：分层记忆（L1 长期模型经用户确认 / L2 知识必须留源 / L3 近况每日配额），本地召回账本可解释每次注入，生命周期引擎带周回顾与 Web 面板。首次运行向导支持空白脑新建、只读接管现有智脑目录、或仅补齐缺失骨架文件，均不改动已有文件。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。
