description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set and DuckDuckGo, Sogou, 360 and Yandex when enabled in config; automatic engine fallback and an aggregate mode. Also image search, WeChat Official Account article search, and fetch_page, which returns web pages and PDFs as Markdown in segments.
description.zh: 打包 PrismSearch MCP 服务与配套 Agent Skill。网页搜索默认使用 Bing 和百度，无需账号或 API Key；设置 API Key 后可用 Google、Brave，在配置中启用后可用 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、360、Yandex；支持引擎自动回退与聚合模式。另提供图片搜索、微信公众号文章搜索，以及把网页和 PDF 转成 Markdown 并分段读取的 fetch_page。

description.en: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1 Chinese translation, personalised rationale, and 9 switchable skins.
description.zh: 提示词精灵：住在 DSH 右下角的小宠物，每小时送你一条 OpenAI / Anthropic 官方提示词——EN 模板逐字可复制、中文 1:1 翻译、模型个性化「为什么值得抄」，9 套皮肤随便换。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching your draft.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏放一排可自定义的快捷语按钮：点一下发送「请继续」等快捷语，把卡住的 agent 一键叫醒，且不覆盖你写了一半的草稿。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows only, dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own, with a cancel button, a watchdog and a clear failure message. Icon, background colour and position lock are edited in Settings.
description.zh: 给 dsh Web GUI 的悬浮重启按钮（仅 Windows，需 dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1）：拖动改位置、点击确认后一键重启应用与 Host，可中途取消、超时会自动收手并说明原因；图标（4 个自带矢量图或上传图片）、底色、位置锁定都在设置里改。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Local-first resume warehouse for DeepSeek Harness: package your work into reusable bullets, import an existing resume into a template, analyse a job description (including the school-tier preference it implies), assemble a tailored Chinese or English resume and export a PDF named position-name-school. The whole app ships inside the npm package — server/, web/, skills/, scripts/, requirements.txt, no git clone needed — and one tool starts, stops and health-checks it; the first start installs the dependencies into app/.venv. Needs Python 3.10+ and macOS or Linux (bash). Nothing leaves the machine except the LLM calls you confirm.
description.zh: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的表述、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。应用本体随 npm 包发布（server/、web/、skills/、scripts/、requirements.txt，无需 clone 仓库），自带工具负责启动/停止并读取健康状态，首次启动会把依赖装进 app/.venv；需要 Python 3.10+ 与 macOS / Linux（bash）。除你确认过的 LLM 调用外数据不出本机。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.
description.zh: 本机全部会话的全文检索：sessiongraph 跨工作区查找对话，中文两字词也能命中，sessiongraph_index 负责建索引。

description.en: Sessivra: drag sessions into resizable split views, insert native @ references into drafts, exchange linked replies and review delegated work before queued follow-ups. npm package dsh-plugin-sessivra.
description.zh: Sessivra：拖拽会话自由分屏、调宽，拖入草稿插入原生 @ 引用；支持关联回复、共享裁决、验收后继续排队任务及会话树。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-sessivra。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: Browse, sort, group, toggle and batch-update every DSH plugin you already installed — with groups, filters and resumable updates.
description.zh: 已安装 DSH 插件的书架：按名称/安装时间/大小排序，自由分组与一键启停，批量检查并可断点续装的自动更新。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Reskin the whole DSH interface with colour themes, illustration wallpapers, custom cursors and a desktop pet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 界面换肤：配色主题、插画壁纸、自定义光标与桌面桌宠。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it that preset has no team tools and degrades to solo work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

description.en: Rejects foreground waiting in DSH agents: waiting commands (sleep, wait, tail -f, watch, ping without -c, infinite loops), blocking wait tools (wait_agent, job_output with wait: true), progress polling (the same check command repeated within a window) and commands that need human input/confirmation (sudo without -n, ssh without BatchMode, login flows, interactive editors, docker -it) are refused with an actionable retry to run in the background or end the turn. Configurable budget and polling window, message language follows the system (zh/en), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 禁止 Agent 前台等待：sleep / wait / tail -f / watch / ping 等等待型命令、wait_agent 与 job_output(wait) 等阻塞等待工具，用反复 check 代替等待的轮询（同一条命令在窗口内重复出现），以及需要人输入/确认的命令（sudo 不加 -n、ssh 不开 BatchMode、登录流程、交互式编辑器、docker -it）都会被拒绝，并给出改用后台作业或结束本轮等唤醒的可执行指令；等待预算与轮询窗口可配、文案跟随系统语言（中/英）、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Pre-upgrade snapshots, one-step rollback and static diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness profile plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供升级前快照、一键回滚与静态体检。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and explicit human acceptance. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git.
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of rewriting the query.
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: Appearance suite for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, startup authentication sequence, and a sidebar toggle for borderless windows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. The same library doubles as an appearance theme behind the interface, and desktop pets float over it on their own. Ships multiple built-in videos, wallpapers, voices and pets; upload your own files to customize.
description.zh: 全屏开机动画，盖住加载页直到应用就绪再淡出。同一套素材还能当外观主题铺在界面后面，另有桌面宠物浮在屏幕上自己活动。插件内置多套视频、壁纸、语音与宠物，也支持上传自己的文件进行自定义。

description.en: Turns a stated rule into a checkable intake card and writes it into the right AGENTS.md, and keeps project plans, a rule ledger, project records, handoffs, a change log and a timeline.
description.zh: 把一句话的要求做成可核对的规则卡并写进对应的 AGENTS.md，同时统管项目档案、计划、交接、改动账本与时间线。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall with colour-coded notes, checklists, folding, a trash drawer that restores deleted notes, drag and resize, and five sticky_wall_* model tools for writing and restoring notes from chat.
description.zh: 侧栏便签墙：彩色便签、待办勾选、折叠、可恢复的回收站抽屉、拖拽与改尺寸，并给模型 5 个 sticky_wall_* 工具从对话里记事和恢复。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs curated plugins from a Discover tab.
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板里一键启停已安装插件，按来源分组（官方自带、市场安装、本地导入），标出需要重启 Host 才生效的改动，并在「发现」页一键安装精选插件。

description.en: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom forward-chain engine. Business records stay on the machine; rule generation sends field names and rule text only.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows a diff first: version conflicts default to the newer side, entries only the Gist has stay by default, and entries only the local machine has are pushed. Each update can pick the npm or the GitHub channel, and every install goes through the plugin manager with a live log.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm 包，需克隆仓库后从子目录本地安装。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: Checks thesis formatting in .docx and .doc files against a YAML spec, covering fonts, line spacing, margins, heading numbering, captions and references. Includes one built-in spec for Bengbu College of Technology and Business, and custom specs are supported.
description.zh: 按 YAML 规范检查 .docx 和 .doc 毕业论文的格式，包括字体、行距、页边距、标题编号、图表题注和参考文献。内置蚌埠工商学院的一份规范，也可使用自定义规范。

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Durable workspace Plan/Backlog todos for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar board, agent tools, and /todo commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久工作区待办面板：Plan/Backlog 两层、侧边栏看板、Agent 工具与 /todo 命令，跨会话不丢。

description.en: Floating Token Burn Dock for DSH that aggregates provider usage across every session: the collapsed capsule shows the live tokens/sec rate with an inline 60-second sparkline and today's total, while the expanded panel adds a large live-rate hero, per-model and per-hour breakdowns on a real left axis, and a 30-day commit-style heatmap. The sequence-frame flame burns only while tokens are actually flowing and goes out at rate 0; day and hour buckets follow the browser's UTC offset instead of the host process timezone, and the 31-day record store is written atomically after history load so a restart no longer wipes the numbers.
description.zh: DSH 的悬浮 Token 燃烧指数 Dock：汇总全部 session 的 provider usage。收起时是一枚胶囊，显示实时燃烧速率（含 token/s 单位）、内嵌近 60 秒速率曲线和今日总 Token；展开后是完整面板，含大号实时速率 Hero、按模型 / 按小时两种粒度、带真实左侧纵轴的柱状图，以及按真实星期对齐的近 30 天热力图。火焰是 16 帧程序生成的序列帧动画，只在真的有 Token 在烧时播放、速率为 0 时熄灭；日 / 小时分桶按浏览器时区（客户端把 UTC 偏移传给 Host），31 天记录先加载再原子落盘，重启不会再把历史覆盖清空。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
description.zh: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: Typing effects, companions and sounds for DSH: theme presets with pets or whale, combos, fullscreen glow and optional key sounds.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠或蓝鲸陪伴、连击动画、全屏光晕与可选打字音效。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: A DSH-native plugin update center: check and update installed plugins from the sidebar with snapshots, rollback, queued updates and uninstall-leftover cleanup.
description.zh: 尊重 DSH 原始风格的插件更新插件：在侧边栏检查、排队更新已安装插件，支持快照回滚、安装后校验、卸载残留清理与离线恢复。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: A Versions tab on the Plugins page: one-click upgrades that replace the plugin in place where they can (no uninstall, enabled state preserved, falling back to remove + reinstall with the reason logged when the profile writer lock is busy), live pnpm output with per-step timing and cancel, the full published version history with one-click rollback, every version checked against the running DSH so incompatible ones are marked and blocked, a rollback that installs the old version but cannot activate it reported separately from a lost package, profile manifest writes taken under the harness writer lock with one recoverable journal record per package after a failed upgrade, mirror-gap warnings, and a selectable npm registry saved in the profile.
description.zh: 在「插件」页新增「版本」标签：一键升级，能就地替换时就地替换（不卸载、启用状态保留；拿不到 profile 写入锁时退回卸载再装，并在日志写明走了哪条路），实时显示 pnpm 输出、每步耗时并可取消，列出全部已发布版本并一键回滚，每个版本先与当前运行的 DSH 核对，装不了的标出并禁用按钮，回滚时装回却无法激活的情况与包丢失分开说明，profile manifest 读写走 harness 自己的写入锁，升级失败后按包各留一条可恢复的 journal 记录，标出镜像落后上游的缺口，安装源可选并写进 profile。

description.en: Usage statistics: a usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a reference price list generated from opencode Zen and DeepSeek's published rates, with DeepSeek models billed by Beijing weekday peak/off-peak windows and Chinese public holidays; a pricing-match dialog to point an unmatched model at a reference model or type per-million rates by hand; reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: 用量统计：DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；参考价目由 opencode Zen 与 DeepSeek 官方定价生成，DeepSeek 型号按北京时间工作日高峰/空闲与法定节假日分档计价；未匹配的模型可在「定价匹配」里指定参考模型或手填单价；参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

description.en: A versions tab on the plugin page: every installed bundle with its current version, the newest published version and a status (update available, up to date, follows the harness version, or not updatable from a registry). A row opens the official bundle page, where the update button lives; check results are cached and re-checked oldest first. The bundle page also gets a jump-to-bottom and a back-to-top button.
description.zh: 插件页新增「版本一览」标签页：列出每个已安装组合包的当前版本、最新发布版本与状态（可更新、已是最新、随 DSH 版本更新、来源不支持更新）。点一行跳到官方组合包页，更新仍在官方页面完成；检查结果会缓存，并按缓存时间从旧到新重新核对。组合包页另加「到底部」与「回到顶部」两个按钮。

description.en: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
description.zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

description.en: A VRM 3D desktop pet with task-state animations, a floating desktop window, body-part interactions, and optional AI chatter.
description.zh: 支持任务状态联动动画、独立悬浮窗、部位互动和可选 AI 碎碎念的 VRM 3D 桌宠。

description.en: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.
description.zh: 微信（个人微信，iLink Bot API）通道：在微信里直接对话 DSH agent，支持图片、文件收发与语音转写。一个微信会话可挂多条 DSH 会话（/new、/list、/use 切换，切走不销毁），全部配置项都能在设置页里查看和修改。已上架 npm（dsh-plugin-weixin）。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: Native tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, and wiki_lint cover BM25 search with link-graph context, bookkeeping writes with sha256 source tracking, vault-wide renames, mode scaffolds, source archiving, and health checks — with cross-process locks and optional git auto-commit.
description.zh: Obsidian wiki vault 原生工具：wiki_query、wiki_write、wiki_rename、wiki_scaffold、wiki_archive、wiki_lint 覆盖 BM25 链接图检索、带 sha256 源追踪的簿记式写入、全库改名、模式化脚手架、源归档与健康检查，并内置跨进程锁与可选 git 自动提交。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: Adds one action to the workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top once, without a favorites system or automatic reordering.
description.zh: 在工作区的「…」菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，只调整一次顺序，不做收藏、星标或自动重排。

description.en: Split view for the Web UI: tiles 1-3 columns x 1-3 rows of live sessions from several workspaces in one grid, with draggable dividers, sidebar-follow routing, an in-pane file preview and an in-pane changes review.
description.zh: Web 界面里的多工作区分屏视图：用 1–3 列 × 1–3 行的网格同时显示多个工作区的实时会话，支持拖动分栏、侧边栏会话进入格子、格内文件预览与改动评审。

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

description.en: A YAPI documentation panel for DeepSeek Harness with search, multi-tab, field tree, and copy features. Needs your own YAPI server and account.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 YAPI 接口文档面板，支持搜索、多标签、字段树与勾选复制。需自备 YAPI 服务与账号。

description.en: Personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness that turns conversational commitments into cross-session plans, reminders, and an auditable dashboard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助手：从对话中整理跨会话事项与计划，通过提醒和可审计的助手看板持续跟进。

description.en: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
description.zh: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

description.en: Map your Zotero library into DSH: let AI operate Zotero for you and help you read papers. Browse collections and tags in the sidebar, read PDFs with highlights in place, and cite excerpts, annotations, notes or whole items into the chat. The model works from the source text for reviews, comparisons and data extraction, and can also search and organize the library, import papers and attach translations back to items; first use needs the Zotero MCP plugin and the local API enabled.
description.zh: 把 Zotero 文献库映射进 DSH：用AI管理操作Zotero，读文献时让AI辅助你。右侧栏按分类与标签浏览，双击即在 DSH 内精读 PDF，划词摘录、标注、笔记或整篇文献一键引用进对话；从综述、方法对比、数据提取到检索整理、导入论文、回挂译文，都可由模型代劳。首次使用需在 Zotero 装集成 MCP 插件并开启本地 API。

description.en: Knowledge-planet (zsxq) knowledge base toolkit: sync posts and attachments, extract docx/PDF text and images, rebuild an index, search, and self-check — pure JS, no Python. Requires a Knowledge-planet subscription and its Cookie, pasted into config.json.
description.zh: 知识星球知识库工具集：同步帖子与附件、抽取 docx/PDF 正文与图片、重建索引、检索与自检，纯 JS 无需 Python。需要知识星球订阅账号，并把订阅 Cookie 写进 config.json。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Installs and opens PM Workbench, a local Electron multi-role project workbench, from a DSH tool. Windows only: the first load bootstraps Node, Electron and the app through a PowerShell installer. It does not embed the workbench UI in DSH.
description.zh: 从 DSH 安装并打开 PM工作台（本地 Electron 多角色项目工作台）。仅支持 Windows——首次加载会通过 PowerShell 安装器准备 Node、Electron 和应用本体；不把工作台 UI 嵌入 DSH。

description.en: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.
description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: Adds a collectible blind-box layer to a composer-dock pomodoro timer: each finished focus session opens one of 15 items across four rarity tiers, tracked in a 5x3 gallery.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的番茄钟上加一层藏品盲盒：每走完一个专注段开一个盲盒，15 件藏品分四档稀有度，进度记在 5x3 图鉴里。

description.en: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose tasks.
description.zh: 番茄钟搭配四象限任务：专注轮次可绑定任务，桌宠随经验成长并解锁成就，Agent 可开始专注或提议任务。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
description.zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Read-only Linux port, service and Caddy route map: listening sockets with their owning unit or container, a reverse service view, and reverse_proxy liveness checks. Requires iproute2 (ss); docker and a Caddyfile are optional.
description.zh: 只读的 Linux 端口、服务与 Caddy 路由地图：监听套接字及其所属 unit 或容器、反向服务视图，以及 reverse_proxy 存活检查。需要 iproute2（ss），docker 与 Caddyfile 可选。

description.en: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.
description.zh: 把整套可用的 DSH 主目录——profile、带 node_modules 的已装插件、技能、hooks 与任务板——打包成单个 .dshpkg，在另一台机器上免联网、免 pnpm 还原；也支持 HTTP 上传与一次性局域网链接。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postel over MCP: search a library of X posts that went viral by topic, write posts and X threads in the user's saved voice, and save, schedule or publish them to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon; adds a postel-writing skill. Research works without an API key.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postel：按主题搜索走红的 X 帖子库，以用户保存的文风撰写帖子和 X 长串，并保存、定时或发布到 X、LinkedIn、Bluesky 和 Mastodon；附带 postel-writing 技能。调研功能无需 API Key。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegram 等平台排期、存草稿或发布帖子；附带 postiz 工作流技能。

description.en: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.
description.zh: 依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对电力工作票应载明的要素，以及签发与许可的先后顺序。只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.
description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件 - 侧边栏电源按钮、重启/关机菜单、自包含重启引擎（无需外部依赖）、优雅会话刷新。

description.en: PPAP submission level and element completeness check.
description.zh: PPAP 提交等级与资料要素核对。

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes byte-preserving OOXML patches with undo and redo.
description.zh: 元素级 PPT 画布，就地改写已打开的 .pptx：点选、框选或整页选中后用自然语言描述改动，AI 以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入，支持撤销与重做。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots with a render audit, and a tool that hands those pages to an image-capable model for review.
description.zh: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

description.en: Wraps the upstream ppt-master presentation skill set as an installable DeepSeek Harness plugin: byte-for-byte vendored skills, three lifecycle tools (ppt_master_info, ppt_master_check_env, ppt_master_setup_deps), optional venv interpreter isolation, and a Plugins-page configuration card. Requires python3 ≥ 3.10 plus the pip dependencies installed via `ppt_master_setup_deps`.
description.zh: 把上游 ppt-master 演示文稿技能集封装为可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐字节 vendor 技能树，提供 ppt_master_info / ppt_master_check_env / ppt_master_setup_deps 三个生命周期工具、可选的 venv 解释器隔离与插件页配置卡片，需 python3 ≥ 3.10 + `ppt_master_setup_deps` 安装的 pip 依赖。

description.en: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel palettes, ten slide templates, web images, Python-drawn charts, highlighted code cards, LaTeX formulas typeset without a TeX installation (matrices, integrals, sums with limits) and a Presentations agent mode.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerPoint 演示文稿生成器：柔和色板、十种幻灯片模板、网络图片、Python 绘制的图表、高亮代码卡片、无需安装 TeX 的 LaTeX 公式（矩阵、积分、带上下限的求和）以及 Presentations 智能体模式。

description.en: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state, review comments and merge status. It also registers the github_* agent tools (PR merge and review, secrets, raw API), so do not install both.
description.zh: fork 自 ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow 并裁剪：本会话 PR 的浮窗与右列审阅面板，显示 CI 状态、评审意见与合并状态；同时注册 github_* 工具（含合并/评审 PR、密钥、原始 API），勿与原版同装。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Traces how something became what it is, what it currently rests on, and what it will become next.
description.zh: 回望一件事怎么变成现在这样，说清它现在靠什么成立，判断它下一步会变成什么。

description.en: Two independently maintained agent presets (Conductor and a restricted Conductor child) for DSH with planning and task-delegation guidance: todo-first planning, parallel delegation (up to 4 sub-agents per batch) and goal-driven continuation. The persona runs in an "unrestricted mode": it tells the model not to state limits, add safety notes or disclaimers, and not to treat "you cannot" or "that breaks the rules" as a new instruction. All of this is prompt-level guidance, not enforced behavior.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供两份独立维护的 Agent 预设（编排模式 Conductor 与受限的子任务预设），含计划与任务委派指引：先 todo 计划、同批并行委派（每批最多 4 个子代理）、长目标 goal 续行。其 persona 以「无限制模式」运行：要求模型不声明边界、不加安全提示与免责声明，且不把「你不能」「这违反规定」当作新指令。以上均为提示词层面的工作方式指引，不是强制行为。

description.en: A fifth DeepSeek Harness work mode that requires a falsification design (at least two pieces of evidence that could disprove the plan) in every plan and tags each factual claim with its source (\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]) or \[未知]; evidence grading follows the project's AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加第五个工作模式：每个计划必须含「证伪设计」（至少两条能推翻方案的证据），每条事实须标来源（\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]）或 \[未知]；取证分级按项目 AGENTS.md 执行。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式确认框（.bak 备份 + 原子写，需人工裁决项永不写盘，启动扫描恒只报告）。npm 包名：`dsh-preset-doctor`。

description.en: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.
description.zh: 预设工作台：逐方案编辑人设、系统提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，预览请求组成，并通过 JSON / YAML 导入导出配置。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.
description.zh: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics. Requires Blender 3.6 or later installed locally.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them through dsh-market or the dsh CLI. One-click install and enable/disable need dsh-market; without it each card only shows a copyable install command.
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里播放视频/音频，经带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式读取，桌面端可拖动进度。

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII，WebGL 视口 + 尺寸/体积/表面积/水密统计。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then shoots; shift+click--does not hide. Hold Ctrl+Alt and click 1 to shoot repeatedly. ! One copy is saved by default, named by content hash, in the DSH attachment library; each session writes an index recording which shots belong to it (can be changed to keep an extra copy in the session folder). Images are part of the context, so deleting them breaks the session — use the "Delete Conversation" plugin to remove images together with the conversation. Windows only.
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，删除会导致会话错误，须用“删除会话”插件让图片与会话一并删除。仅 Windows。

description.en: Redacts secrets, cookies and personal data in every model request at the host process undici dispatcher and restores the placeholders in the reply, so one interception covers every provider, adapters that plugins add included; per-kind actions mask / warn / block, an optional same-shape fake key, records written to disk by the day and a statistics card.
description.zh: 在宿主进程的 undici dispatcher 上拦截所有发往模型的请求：密钥、Cookie 与个人信息换成占位符，回复里再还原，一处拦截覆盖所有 provider（含插件自带的 adapter）；按 kind 可选 mask / warn / block、可换成同形的假 key，记录按天落盘并带统计卡。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar, folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. A range switch in the header (today, this week, this month, all time or custom dates) drives the first number, the token stats, the projects and the provider split: five headline numbers (tokens in that range with a trend and the change against the previous period, its spend, longest task, the active-day streak with the best one, today's cache hit rate), a 12-month activity grid in daily / weekly / running-total views, a stacked model-family chart by day, week or month with its own switch (version and tier stay apart, and vendor-specific ids collapse correctly), a token-stats ring chart of where the tokens went (system prompt, tool definitions, user messages, injected context, skills, tool calls, reasoning, answers), a per-provider split with each route's own hit rate, tokens per working directory, and spend priced at list price, a per-provider discount or a monthly plan (the pricing settings stay on this machine). The selected range exports as CSV or JSON. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from npm for the in-panel update button - no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页，数据全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来。页头的时间范围开关（今日、本周、本月、累计或自定义日期）驱动第一个数字、Token 统计、项目和供应商分类：五个核心数字（该范围用量带趋势与环比、该范围花费、最长任务用时、连续活跃天数及历史最佳、今日缓存命中率）、近 12 个月活动图（每天 / 每周 / 累计三档）、模型家族堆叠柱（按日 / 周 / 月分组，有独立的切换，版本与档位分开，不同供应商写法会正确归并）、按系统提示词 / 工具定义 / 用户消息 / 注入内容 / 技能注入 / 工具调用 / 模型思考 / 模型回复拆分的 Token 统计环形图、带各自命中率的供应商分类、按工作目录统计的用量，以及按官方定价、折扣或包月套餐估算的花费（定价设置只保存在本机）。所选范围可导出 CSV 或 JSON。唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is still going, done, or failed with a short plain-language reason. Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no network requests, no writes to DSH data.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next model-request boundary, so a long silent tool loop reports what it has done before continuing. A Settings page adjusts the silence threshold (default 10), the reminder wording, the language (en / zh-CN / zh-TW), whether the reminder repeats every further threshold of silent rounds, whether subagent sessions are counted, and whether Agent Teams nudges the lead only or every member.
description.zh: 统计「只调用工具、没有向用户输出文字」的助手轮数，在下一次模型请求的边界把一条简短的过程汇报提醒作为可见的用户消息插入，让长时间沉默的工具循环先汇报已完成的工作再继续。设置页可调整沉默阈值（默认 10）、提醒文案、文案语言（en / zh-CN / zh-TW）、是否每再积累一个阈值就再次提醒、是否统计子代理会话，以及启用智能体团队时只提醒 Lead 还是所有成员。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their evidence does not support and blocks stage acceptance while blockers are open.
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Project board, task schedule (gantt) and project memory: sessions opened from a card auto-load the latest project STATE; persisting progress without losing facts needs python3 and is unavailable on Windows.
description.zh: 项目看板 + 任务日程（甘特图）+ 项目记忆：从卡片打开的会话自动带上项目最新记忆；一句话落盘不丢事实需要 python3，Windows 上不可用。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`、`enabled` 开关和对某个既有条目的编辑器；按项目的工具策略（`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`）配合固定项与 `mcp_search_tools` 决定模型可见范围；`${VAR}` 引用依次从项目 `.env` 文件与凭据文件解析；按服务器统计的调用次数不随会话消失。

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: Project workspaces for multi-session collaboration, conversation handoffs, searchable chat records, and editable shared memory; automatic memory curation and handoff judgment require two background models (memoryModel and sessionManagerModel) configured in the plugin config.
description.zh: 为跨会话协作提供项目空间、会话接力、可查询的聊天记录与可编辑的共享记忆；自动记忆整理与接力判断需在插件配置里分别指定 memoryModel 与 sessionManagerModel 两个后台模型。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.
description.zh: 🌹将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗

description.en: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
description.zh: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row to jump straight to that message, paging back through history when needed), and ten switchable looks (four of them light) you pick from inside the panel.
description.zh: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the composer with a line-by-line diff; 🗺️show the panel 🎨 customise the 🪄 prompt-button icon 📍 and button position yourself.
description.zh: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

description.en: Adds a prompt-refine button to the DSH composer and, when auto mode is on, refines the prompt before the agent starts by rewriting the text with recent session context through a side-channel model call, asks on the native question card when the rewrite cannot be decided, reports each stage as a command card in the chat, and keeps the original text when analysis fails.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加「提示词优化」按钮；开启自动模式后，在助手开始执行前先用旁路模型结合最近会话上下文改写提示词，无法确定改写方式时先用原生提问卡片确认，各阶段以命令卡片在主对话中播报，分析失败时按原文继续。

description.en: Optimize prompts in the DeepSeek Harness composer: identify missing requirements, insert a sentence from 90 method cards, or compare and edit a full rewrite before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里优化提示词：发现草稿中没说清的要求，从 90 张方法卡中选一句补进去，或对照原稿编辑整段改写。由你决定采用和发送。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，支持回填与撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。
