description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Adds the owning workspace and current Git branch under each session row in the flat session list.
description.zh: 在单列表的每个会话行标题下方显示所属工作区与当前 Git 分支。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.
description.zh: DSH 会话与工作区管理——工作区：归档与显示。会话：跨工作区移动、预设迁移、删除；收藏、待回看、优先级、标签、备注。批量操作。

description.en: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.
description.zh: 把当前会话导出为可读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话正文：用户消息、助手文本与 ask_user_question 问答，通过会话标题栏按钮或 /md 命令触发。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: Read-only monitor for local DSH sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im. Requires Python 3 with the zstandard package; IM push additionally needs the dsh-im plugin.
description.zh: 只读的本机 DSH 会话监视器：实时任务看板、会话事件尾随、阻塞等待回复、Markdown 导出，可选配合 dsh-im 推送 IM。需要 Python 3 与 zstandard 库；IM 推送需另装 dsh-im。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: move, delete, search, archive, favorite and flag sessions as to-dos, and organize them with tags, notes and folders across workspaces. An AI pass can summarize a session and write its notes and tags in one go.
description.zh: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：进行会话转移、删除、搜索、归档、收藏、待办等操作，对您的会话进行标签、备注，使用文件夹分组，方便地管理您的会话和工作区。同时也可以调用 AI 对您的会话进行一键总结、备注、修改标签。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: Session operations for DeepSeek Harness: really delete persisted sessions (ungrouped, temp, archive and subagent filters; guards on running, live and workspace sessions) and move sessions between workspaces (log relocation, header.cwd rewrite, workspace registry follow). Ships the shared session-store library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话运维：真正删除持久化会话（未分组、临时、归档、子代理四种筛选；运行中、仍在宿主加载中与属于工作区的会话默认拒绝删除），并在工作区之间搬迁会话（日志迁移、header.cwd 改写、workspace 注册表跟随）。内含共享的会话存储库。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it is costed from the Flash rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool full-text searches past session logs with cwd-scoped authorization, a CJK substring fallback and a degraded raw-scan; every hit carries the sessionId plus the newest exported-report path, closing the loop with the export and eval plugins.
description.zh: 确定性跨会话转录检索：`recall` 工具全文搜索历史会话日志，带 cwd 授权边界、CJK 子串回退与降级直扫；每条命中携带 sessionId 与最新导出报告路径，与 export、eval 插件闭环。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachments along the way. It also scans the files a conversation actually wrote, adds a file query that pastes the path information into the conversation so an agent can judge which files are safe to delete, highlights them in Explorer, and copies the paths grouped by type. Both this and iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 会话两段式删除：对话移入回收站、可恢复回侧栏原位置；两段确认式删除，防止误删文件，连带整条子代理树、侧栏账本、投影缓存、日志与专属附件。同时能扫出一条对话真正写过的文件，增加文件查询功能，点击后将路径信息粘贴到对话中，通过Agent来判断哪些文件可以删除；在资源管理器中多选高亮，并复制按类型分好的路径。本插件与 iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Rewinds a finished turn in place — a button next to your own message withdraws that message and everything after it from the model context, puts its text back in the composer for editing, and optionally restores the files the turn changed through the DSH filesystem service.
description.zh: 就地回退已完成的回合：点你自己消息旁的按钮即可把这条消息及之后的内容从模型上下文中撤回，原文回到输入框可直接改完重发，并可一并恢复该回合经 DSH 文件系统服务改动过的文件。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Saves a whole DSH session as one .dsproj project file and opens it back. The session header gains an open button, a save button, a save-as button and an autosave switch, and the blank-session page gains its own open button. The first save asks where to put the file and later saves overwrite it; opening a .dsproj re-imports the session, switches to it, and can write the bundled workspace memory back on request.
description.zh: 把整个 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，并能再打开回来。会话标题栏上多了打开、保存、另存为三个按钮和自动保存开关，空会话页面另有自己的打开入口。第一次保存会问存到哪里，之后一键覆盖；打开 .dsproj 会导入该会话并切过去，按需可以把包里的工作区记忆合并回本机。

description.en: Persistent search bar in the conversation header: keyword-search the message bodies of past sessions, then open the session at the matched text.
description.zh: 对话页顶部常驻搜索栏：按关键词搜索历史会话的消息正文，点击结果直接打开会话并定位到命中的那段文字。

description.en: Names sessions as a category plus a short topic. A sidebar action reads the conversation, asks its model for the pair, and pre-fills an editable title; a smart_rename_session tool gives the same naming to the agent, which renames the session it runs in when the topic moves on.
description.zh: 把会话命名成「分类 · 主题」：侧边栏菜单读对话、让会话所用的模型给出分类与主题并预填可编辑的标题；另有一个 smart_rename_session 工具，让 agent 在话题切换时自己改名。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the credential never reaches the model.
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：盯一个 GitHub 仓库，issue/PR 有变化就唤醒本会话；需已登录 gh CLI，凭证留在插件内，不进模型。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Call between DSH sessions in different working directories or projects: message any session (next-step delivery or a new turn), end a blocking tool call on request, and read transcripts and usage without waking the target.
description.zh: 在不同目录 / 项目的 DSH 会话之间通话：向任意会话发消息（下一步直达或开新轮），可按需结束对方阻塞中的工具调用，并在不唤醒对方的情况下读取记录与用量。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, title-language control, a settings page, and hover duration/cost/token stats.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题固定为「日期 | 分类 | 名称」，支持自动重算、标题语言、设置页，以及悬停查看耗时/估算成本/token。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Idle-time context truncation for a single DeepSeek Harness session. After a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped without a summary, so one long-lived session cannot leak one task into the next; it ships a per-session toggle, a tab next to the chat, and a /truncate command that IM bridges can drive.
description.zh: 单个会话的空闲定时上下文截断：可配置空闲多少小时后整段丢弃较早的对话（不生成摘要），避免长期存活的会话把上一个任务带进下一个；带每会话开关、会话上方的「上下文截断」选项卡，以及 IM 桥接可直接驱动的 /truncate 命令。

description.en: Session-first DSH sidebar: pinned, active and recent sections, workspace grouping, focus groups, search and a session trash bin.
description.zh: DSH 的会话优先左侧栏：置顶、活跃、最近分区，工作区分组，专注模式，搜索与会话回收站。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
description.zh: 把 ShaderToy 作品作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景：WebGL2 播放器 + 背景库（含 5 个预设），可调界面不透明度、亮度、分辨率与帧率，支持画面循环与音乐播放设置，并能在设置页直接编辑当前着色器代码。

description.en: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
description.zh: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
description.zh: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
description.zh: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

description.en: One image behind the whole DSH shell. The image layer sits at z-index -1 and the shell's two --dsw-* tokens are repointed at translucent tints, so the picture shows through the frame, sidebar and composer. Ships a bundled default picture so it works with zero configuration, plus a floating panel with five sliders, presets, upload, and an SSRF-guarded URL import; changes persist to a local settings.json and the client self-heals when the SPA replaces its stylesheet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 外壳铺一张背景图：图片层挂在 z-index -1，并把外壳的两个 --dsw-* 令牌改成半透明色，让背景透出侧栏、中栏和输入框。内置一张默认图，装完零配置就有；右下角浮动面板提供五个滑杆、预设档、上传与带 SSRF 防护的链接导入，改动写进本地 settings.json，样式表被 SPA 顶掉时会自动重画。

description.en: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠「深深」：跟随任务状态切换待机/敲键盘/思考/庆祝/失败，支持点击挥手、拖动左右奔跑，并保留 API 余额、本机用量记账、角色、气泡与音效设置。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）；请勿与上游同时安装，否则会出现双角色与重复请求。

description.en: Public-username checks over a pinned 481-site Sherlock manifest; six states, random negative-sample verification for claimed results, default core 41, all capped at 120, NSFW off by default.
description.zh: 基于固定 481 站点 Sherlock 清单检查公开用户名，返回六态结果，对 claimed 做随机负样本校验；默认 core 41，all 单次最多 120，NSFW 默认关闭。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Keyboard-driven quick switching for DSH — model palette with colored provider tags, suffix tags and pins, a two-column session palette with per-question prompt preview and archived-session restore, recency-ordered session cycling, find-next-answered jump, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling, managed from a sidebar control panel.
description.zh: 键盘驱动的快速切换：模型面板（彩色提供方标签、后缀与推理标签、置顶）、两栏会话面板（提问预览、归档会话恢复）、按活动时间顺序的会话循环、查找下一个已回答的会话、聚焦输入框、可配置的权限循环，侧栏控制面板统一管理开关与改键。

description.en: Adds a strip of saved prompts above the composer: click a chip to insert its text at the draft caret, and manage the list — add, edit, reorder, delete — in an inline panel that opens in place. Prompts persist per profile and are also exposed to the agent as a quick_prompts tool; a fresh install starts with no entries.
description.zh: 在会话输入框上方维护常用 prompt：点胶囊把内容插入草稿光标处，并可展开内联面板新增、编辑、排序、删除；条目按 profile 持久化，同时以 quick_prompts 工具提供给 agent，初始不预置任何条目。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a sidebar card to DeepSeek Harness (Windows verified) that shuts the machine down once every task finishes and the card is armed, holding back while background jobs, errored sessions or manual interruptions are still in play; the 1.6.1 beta adds restart, sleep, hibernation, lock, sign-out and user-supplied scripts, and mounts on macOS and Linux too (implemented, not yet tested there).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一张卡片（Windows 已验证），武装后等所有任务结束自动关机；后台任务在跑、本批次有会话报错、或你手动中断过，都会按条件暂缓并说明原因。1.6.1 beta 另加重启、睡眠、休眠、锁屏、注销与自定义脚本，并可在 macOS 与 Linux 上挂载（已实现，尚未在真机实测）。

description.en: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

description.en: Native agent control for the DSH right-sidebar browser: semantic snapshot with stable refs, clicks/typing/key presses, shadow DOM and same-origin iframes, recorded JS dialogs, full-page screenshots, back/forward, viewport resizing, and native large-file download/upload through the Electron webview. Page control needs DSH Desktop (Electron webview); in the Web build only tab management works.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏原生浏览器的 Agent 控制：语义快照与稳定 ref、点击/输入/按键、Shadow DOM 与同源 iframe、JS 对话框记录、整页截图、前进/后退、视口尺寸调整，以及基于 Electron webview 的原生大文件下载/上传。页面内容操作需 DSH Desktop（Electron 原生 webview）；Web 版只能管理标签页。

description.en: Controls the Browser panel DSH renders in the right Sidebar: numbered refs from a snapshot, click/type/press/select/scroll, query-scoped reads and change diffs, up to 12 steps in one call, and multi-tab focus/close.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照返回编号控件，支持点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动，按问题检索阅读与变化对比，一次调用最多 12 步，并可切换和关闭多个标签。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.
description.zh: dsh 网页端侧边栏整体增强：长按拖拽重排面板图标栏，一个箭头即可整栏折叠；面板列表与置顶区都按整行限制高度（占侧栏 30%，向下取整行）；置顶会话区镜像原生行的实时状态（转圈、待回复、相对时间）；顶部会话视图标签可拖拽换位；归档会话按时间新到旧沉到每组末尾；分叉出的子会话自动跟进父会话所在的置顶区；并把任意插件注册在侧栏底部的入口提升到同一栏内。每个子系统各自带启动守卫，单个失败只返回 null，不影响整个插件挂载。

description.en: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的加项面板行（自动化任务、agent 团队、插件市场、上下文页等）收进宿主「更多」行：在该行挂一个 28x28 箭头按钮，点一下把它们收成一行、再点复原；折叠状态按窗口持久化，保持可见的行用逐行开关从当前侧边栏实时枚举后选择，被管理行的图标与文字还能切换左/中/右对齐。纯 client 插件：只新增 DOM，不打宿主补丁，卸载后恢复原样。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，其它版本装上也不会生效。

description.en: Fold the DSH left sidebar's plugin entries into a single 「插件列表」 row with grouping and custom ordering, giving vertical space back to the workspace and session list; expanding restores the full entry list.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，支持按组归类与自定义顺序，把纵向空间还给工作区与会话列表；展开即恢复完整入口。

description.en: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: Adds custom ordering and tucking away to seven strips of buttons and cards in DSH (the left sidebar, sidebar footer, conversation tabs, composer dock, session header icon strip, right sidebar and settings navigation), plus per-area drag switches and JSON layout import/export. Tucked rows land in the built-in More menu of that region and can be dragged back out.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的七处按钮与卡片区域（左侧边栏、侧栏底部、对话标签、输入框工具条、会话头部图标条、右侧栏、设置导航）提供自定义排序与收纳，并支持分区拖动开关和布局 JSON 导入/导出；收纳项会进入该区域内置的「更多」菜单，可随时拖回。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: Let the model read the current session's sidebar: the active tab, open tabs, terminal screens and browser page text (page text is desktop only; the terminal channel needs DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: 让模型按需读取当前会话的侧边栏：当前选中标签、打开的标签、终端屏幕与浏览器网页正文（网页正文仅桌面端；终端通道需 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Right-click menus for DSH sidebar rows: on DSH 0.2.2+ both rows use the host menus — workspace rows follow the session grouping (new session, copy path and reveal, pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu, bulk delete) and session rows extend the menu that opens at the pointer with pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu and permanent deletion of archived sessions; entries stay in the right-click menu by default and can be opted one by one into the shared "…" menu. On 0.2.1 the workspace menu is drawn by the plugin. Adapted from miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu and 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu; do not install it alongside either - all of them attach right-click menus to the same sidebar rows.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏行右键菜单：在 DSH 0.2.2 及以上，两类行用的都是宿主菜单——工作区行按会话菜单的分组排入新建会话、复制路径与在文件夹显示、置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单与批量删除；会话行在指针处展开菜单，并追加置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单以及已归档会话的永久删除。条目默认只出现在右键菜单，可在设置里逐项开启「同时放进「…」菜单」；0.2.1 上工作区菜单由插件自绘。 改编自 miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu 与 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu，请勿与它们同时安装——三者都会给同一批侧边栏行挂右键菜单。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部固定状态区：DeepSeek 账号钱包余额、当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）、手动刷新与官方充值入口。

description.en: Adds three switchable sidebar layouts, an always-expanded session list and temporary sessions that are deleted when DSH exits (by default) to DeepSeek Harness, with default-layout and feedback controls in the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三种可切换的侧栏布局、默认全部展开的会话列表与默认在退出 DSH 时删除的临时会话，并在插件详情页设置默认布局与反馈入口。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Hides the sidebar's global panel navigation (Plugins / Market / Schedules / More) and gives the vertical space back to the session list; three modes, switchable in Settings → Sidebar.
description.zh: 隐藏侧栏顶部的全局导航（插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 更多），把垂直空间还给会话列表；三档模式，在 设置 → 侧栏 里切换。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边追问与划选注释，保留完整对话历史，将结论带回主线。

description.en: Right-sidebar browser for DSH Web: renders public sites over CDP, local/dev pages through a same-origin proxy, emulates desktop and phone viewports, and turns element picks into chat annotations. Fork of zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser (MIT), install one or the other — both add their own right-sidebar browser tab and drive a separate Chromium. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 to 0.2.x, Node.js 22.19+ and a Chromium-based browser on the host (auto-detected, or set chromePath).
description.zh: DSH Web 的右侧栏浏览器：经 CDP 渲染公开网站，本地/开发页面经同源代理访问，可模拟桌面与手机视口，并把元素点选转成聊天批注。fork 自 zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser（MIT），两者二选一安装——都会新增自己的右侧栏浏览器标签页并驱动各自独立的 Chromium。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 至 0.2.x、Node.js 22.19+，以及宿主机上的 Chromium 系浏览器（自动检测，或设置 chromePath）。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Browser bridge for DeepSeek Harness: captures page markup (DOM with boxes and computed styles, selector candidates checked for uniqueness) and the site's own xhr/fetch calls with headers and bodies, redacting credential-shaped values on ingest, into workspace files — then drives the page with trusted CDP input to verify what was captured. Ships 11 tools and an MV3 extension that works in the browser's own session. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+; the extension is loaded manually and paired with a local token.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器桥接：把页面结构（带盒子与计算样式的 DOM、经过唯一性校验的选择器候选）与站点自身的 xhr/fetch（含请求头与请求体，凭据形态的值在写入时脱敏）抓取为工作区文件，再用可信 CDP 输入驱动页面验证抓取结果。包含 11 个工具与使用浏览器自身会话的 MV3 扩展。需 Chrome/Edge 125+，扩展需手动加载并用本机 token 配对。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
description.zh: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: Skills and MCP browser behind one floating ball with five tabs: Skills (native folder picker, two-level categories plus custom groups, tree or flat view, manual, keyword and AI grouping on metadata only, search, and per-card or whole-library enable/disable with timestamped backups), Call Ledger (counts, success rate, trend, ranking), MCP (live loader config, real Fiber states, per-server tools and call stats, enable, disable, reconnect, export to mcpServers JSON, plus scan-and-AI-fix for unconfigured servers), Market (MCP marketplace: the official MCP Registry plus 29 curated free servers, 19 flat categories with per-category counts, grid and list views with 3-6 cards per row, one-click install into cordis.patch.yml with automatic backup, one-click uninstall, every server shown with its own real icon, two-way instant sync with the MCP tab, and the last scroll position is recalled) and Quick Start. 130 skins sync across the three balls. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 技能与 MCP 浏览器：一个悬浮球五个页面。技能浏览（系统目录选库、两级分类加自定义分组、树状/平铺、手动/关键词/AI 分组且只发元数据、搜索、单卡或全库启停并自动备份）、调用台账（次数/成功率/趋势/排行）、MCP（真实 loader 配置与 Fiber 状态、工具与调用统计、启停/重连/导出）、市场（MCP 市场：官方 MCP Registry 与 29 条精选免费服务器，19 大类平铺并带每类数量，网格/列表双视图且每行 3~6 列，一键安装写入 cordis.patch.yml 并自动备份、一键卸载，每条服务器用其自身真实图标，与 MCP 页双向即时同步，并记忆上次滚动位置）与快速上手。130 款皮肤在三颗悬浮球间同步。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Skill cockpit page in the DSH app-level nav (sidebar.panellist seat): lists every skill this machine actually exposes across all six skill-root kinds, explains why a skill is invisible (dropped reason, missing root, or disabled), and toggles one skill by renaming only its entry file (SKILL.md and SKILL.md.disabled); project-level skill roots stay read-only.
description.zh: DSH 应用级导航里的「技能中心」页（sidebar.panellist 席位）：列出本机实际暴露的全部技能（覆盖六类技能根），说明某技能为何不可见（被丢弃的原因、根目录缺失、已停用），只改入口文件名（SKILL.md 与 SKILL.md.disabled）即可单独启停；项目级技能根保持只读。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Diagnoses why a skill is not picked up — truncated description, broken frontmatter, missing resource files — and checks installed plugins for conflicting loader entries. Keeps a per-profile record so every checkup is diffed against the previous one, groups repeated findings into one root cause, produces rewrite worksheets for oversized descriptions, and lists the plugin patches that touch the skill directory configuration.
description.zh: 诊断技能为什么没被模型选中——简介被截断、文件头损坏、引用文件缺失——并检查已安装插件之间是否存在 loader 条目冲突；按 profile 自动保存体检病历、每次复诊对比上次差值，把重复出现的问题归并为同一根因，为超长简介生成改写工单，并列出改动了技能目录配置的插件 patch。

description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all. It uses the same package name (dsh-skill-hub) and mount id (skill-hub) as hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub and amd47802574/dsh-skill-hub, so only one of the three can be installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。包名 dsh-skill-hub 和挂载 id skill-hub 与 hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub、amd47802574/dsh-skill-hub 相同，三者只能装一个。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: Manages DSH skills and MCP servers from the web settings: skill cards with hot enable/disable, workspace scopes, groups, batch migration and drag-and-drop import, plus stdio/HTTP MCP CRUD with connection tests, secret redaction and the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: A skills button at the bottom-right of the input box: one click opens every installed skill with search, categories and favourites, and the skill you pick is inserted into the box. Each answer also lists the skills that turn actually used.
description.zh: 输入框右下方有一个「技能」按钮，点开就能搜技能、按分类浏览、收藏常用的，选中后直接插进输入框；回答下方还会列出这一轮真正调用过的技能。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, appends the selection to the composer in one click, and can pin skills and prompts as always-on context injected through the system prompt.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出当前会话可用的 Skill，支持搜索与标签，可与自存提示词组合后一键追加到输入框；还能把 Skill 与提示词设为常驻，经系统提示注入每个新对话。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-skills` teaches the agent to derive a tag set from the machine it is running on.
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Grouped on/off switches for the skills a DSH profile exposes: the effective set is the union of the groups that are switched on, with a catalog-derived group for the skills shipped with the harness, a panel over the composer, and skill_toggles_* tools for agents.
description.zh: 按分组开关 DSH 暴露的技能：生效集合是所有启用中分组的并集；含成员由当前目录判定的自带技能分组、输入框上的面板，以及给智能体的 skill_toggles_* 工具。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailable。证据视图给每一类对象三态之一（声明 / 已观察 / 无法取得），沿定义 → 加载 → 使用 → 结果走一遍，逐段写明它够不着什么，不把结果归因给这个 Skill，并能把快照按逐字节稳定的 JSON 复制出去。验收把 Agent Skills 开放标准与各平台 Profile 分开判，每条发现落在规则 id 上并标注「标准合规」或「平台兼容」。评测用可重复的用例记录每次运行的条件与四段运行时证据，只在同一个用例内逐项对照两次运行，不给分。触发边界维护「应触发 / 不应触发」的提示词，由你在真实新会话里跑一遍再记录观察到的结果——加载记录出现过没有、`model-invoked` 还是 `user-explicit`；手打 `/name` 不算自然触发，没有加载记录只写成「未观察到」，不写成「没有触发」。同一批投影也作为只读工具 `skill_review` 交给 Agent，它返回结构化审查包，包太大时会说明省略了什么。检视器、证据链与上面这些审查都在本机按定义与会话收据算；中文阅读版在你需要时把正文交给宿主模型翻译，代码围栏、路径与 frontmatter 逐字保留，译文只存本机。另外可以把一份 Skill 复刻成本机副本。它不改写源 Skill，也不执行源里的脚本。

description.en: Searches the installed skill catalog on a trigger word, requires a use-or-skip decision for every candidate, and blocks other tools until all selected skills are loaded.
description.zh: 触发词命中后先检索本机已安装的 skill，要求对每个候选登记使用或弃用的理由，并拦住其它工具直到选定的 skill 全部加载。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: Registers the Zemingxingxiao five-element brand-diagnosis skill with five companion reference skills (theory, diagnosis playbook, 240-case library, visual templates, glossary), a system-prompt router, and the mandatory HTML report template with 13 theory diagrams.
description.zh: 注册择命行效五行品牌诊断技能及五个伴随参考技能（理论、诊断手册、二百四十案案例库、可视化模板、术语表），带提示词路由与强制 HTML 报告模板、13 张理论配图。

description.en: Knowledge-planet (zsxq) knowledge base skill: sync posts and attachments, extract docx/PDF text, guide topic category, summary and quote enrichment, rebuild the index, and search. Requires Python ≥3.10 with the packages in requirements.txt plus your own zsxq account cookie.
description.zh: 知识星球知识库 skill：同步帖子与附件、抽取 docx/pdf 正文、指导分类/摘要/金句富化、重建索引与检索。需要本机 Python ≥3.10 与 requirements.txt 里的依赖，以及你自己的知识星球账号 Cookie。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against the published npm package (same source as market installs; npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取 npm 发布版本的更新检查（与市场安装源一致；npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Import Agent Skills from Git repositories, group them by repository, and enable or disable each one in DSH settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中从 Git 仓库导入 Agent Skills，按仓库分组管理，并逐项启用或停用。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

description.en: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 桌面外观：按度量表还原的灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体边框、直角、16px 滚动条，以及由插件自身路由提供的点阵字体。

description.en: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页工作区添加按城市当地时间变化的天空主题，支持太阳移动、日夜配色、浮云、时间预览与沉浸天空。

description.en: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
description.zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply/health 五工具），Socket Mode 免公网回调。

description.en: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.
description.zh: /new 指令：在当前工作区打开空白会话（已有空会话可直接复用），并把原会话的权限预设与 Agent 预设带入新会话，开新会话不会悄悄改变代理的可用权限。

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Creates and edits presentations in DeepSeek Harness and exports editable PPTX files.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中生成和编辑演示文稿，并导出可编辑的 PPTX 文件。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

description.en: What it does while she sleeps, in one card. Two things: (1) tidy the element memory — merge synonyms only when the model agrees, trim descriptions, prune weak links, propose analogies for the user to confirm, with a backup before every write and a 15%-of-library cap per pass; (2) dream — stitch her own past experiences (plus props from the element memory) into a short 3–6 sentence story, leave one line on her desk as a note labelled "this is a dream, not something that happened". The dream lives in its own file and never enters her memory or her personality prompt. Requires @ssamurias/dsh-fish for her event stream and dsh-memory-brain for the element library; model-approved merges and dreams need a local Ollama model (or a paid API key).
description.zh: 她睡着时的两件事，装在同一个设置页里。① 睡眠整理：模型点头才合并同义词，压短描述，剪掉弱边，把元素组合成猜想请用户确认；每次写入前先备份，单次改库不超过全库 15%。② 潜意识梦：拿她自己经历过的旧事（加上元素库里的"道具"）拼成 3–6 句的小故事，在桌上留一句并标明「是梦，不是发生过的事」。梦只存在自己的文件里，不进她的记忆，也不进她的人格提示词。需已装 @ssamurias/dsh-fish（提供经历）与 dsh-memory-brain（元素记忆库）；模型复判与做梦还需要本地 ollama（或付费 API）。

description.en: Context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: when the window fills up it rolls over to a fresh one with zero summarization model calls, archiving the old window verbatim for line-by-line recall; handoff anchors carry task orientation, working notes survive compaction, and a stale-notes gate warns instead of vouching for outdated notes. The trigger follows the provider budget equation (window - max_tokens) and the real routed model even after a mid-session switch. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文窗口自动管理：窗口快满时零模型调用换窗，旧对话整窗无损归档、可逐字回查；交接锚点带任务定向，工作笔记跨压缩存活，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；触发线按（窗口 − max_tokens）预算方程计算，中途切模型也按真实路由测量；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 命令，三带自动换窗，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.
description.zh: 缓存优先的上下文压缩，提供可选的自适应经济策略，默认仅观察，不保证缓存命中或费用节省。

description.en: Smart naming for sessions and workspaces: one click asks the profile model for short name candidates from the item's own content, then renames in place.
description.zh: 会话与工作区的智能命名：点一下让模型基于条目自身内容给出短名候选，选中即改名。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: Layered global and workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, with a web panel to browse entries and tune distillation and consolidation, an index kept in context with records loaded on demand, and a per-session choice of layer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层的全局与工作区记忆：Web 面板中查看、控制条目并调整记忆整理与整合设置；索引常驻上下文、详情按需加载，每个对话手动选择要加载的记忆层。

description.en: Hangs a clothesline of polaroid photos under the DeepSeek Harness message composer, on the session page and the new-session home screen; photos from a local folder refresh within seconds and clicking one opens a lightbox preview.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 消息输入框下方挂一条拍立得照片晾衣绳（会话页与新会话首页都会出现）；可换成自己文件夹里的照片，几秒内自动刷新，点击照片打开灯箱预览。

description.en: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
description.zh: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

description.en: DSH-SOLO desktop plugin for its companion app. Pair by QR code to view sessions, send tasks, switch models, transfer attachments and approve operations with end-to-end encryption; official cloud relay preconfigured, no server setup required. Download the App APK at https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk (GitHub Releases).
description.zh: DSH-SOLO 手机远程协作的电脑端插件，搭配 App 扫码连接，查看会话、发送任务、切换模型、传递附件并确认操作审批；支持端到端加密，已配置官方云转发服务，无需自行部署服务器。App 安装包下载：https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk （GitHub Releases）。

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
description.zh: 管理 soul.md 人设卡与长期记忆，支持按工作区和会话选择人设，并提供读取和更新工具。

description.en: Persona, mood, long-term memory and per-person ledgers for a DSH agent, with a portable soul pack for moving between machines.
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 装上人设、心情、长期记忆和按人账本，并支持把整套灵魂打包迁移到另一台机器。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: Plays a sound when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权时播放提示音，并提供分类开关。

description.en: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

description.en: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alone.
description.zh: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2—2020 control-chart constants.
description.zh: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图控制限与 CPK。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.
description.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆表盘与流动曲线趋势图，一秒 50 次获取 tok/s，测量更细更精准。

description.en: Chrome-style spell check for the dsh composer: the misspelled word under the caret gets a suggestion strip, and Tab accepts it. Local only — no network, no LLM, no telemetry.
description.zh: 给 dsh 输入框做像 Chrome 那样的拼写检查：光标所在的错词上方出现建议条，按 Tab 直接接受；错词下画蓝色波浪线，右键可看完整候选。完全本机运行，不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the intro but capped by real DSH boot milestones. Any bare key skips it, ten palettes come from Monument Valley and Geometric Islands, and when the intro ends the triangle stays on as a small mark beside the composer that reflects what the agent is doing.
