description.zh: 页面级启动开屏：彭罗斯三角在等距菱格海面上旋转受光，取景框本身就是进度计，按开屏节奏平滑推进、以真实 DSH 启动完成度为上限；按任意键跳过，主题坞提供 Monument Valley / Geometric Islands 十套色板。开屏结束后三角留在输入框旁，作为一枚反映当前工作状态的小标记。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Splits the DSH main area into vertical columns, one live conversation per parallel task, with mouse-wheel paging past four columns, draggable dividers, a split toggle on every session-list row, a progress-only compact view and a one-click exit.
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区域竖着分成多列，每个并行任务一列实时对话；超过 4 列用鼠标滚轮整页翻，分隔线可拖拽调宽，侧边栏会话行可直接加入或移出分屏，另有只显示进度与当前步骤的极简视图，并可一键取消分屏。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区拆成任意数量的原生窗格：左右、上下、田字 2×2 与自动网格，每个窗格都是独立会话。

description.en: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.
description.zh: 居中全局搜索弹窗：提供类似 Spotlight 与 IntelliJ 的会话及聊天消息实时检索与上下文预览。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 主机管理插件：浏览 ~/.ssh/config，保存 AES-256-GCM 加密密码，执行批量命令与 SFTP，并在可保持的侧边栏标签页中打开交互式 PTY 终端。

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep context lean. Ships 29 skills (plan loops, review loops, TDD, unsticking, PR watching) plus a turn guard that pushes back when a turn edits files without a successful check afterwards, and pushes back harder on a second miss.
description.zh: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

description.en: Pre-execute hook that denies writes under a read-only result zone of protected roots; every other path passes through.
description.zh: pre-execute 钩子：拒绝写入受保护根下只读的成果区，其余路径放行。

description.en: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the tool result, so the agent retries from another mirror instead of waiting on a dead one. Timeouts are set per kind of work, and acting versus only reporting is switched per scene. A supervisor indicator reacts while something is stalled.
description.zh: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
description.zh: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

description.en: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, optional question text in the notification, an optional native Windows and WSL toast channel that bypasses Focus Assist, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no browser is ready.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可在通知中显示提问正文、可选的原生 Windows/WSL 通知通道（可越过专注助手），没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 显示账户额度、Git 状态、上下文、公开 API 参考费用、Subagents 活动和生成速度。

description.en: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for text, images, and files, with read and pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加独立插话栏，支持文字、图片和普通文件，显示读取状态并可在未读取时取消，任务结束时救援未发送草稿。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max), while a procedurally rendered micro-universe contracts and collapses into a black hole as effort rises. Levels go through the DSH model-selection interface, so the rail shows the level DSH confirms, and the plugin writes only to $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一条推理强度滑轨：拖动或用键盘预览并提交当前模型支持的档位（Off 到 Max），滑轨背后由程序实时渲染的微缩宇宙随档位收缩、坍缩成黑洞。档位通过 DSH 自身的模型选择接口提交，显示的是 DSH 确认后的等级；插件只写入 $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/。

description.en: Deterministic step governance for DSH agents: rejects over-budget agent steps and denies risky tool executions before they run, with shadow mode by default and fail-open on errors.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供确定性步数治理，在超预算的 agent 步执行前拒绝、在风险工具调用执行前阻断，默认影子模式，出错时放行不阻断业务。

description.en: A sticky-notes panel for DSH with a draggable floating window, a full sidebar page, Markdown preview, pasted images and configurable settings.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 便签面板，支持可拖动悬浮窗、侧栏整页、Markdown 预览、粘贴图片与设置项，数据仅存于浏览器本地。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: Sticky notes on a wall, with five paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of pin, tape or clip.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的便签墙：五种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，图钉或胶带或回形针固定，随手记下自动保存。

description.en: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or OAuth access token.
description.zh: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.
description.zh: A 股 / 港股 / 美股与板块自选面板，带分时迷你走势图，并向 agent 提供 stock_quote 工具。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them, and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Deleting to the system Recycle Bin and Open folder are Windows-only; scanning works everywhere. Host routes accept loopback connections only and are CSRF-guarded; nothing leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF 防护，不联网。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话流式折叠：运行中只展开最新的思考小窗、其余过程行折成一条摘要，一轮结束滑回你提的那句话；读到哪一轮那轮提问就钉在顶部。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Persona mode + structured output for DSH: identity header, three cards and signature rendered by the plugin while the model only submits a persona JSON envelope; per-session structured toggle, default-on persona.
description.zh: DSH 人格模式 + 结构化输出：身份头 / 三卡 / 收尾由插件渲染，模型只交 persona 内容块；人格默认开启、可显式关闭，结构化按会话开关。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Fork selected text into contextual learning branches, continue native DSH chat in each session, and navigate the branches in a tree.
description.zh: 划词派生继承上下文的学习分支，在每个会话中继续原生 DSH 聊天，并用树状导航切换分支。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.
description.zh: 为官方子智能体工具提供具名预设与模型路由白名单：越界的子模型在派发前被拒绝，子会话标题栏显示最近一次请求实际使用的模型。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied when each in-process child is created (agent/created + agent.model.select()); no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.
description.zh: 在输入框旁的「子代理」胶囊里统一设置委派子代理使用的 provider、模型与思考强度：卡片的「本对话 / 全局默认」两个范围共用同一组控件，胶囊上始终显示当前生效的路由；在每个进程内子代理创建时生效（agent/created + agent.model.select()），不注册设置页、不改 agent preset、不给工具加模型参数。

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token cap, agent preset, tags, plus a "when to use" line the model reads to pick it, so a delegation names only the alias. Adds five tools (delegate, list routes, edit config, wait, release), shows the route a child actually ran on in its session header, lets each UI element be switched off, and keeps all configuration in one local JSON file instead of YAML.
description.zh: 给子智能体配命名模型路由：每个别名绑定子智能体代理、模型与可选的思考档位、令牌上限、Agent 预设、标签，并写清「何时使用」供模型选路，委派时只写别名。插件提供委派、查目录、改配置、等后台、释放五个工具，在设置页完成全部配置（两级下拉、逐项校验），在子代理会话头部显示其实际运行的路由，界面元素均可单独停用；配置存于本地 JSON，不需要改任何 YAML。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
description.zh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.
description.zh: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Up to 5 clickable next steps under every reply: click one to send it, or fill it into the composer and edit first. The suggestions come from the main model as it closes the turn — no extra model call.
description.zh: 每条回复末尾最多 5 条可点的下一步：点一条直接发出，或填入输入框改完再发。建议由本轮主模型在收尾时给出，不额外调用模型。

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables, charts, timelines, kanban, flow charts, clickable actions), a content auto-layout mode, four placements (inline, process, dock board above the composer, turn-tail next-step card), a schema-backed settings form, and an optional automatic next-step card. Cards are rebuilt from the recorded tool arguments, so they survive replay and fork; 253 offline tests, no build step.
description.zh: 用原生 UI 卡片代替 Markdown 回答：模型调用 render_ui，答案直接渲染成对话里的卡片——29 种区块（指标、表格、图表、时间线、看板、流程图、可点击按钮）、content 自动排版模式、四种落位（正文内联、过程折叠区、输入框上方看板、回合尾卡）、原生设置表单，以及可选的自动「下一步」卡片。卡片按会话日志里的调用参数重建，回放与 fork 后仍在；253 个离线测试，无构建步骤。

description.en: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average elapsed time decreased by 36%, average input tokens per task decreased by 17%, and accuracy increased by 5 percentage points.
description.zh: 提供一个更快、更节省、更准确的编码 Agent 预设。在按多维难度规则筛选的 SWE-bench Pro 高难度 100 题评测中，平均耗时减少 36%，平均每题输入 token 减少 17%，正确率提高 5 个百分点。

description.en: Super input suite — model and effort picker, prompt enhancer, follow-up suggestion chips, a full cost engine with daily heatmap and Coding Plan quotas, voice-input light effects and transcript cleanup (needs the built-in voice-input bundle enabled), prompt templates, selection reference chips with comments, a compaction ring and a settings hub. Bundles the author's standalone dsh-cost, dsh-power-picker, dsh-prompt-enhancer, dsh-followup, dsh-siri-voice and dsh-compaction-control; uninstall those before installing.
description.zh: 超级输入框套件——模型与推理强度选择器、提示词增强、跟进建议 chips、带每日热力图与 Coding Plan 配额的完整费用引擎、语音输入光效与转写清理（需先启用官方语音输入包）、Prompt 模板库、划选引用与评论 chip、压缩圆环和设置总览。已并入作者原独立插件 dsh-cost、dsh-power-picker、dsh-prompt-enhancer、dsh-followup、dsh-siri-voice、dsh-compaction-control，安装前请先卸载它们。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with memory management, persona settings, and compaction prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话独立的长期记忆、记忆管理、人设设置和压缩提示词。

description.en: Renders SVG code fences in chat as theme-aware inline figures with source, copy, download and zoom.
description.zh: 将聊天中的 SVG 代码块渲染为跟随主题的内联图形，支持源码、复制、下载与缩放。

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两者都只广告两个元工具而非完整工具表（SolidWorks 用本仓库的 discovery 垫片，AutoCAD 用上游 DISCOVERY_MODE=search），首次请求前加载的工具定义分别从 23,404 降到 256 token、从 83,732 降到 365 token。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 快捷按钮，一键插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

description.en: Old conversation is folded into short summaries by a side model before the window fills (on-disk ledger survives restarts and re-anchors after host compaction), so long sessions stop getting more expensive every turn — one real full-day session: 6 folds replaced 209 old messages and the live context stayed in the tens of thousands of tokens. The session model picks the model per subtask across six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review); or pick Auto and a small intent classifier routes each message itself, switching only past a confidence threshold to keep prompt caches warm. A three-line watermark ends in an automatic four-step handover (fork backup, handover doc, compact, wake) without losing in-flight subagents; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover keep it manual when wanted. Optional Agent Teams mode adds teammates and a shared task board; /vision gives text-only models eyes via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester plus an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and language preferences cover the same 11 languages. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.
description.zh: 旧对话在窗口塞满前由侧模型自动折成短摘要（折叠账本写在磁盘上、重启不丢、宿主压缩后自动重锚），长会话不再越聊越贵——一个真实整天的会话：6 次折叠换掉 209 条旧消息，模型实际背着的上下文始终停在几万 token。会话模型自己给子任务选模型，六个派发池（轻量/机械/主力/高难/多模态/复审）；也可以选「自动（意图识别）」，小分类模型逐条决定交给谁，置信度不足不切换、护住提示词缓存。三条水位线到顶自动四步交接（fork 备份、交接文档、压缩、唤醒续跑），跑着的子智能体不丢；/ctx-pause、/ctx-resume、/ctx-handover 随时手动接管。可选 Agent Teams 模式带来常驻队友与共享任务板；/vision 让纯文本模型看图；分级验证给大改动配 tester 和独立复审。设置界面、README 与语言偏好覆盖同一套 11 种语言。内置三个技能：MySQL/Redis 只读核验、commit 文案生成、需求与设计文档规范。

description.en: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

description.en: System guard for DeepSeek Harness (Windows-first, protected actions via UAC/sudo): classifies core system files and runtime junk, keeps a hidden SHA-256 backup of core files on the largest free disk, patrols integrity and restores damaged files, and asks for administrator rights only to protect the system. On macOS/Linux it only classifies and hashes (no junk deletion; repair prints manual steps), and that path has not been tested on real hardware.
description.zh: 系统守护（以 Windows 为主，保护类操作走 UAC/sudo）：分析并分类系统核心文件与运行时垃圾，把核心文件隐藏备份到剩余空间最大的硬盘、定期巡查完整性并从备份修复损坏文件；守护权限只用于保护系统。macOS/Linux 上只做分类与哈希（不删垃圾，修复仅给出人工步骤），且该路径未在真机验证。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: monitor the resource utilization of dsh system processes, and report the results to the user in the form of charts.
description.zh: 监控dsh进程及其派生子进程的资源占用,并以面板图表报告整机与各会话的CPU与内存占用

description.en: Injects your own text into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt as real system sections from a sidebar editor: each section lands after the persona, after the tool docs, or at the very end of the prompt, can be switched on or off, and can resolve {{variables}}; a preview runs the host's own assemble and render pass so you see the exact prompt the next request will send, with empty, duplicate, unknown-variable and oversize sections flagged.
description.zh: 把你的文字作为真正的 system 段落注入 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：侧栏编辑器里为每段选择落点（人格之后、工具说明之后，或提示词最末尾），逐段启停，可解析 {{变量}}；预览调用宿主真实的 assemble 与 render，看清下一个请求实际发出的提示词，并标出空段、重复行、未知变量与超长段落。

description.en: Connect multiple decision providers and models through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef via Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya, and compatible custom providers. Agents and plugins can classify content, filter candidates, score against criteria, or locate objects in images, then use structured results in their workflows.
description.zh: 用同一接口接入多种决策提供商与模型：在线可选 TypeSafe 提供的 Jev、Cloudflare 提供的 Clef、Nace 提供的 Drex、meraGPT 提供的 Decider 1；本地可连接 Laya，也支持兼容的自定义 provider。Agent 和插件可用它进行内容分类、候选筛选、按标准评分或图片定位，再用结构化结果继续自己的流程。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: Draws a bar chart under Markdown tables whose columns are mostly numeric, with no tool call or server.
description.zh: 在数值列为主的 Markdown 表格下方自动绘制条形图，无需工具调用或本地服务。

description.en: Adds a hover toolbar to every Markdown table in DSH Web: one button copies the table as Markdown, the other copies a 2x PNG of it taken with the current theme background.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 里每张 Markdown 表格加一条悬停工具条：一个按钮把表格复制成 Markdown，另一个按钮把它按当前主题背景截成 2 倍图 PNG。

description.en: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.
description.zh: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Adds a "Handoff session" item to the session context menu: pick an older session, choose how the new one should read it, and a fresh session is created with the handoff instruction pre-filled in its composer while the old session stays untouched. Three read modes — the AI decides what to read, a six-part summary written into a .md file, or just the last 20 turns. The second tab turns those .md files into a cleanup list grouped by workspace, deletable once the receiving session has run 3 turns or the handoff is 7 days old. All file, record and turn-count operations run in the host process; the browser half only renders and requests. Requires Windows and the DSH desktop app (it uses Electron shell.openPath and explorer.exe/cmd.exe).
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单加「移交会话」：选一个老会话、挑新会话用哪种模式怎么读，新开一个上下文干净的会话，交接指令已预填进输入框；老会话全程不动。三种读取方式——AI 自行判断读多少、让 AI 先写成六段摘要落到 .md、或只读最近 20 轮。第二个标签把那批 .md 变成按工作区分组的清理清单，接手会话跑满 3 轮或移交满 7 天即可逐条删除。删文件、写记录、数轮数全部在主进程完成，界面只负责画和发请求。需要 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面版（依赖 Electron shell.openPath 与 explorer.exe / cmd.exe）。

description.en: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
description.zh: 从 Tako 公开模型目录把聊天模型接入官方 llm-pi-ai，实时刷新并按尺寸标签写入上下文窗口，支持浏览器一键登录，把 cr_ 密钥存入 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: A visual map for your sessions: every conversation is a card on an infinite whiteboard — workspaces become frames that fold their overflow into a drawer, card positions are never rearranged, lines between cards carry context (drag one to fork with an injected digest), and each card shows a status lamp for running, waiting, unread or interrupted.
description.zh: 会话地图：每个对话都是白板上的一张卡片——工作区是会自动折叠溢出的框，点开是抽屉；卡片位置摆好就不会被打乱；卡片之间的连线承载上下文（拉一条就能带摘要分叉），每张卡还有运行中 / 等你回复 / 待查看 / 已中断的状态灯。

description.en: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.
description.zh: 按请求记录费用，涵盖重试与子代理，支持节假日峰谷计价、共享计价/用量/余额/预算服务和 DeepSeek 账单对账。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
description.zh: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

description.en: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

description.en: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Adds custom task groups and an activity bell to the sidebar: drag sessions into or out of a group, reorder them by hand, collapse groups, and see running, waiting and unread sessions in one place.
description.zh: 给侧边栏加上自定义任务分组和活动铃铛：把会话拖进拖出分组、手动排序、折叠分组，并在一处集中查看运行中、待确认和未读的会话。

description.en: TAPD + ZenTao task hub for DSH: list assigned work in the sidebar and dispatch an agent on a branch you name.
description.zh: DSH 的 TAPD 与禅道任务中心：在侧边栏查看分配给自己的需求或任务，并在手动指定的分支上派发 Agent。

description.en: Task ledger: a dsh plugin that has the agent create, claim, advance and close tasks, writing each step straight into a plain-text ledger in the workspace so the owner, the current state and the next step stay on record; no cloud service is involved, single-user and multi-user both work with Git synchronisation, and a control panel summarises in-flight, overdue and stalled work with weekly trends.
description.zh: 任务台账：任务由代理创建、认领、推进与结案，每一步直接写入工作区内的纯文本台账，使负责人、当前状态与下一步全程留痕；不涉及云服务，单人多人皆可用、以 Git 同步，看板汇总进行中、逾期与停滞的任务与每周趋势。

description.en: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
description.zh: 跟随 Agent 每一次工具调用（读、写、改、搜、运行、规划、子代理、等待、出错）实时切换动作的网页吉祥物，并在对话中显示对应步骤卡片；内置两套可切换角色包。

description.en: Adds a "Task Planning" agent preset that asks requirements in versioned rounds, then writes step-by-step plans and prompts without implementing them itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「任务规划」模式：按版本迭代逐轮提问把需求问清楚，再产出可逐条执行的规划与提示词，自身不实现代码。

description.en: Ranks this DeepSeek Harness profile's installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand, and prints the exact next step for each — enable, install, or nothing.
description.zh: 按任务排序本 profile 的插件（已启用 / 已安装但未启用 / 市场可安装），并给出每个候选的确切下一步——启用、安装，或无需操作。

description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
description.zh: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

description.en: Adds a Task Progress tab to the conversation view, next to the Context tab, with a progress bar for the session's todo list and completed items ordered by completion time.
description.zh: 在会话顶部“上下文”标签右侧增加“任务进度”标签页，用进度条显示已完成与未完成的任务，已完成项按完成顺序排列。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a chime the moment DSH needs you to step in: an approval request, a question, or a plan confirmation. Three independent switches and sound pools, persisted on disk.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

description.en: Organizes task materials and supports session handoffs across workspaces.
description.zh: 整理任务资料，支持跨工作区的会话交接。

description.en: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea pool, and daily/weekly/monthly reviews that only a human can write.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

description.en: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.
description.zh: 任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。

description.en: Task board for DSH: create tasks with project and model assignment, run them manually or on cron schedules; new sessions in a project automatically pick up its todo tasks and move them to in-review when done.
description.zh: dsh 的任务看板：创建任务时可指定项目与模型，支持手动执行及定时执行；项目内新建会话会自动拉取该项目的待办任务，完成后移至待验收。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: Tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: character cards, worldbooks and presets with per-session isolation, memory summaries, a character relationship web, one-click plot options and an NSFW mode. The full experience also needs the companion plugins dsh-muv-engine and dsh-muv-table, which render the status bar, the plot options and the variable tables. Card-provided status bars, variable folds and option cards now render inside a sandboxed iframe, so card styles no longer leak into the host UI.
description.zh: 酒馆管理面板：多角色卡、多世界书、多预设与会话级隔离，记忆总结、角色关系网、剧情选项一键发送，另有 NSFW 模式。完整效果需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-engine 与 dsh-muv-table，用于渲染状态栏、剧情选项与变量表格。角色卡自带的状态栏 / 变量折叠 / 选项卡片在沙盒 iframe 中渲染，卡内样式不再外溢到宿主界面。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.
description.zh: 集成 TencentDB Agent Memory，支持对话捕获、结构化记忆提取、自动召回，以及记忆和对话搜索工具。

description.en: Agent-team orchestration sidecar for DSH: teams with a configurable member cap, real sub-agent members with per-member model routing, task DAGs that dispatch automatically when their dependencies finish, a broker that enforces fs/exec/net/env permissions, and a live web panel over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 团队编排 sidecar：成员上限可配，成员是真实的 sub-agent 且可单独指定模型；任务按 DAG 依赖自动派发；fs/exec/net/env 四域权限由 broker 强制；运行过程通过 SSE 在 Web 面板实时查看。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for TeamAI skills, MCP, and prompts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于团队技能、MCP 和提示词管理与同步。

description.en: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel (MIT).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 遥控器：在手机上接续正在运行的 Web 会话并回答问题，界面为俄语。hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的俄语分支（MIT）。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.
description.zh: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Keeps terminology in two-level plain-text glossaries and injects a term's meaning the first time it appears in a session.
description.zh: 把约定俗成的称谓存成两层纯文本字典，某个词第一次出现时自动把它的口径注入上下文；带查／写／体检三条工具与设置面板。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: Installs and runs Android native command-line tools from inside DSH: fetches aarch64 bionic packages from the Termux repository, unpacks them in pure JS and runs them through /system/bin/linker64, with no root, no Shizuku and no external package manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内部安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库取 aarch64 bionic 包、纯 JS 解包，再经 /system/bin/linker64 执行，无需 root、Shizuku 或外部包管理器。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm), extracts the file, line and assertion of each failure, and stops the loop when failures with an identical signature repeat. Output is decoded so Windows-encoded and non-Latin assertion text stays readable.
description.zh: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
description.zh: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Quiet Carl the hedgehog easter eggs after a finished turn, plus local water, meal and rest reminders. Fully local scheduling with no model calls and no chat messages.
description.zh: 任务结束后偶尔让卡尔从屏幕边缘探头，并提醒喝水、吃饭、休息；完全本地调度，不发送聊天消息、不调用模型。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Animal Island theme with boarding-pass masthead, cream notebook paper, 118 ThemeRuntime tokens, in-app appearance presets, and starry night mode.
description.zh: 动森风手账主题：渡岛船票品牌区、奶油手账纸、覆盖 118 项 ThemeRuntime token、应用内外观设置与夜岛星空。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》工业编辑风主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、全局直角，两套强调色配色（谷地黄信号黄 / 武陵青青碧色）可在设置切换，另有可选的等高线地形背景、ENDFIELD 水印与启动加载屏。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: EVA Unit-02 theme with an entry-plug boot cinematic, a context-based sync meter, and configurable dark interface styling.
description.zh: EVA 弐号机主题，提供插入栓启动演出、基于上下文余量的同步率表和可配置的深色界面样式。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness. Each launch starts with an about 5 second mirror-break opening: the key art appears as a glass pane, cracks outward from the impact point, bursts into 56 shards with gold edges, depth and spin, hangs still, then rotates back together before a golden flash reveals the picture, the sun halo and the light beams. The key art is also inlined as the window backdrop and the texture of both main panels over an ink night sky with a molten sun, frosted mirror shards and drifting embers; the mirror emblem at the bottom left switches motion between full, calm and off, and colours come from overridden design tokens so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」主题。每次启动先播一段约 5 秒的镜面破碎开场：原图先作为一面玻璃浮出，从撞击点向外裂开，炸成 56 片带金边、各有景深与自转的碎片，短暂悬停后逆向旋转重组，金色闪光推开镜面，日轮光环与光束随之展开。主视觉同时内联为整窗底图与两个主面板的肌理，底子是墨色夜空、熔金日轮与光冕、磨砂镜片与漂浮金烬；左下角「镜」徽记可在 神光 / 静谧 / 关闭 三档动效间切换，配色通过覆写设计令牌实现，面板、气泡、菜单与代码块一并跟随。

description.en: Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with SVG edge refraction on the composer, bubbles, queue dock, menus and sidebar, translucent token overrides driven by live sliders for tint, opacity, blur and refraction, custom or built-in animated wallpapers, and desktop chrome extras such as a session bar merged into the system title bar and a fullscreen button.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的液态玻璃主题：输入卡片、气泡、队列坞、菜单与侧边栏带 SVG 边缘折射；半透明 token 覆盖，色调、不透明度、模糊与折射强度都有实时滑块；壁纸可自定义或使用内置动态壁纸；桌面版另把会话顶栏并入系统标题栏，并补了全屏按钮。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: Path to Nowhere MBCC dossier theme for DSH, with dark and light palettes, a boot splash, a balance capsule and a settings panel.
description.zh: 无期迷途 MBCC 档案风 DSH 主题：深浅两套色板、开屏动画、余额胶囊与设置面板。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Five palettes for DeepSeek Harness — mono, warm sand, indigo, moss and a custom three-colour palette — each rebuilt in OKLCH for light and dark, with text and surface contrast solved per palette. Includes config export/import codes and a high-contrast mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的五套配色（黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿、自定义三色），明暗两模式各自用 OKLCH 重算整条色阶，并按配色求解文字与承载面的对比度；附配置导入导出短码与高对比档。

description.en: Nine single-ink print palettes — sage linen, kraft paper, lead type, cyanotype, risograph, CRT tube, phosphor screen, punch card, floppy disk. Each palette carries its own paper grain, type pairing, corner shape, section rule and a whale mark redrawn in its ink, plus a letterpress pass (paper tooth, sheet mottle, ink bite) that can be switched off. Every palette ships separate light and dark tokens.
description.zh: 复古油墨主题：九套单色油墨配色——鼠尾草、牛皮纸、铅字、蓝晒纸、孔版、显像管、荧光屏、打孔卡、软盘。每套自带纸张质感、字体搭配、圆角与直角、章节线，以及按自身油墨重画的鲸鱼标记；另有一层可关掉的凸版压印（纸齿、纸不匀、墨的压痕）。每套都配浅色与深色两套 token。

description.en: Immersive weather theme for DeepSeek Harness: physical rain with splashes and ripples, snow in two crystal habits, a hearth, lightning with distance-coded thunder, a night mode, and a compact control panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供沉浸式天气主题：按物理模拟的雨滴（含溅射与水花）、两种晶型的雪花、炉火，以及带分叉的闪电与按距离延迟的雷声，并提供夜间模式和紧凑控制面板。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·组件替换版：走 dsh 官方客户端主题机制，在完整保留的官方 React UI 上叠加奶油纸面 alias token 层、缝合像素字体与山谷壁纸。npm 包名 dsh-theme-stardew-valley。

description.en: Strinova theme: light/dark modes, a Cielle character illustration on the new-session screen, a corner character randomly picked on each page load with a matching composer placeholder line, and floating particles.
description.zh: 卡拉彼丘主题：日夜双模式；新会话页展示汐的角色立绘，右下角角色与输入栏台词按页面加载随机轮换，并点缀漂浮粒子。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: a full native --dsw-* token remap, the artwork as an ambient wallpaper behind a single light paper layer, and live controls for glass strength, conversation-only paper, wallpaper veil/focus/zoom and the composer focus glow, with a bilingual settings form on the installed-package page. Visual identity: 溟月 by 上善无形 → DeepSeek maid ver. by ZipZipPipe; artwork CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code MIT.
description.zh: 移植自 DreamSkin 皮肤包的 DSH Web UI 鲸鱼娘亮色主题：完整重映射原生 --dsw-* 令牌，插画作为环境壁纸衬在单层轻纸面之后，玻璃强度、对话区独立纸面、壁纸遮罩/焦点/缩放与输入框聚焦光晕均可实时调节，设置表单以中英双语呈现在已安装插件详情页。视觉定型：溟月（上善无形）→ DeepSeek 女仆装（ZipZipPipe）；插画 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，代码 MIT。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.
description.zh: 所有事在一个对话框（主聊天）里聊：每条消息自动分到所属话题，每个话题在后台有独立的会话和上下文；已有的 DSH 旧会话也会自动整理、分类成话题。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Keeps manually opened Think rows expanded by default, with a per-session switch to open or close every Think row; tool cards stay collapsed and state resets on page reload.
description.zh: 手动点开的 Think 默认保持展开，并提供每会话开关批量展开或收起全部思考；工具卡保持折叠，状态随页面刷新重置。

description.en: Translate DSH reasoning, tasks, answers and review reasons into 9 languages. Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or Google/Bing; ordered fallback, local model memory controls, originals preserved.
description.zh: DSH Web 显示层翻译：思考链、任务、可选回答和审查拒绝理由，支持 9 种语言；本地 Ollama、自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic API、Google/Bing，按序回退与本地模型内存管理，原文保留。

description.en: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
description.zh: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.
description.zh: 把输入框右下角的模型 / 推理等级选择器换成两级菜单，并提供六种滑杆视觉。

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.
description.zh: 把 composer 的模型选择器换成「模型名 · 推理等级」触发区：滑块覆盖模型上报的全部等级，可切换三种模式（DSH 官方原生选择器、渐变粒子轨道、能量充能轨道），并可按代理商一键为未声明等级的模型补齐四档。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.
description.zh: 在底部 Dock 添加模型思考 token 统计信息的轻量化插件。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

description.en: Bundles five TIA Portal skills (Siemens PLC docs lookup, ladder-logic generation, SimaticML-to-PNG rendering, scan-cycle simulation with PASS/FAIL scenarios, and a TiaLink gateway skill for driving a real TIA Portal project) and wires five MCP endpoints. Requires TiaLink (paid; Windows + TIA Portal V19/V20 + Openness) for real-project work, API keys for the four cloud services (100 free calls each, then paid; rendering is billed per call even on failure), Node 22+, and network access; program snippets are uploaded to tia.hubwiz.com.
description.zh: 一次装齐西门子博途（TIA Portal）的五项技能（官方文档检索、梯形图生成、SimaticML 转 PNG 渲染、逐扫描仿真与 PASS/FAIL 验收、操作真实工程的本机网关）并接好五个 MCP 端点。操作真实工程需另装付费的 TiaLink（Windows + 博途 V19/V20 + Openness 用户组）；四个云端服务需 API Key（各 100 次免费，之后付费；渲染每次计费且失败也扣），且需 Node 22+ 与联网；程序片段会上传到 tia.hubwiz.com。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿自动保存，另可选剪藏书签（选中图片一并存为二进制附件）——全部由自动提交的 git 仓库支撑。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Deep-sea tidal-blue theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web client with a single accent color and matte (non-glass) surfaces in light and dark modes. Same-token UI additions: a single-line dock HUD reading real session projections (context usage vs. window, TPS, cache-hit rate, elapsed time), per-turn subagent delegation cards showing token usage and an optional cost estimate from OpenRouter public prices, sidebar pagination with pinned sections and type-to-filter, and model / reasoning-effort / permission controls under the composer. Each addition can be toggled in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 的深海潮汐蓝主题：单一强调色、磨砂（非玻璃）材质，明暗双态一致。同套令牌下的界面增强：单行底栏 HUD（读取真实会话投影的上下文占用与上限、TPS、缓存命中率、耗时）、按回合绘制的子代理委派卡片（显示 token 用量，并可附上按 OpenRouter 公开单价估算的金额）、侧栏分页与置顶小节加实时筛选、输入框下方的模型/思考等级/权限控件，每项均可在插件设置中单独开关。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day.
