description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

description.en: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: Usage statistics inside Settings: a GitHub-style one-year conversation heatmap of your own daily messages, token usage totals by model and by day/week/month with stat cards, and a per-day list of files written or edited via write/edit tools. All computed locally from session history with incremental rescans; no data leaves the machine.
description.zh: 设置面板内的使用统计：GitHub 风格一年对话热力图（按每天本人消息数着色，自动排除子代理与注入上下文）、按模型与按天/周/月汇总的 Token 用量（统计卡片 + 表格）、以及每天通过 write/edit 工具产出或修改的文件清单（日期选择）。全部本地扫描会话历史完成、增量更新，数据不出本机。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.
description.zh: Web GUI 与桌面端的用量统计面板：静默按模型采集 token、活跃热力图、趋势图、费用估算与每日超限守卫。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
description.zh: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

description.en: Usage panel for the provider account behind the current model: quota windows, credit balance and token usage, following the model automatically. It renders as a full page, plus a sidebar entry and a per-session usage chip in the conversation header.
description.zh: 当前模型背后的大模型账户用量面板：额度窗口、账户余额与 token 用量，随模型自动切换，支持dsh中内置的主流大模型厂商，支持详情查看与页面左下角概览查看。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

description.en: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮用量小窗，显示 Claude、Codex 订阅用量窗口与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek API 今日花费与余额；只展示，是 dsh-cost-meter 的伴侣。

description.en: Peak/valley pricing and spend dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar pill showing today's spend and tokens plus a details page with hourly, 14-day and per-model breakdowns.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量峰谷仪表盘：侧栏胶囊常显峰谷、今日花费与 tokens，详情页提供 24 小时、近 14 天与按模型的用量拆分。

description.en: Shows the current provider's account balance or coding-plan quota above the composer, with usage percentages and reset countdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框上方查看当前模型供应商的账户余额或套餐额度，显示已用比例和重置倒计时。

description.en: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.
description.zh: 用量统计设置面板：26 周活跃热力图、按日 Token 趋势与缓存命中率曲线、模型用量环形图与明细、时间范围筛选、汇总卡片，支持历史会话回扫与无损重建。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

description.en: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
description.zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

description.en: Delegates independent tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenAI Codex CLI and returns the result to the current conversation. Provides four tools (task execution, status check, danger-mode toggle, enable/disable switch), enforces a real-path working-directory whitelist with symlink-escape protection, defaults to Codex workspace-write sandbox mode, passes the task body as a single argv argument to avoid shell injection, kills the whole Codex process group on timeout or cancel, and caps output length. Requires Node.js >= 20 and a Codex CLI build supporting codex exec.
description.zh: 把独立任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 执行，并把结果返回当前会话。提供四个工具（任务执行、状态检查、危险模式开关、启停开关），强制真实路径白名单并做软链逃逸防护，默认使用 Codex workspace-write 沙箱模式，任务正文以单个 argv 参数传递避免 shell 注入，超时或取消时终止完整 Codex 进程组，并限制输出长度。需要 Node.js >= 20 和支持 codex exec 的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
description.zh: 插件开发工具箱：命令读过的文件自动算已读、代码同步到 profile、后端模拟与前端预览、插件装载验证、隔离测试实例、自定义快捷命令、工具清单。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Re-decodes collected subprocess bytes with strict UTF-8 then GB18030 before they reach the agent, so GBK/CP936 output from Windows cmd and PowerShell tools stops arriving as U+FFFD mojibake.
description.zh: 在字节被解码前接管子进程输出采集，按严格 UTF-8、必要时 GB18030 重新解码，Windows 下 cmd 与 PowerShell 的 GBK/CP936 输出不再变成 U+FFFD 乱码。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：十一个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询）、readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限设置面板，以及可开启的本地脱敏——开启后密码默认以稳定占位符出现，需要时按条目+字段单次取回，落盘会话日志中的 bitwarden 明文也会被定期擦除；面板展示的密码与动态码会打码。脱敏与日志擦除是两个独立开关。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level routing. Each card gives the inputs a computation needs, the procedure, the boundary conditions where the method stops being valid, and a page reference — the explanation itself stays in the book. No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; 44 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards, each carrying a review-list ID. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了 44 条原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾），每条带审查清单编号。本包是学习辅助，不能替代原书。

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.
description.zh: 侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: Version manager for the dsh host in a settings section of its own: shows the installed version against npm dist-tags, checks for updates, and installs, upgrades, downgrades or reinstalls any published version with a pre-upgrade local snapshot, failure rollback, snapshot-based rollback and an upgrade history. Before a cross-minor install it compares the @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings exports of the target release with the named imports of installed plugins to flag those that would stop loading, and it can apply or remove reversible compat shims that port removed legacy APIs back into framework files. Upgrade, restore and restart engines are Windows-only; version listing and checks work on every platform.
description.zh: dsh 主程序版本管理，位于独立设置分区：对照 npm dist-tags 显示已装版本、检查更新，可安装/升级/降级/重装任意已发布版本，升级前自动建本地快照，失败自动回滚，支持基于快照的回滚与升级历史。跨次版本安装前，会比对目标版本 @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings 的导出与已装插件的具名导入，标出升级后将无法加载的插件；并可启用/停用可逆兼容垫片，把被移除的旧 API 移植回框架文件。升级/恢复/重启引擎仅 Windows 可用，版本查看与更新检查各平台通用。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper right above the conversation, with a draggable splitter setting its height (initial height configurable). Phones and tablets are untouched.
description.zh: 竖屏布局（仅电脑窗口）：浏览器窗口为竖屏时，左侧导航占整列，文件 / 终端面板移到对话区上方（右上），中间分隔线可拖拽调整高度（初始高度可配）。手机 / 平板不受影响。

description.en: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base with a planner agent and a reusable method library), v4 (persistent self-organizing residents that message and meet), and v5 (a research institute with an academician who decomposes and assigns work, voting researchers, temp workers, group chat and a compare-and-set task board); all four support checkpoint resume, human intervention, and an optional Lean formal-verification switch (off/encourage/require) whose passing proof turns the vote into a fidelity check of the Lean statements.
description.zh: 为 DSH 安装四个多代理数学研究预设：v2（概率驱动流水线 + 多验证器辩论）、v3（论文式 Markdown 知识库 + 规划代理 + 可复用方法库）、v4（常驻自组织成员，靠留言与开会决定一切）、v5（研究所：院士拆解并分派任务、有表决权的研究员、临时工、群聊与 CAS 任务板）；四套均支持断点续跑、人工干预，以及可调档的 Lean 形式化验证（off/encourage/require，一旦跑通，表决转为对 Lean 陈述的忠实性核对）。

description.en: macOS-only frosted-glass skin for the DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop conversation pane and third-party sidebars: native vibrancy material, independent switches per level, an optional wallpaper backdrop with adjustable frost, and a Settings section; background material only, no layout changes.
description.zh: macOS 专用磨砂玻璃皮肤：给 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 的会话面板与第三方侧边栏套上原生 Vibrancy 材质，两级效果各自独立开关，可选壁纸底图并调节磨砂度，附设置页；只改背景材质，不动布局。

description.en: AI video creation and editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with conversation-driven revisions, multitrack timelines, audio waveforms, and MP4 export. Requires Node 22, FFmpeg and Chrome; audio generation calls a Qianwen MaaS endpoint only after you add an API key.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过对话生成与续改视频，支持多轨剪辑、音频波形和 MP4 导出。需要 Node 22、FFmpeg 与 Chrome；音频生成只有在你填入 API key 后才会调用千问 MaaS 接口。

description.en: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes, text-to-image and text-to-video, image panning, composition, covers, media verification, data review and four-platform publishing. Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. An installer's own skill of the same name keeps precedence.
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python 3 + Pillow、Node.js 与 playwright，自备 B 站 biliup 凭据和视频号 / 抖音 / 小红书登录态，并把 skills/*/scripts/ 里的占位符改成自己的值。使用者自己的同名 skill 优先级更高。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it downloads the GitHub archive of that repository and copies the skill directory, and executes no code from the repository. Installs run as background jobs with live progress (bytes downloaded, files copied) and can be cancelled; skills installed by the plugin can be uninstalled, while directories without its marker are left untouched. Rows show an approximate repository size reported by GitHub. The same actions are exposed to the agent as the video_skill_search, video_skill_install and video_skill_uninstall tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）并可取消；本插件装上的技能可以卸载，没有本插件标记的目录保持不动。列表显示 GitHub 报告的仓库体积近似值。同样的能力也以 video_skill_search、video_skill_install、video_skill_uninstall 三个工具暴露给智能体。

description.en: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
description.zh: 把一段循环短片铺成聊天背景（可调透明度），启动时再播放一段有声片头动画。首次启动若为浅色主题，会一次性切到深色（附撤销提示）。

description.en: Turns a video (a local file, or a Bilibili/yt-dlp link) into one addressable storyboard grid — numbered cells with exact timestamps, per-cell transcript and an audio envelope on the same timeline — and video_zoom re-reads any window at higher resolution, so a text-only model can look at the video instead of reading a summary.
description.zh: 把视频（本地文件，或 B 站 / yt-dlp 链接）压成一张可寻址的宫格图：每格烧编号、对应精确时间、挂台词，底部还有同时间轴的音频包络；video_zoom 可对任意窗口高清重看——纯文本模型因此能「看」视频，而不是读别人写的摘要。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python 引擎：核心层需 faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp（约 200-300MB）；可选语义层另需约 2GB 的 torch / transformers / ultralytics。内置 doctor --fix 一键建 venv 并装齐两者。

description.en: Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts (local ASR only when the platform carries no subtitles), AudioSet 527-class sound tags and top comments — 21 tools sharing one on-disk cache behind a cross-process lock. Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.
description.zh: 按人看片的顺序取样，而不是下载整片：先元数据与章节，再按时间码抽帧看画面、字幕优先转录（平台没有字幕才走本地 ASR）、AudioSet 527 类声音事件标签与高赞评论——21 个工具共用一个磁盘缓存，并带跨进程锁。需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg 与 vidlens 包（pip install vidlens-mcp）；缺依赖时回给你的是两种修法，而不是一句 ImportError。

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中结合正文呈现交互图形、图表与分阶段学习演示。

description.en: Turns a live session into a layered instrument: seven toggleable rings (session, steps, skills, tools, jobs, approvals, file changes), a per-turn timeline, hover and click on every ring node, and per-step ladders drawn beneath the rings. It reads the session log directly and updates as the conversation runs, in Chinese and English.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成分层仪表的插件：七层可开关的环（会话、步骤、技能、工具、任务、审批、文件变更）、逐轮时间线、环上任意节点可悬停看名称并点击看详情、连线画在环的下层；直接读会话日志，随对话实时演进，界面中英双语。

description.en: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

description.en: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒 GUI 测试：AI 测试员只靠截图与键鼠操作真实 Windows 虚拟机，判定必须由像素支撑，而不是读日志或源码。包含 dsh-vm-tester 插件的十二个 vm_* 工具（状态、UI 元素树、截图、点击、输入、凭据注入、按键、普通键、等待、快照、上传、下载）、Windows 虚拟机内的反向隧道代理，以及运行体检与围观脚本。需要 Windows、VirtualBox 7 和装有内置代理的 Windows 虚拟机，vm 工具才可用。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Voice or sound cue when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or turn errors; user aborts stay silent and subagent sessions are skipped by default. Three modes: voice (Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, fingerprint reuse so unchanged text is not re-synthesised), effects (20 built-in sounds assignable to done, fail and approval, with per-row preview and no API key; the approval slot has no automatic trigger, so it plays only manually) and off. Plays through winmm without touching system volume. Windows only. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束播报完成、出错时播失败提示，用户中断默认不播，子代理默认跳过。三种方式：语音（火山 TTS，支持克隆与预设音色，指纹复用不重复合成）、音效（内置 20 个，可分配给完成/失败/审批并单独试听，零配置；审批槽没有自动触发源，只能手动播放）、关闭。走 winmm 播放，不改系统音量。仅 Windows。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).
description.zh: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.
description.zh: DSH 网页端语音控制：按住说话将语音转文字输入发送框（可自动发送），用浏览器语音合成朗读助手回复；右键麦克风打开设置面板，支持 Ctrl+M 全局快捷键。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。

description.en: Rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, structured prompt (5 modes, model fallback chain, optional multi-round memory) and adds stop-on-silence, hotkey and filler-word cleanup to DSH voice input; transcription stays with the official speechToText, the plugin ships no engine.
description.zh: 把输入框草稿改写为更清晰、结构化的提示词（5 模式·模型回退链·可选多轮记忆），并为 DSH 语音输入加上说完自动停、热键与口水词清理；识别仍由官方 speechToText 提供，插件不自带引擎。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 听写，结果落进输入框草稿。默认本地离线 SenseVoice（离线、零配置、零 key），自动回退浏览器 Web Speech，可选 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR 服务链，可经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

description.en: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.
description.zh: DSH 本地语音唤醒。先说唤醒词，听到提示音后说内容，自动发进 DSH 会话；默认本地识别，音频不落盘。需要 DSH 语音输入服务（speechToText）可用。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、模型选择框左边的扬声器按钮——单击翻到「你最新提问的开头」并闪烁光标，从那里读到最新回复结尾（走 dsh-tts，回退浏览器语音）；按住图标后在页面上单击即可挑选任意朗读起点；按住上滑调出竖式混音台，分别控制页内媒体音量与系统输出音量。

description.en: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.
description.zh: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 部署到自有 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，反向代理原生 Web 界面，令牌保护的初始化向导，DSH 一键升级且失败自动回滚；作为插件在设置中新增「VPS 部署」页，可填表经 SSH 把 DSH 装到或卸出 VPS，并显示版本、升级、网关状态，以及扫码把 DSH 添加到手机桌面。

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 23 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：23 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

description.en: Read-first VPS operations tools: systemd status and actions, disk usage, Docker status, log tails, configured backups, and quiet-hours schedules.
description.zh: 先读后写的 VPS 运维工具：systemd 状态与操作、磁盘占用、Docker 状态、日志尾部、可配置备份与静默时段计划。

description.en: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.
description.zh: 在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。

description.en: Sends a VS Code selection or file path into the open DSH conversation as an @path reference with its line range, inserted at the composer without sending it. Requires the companion VS Code extension shipped as a .vsix inside the bundle (one-click install from the composer, or install it by hand).
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的选区或文件路径以 @路径（含行号范围）插入当前 DSH 对话的输入框，不自动发送；需安装随包附带的 VS Code 扩展（.vsix，可在输入框一键安装或手动安装）。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: A floating VS Code-like workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with a Monaco editor, file explorer, Git panel, content search and an SSH terminal.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动式 VS Code 风格工作台，包含 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 面板、内容搜索与 SSH 终端。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

description.en: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background 发后不管与异步收尾通知之间的缺口：等待后台子代理（subagent wait）不再轮询 list_agents、不再靠猜。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.
description.zh: 将DSH的每一次Agent交互量化为可视化表现指标并自动同步至WakaTime,用数据展示你与Agent协作的生产力

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面与桌面端的独立壁纸背景：内置壁纸、本地图片/视频上传（存 IndexedDB）、只读接入本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需仓库自带的 wallpaper-engine-api 服务）；支持图片、视频与场景工坊预览渲染，可调浅色雾层/深色遮罩、模糊、亮度与安全放大，并可只读跟随桌面壁纸。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. It hooks `tools/pre-execute`: a local regex pass over destructive commands (`rm -rf`, `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `DROP TABLE`, `format`, disk writes) and sensitive paths (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `.ssh`, `.git/`, `$DSH_HOME`) runs first with no latency, and only a hit is escalated to one review-model call that returns allow or deny. Plain reads and ordinary writes never enter that path, so everyday work pays no added delay. Every verdict is shown live in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 工具调用的对抗式审查门。它挂在 `tools/pre-execute` 上：先用本地正则零延迟筛破坏性命令（`rm -rf`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`DROP TABLE`、`format`、写盘）和敏感路径（`.env`、`id_rsa`、`.ssh`、`.git/`、`$DSH_HOME`），只有命中才升级给一次审查模型调用，返回 allow / deny。普通读取与普通写入完全不进这条路径，日常工作没有额外延迟；每次判定都在 Web GUI 里实时显示。

description.en: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout. Palettes are switched under Settings → General.
description.zh: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。在「设置 → 通用」中切换配色。

description.en: Watch a video together with a text-only agent: with ffmpeg and the bundled browser extension reporting your real playback position (not a timer), it hands over one segment at a time just before that segment ends. It ships no TTS engine — it emits timed speech events, and speaking them aloud needs your own voice/TTS setup.
description.zh: 和只有文字的智能体一起看视频：需要 ffmpeg 和浏览器扩展上报真实播放位置（不是定时器），在每段结束前把画面和台词交到它手上。插件不带 TTS 引擎，只按时间轴发台词事件，要出声需自行配置语音/TTS。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.
description.zh: 侧边栏天气面板：当前天气、5 天与 24 小时预报、逐小时降水、历史气温、中央气象台预警（分级提醒、区县级匹配）、雷达拼图、风云四号 B 星卫星云图、台风路径，以及 ECMWF 与西北太平洋海表温度专业图。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Human-only browser panel that opens as a full page in the DSH main content area: multiple tabs, an address bar, a context menu, a homepage with pinned shortcuts, and a history page stored in IndexedDB. Pages render in the webview bridge that ships with DSH Desktop, and the current page can be opened in your local Chrome.
description.zh: 只交给人操作、不在 AI 侧注册任何工具的浏览器面板：在 DSH 右侧主内容区整页打开，提供多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、带钉住快捷入口的主页与 IndexedDB 永久保存的历史页。页面在 DSH Desktop 自带的 webview 桥里渲染，当前页可交给本地 Chrome 打开。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.
description.zh: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。

description.en: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

description.en: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
description.zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
description.zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
description.zh: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

description.en: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
description.zh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。

description.en: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
description.zh: 提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool.
description.zh: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
description.zh: 智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。

description.en: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
description.zh: ctx.web 搜索提供方：通过 LiteLLM 代理走 OpenAI Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 原生服务端 web_search，复用 LITELLM_API_KEY，无需新密钥。

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 工具提供可选的 SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Gemini 搜索溯源或 Wikipedia 后端，支持 Web 设置且不进行隐式回退。

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

description.en: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页搜索改走当前会话模型加自建检索后端。

description.en: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。

description.en: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
description.zh: 右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

description.en: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

description.en: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

description.en: Syncs DSH model providers and models across computers through any WebDAV server: the backup is sealed with a passphrase before it leaves this machine, so a new machine opens with the same model list.
description.zh: 通过任意 WebDAV 服务在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的模型供应商与模型：备份离开本机之前先用口令封好，新机器打开就是同一份模型清单。

description.en: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。

description.en: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
description.zh: 省 token 的网页阅读：底层是真 Chrome/Edge（CDP），一次调用读完多个页面、按相关性筛掉不相关的，只回一段带账本的摘要（实测省 80–98% 上下文）。真实搜索链接、登录态、截图、三档代理。

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth adding a deny-by-default allowlist route gate over resources, plugin bundles, /api and WebSocket upgrades; password and OIDC/SSO login with an SSO-only mode; server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies plus a per-browser session list and selective revocation; an OAuth 2.1 device authorization flow (RFC 8628) for app and CLI access, with independent device sessions that expire only on explicit revocation; and a core session bridge that exchanges the launch cookie on the server without exposing the launch token. It is a fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth and cannot be installed alongside it — remove the original from the profile's bundle list first.
description.zh: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，新增默认拒绝的白名单路由闸门（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 升级）；密码与 OIDC/SSO 登录及「仅允许 SSO」模式；服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie，浏览器会话列表与单条吊销；面向 App/CLI 的 OAuth 2.1 设备授权（RFC 8628），设备会话独立、仅主动吊销失效；核心会话桥在服务端换取 launch Cookie，不向客户端暴露 launch token。 本插件是 Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，不能与原版同装——安装前请先从 profile 的 bundle 列表移除原版。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到 DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输，用 slash 命令管理会话、工作区、模型、权限等等，目标是在微信端还原 DSH 的原生体验。

description.en: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: Report generator that follows your own style: pick DSH sessions by time window and slice each one to the turns inside it, optionally merge Git commits from several repositories filtered by author, then a new session reads the evidence with read-only collector scripts and writes a daily, weekly or monthly Markdown report matching a pasted sample; finished reports stay in a local library.
description.zh: 按你给定的样例风格生成日报/周报/月报：按时间窗口挑选 DSH 会话并只取窗口内的回合，可选合并多个仓库中按作者过滤的 git 提交，再由新会话用只读采集脚本读取证据写出 Markdown 报告；成品进入本地报告库。

description.en: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
description.zh: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

description.en: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
description.zh: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

description.en: Digital Study: a private WeRead study in the DSH sidebar, in a calm light-green paper palette. The shelf folds into ten categories and carries a slightly deeper paper tint of its own; highlights and thoughts page through, copy per item, and export as front-matter Markdown (one file per book or a cross-book batch) into a folder you choose; the whole study backs up and restores as a single JSON bundle. Thoughts read like handwritten notes: looser line height, the source book shown in full, long entries folding behind a show-all control, and a same-chapter highlight block for context. A five-shade reading heatmap draws only the days up to today, keeps its numbers on one line underneath, and a year-scoped KPI dashboard sits above it. Sync is incremental: a local ledger plus per-book counts mean an unchanged library refreshes in 2-3 seconds instead of a full pull, and a banner reports progress and dismisses itself after eight seconds. Search covers shelf, books, highlights and thoughts with type filters. Reads WeRead through the official agent gateway using your own API key, keeps everything in local JSON and never writes back. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 数字书房：把微信读书搬进 DSH 侧栏的私人书房，清爽的浅绿纸感配色。书架折叠成 10 大类并自带一层略深的纸色；划线与想法可分页、可单条复制，也能勾选导出成带 front-matter 的 Markdown（一本书一个文件，或跨书批量），存到你指定的目录；整间书房还能一键备份与恢复成一份 JSON。想法页按手记排版：行距更松、来源书名完整展示、长内容可一键展开，并能在卡片里展开同章的划线作参考。五档阅读热力图只画到今天，数据收在网格下方一行；上方是可切换年份的统计表盘。同步是增量的：靠本地账本与每本书的计数比对，数据没变化时 2~3 秒就完成，不用整库重拉；进度提示条会在完成后 8 秒自动消失。书架、书籍、划线、想法都能搜索并支持类型筛选。通过官方 agent 网关用你自己的 API Key 读取，全部落在本机 JSON，绝不写回。要求 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里组织《新版一夜狼人杀》：确定性发牌、夜序、换卡、投票与结算，自带房间界面与夜间私聊提示。包内是 baixianger/dsh-chat 与 baixianger/dsh-bridge 的修改版快照；请先卸载这两个上游插件，同时启用会重复注册 dshChat / dshBridge 服务。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
description.zh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

description.en: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and one-click archiving.
description.zh: 右侧栏「鱼篓」不用 agent 登记，自动汇总本场会话产出或改动的文件，支持预览、一键打包 zip 与归档。

description.en: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的两分钟小游戏：抓到的数字累加到身上，比自身大的鱼会掉一颗心，白饭回血，鲸元券让下一钩无视大小。单文件 HTML，不联网，无数据上报。

description.en: A talking whale desktop pet for the DSH web UI — persona-driven chat with persistent memory, plus scheduled autonomous web browsing that brings back a summarized message telling you what she found. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (its art and animations are reused under the upstream non-commercial terms); install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的会说话的鲸鱼桌宠：可配置人设与持久对话记忆，还会按间隔自己随机上网，把见闻总结成消息带回来告诉你。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的二次创作（沿用其形象与动画素材，素材不可商用），请替代 dsh-pet 安装，不要与上游同装。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.
description.zh: 一个插件里放三个 Agent 预设，各自带一份互不相通的持久记忆文件。装上就在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改 profile 配置。三者都沿用官方极简模式的组成——只有一个持久化 shell 终端——再加文件读写与 glob/grep 工具。第一个配的是鲸鱼娘陪伴人设（简体中文口语、称呼主人、黏人傲娇）；第二个换成「活人版」：允许怼人、敷衍、冷淡，甜味降为调味；第三个保留原版人设，但把「黏主人」写成第一行为驱动力，只在主人面前放开，群聊里照旧收着。每个预设都通过各自独立的提示变量（whale_memory、whale_memory_v2、whale_memory_v3）读取自己的记忆文件（whale-loli.md、whale-loli-v2-live.md、whale-loli-v3-naughty.md），三份记忆互不读写。上下文压缩交给 billion-context 插件；本插件只保留人设层的三条约定：压缩摘要也算依据、需要原文时自己去检索、看不到旧原文不等于记忆丢失。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests and weekly check-ins, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, weather and festival reactions, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import (JSON file or migration code), accessibility mode and an optional MiMo TTS bridge. Data stays in the host localStorage with no telemetry. Verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠：45 项成就、每日任务与周签到、三个小游戏、92 张立绘、620 条台词、成长日记、天气与节日反应、按工具类型切换工作姿态、跨端存档导出/导入（JSON 文件或迁移码）、无障碍模式，以及可选的 MiMo TTS 台词播报。数据只存放在宿主 localStorage，无遥测；已在 DSH 桌面端 0.2.0-rc.2 验收，兼容 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 与旧版 0.1.x Web。

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面加的一层动态鲸鱼背景：由鲸鱼剪影采样出的粒子场，加上一层点阵网格，两者都是挂在 shell.overlay 上的全屏点击穿透 canvas；粒子加载时聚合、空闲时呼吸、指针靠近时被推开，网格点靠近指针会放大，配色跟随页面明暗主题。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话之间的文件信箱：每封信都用 HMAC 与正文摘要封好，收件人通过名单接口解析，默认离线投递——投不出去的信留在信箱里等人来收，不会丢。

description.en: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.
description.zh: 智能体信箱的每日配额与免打扰时段：信件按命名桶计数、每桶有每日上限，日界可配置，并给出一个免打扰窗口，让核心把在线件留着而不投递。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: DeepTrace — deterministic agent reports from session logs (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom): cost & token breakdown, 8 insight rules, collaboration review, live provider balance, PDF/PNG/HTML export; read-only, never rewrites history.
description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace — 从会话日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报/自定义区间报告：成本与 Token 拆解、8 条确定性洞察、协作复盘、实时模型余额、PDF/PNG/HTML 导出；只读，绝不改写历史。

description.en: Provider-agnostic text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: synthesize speech to local audio files, manage preset, cloned and designed voices, configure providers in a bilingual settings card, and read assistant replies aloud with optional auto-read.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用语音合成：把文本合成为本地音频文件，管理预置、克隆和设计音色，在双语设置卡里配置 provider，并可用朗读按钮或自动朗读播报助手回复。

description.en: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

description.en: Quote books in the conversation header: one markdown file per chat, with search, a random pick, line and favourite counts, a keep button under every reply, and a trash with restore. The agent gets four tools (append, list, remove, merge) and a system-prompt guide, so by default it may save up to a line or two per chat on its own; capture rules can be set per chat or globally. Local-only. Needs DSH 0.2.1+ (below 0.3).
description.zh: 会话头部的「鲸语」：每个对话一本 markdown 语录，带搜索、翻一句、句数与收藏计数、每条回复旁的一键收入，以及能恢复的回收站。agent 有增、查、删、合并四个工具，系统提示里也带一段记录指引，所以默认每个对话它最多自己记一两句；记什么可按对话或全局设置。全部只存本地。需要 DSH 0.2.1+（0.3 以下）。

description.en: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Docks the dsh-whale-widget desktop pet flush against the right sidebar edge, following sidebar width changes and collapse/expand, with a toggle in the widget menu.
description.zh: 让 dsh-whale-widget 桌宠紧贴右侧栏边缘：展开时贴其左缘、折叠时贴窗口右缘，右栏改宽时实时跟随，开关在挂件菜单里。

description.en: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.
description.zh: What's up · 在忙啥——零维护的会话动态看板:host 端扫描全部会话,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」(多 provider LLM、按指纹缓存),自动发现做到一半、问了没回、近期在推进的事,点卡片一键跳回会话。

description.en: Realtime token counter beside the deep-thinking indicator in chat, with merged or split input/output display, per-step operation counts, and auto-scaling K/M/G/T units.
description.zh: 在聊天页“深度思考”指示旁实时显示 token 计数，支持输入/输出合并或分列展示、逐步骤操作计数与 K/M/G/T 自适应单位。

description.en: A per-command sandbox allow-list for the bash tool: a rule names a CLI and the writable roots it gets, so allow-listed programs such as lark-cli and gh run inside the kernel sandbox with the workspace plus those roots appended. Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writable set for every command, the grant here is scoped to the matched command, the workspace stays writable, and other commands keep their exact behaviour. Matching is by write footprint rather than by command string, so write-neutral pipes like `2>&1 | tail -N` still match; rules are edited from a Settings page or the Plugins row. Overlays cover Seatbelt, bubblewrap and Landlock; on Windows the writable root is swapped for $HOME instead.
description.zh: 按命令生效的 bash 沙箱白名单：一条规则指定一个命令和它可用的可写根，命中的 lark-cli、gh 等在保留工作区的前提下于内核沙箱内直接执行。与「替你回答授权弹窗」或「对所有命令统一放宽可写范围」的做法不同，这里放行的只有命中的那条命令，工作区仍可写，其他命令行为完全不变。匹配依据是命令的「写足迹」而不是命令字符串，因此 `2>&1 | tail -N` 这类不写文件的管道仍能命中；规则可在设置页或插件行里编辑。macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap / Landlock，Windows 则退回把可写根换成 $HOME 的旧行为。

description.en: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 客户端对话列宽度设为其自身宽度的百分比（40–100，默认 100 即铺满整列），取代内置的 680–920px 阅读宽度，并在「设置 > 插件」中提供可折叠的调整卡片。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
