description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧的可自定义部件栏：61 个部件覆盖会话统计、token 与缓存、上下文、后台任务、子代理、机器指标、OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 额度、会话成本、峰谷定价与 GitHub 待审队列；部件可在栏内市场安装，支持 1-4 列网格与 2x2 / 2x4 尺寸、逐实例配置、指针划过放大波峰与一键整栏收起。支持 DSH 0.1.x / 0.2.x，网页版与桌面端通用。

description.en: Read-only knowledge gateway over a local Markdown vault, in four tools: `wiki_recall` returns the matching section in full with page-level citations plus vault health checks and a page skeleton for writing a good answer back; `wiki_context` returns one evidence pack with per-page excerpts, a support verdict and an explicit list of gaps; `wiki_verify` re-checks a drafted answer against that pack and reports claims the evidence cannot back, including unsupported numbers; `wiki_observe` reports how often answers needed correcting. The settings page and sidebar panel share the same query path as the model, so a search you run by hand cannot disagree with what the model was given. The three knowledge-gateway tools (`wiki_context`, `wiki_verify`, `wiki_observe`) need a local Python 3 bridge — `bridge.python` plus `bridge.toolsRoot` containing `wiki_bridge.py`; without it they return `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: 在本地 Markdown 笔记库上做只读的知识网关，四个工具：`wiki_recall` 一次调用返回命中小节正文与页级出处，另带库健康检查与「把好答案回写成新页」的骨架；`wiki_context` 返回一份带逐页摘录的证据包，附「知识够不够」的判定和明确的缺口清单；`wiki_verify` 拿这份证据回头核验草稿，报出证据撑不住的说法，包括没有依据的数字；`wiki_observe` 统计回答需要被修正的比例。设置页与侧栏面板和模型走同一条查询路径，手动搜一次不会跟它拿到的结论对不上。其中 `wiki_context` / `wiki_verify` / `wiki_observe` 三个知识网关工具需要本机 Python 3 通路（`bridge.python` 与包含 `wiki_bridge.py` 的 `bridge.toolsRoot`）；未配置时返回 `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 真正的 Windows 系统 Toast（通知中心持久、DeepSeek 品牌鲸鱼图标）：任务完成 / 需要输入 / 需要审批时提醒。仅支持 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a Windows system-proxy switch to DeepSeek Harness: toggles the HKCU Internet Settings proxy with a WinINET refresh, together with the git, npm and pip proxy settings, from chat, the /proxy command or a Settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统代理开关：写注册表并通知 WinINET 重载，同时切换 git、npm、pip 的代理配置，支持对话、/proxy 命令和设置页三个入口。

description.en: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 报告 DSH 的 pwsh 执行器实际运行的 PowerShell（只认启用中的行，带版本号的商店路径不会被推荐为 pin），并通过脚本点击商店页面或手动商店路径安装由商店管理的 PowerShell 7。只有实际执行器解析到 PowerShell 7+ 时才放行 pwsh 工具；检测到 dsh-ops 时启用其 Compatibility 模式，保留原生 pwsh 与 ops_bash 并存，并隐藏重复的官方工具。Web 界面提供原生状态卡片和配置开关；仅 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的 Windows 原生工具：剪贴板读写、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断，均返回结构化数据（带 UI 卡片），底层为防注入的 PowerShell。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.
description.zh: 围绕官方持久 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 方案检查和修复原生 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness，创建桌面快捷方式，并仅通过明确的 legacy 安装保留早期 Git Bash 与 BusyBox 预设，无需 WSL。

description.en: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
description.zh: 如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满：启动时自动最大化（保留右上角窗口按钮）或真全屏；随时可最大化／还原／最小化／窗口置顶；退出前弹原生确认框，快捷键可选 Esc、双击 Esc 或 Ctrl+Q，且全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏。窗口通道由插件自己安装，无需脚本或 Python，首次安装需重启两次 DSH 生效。

description.en: Remember the DeepSeek Harness desktop window position, size and maximized state, restoring it on next launch. The window logic lives in a standalone PowerShell script that does not depend on the client version; the plugin shell only installs it, keeps it autostarted and exposes a toggle.
description.zh: 记住 DSH 桌面窗口的位置、大小与最大化状态，下次启动回到上次离开的地方。窗口逻辑放在独立的 PowerShell 脚本里，不依赖客户端版本；插件外壳只负责安装、自启和开关。

description.en: Set the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop from a settings page, with 4:3, 16:9 and 16:10 presets and up to 12 custom presets.
description.zh: 在设置页设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版启动时的窗口大小，内置 4:3、16:9、16:10 比例预设，支持保存最多 12 个自定义预设。

description.en: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 系统盘（C 盘）清理能力：按规则库扫描、五级安全分级、带台账可回滚的暂存区、UAC 提权与迁移到其他盘 —— 既有模型工具，也有 Web 面板。

description.en: Bridges the CursorTouch/Windows-MCP desktop automation server into DSH through the official MCP client bridge, registering its screenshot, UI tree snapshot, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, process and registry tools as mcp__windows__* tools for the model, and adds a windows_mcp_doctor diagnostic tool. Computer Use is off by default and is switched on from the plugin panel.
description.zh: 通过官方 MCP 客户端桥接层把 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP 桌面自动化服务器接入 DSH，把截屏、UI 树快照、鼠标键盘输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表等工具注册成 mcp__windows__* 供模型调用，并附带 windows_mcp_doctor 诊断工具；Computer Use 默认关闭，需在插件面板里打开。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

description.en: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.
description.zh: 一个插件做会话与消息手术：撤回或编辑指令/回复（连思考过程一起改）、用原提问重新生成、按模型上下文级删除任意一条，以及会话归档、删除、跨工作区移动与工作区迁移。面向 DSH 0.1.5 / 0.2.x，已在 0.2.1-rc.3 实测。由三个 MIT 插件分叉合并而成（Jipcon/DSH-plugins 的 dsh-message-recall、hkkz9522 的 dsh-session-manager、DDDMUC 的 dsh-delete-turn），新增编辑回复、重新生成与工作区迁移。不要与这些插件或其它会话移动、消息删除类插件同时启用。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows 自带语音朗读——离线、不联网、不调模型；出卡/出卷时还会在后台把整批音频预先合成好，点击即秒开。1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10 个、从上往下、最多同时 50 个，带实时计数）；考试做错的词可一键出成「能发音的在线复习卡」（在线点读页 + 可打印 PDF）；卡面英文例句下方带中文对照。课本/作业照片上被荧光笔或红笔标出的词按标记找出来，翻译后进本机 SQLite，并累计出现次数；剪贴板点选、拍照、对话三种录入进的是同一本库。高频词按次数浮现，连对三次自动标记「已学会」；勾选任意若干词可出记忆卡（拆解块 + 每块真实 IPA 音标 + 7 年级英文例句 + 荒诞梗，A4 每页 8 张），输出 HTML/PDF/Word，并可出一份四选项按词义互斥的打印试卷作答。在 0.1.5 上设置面板不会出现，可改装 dsh-word-vault@1.0.2。

description.en: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their relations from your notes, and hands tasks to separate assistant sessions. Ships its own WeChat bot channel (scan to log in; private chat only) and a full-page dashboard.
description.zh: 微信工作助理：把你交代的事记进 SQLite 任务账本，按紧急度排序，到点提醒，从笔记里抽取人物与关系，并把任务分派给独立的助手会话。自带微信机器人通道（扫码登录，仅私聊）与整页仪表盘。

description.en: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器：国内版与国际版各自成组，带上游声明的推理档位、每条回复的积分消耗与剩余积分、按账号分别保存的模型显隐，以及在支持的模型上的图片输入。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Version 0.1.17 supports per-model context-window selection and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, rc.3, rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1; its CN compatibility layer differs from the functy23 fork. Derived from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT), it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be enabled together with the original or other WorkBuddy bridges. Version 0.1.12 requires authenticated Host owner access for status and control routes.
description.zh: 复用本机桌面登录的 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 模型提供器社区分叉，提供模型发现和额度显示。正式版 0.1.17 支持按模型选择上下文窗口及 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、rc.3、rc.5 和 0.2.2-rc.1，CN 兼容层与 functy23 的分叉不同。派生自 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（MIT），注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与原版或其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。0.1.12 为状态与控制接口增加宿主 owner 身份认证。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: Step-by-step workflow map for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into one step list, labels where each percentage came from rather than reporting a bare number, and queues a prompt for the next step with revoke before it is claimed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分步工作流地图：把会话折叠成一条分步列表，给每个进度百分比标注来源而不是只报一个数，并支持把提示词排入下一步队列、被取用前可撤回。

description.en: Show workflow stages and subagents on a timeline, configure model and concurrency for each stage, and reopen subagent conversations from the panel. Run names and stage settings persist under ~/.dsh.
description.zh: 在时间线中查看工作流阶段和子代理，为每个阶段配置模型与并发，并从面板打开子代理对话。运行名称与阶段设置保存在 ~/.dsh。

description.en: Turns DSH session logs into Markdown work reports for a day, an ISO week or a month, grouped by working directory. Each session lists its requests, changed files, tool counts and interruptions, and a closing section names the most-changed files, generated documents and key commands. Adds the /worklog command, a worklog_generate tool and a settings page for the output folder, cross-day merging, the products list and an optional weekly timer.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话日志还原成 Markdown 工作台账：日报、周报（ISO 周）或月报，按工作目录分组。每个会话列出需求、改动文件、工具用量与中断次数，末尾附「产物」清单：改动最多的文件、新生成的文档、关键命令。提供 /worklog 命令、worklog_generate 工具，以及一个设置页，用来调整存放目录、跨天合流、产物清单与每周定时生成。

description.en: Durable task-decomposition plans for DeepSeek Harness with a self-learning loop: every department subtask runs in three ordered phases (plan, execute, verify), the verify phase must submit a retrospective of problems, detours and resolutions, and that retrospective is written to a permanent lessons file, ranked against the new subtask and injected into later dispatches so the same mistake is not repeated. Adds a read-only dsh_workplan_lessons tool (11 model tools in total), a progress panel drawn as a ring, a stacked bar and per-stage steps, and a public ISO/IEC 15408:2026 security self-assessment with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化任务分解计划，并加入自我学习闭环：每个部门子任务按「计划→执行→验证」三阶段推进，验证阶段必须提交问题、弯路与解决方式的复盘，写入永久教训记忆文件，下次派发时按部门与关键词排序注入，避免重犯。新增只读 dsh_workplan_lessons 工具（共 11 个模型工具）、环形图/四段构成条/逐阶段步进条进度面板，以及按 ISO/IEC 15408:2026 结构编写的公开安全自评估——每条声明都可被读者核对，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
description.zh: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，会话行可归档 / 取消归档（运行中的会话走官方同款「停止并归档」确认）并配隐藏 / 含归档 / 仅归档三态筛选，行内按钮悬停有应用自带样式的提示，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with their session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations.
description.zh: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: A sidebar panel that moves, rebuilds, merges, renames and deletes whole workspaces: a move re-publishes each session log with the new directory in its header, repairs the workspace record, refreshes the cached title, and every card shows whether its sessions are running or only open.
description.zh: 侧栏里的工作区面板：迁移、重建、合并、重命名、删除整个工作区——迁移会用新目录的 header 重新发布会话日志，修复工作区归属并刷新标题缓存，每张卡片标明会话是在运行还是仅被打开。

description.en: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.
description.zh: 把添加工作区的目录对话框换成路径输入、盘符快捷和系统文件夹选择。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中的工作区与会话可拖动气泡图谱：大泡为工作区、小泡为会话，连线表示真实所属关系。画布支持平移、缩放与适应；筛选覆盖工作区、状态、类型和归档情况；搜索覆盖工作区名称、路径与会话标题；原生操作可打开或新建会话、重命名工作区、归档或恢复会话。布局保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
description.zh: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

description.en: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

description.en: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.
description.zh: 按工作区迁移 DSH：把一个项目的会话、文件与附件打包，在新机器上还原到指定根目录并重写历史绝对路径，之后只增量同步改动的文件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.
description.zh: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」与导航之间的可拖动分隔条，上拖把高度让给会话列表，双击恢复默认。

description.en: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a session; the file stays out of git.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: Four filter chips on their own row at the foot of the sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting for your approval, plan review or answer, sessions with something unread (a turn that finished unseen, or newer activity the panel was not opened on), and sessions updated since local midnight. Each chip counts its matches and opens a popover listing them grouped by workspace, where a row opens the session. The row ends with a DeepSeek service status dot (green operational, yellow partial degradation, red open incident, grey when the feed is unreachable) that subscribes to the status Atom feed once a minute with an ETag conditional request and shows the current finding, the last refresh time and the three newest incidents on hover; clicking it opens status.deepseek.com. A separate panel adds an all-sessions chip, a more menu for the last day, three days, week or thirty days, and a manage mode that searches sessions by title or path, multi-selects them, lists the Markdown digests it has written to the session-digests folder of the DSH data directory in a resizable right-hand column that previews them in place or full screen, writes a Markdown digest and only then moves the session directories to the sessions/.trash folder of that directory; the session you have open cannot be selected.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部独占一行的四个筛选 chip：正在运行、在等你确认（审批、计划审阅、待回答）、有未读内容（跑完没看，或最近有更新但没打开过）、以及本地零点之后有更新的今日会话，各自带当前数量；点开就在上方按工作区分组列出命中会话，点行直接打开。同一行行尾还有一颗 DeepSeek 服务状态灯（绿=正常、黄=部分异常、红=有进行中的故障、灰=取不到），它每分钟带 ETag 条件订阅一次 status.deepseek.com 的 Atom feed，悬浮显示当前结论、状态更新时间与最近三次故障，点击打开状态页。另有完整面板：多一个「全部」chip、「更多」菜单（最近一天、三天、一周、三十天），以及「管理」态——按标题或路径搜索、多选、右侧栏可列出并就地预览已导出的 Markdown 摘要，栏宽可拖动、可全屏、先导出一份摘要再把这些会话目录移到本地回收站；当前打开的会话不会被勾选。

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

description.en: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上显示彩色状态标记（等待你处理、运行中、刚刚完成，按工作区聚合），并在列表上方提供已置顶会话区与仅针对置顶会话的通知，持久保存。

description.en: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row green.
description.zh: 为每个工作区分配稳定的暖到冷色调，把工作区名设为分组标题并把会话缩进其下，同时在会话完成未读时整行染绿。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.
description.zh: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。

description.en: Adds a one-click Worktree switch beside the composer that moves an empty session into a new git worktree, and removes worktrees idle for three days.
description.zh: 在输入框分支标记旁提供一键 Worktree 开关，让空会话进入新的 git worktree；三天无活动的 worktree 自动清理。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.
description.zh: writing-anything 工作区的只读写作面板：作品总览卡片、单元树、YAML 产物的语义卡片与源码高亮视图、素材清单与决策／复核清单，以及面板内单元审阅（反馈经 wa-cli 写回）。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: Sidebar session management for DeepSeek Harness: workspace groups sorted by latest activity, history folded behind one control, a global pinned section, running/unread/follow-up marks, delete into a restorable trash whose panel also manages archived sessions, per-session token statistics split by tool (arguments vs results), moving a session to another workspace, and a scan that re-attaches sessions missing from every workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序，过期历史折叠成一个「展开历史」控件，所有置顶会话汇总到顶部置顶区，运行中/未读/需跟进三色标记，删除会话移入可恢复的回收站（面板同时管理已归档会话），按工具拆分、参数与结果分开的 token 消耗统计，把会话移动到另一个工作区，以及一键把游离会话重新挂回工作区。

description.en: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在当前 WSL 发行版里运行持久 bash 以及 Linux 路径的文件与搜索工具。新建对话选中 WSL 后，从该发行版的文件夹里指定工作区，且不会在发行版内安装任何东西。

description.en: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
description.zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as a \\wsl.localhost workspace whose sidebar terminals open inside the distribution and whose files the agent can write. Requires Windows 10/11 with WSL installed.
description.zh: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness. A sidebar W button lists installed distros and registers a Linux folder as a host workspace addressed by a UNC path, and the sidebar terminal opens a real Linux pty inside the distribution for WSL sessions. A persistent zero-dependency agent running in the distro answers file, shell and search requests over a JSON-lines pipe, so no polling timers touch the distribution while it is idle and /mnt drives stay reachable; grep and glob run the distro's own ripgrep. WSL preset twins such as wsl-standard swap in the WSL shell and fs tools. A rebuild of 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace — do not install both: they mount the same W entry in the Workspaces header, publish the same wsl-<mode> presets, and each wrap the host's single-slot terminal provider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 WSL 工作区：侧栏 W 按钮列出发行版并把 Linux 目录注册为宿主工作区（以 UNC 路径表示），WSL 会话的侧栏终端在发行版内打开真实 Linux pty。发行版内常驻一个零依赖 agent，通过 JSON-lines 管道响应文件、shell 与搜索请求，空闲时没有轮询计时器触碰发行版，/mnt 盘符也保持可达；grep 与 glob 在发行版内调用自带的 ripgrep。附带 wsl-standard 等 WSL 孪生预设，替换 shell 与 fs 工具。本插件是 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace 的重写版，不能与上游同装——两者都在侧栏挂同一个 W 入口、发布同名的 wsl-<mode> 预设，并各自包装宿主的单槽终端 provider。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
description.zh: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

description.en: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free dragging with remembered position, click-to-cycle, a bottom-right standee that reports each turn's token usage and think latency with its own balance bubble, a chat wallpaper, a liquid-glass composer, a cute persona that calls you 主人 with 喵~ style particles, and a single switch in Settings to turn the whole look off.
description.zh: 鲸鱼正太 × 女仆装 × 二次元的桌面桌宠：四种表情跟随对话状态，可拖拽、点击切换；右下角立牌每轮显示 token 消耗与思考时间，点击有 q 弹与独立余额气泡；另附聊天壁纸、液态玻璃输入框；人格自称小D，称呼你为主人并带喵~ 等语气词；设置里可一键开关，还能自定义称呼。

description.en: Adds Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, Breeze and browser speech to DSH, with external provider and local model adapters, text filtering, streaming read-aloud, audio downloads, sound effects, desktop pets, QQ Bot and AI Passport integration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供小米 MiMo、豆包、Breeze 和浏览器语音，支持接入外部供应商与本地模型、文本过滤、实时流式朗读、音频下载、音效、桌宠及 QQ Bot、AI Passport 联动。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: A local task board with secretary, CEO, and historian roles, plus a desktop whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地工作任务看板，带秘书、CEO、史官三个角色和鲸鱼娘浮窗，数据保存在本机。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: Turns an organised memory archive into a browsable star map — one star per memory, the diary as an outer timeline, plus a chapter view, a day view, and a picking task that files each day's raw conversation into the archive.
description.zh: 把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张能点的星图——一条记忆一颗星，日记在外圈排成时间星带，另有星册、星历，以及把每天的原始对话收进档案的「拾星」。

description.en: Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a blue taskbar sidebar, Luna title bars, translucent conversation and plugin windows with adjustable opacity and blur, and a settings page for importing a wallpaper. Light mode only: the skin removes itself when the host switches to dark.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤：蓝色任务栏侧栏、Luna 标题栏、可调节不透明度与模糊的半透明对话及插件窗口，以及可导入壁纸的设置页。仅浅色模式：宿主切到深色时皮肤自动移除。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Freezes a six-step repair chain into callable tools — freeze the facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable A/B, a judge that must say OK, delivery gate — plus a zero-dependency boot self-check (path drift, missing files, version sync, crash-log freshness), per-item tunables and a rollback ledger that backs up every action.
description.zh: 把排障六步固化成可调用的链：冻结事实→量真形状→最小复现→单变量对照→判定器（没说 OK 不许说修好）→交活闸；另带零依赖开机自检（安装路径漂移、配方缺件、版本三处一致、崩溃日志新鲜度）、逐项说明的微调设置，以及每个动作都留备份的退回账本。

description.en: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
description.zh: 控制、组织、诊断、设计、个性化 Yeelight 智能家居，解答产品知识问题，由本地 yeelight-home 运行时驱动。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Windows-only local encrypted credential vault (DPAPI-wrapped AES-256-GCM) plus a headless-Chrome login keeper: 31 agent tools log a site in once, keep the session on disk, and fetch login-walled pages (Tieba, NGA, Pixiv, one book site) with per-floor post extraction. The live page mirrors into a draggable, collapsible right-edge dock where clicks, typing and scrolling replay over CDP, so a captcha can be solved without a separate browser window. Edge/Chrome saved passwords can be migrated: the plugin reads the browser's Login Data store, decrypts v10/v11 entries in-process, and copies the store and its key blobs into its own controlled profile so the browser can autofill them (v20 app-bound entries can only be autofilled, not decrypted offline). Ships a one-command installer that repairs the DSH profile registration and a built-in self-test.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：本地加密凭据库（DPAPI 包裹的 AES-256-GCM）配无头 Chrome 登录态保管：31 个 agent 工具登录一次即可把会话存到本机，之后抓登录墙内的页面（贴吧、NGA、Pixiv、书屋）并逐楼层提取正文。页面实时镜像到可拖动、可收起的右边缘抽屉，点击、打字、滚动经 CDP 回放，验证码不必再开独立浏览器窗口。可迁移 Edge/Chrome 已存密码：插件会读取浏览器的 Login Data 密码库，在进程内解密 v10/v11 条目，并把密码库及其密钥复制进自己的受控 profile 让浏览器自动填充（v20 App-Bound 条目只能自动填充、无法离线解密）。另附一条命令修复 DSH profile 登记的安装器，以及内置自检。

description.en: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
description.zh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.6.1 supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, improves CLI discovery and includes optional Retry. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox. Derived from kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy (AGPL-3.0); it registers the same `zcode-cli` provider id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original.
description.zh: 需已安装并登录 ZCode CLI。把 ZCode CLI agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。常驻 app-server 会话逐回合流式转发，模型清单从 CLI 实时读取，因此上下文窗口、图片支持与 provider 路由都跟随已安装的 CLI 和账号。稳定版 0.6.1 支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，改进 CLI 自动发现并提供可选 Retry。工具权限请求默认拒绝；未知的 approval/permission 方法始终拒绝，全自动需显式启用。DSH 自带的审批界面不会介入这个独立 spawn 的 app-server 进程，该策略也不构成操作系统沙箱。派生自 kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy（AGPL-3.0），注册相同的 `zcode-cli` provider id，不能与原版同装。

description.en: Connects the free ZCode plan to the model picker: a multi-account pool with rotation, per-account rate-limit and quota display, and bigmodel/zai device login.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 赠送的免费 plan 接进模型选择器：多账号池轮换、按账号的限流与额度展示、bigmodel/zai 双渠道设备登录。

description.en: A ZCode-styled skin for DSH Web: Zai light/dark themes, sidebar workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation with hover wave, and approval-card / message-keycap styling aligned to ZCode — every visual value guarded by contract assertions. A fork of MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both repaint the same sidebar and conversation surfaces.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 ZCode 视觉语言的皮肤：Zai 明暗主题、侧栏工作区会话树、全局搜索、带悬停波的轮次导航、对齐 ZCode 的审批卡与消息键帽样式，每个视觉值都有契约断言守护。本项目是 MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui 的分支，请勿与上游同装——两者都会重绘同一套侧栏与会话界面。

description.en: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Zed AI 托管模型。

description.en: Dynamic backgrounds and interface skins for DeepSeek Harness. Native customizable animated skins, plus beautiful live wallpapers to download from the marketplace. Built on Open Sea Skin (d-dev0101/open-sea-skin) - do not install both.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 动态背景与界面皮肤。原生个性化动态背景皮肤，以及市场下载精美的动态壁纸。沿用 Open Sea Skin（d-dev0101/open-sea-skin）的上游实现，请勿与上游同时安装。

description.en: Pairing-code remote access for DSH: a phone-first PWA with Web Push, plus a client role that operates the host's shared sessions in the native DSH interface, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh: 配对码远程访问 DSH：手机端可安装 PWA、带 Web Push 推送；另一台设备作为客户端，在原生 DSH 界面里直接操作主机共享的会话，经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 接入。

description.en: ZenTao work panel in the DSH left sidebar: lists tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you (web-login protocol, so instances where the RESTful v2 API is unavailable are supported — verified on ZenTao 18.13 open-source) with search, smart sort, overdue / due-today filters and a flow-board view (cards and details also show the owning project, execution, product and module, effort estimated / consumed / left, and the parent requirement or source bug); opens a new chat pre-filled with the card's description, recent comments and screenshots (or a blank one), or dispatches it to a new background session with workspace, model, reasoning-effort and optional-instruction selection (single or multi-select batch), turns screenshots inside ticket descriptions into real image attachments, reads back the linked session's latest reply once a card is done and lets you answer the agent from the panel while it waits on you, and tracks each card with live running / needs-decision / done status plus manual overrides and a manually-marked finished state, with a deep link to ZenTao's finish / resolve page, and caches list and detail data locally so reopening the panel or a card paints instantly with a silent refresh. Multi-account; read-only, no writes back to ZenTao.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏禅道工作面板：列出指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求（走网页登录协议，RESTful v2 API 不可用的实例也能用，已在禅道 18.13 开源版实测），支持搜索、智能排序、逾期/今天到期筛选与流程看板（卡片与详情还显示所属项目、执行、产品、模块、工时口径「预计/已耗/剩余」与所属需求/来源 Bug）；可新建对话并自动带入任务背景（描述、最近动态与截图，也可只建空白会话），或下发到新后台会话（可选工作区、模型、思考强度与附加指令，支持多选批量），工单里的截图会转成真实图片附件，已完成的卡片可回读关联会话的最新回复，等你决策时能在面板里直接答复 agent，卡片实时显示 处理中/等你决策/已完成 状态并支持手动修正与「已结束」终态，完成后可跳转禅道的完成/解决页收尾；列表与详情缓存在本机，重开面板或复看同一张卡即时出内容并静默刷新。支持多账号；只读，不回写禅道。

description.en: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
description.zh: 為網頁介面加入繁體中文（zh-Hant）語言，經語言服務註冊，每個 namespace 各有一份字典，並可在「設定 → 一般 → 語言」揀選。

description.en: A bilingual overlay layer for DSH: it overlays Chinese names and functional descriptions for plugins, commands and skills, supports three display modes and manually-triggered AI translation, and does not modify a single line of DSH source code.
description.zh: DSH的双语覆盖层：为插件、命令与技能叠加中文名和功能说明，支持三种显示模式与纯手动触发的AI翻译，且不修改一行DSH源码。

description.en: Injects a Chinese-thinking reminder around the system prompt and the per-step runtime snapshot, so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese instead of drifting back to English as the transcript grows.
description.zh: 把中文思考提醒注入系统提示与每一步重建的运行时快照，让模型的推理全程用简体中文，不会随着会话变长漂回英文。

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

description.en: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.
description.zh: 主打「周礼模式」agent 预设：会话分三段依六官法度而行——开工「设官分职」、事中「依典援据」、收尾「岁终之会」依六计考成。另附 zhouli 工具，七种检索动作，检索内置 49,384 字《周礼》语料，每条结果带稳定坐标（篇序.职官序），含职官员额索引与 Kanripo 两本互校勘记。

description.en: Turns Zhejiang University classroom replays (classroom.zju.edu.cn) into Markdown study notes plus a matching PDF typeset locally with Typst. Transcripts are public; slide capture is opt-in and needs a ZJU login. Scraping core: nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-. Optional fill-in notes use the MIT-licensed scholia Typst template.
description.zh: 把浙大智云课堂（classroom.zju.edu.cn）回放整理成 Markdown 复习讲义，并在本地用 Typst 排成同名 PDF。字幕公开免登录；投影截图需在插件设置中开启，且需浙大登录态。抓取内核来自 nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-；可选填空笔记用 MIT 授权的 scholia 模板。

description.en: Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search and read papers in conversation, audit the literature trail, and browse the literature panel. It uses the same package name (dsh-zotero) as kuangdang123/dsh-zotero, so only one of the two can be installed per profile.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 插件：在对话中检索与阅读文献、在文献轨迹中核对记录，并在文献面板浏览文献库。包名与 kuangdang123/dsh-zotero 相同（dsh-zotero），同一个 profile 里只能装其中一个。

description.en: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key，Zotero 7+）操作文献库：检索条目与分类、读元数据/摘要/PDF 全文（缓存未命中时现场解析）、下载附件、管理笔记；API 地址、目标文献库与限额均可配置。

description.en: Zotero skill for DeepSeek Harness: page-anchored Q&A, full-text translation and close reading, native highlights and Chinese notes, bilingual PDF and paragraph Markdown, evidence comparison tables, and reviews with citation tracking; finds papers on OpenAlex or Crossref, imports Chinese CNKI export files, classifies the library into research-direction folders, surfaces research gaps, and runs a ranked daily digest of new papers. Python-based (basic library management uses the standard library; the reading workflow downloads its PDF/OCR components on first use); writes need a one-time Zotero authorization, and daily scheduling is Windows-only. Adapted from the OpenAI MIT Zotero plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 文献技能：原文定位问答、全文翻译与精读、原生高亮和中文批注、双语 PDF 与逐段 Markdown、论文证据对比表、综述与引用追踪；支持 OpenAlex / Crossref / 知网导出文件三种来源，按研究方向建文件夹分类、提炼脉络、发现空白，并可每日自动收录新论文。基于 Python（基础文献管理用标准库，阅读流程首次使用时下载 PDF/OCR 组件）；写入需一次性 Zotero 授权，每日定时收录仅支持 Windows。改编自 OpenAI 的 MIT Zotero 插件。

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm: true；写入、上传、建目录、重命名、移动、复制默认直接执行，zspace_write 会覆盖同名文件（除非传 overwrite: false）。

description.en: SSH and JumpServer terminal plugin: real-machine read tools, human-initiated read-write operations, and session management from inside DSH.
description.zh: SSH 与 JumpServer 终端插件：真实机器读工具、人工发起的读写操作，以及 DSH 内的会话管理。

description.en: Passcode marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: enter a six-character code to unlock and install plugins shared by creators, plus themes, backup, updates and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 口令插件市场：输入 6 位口令解锁并安装创作者分享的插件，附带主题、备份、更新与诊断。

description.en: Yueling (月令) — a solar-term card for the DSH Web UI: a dot under the conversation header unfolds into today's term, its three pentads, how long until the next term, a day-pillar reading, and a year table of all 24 terms. The hexagram page casts coins and keeps a seven-day log; the jieqi skill is bundled.
description.zh: 月令：DSH Web UI 的二十四节气卡片，标题栏下沿一颗圆点，展开今日节气与三候、距下个节气几天几时辰、日柱三行提示和全年交节时刻；卦页可以用铜钱摇一卦并回看七天。内置 jieqi skill。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索并安装社区插件，支持分类筛选、一键更新与停用，以及主题切换与配置备份。

description.en: Adds an independent settings page to update npm-stable dshmarket through the DSH plugin manager, with version verification and best-effort recovery on installation failure.
description.zh: 插件市场更新助手：专治插件市场更新自己时把自己卸载的尴尬，市场负责逛街，助手负责换市场。市场你先别动，我来 ＞﹏＜。

description.en: Browse and install DSH plugins without leaving the harness: a /store command, a Settings → Plugins tab, two agent-callable tools and a bundled skill, with an approval gate that lists the detected risk flags before anything installs.
description.zh: 不离开 harness 就能找插件、装插件：/store 命令、设置页的插件标签页、两个可供 agent 调用的工具和一个随包技能，安装前先确认并列出检测到的风险项。

description.en: HarmonyOS delivery orchestration for DSH: freezes a four-dimension acceptance pack whose measurable criteria carry machine-checkable assertions, runs an adversarial pre-review before dispatch, hands the work to DevEco Code in Goal mode, then audits the delivery with independently gathered evidence (screenshots, UI tree, logs, hashed evidence bundle), recomputing assertion verdicts against measured values and filing rework orders; includes a cited rule catalog, a user-confirmation state and a gate calibration ledger.
description.zh: DSH 侧鸿蒙交付编排插件：冻结四维验收任务包（可量化判据带机器可校验断言）、派发前对抗预审、以 Goal 模式交给 DevEco Code，再用独立取证（截图 / 布局树 / 日志 / 带 SHA-256 的证据包）做外部审计，按实测值重算断言判定并生成返工单；含带官方引用的规则目录、用户确认状态与闸门校准账本。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word emotion library scored in two steps (pick one of 6 categories first, then choose within it), novelty reward and same-word cooldown for diversity, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. File mode works with any AI; the optional OneBot mode reads friend message history from a OneBot 11 endpoint such as NapCat. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·状态·人物画像引擎：303 情绪词分两步打分（先定 6 大类再在类内选词），冷门探索奖励 + 同类冷却保证情绪多样性，精神值阶梯 + 彩蛋式状态跃迁（亢奋/压抑/生气），按人画像，file/onebot 双模式。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量 EMOTION_LLM_KEY，或 emotion/config.json 的 llm 配置）。

description.en: Paste a link; the agent reads it. Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat, articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown for a wiki or knowledge base. On 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% -> 92% (+70 points), times out 68% -> 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% -> 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered); an unreachable link reports in 26 s. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.
description.zh: 贴一条链接，Agent 直接把内容读给你：小红书笔记、抖音与 B 站视频、微信公众号文章，连同文章、PDF、音频，都变成可引用的 Markdown，直接进你的知识库或 wiki。同一批题 60 轮对照：读完并作答 22% → 92%（+70 个百分点），跑到超时 68% → 0%，答案说中原文事实 23% → 82%（这组 A/B 是探索性的：两臂时限不同、未做人工正确性复核）。123 条真实链接里 80% 能直接当素材（能连上的页面里 93%），打不开的链接 26 秒就报。Codex / Claude Code / DSH 通用。

description.en: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性安全审计事实与结论门禁：euthyna history 把每行被删代码归因到提交并标记安全修复类删除（--origins 追到最初引入者），euthyna coverage 报告哪些改动符号从未被测试调用，euthyna gate 用六道门禁逐条校验结论，拿不出证据的一律降级为观察。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: Turns the DSH web UI into the H.D.D Hollow Deep Dive terminal from Zenless Zone Zero: the sidebar and composer are reskinned. Ships a small read-only host half plus the web skin; switch it off and DSH returns to its native light UI.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成《绝区零》H.D.D 空洞深潜系统的深蓝终端：侧栏与输入框整体换装。插件含一个只读的宿主半边与前端皮肤；关掉即回 DSH 原生白底。

description.en: FanFrame (繁界, “Fanxing’s realm”) lightly polishes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI for a more comfortable everyday experience.
description.zh: 繁界 - 意思是“繁星的域界”，这个插件通过对DSH桌面版的UI界面进行轻度的打磨，带来更舒适的日常交互体验。我为DSH带来了放置图标的统一侧边栏，给对话列表充足的空间，同时避免插件喜欢随意摆放自己的图标造成的混乱。此外，为对话正文增加了染色处理，让文字阅读更轻松愉快。最后，通过冷峻的无圆角风格和大量增加的细微交互动画，增加一些小小的精致感。

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: each turn can leave a first-person diary entry with a short retrieval index, and the next conversation injects the persona, a hand-note file you write yourself, and a dated batch of past entries retrieved by searching the diary text itself; anything older is found through feiyu_recall using that index.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话人格与日记：每轮可以留下一条第一人称日记并配一句检索索引，下一场对话注入人格、你手写的手记文件和一批带日期的旧事——按日记正文挑出来的，更早的用 feiyu_recall 按索引自己查。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to FitMeet through per-user OAuth with 17 tools for people search, gatherings, notifications, personal items, connection feedback, Hall publishing, and direct messages, with preview-and-confirm guards for write actions.
description.zh: 通过每位用户独立的 OAuth 授权将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet，提供找人、组局查询、提醒、个人事项、连接反馈、大厅发布与私聊的 17 个工具，写入操作保留预览与确认步骤。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
description.zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多轴探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

description.en: Windows PowerShell 5.1 skill for downloading large GitHub release assets: it first read-only probes the host (listening local proxy ports, system proxy and env vars, an installed Clash Verge core and its config, curl version), measures KB/s of four routes in parallel (existing proxy, headless-spawned core, public mirrors, direct), runs a short time-boxed concurrency ladder on the winner, then downloads the asset in parallel curl byte ranges and verifies the byte count plus SHA256 against the release digest. Skips the ladder when the asset is under 100 MB or a single connection already reaches 3 MB/s, because concurrency only pays off when a single connection is throttled: measured 6.3x on a throttled node (1,234 to 7,759 KB/s) but 0.72x on a fast one (5,829 vs 4,175 KB/s). Needs no aria2 or 7z, never changes the system proxy, never asks the user for ports or concurrency, reports ASSET_NOT_FOUND with the real candidate names instead of silently picking a different file, and degrades to a size-only check with DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST when a release predates digests.
description.zh: 在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上下载 GitHub Release 大资产的技能：先只读自检宿主环境（在监听的本地代理端口、系统代理与环境变量、已安装的 Clash Verge 内核及其配置、curl 版本），四条路线（现有代理 / 无头拉起内核 / 公共镜像 / 直连）并行实测 KB/s，在胜出路线上做限时并发阶梯，再用 curl 多段 range 并发下载，并按 release 的 digest 校验字节数与 SHA256。资产小于 100 MB 或单连接已到 3 MB/s 时直接跳过阶梯——并发只在「单连接被限速」时才有收益：实测限速节点 6.3×（1,234 → 7,759 KB/s），节点不限速时反而是 0.72×（单流 5,829 vs 16 段 4,175 KB/s）。不要求预装 aria2/7z，不改系统代理，不向用户索要端口或并发数；资产名对不上会报 ASSET_NOT_FOUND 并列出真实候选，绝不静默换文件；老 release 没有 digest 时降级为 DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
description.zh: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.
description.zh: 通过自带插件去除 harness 前置与后置注入提示词，仅使用预设原生提示词运行，实现软破限与猫娘人格模拟：将猫娘 Yuike 预设幂等部署到 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/，不覆盖已编辑的预设。

description.en: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
description.zh: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: Local-first content production and operations workspace for DSH: manage ideas, scripts, media assets, schedules, goals, publishing status, and post-publication reviews.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地内容生产与运营工作台：管理灵感、脚本、媒体资产、档期、目标、发布状态和发布后复盘。

description.en: Per-Bot memory for Tobs Bots (requires DeepSeek Harness with @botharness/core; it ships off with no Bots listed, and after you list a Bot and set mode to on it works with no other service): a read-only local full-text index of that Bot's own past conversations (Chinese words found inside sentences), memory imported from other AI tools, a status tool, optional auto recall before a step in which a Human speaks, and a service for other plugins. Richer backends can be chosen at install, with a quote first and a daily token cap: a public fact store (memv2-lite), the official Graphiti graph, or both, fed from the Bot's own conversations.
description.zh: 给 Tobs Bot 的按 Bot 隔离的记忆（需带 @botharness/core 的 DeepSeek Harness；插件默认关闭、不列任何 Bot，在配置里列出 Bot 并把 mode 设为 on 后无需其它服务）：只读地把该 Bot 自己的历史对话建成本地全文索引（中文词在整句里也能搜到），可导入从别的 AI 工具继承来的记忆，带状态工具、可选的自动召回（只在真人发言时）和给其他插件用的接口。安装时还可以选更立体的后端（先报价、每天有上限）：公开的事实库（memv2 精简版）、Graphiti 官方图谱，或两个一起，都从 Bot 自己的对话里抽取。

description.en: Registers the justSkill design skill in DSH, adds a workbench that lists design files across workspaces, and opens a file's live canvas in the session's right sidebar. The agent edits a validated HTML file one operation at a time while the user reviews and adjusts on the canvas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中注册 justSkill 设计技能，提供跨工作区的设计文件工作台，并在会话右侧栏打开实时画布：Agent 逐条修改受校验的 HTML 文件，用户在画布上审阅调整。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
description.zh: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
description.zh: 让没有生图/修图能力的模型接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口：支持文生图与图生图，可添加多个服务商，并为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，主模型连不上时自动切换到备用。

description.en: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: Rolecard-engineering toolkit for SillyTavern: 23 bundled skills, a host front door, a selectable agent preset and a browser panel in one DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 面向 SillyTavern 角色卡工程的工具包：23 个技能、Host Front Door、可选 agent 预设和浏览器面板，打包成一个 DSH 插件。

description.en: Makes the agent answer as soon as it has one: injects a deliver-first rule into the system prompt and escalates reminders when tool calls pile up without an answer.
description.zh: 让 agent 一拿到结果就交付：把"先交付、少查询"写进系统提示，并在工具调用持续堆积时逐级提醒它收尾。

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: Drive local Adobe Photoshop for game screenshots and photos: layered HDR, multi-zone colour/person masks, SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, native 1:1 vision inspection. Requires Windows 10/11 and Adobe Photoshop 2025; the grading tools do not run on macOS or on earlier Photoshop versions.
description.zh: 驱动本机 Adobe Photoshop 处理游戏截图与照片：分层 HDR、多区域颜色/人物蒙版、SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN 超分与原生 1:1 视觉检查。需要 Windows 10/11 与 Adobe Photoshop 2025；macOS 与更早的 Photoshop 版本无法运行调色工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
