description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
description.zh: Minecraft 26.3 mod 开发工具：按 JSON 实例登记启动真实的专用服与客户端，通过带鉴权的 HTTP 探针驱动两端，并对世界、UI 与日志状态做断言，覆盖 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge；每轮运行留下取证目录，且不随包分发任何游戏或加载器文件。需 JDK 25 与 Minecraft 26.3 实例。

description.en: Adds a Share to chat action under each reply: converts the answer to WeChat or WeCom text, ordered segments or a long image, editable-table email HTML, or a downloadable Word document.
description.zh: 在每条回复下加「分享到聊天」：把回答转成微信/企微可直接粘贴的文本、分段或长图、可编辑表格的邮件 HTML，或直接下载 Word 文档。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天记录中自动将本地音视频路径渲染为可播放预览：将路径替换为同源 /api/media-preview/* 路由支持的 <audio>/<video> 播放器，并返回明确的错误状态码。

description.en: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.
description.zh: 别的记忆插件让 AI 记住更多，我们让 AI 只记住对的：Agent 只能提案，人工审核才进主库（三库分离 + 不可变审计日志）；召回走 SQLite FTS5/BM25、零模型调用（实测 p50 2.3ms），记忆账本摊开召回成本与有用率。一个库接 DSH / Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw / Hermes / MengBot（任意 MCP 客户端）；v0.31 起内置五套一键切换皮肤（默认暗色 / 波普 / 明亮 / 生化危机 / 蜘蛛侠）与全幅主题头图。

description.en: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones fall asleep instead of bloating your context. Long-term writes stop in an approval center, so the agent cannot rewrite your persona on its own.
description.zh: 会遗忘的记忆插件：短期记忆 48 小时自动过期，长期记忆按艾宾浩斯/SM-2 曲线复习，久不用的沉进沉睡区（可唤醒）而不是无限撑爆上下文。长期写入停在审核中心，模型不能自行改写人格设定。

description.en: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.
description.zh: 点开输入框旁的上下文圆环即见本轮账单：缓存命中/未命中/输出各花多少钱（¥），官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定；非 DeepSeek 官方路由不显示。

description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 七层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic），首条消息缓存友好注入 + 每条消息关键词命中，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具，空闲窗口自动整理记忆（dream，峰时抑制）。prompt 文案按语言数据文件加载——框架支持多语言用户。

description.en: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
description.zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

description.en: Minecraft development for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), covering Minecraft 1.7.10 through 26.3: 9 skills for Paper/Spigot plugins, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, addon development against major mods, and Gradle/JDK setup per era; the mc_scaffold generator and mc_gradle runner; 18 offline API signature indexes generated from the pinned artefacts with provenance headers; and mc_arbitrate, a deterministic sharded pipeline (contract freeze, per-shard briefs, 21 high-confidence audit rules including 5 cross-shard checks, manifest merge, compile-error routing) that calls no model inside the engine. Apache-2.0 with NOTICE.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 Minecraft 开发插件，覆盖 Minecraft 1.7.10 至 26.3：9 个技能（Paper/Spigot 插件、Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 模组、大型模组附属、分时代 Gradle/JDK 构建）、mc_scaffold 项目生成器与 mc_gradle 构建执行器、18 份由钉选工件生成且带 provenance 头的离线 API 签名索引，以及确定性分片流水线 mc_arbitrate（契约冻结、分片任务书、21 条高置信审计规则含 5 条跨分片检查、清单合并、编译错误定点路由），引擎内部不调用模型。Apache-2.0 + NOTICE。

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header, with launch logs in a sidebar tab. One-shot tasks such as data generation and GameTest report a pass or fail verdict when they finish.
description.zh: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

description.en: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
description.zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: Floating photo companion for the DSH Web UI with a 15/25/45/60-minute focus timer, water and stretch reminders, Open-Meteo weather, and a session radar listing running, ended, input-waiting and permission-requesting conversations for one-click navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的悬浮照片陪伴插件：15/25/45/60 分钟专注计时、喝水与站立提醒、Open-Meteo 天气，以及可一键跳转的会话雷达（运行中、刚结束、等待输入、请求权限）。

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
description.zh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two can be installed side by side).
description.zh: 本地表情包库：从文件、文件夹或工具导入，在待识别队列里由你确认后才打标签，分组管理，再让 agent 按情绪检索发图。功能设计参考 Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers，代码自写、工具名不同，可与上游并存。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Memory the assistant writes and maintains itself — diary, index, self-description, the live emotion value — put back in front of it at the start of every session. It reads only the sections you name, never summarises, fills in missing starter files, and stamps a start date into an undated anchor in place — apart from that one additive edit it never changes an existing file. The writing side ships as skills.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己写、自己维护的一份记忆——日记、索引、自我描述、此刻的情绪；插件每个会话把她写的那几段摆回她眼前。只读你点名的几段，不自动总结、不替她写正文，只补缺的起始文件、给没有日期的锚点补上起算日；除此之外不改动已有文件。怎么写做成 skill 随包发。

description.en: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.
description.zh: 合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
description.zh: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

description.en: Realtime ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness, rebuilt from d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7 under MIT. Wave height follows the live session load, the sky comes from a local NOAA ephemeris, the star field is a real 2851-star HYG subset with 88 constellations, one boat per running subagent, plus a searchable 11-group settings panel and three quality tiers. Published to npm as "open-sea-skin-dsh"; it keeps the upstream bundle id, so uninstall d-dev0101/open-sea-skin first — the two cannot be installed side by side.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的实时海洋皮肤，基于 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7（MIT）重新构建。浪高跟随会话负载，天色来自本地 NOAA 星历，星空是 2851 颗真实恒星的 HYG 子集与 88 个星座，每个运行中的子智能体一艘船，另有可搜索的 11 组设置面板与三档画质。已以 open-sea-skin-dsh 发布到 npm；bundle id 仍与上游相同，安装前须先卸载 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠，桌面端和网页端都能用：SVG 动画和表情随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错／等待确认），还能跟随其他在跑的会话并用角标显示个数；可戳可拖、能甩晕、按在屏幕边上会压扁，鼠标在头顶来回蹭就是摸头；7 套色板、4 档大小、合成音效，跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Turn your phone into a full-featured camera for dsh sessions (requires the open-source Android companion app — install the plugin and scan the QR code it shows to download the APK): 1. Live viewfinder over LAN or USB, injectable into the chat or savable to a folder. 2. Callable tools let the dsh model take photos, zoom, and switch lenses on demand mid-conversation, so in fully automated workflows the model can actively "see" the physical world. 3. Full zoom/flash, crop, and annotation. 4. Rich settings.
description.zh: 手机变 dsh 会话的全功能摄像头（需配合开源的 Android 手机 App——安装插件后扫插件提供的二维码即可下载 APK）：1. 局域网或 USB 直连实时取景，画面可直接注入对话框或保存到指定位置；2. 提供可调用工具，dsh 模型可在流式对话中按需主动拍照/变焦/切换镜头，便于全自动开发中模型主动"看见"物理世界；3. 提供完整的变焦/闪光灯、照片裁剪、标注等功能；4. 提供丰富的设置选项。

description.en: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
description.zh: Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎：装一次之后，npm 上的 Pi 扩展原包经 `dsh plugin add <pi-package>` 直接作为 DSH 原生插件挂载。已在官方 DSH 上端到端验证 pi-mcp-adapter（完整 MCP 管理面：OAuth、resources、prompts、MCP Apps、elicitation、sampling）、@tintinweb/pi-subagents、pi-code、pi-hermes-memory、pi-background-tasks；`pi2dsh inspect` 在安装前报告一个包的兼容情况。

description.en: Image "reading" for text-only models: downscale + reduce color depth + structure/color fingerprints into text grids fed back to the conversation, letting the model zoom, sample and OCR autonomously like a multimodal model; fully local with zero external model dependency, ships an image-reading methodology skill and optional PaddleOCR.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的"读图"能力：图片降分辨率+降色深+结构/色彩指纹渲染成文本网格喂回对话，模型像多模态一样自主缩放、取样、OCR 读图；纯本地零外部模型依赖，附读图方法论 skill 与可选 PaddleOCR。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供兼容 SillyTavern 的角色扮演，支持角色卡、预设、世界书及保留后续对话的 swipe 分支，并可切回原生会话视图。

description.en: Pocket Harness: the phone side of DSH. Continue the same DSH session from your phone, with the same history, projects, goal, queue and pending questions, connected over your LAN, your own domain or a relay you run (no author-run server, no account). Needs the Android companion app (APK from the repo's releases) paired by QR code; an optional pixel-whale desktop pet can talk and listen, and neural voice and local speech recognition are optional extras. Formerly dsh-pet-voice.
description.zh: Pocket Harness：DSH 的手机端。在手机上接着用电脑里的同一份 DSH——同一条会话、历史、项目、目标、队列和待确认提问，可经局域网、自建域名或自建中转连接（不经作者服务器、无需账号）。需要配套的 Android App（仓库 Releases 里的 APK），扫码配对；可选的像素鲸鱼娘桌宠会听会说，神经语音与本机识别也是可选件。原名 dsh-pet-voice。

description.en: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

description.en: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 project-cross-migration 技能：对话/记忆/人格/工具/环境五层迁移，含入口校验、JSONL 完整性检查与可读还原。三平台 1418 条消息真实迁移实测；纯 Python 标准库，MIT。

description.en: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 用的「md 即数据库」项目知识库：10 个 kb_* 工具（含登记已有笔记的 kb_register）、稳定 TID、`[[node]]` 只出链接不复制正文、`[[tscl]]` 定义就地展开、有界读取、覆盖 tscl 的结构 lint、工作区优先的库发现、内嵌 git 快照、节点图面板，另带系统提示词段落与随包技能，让 Agent 优先用 kb_* 而不是手写 docs/。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的网页搜索提供方：默认开启 Exa Dynamic Highlights（并带上该设置必需的 Exa-Beta 请求头），开放全部 8 种 Exa 检索类型，提供 /exa 命令在运行时改高亮、检索类型与返回条数，并注册一个可自行指定条数的 exa_search 工具。

description.en: Sets up QuickTUI from a dsh plugin page: installs QuickTUI server on macOS and Linux, pairs the phone app by QR code, and connects dsh sessions so the app can follow them, answer approvals and questions, send prompts, and interrupt turns.
description.zh: 在 dsh 插件页配置 QuickTUI：在 macOS 与 Linux 上安装 QuickTUI server，扫码配对手机 App，并接入 dsh 会话，让 App 能查看会话、回应审批与提问、发送提示词、中断回合。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.
description.zh: 会话头部按钮：预览并下载 DeepSeek Harness 真正发给模型的请求帧——完整 system prompt、声明的工具数组 tools 与 wire 消息数组（system/user/assistant/tool-result），按 agent loop 读取所用的同一会话折叠重建。

description.en: Mounts the hosted ROFilter MCP service (rofilter.cn) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: reverse-osmosis element library lookup, feed-water and scaling analysis, and full multi-stage system design. Ships a shared trial token (1,000 calls per day for all users) and run_design is metered, so use your own rofilter.cn token for real work.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 ROFilter MCP 服务（rofilter.cn）：膜元件库查询、进水水质与结垢分析、完整多段系统设计。包内带全站共享的试用令牌（1000 次/天），run_design 计费，正式使用请换成自己的 rofilter.cn 令牌。

description.en: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.
description.zh: 把选定的 DSH、本地 MCP 或原生 WebMCP 调用捕获为经过评审的参数化例程，暴露为带类型的工具，重放时重新请求批准。

description.en: 15 skills and three mutually exclusive optional MCP rows (ru-marketplace-compare, ru-marketplace-decision, ru-marketplace-full) for twelve marketplaces: price comparison across Wildberries, Detsky Mir and Yandex Market, plus per-source search, product cards and reviews, including Ozon, Avito, AliExpress, Taobao, Megamarket, Lamoda, DNS, Citilink and Cian. The 15 skills load on install; the MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR points at a local clone, which needs Python 3.12+ and uv.
description.zh: 面向十二家电商与分类信息平台的 15 个技能与三行互斥可选 MCP（ru-marketplace-compare、ru-marketplace-decision、ru-marketplace-full）：跨 Wildberries、Detsky Mir、Yandex Market 比价，以及各平台（含 Ozon、Avito、AliExpress、Taobao、Megamarket、Lamoda、DNS、Citilink 与 Cian 房产）的搜索、商品卡与评论。安装后 15 个技能立即可用；三行 MCP 默认关闭，需将 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 指向本地克隆，该克隆需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

description.en: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工作区，支持导入本地 VS Code JSON／JSONC 主题、继承终端背景效果、鼠标文本选择、结构化工具与 Diff 视图、Session／Profile／插件管理，以及 Skill／MCP 浏览。

description.en: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).
description.zh: 把互相交接的對話自動聚成一條鏈：從交接提示詞自動判定、場次編號、就地改名、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、把鏈置頂、把鏈封存進面板裡的封存庫（側欄不再顯示，有新場次也留在封存庫）、本場上下文與請求數讀數，以及可調的交接門檻（達到可自動交接：寫提示詞→開新對話→貼上→切換）。

description.en: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto Log trail, task=<id> routing, continuation re-injection, a compaction guard with clear-required alerts, and read-only subagent handling — all writing the same .agents/state/ as the Codex, Claude, and pi editions for one-repo multi-agent handoff.
description.zh: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份 .agents/state/,一个仓库多代理共享交接。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval install flow.
description.zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

description.en: Slumber Pavilion physically moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into ~/DSH-Archive, and ships archive, read, restore and delete tools for them.
description.zh: 沉眠阁把 DSH 里已归档会话的日志与投影记录真正搬出加载路径，并提供归档、读取、还原、删除会话的工具。

description.en: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
description.zh: 让模型自己挑安全时机触发压缩：提供 compact_now 工具（回合进行中也能用），另有 context_status 工具，按会话真实的上下文窗口报告 token 占用。

description.en: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Also re-titles stored sessions in bulk, with a progress overlay that keeps running after Settings is closed.
description.zh: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

description.en: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.
description.zh: 保留原话引用、修改历史并支持受管来源撤回的全局与项目文字记忆。公开测试版。

description.en: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ICVO 编码规范套件（原 dsh-coding-kit）：bundle 插件加载时仅注册工具，须调用 apply_coding_standards 才注入规范；另附 P0 门禁 CLI（npx spec-wave），含 G1–G7 过程命令、skills install、host apply 与 IDE 块刷新。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: Superpowers for DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers, installed as a Cordis plugin registering 14 skills with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版 Superpowers 技能包：移植自 obra/superpowers 的 TDD、调试、规划与协作技能，以 Cordis 插件安装并注册 14 个技能（零运行时依赖）。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description.zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

description.en: Agent-team task workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar board and requirement view track tasks across backlog, execution, review and done, dispatch work to coding agents, and run multi-role team orchestration on a local SQLite store.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体团队任务工作台：侧栏看板与需求视图跟踪任务从待办、执行、评审到完成，把工作派发给编码智能体，并用本地 SQLite 承载多角色团队编排。

description.en: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

description.en: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
description.zh: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

description.en: Fetches Tsinghua MadModel API tokens and renews them from the saved SSO session on a 20-minute timer in a windowless browser, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; one manual Get captures that session through the campus login window.
description.zh: 获取清华 MadModel 的 API token，按每 20 分钟在无窗口浏览器里用已保存的 SSO 会话续期，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点一次 Get 就通过校内登录窗口捕获该会话。

description.en: Tracks token usage and estimated costs for every model call, with daily charts, session and workspace names, provider balances, budgets, and secret-free CSV/JSON exports.
description.zh: 统计本机每次模型调用的 token 用量与预估费用，提供每日图表、会话/工作区名称、账户余额、预算与无凭据 CSV/JSON 导出。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself. Every change is a new version; local only. A local-only fork of tdoc (https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc), rewritten as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Use plugins from ecosystems such as Claude Code and Codex in DSH: add Git plugin sources and marketplaces, upload plugins and skills, add MCP servers, automatically discover and toggle local skills, and manage plugins, skills and MCP in one place, including plugin-provided subagents, Hooks and LSP.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content on your device. Supports both DSH desktop and dsh web. Optional session sounds tell you when the agent is working, finished, or waiting for your answer — with swappable built-in tones and support for your own audio.
description.zh: 让 DSH 开口说话：每轮回答先改写成自然口语再朗读，代码、表格与 Markdown 自动处理；系统 TTS 开箱即用，豆包（第三方 API）提供方言与情感演绎，本地 Kokoro 引擎离线运行、内容不出本机；支持 DSH 桌面版与 dsh web。另附工作／完成／提问三种会话状态提示音——会话在跑、跑完了、等你回答各有提示，音色可换、也能上传自己的音频。

description.en: Transforms the local Wallpaper Engine library into a live background for DSH, with video and web wallpapers playing for real. An adaptive veil adjusts with picture brightness to keep text readable, while floating surfaces render as liquid glass. Includes a bilingual settings panel featuring framing adjustments, playlist rotation, library search, and real-time resource monitoring. Scene and application wallpapers are not supported.
description.zh: 将本地 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库化为 DSH 界面的动态背景,视频与网页壁纸真实播放。自适应遮罩根据画面亮度智能调节,保持文字清晰可读;壁纸生效时,悬浮组件呈现液态玻璃。内置中英双语设置面板,提供画面取景、轮播管理、搜索与实时资源监控。不支持场景与应用类壁纸。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
description.zh: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI 只能追加 status:"proposed" 候选，人执行一行 confirm 才转正，日志物理只追加、按行序重放。已确认条目以「数据而非指令」的引号块注入；带 kind 的条目改为在确认那一刻按路由追加进指定文件、永不进提示词。三段提示词每次装配都从磁盘重新求值，改配置下一步生效、不用重启。人设预设是可分享的 JSON 快照（导入导出酒馆角色卡：v2/v3 可读、v2 可写），且刻意不携带记忆。零运行时依赖、不联网、不执行命令；任何异常降级为空段，最坏是「没有人设」而不是会话起不来。出厂空白——不写配置就什么都不改变。

description.en: Registers a read-only tool that lets a parent agent read what each subagent is actually doing, not just whether it is running: the progress notes the child wrote itself, oldest first, paged backwards by seq, plus how many steps passed since the last look, and a quiet count when five or more steps go by with no new note.
description.zh: 注册一个只读工具，让父代理读到每个子代理实际在做什么，而不只是它有没有在跑：子代理自己写下的进度旁白，时间早的在前，按序号向前翻页，给出距上次查看已过去多少步，并在连续五步以上没有新旁白时给出沉默计数。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Windows 电脑操控与 computer use 插件，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、窗口绑定截图、后台优先的验证输入、隔离 Chromium 自动化、MCP、CLI 和可安装 Skill。

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。
